entityDescription:
Quest Energy SA was established in April 2006, with the purpose to contribute in the alteration of the energy sector in Greece, as initiated by Greek and EU policy and legislation for the protection of the natural environment and sustainable development.
Since its establishment, Quest Energy SA is active in the production of electric energy from renewable sources through its participation to subsidiaries and affiliate companies specialized in the development, construction and operation of wind farms and photovoltaic plants.
Currently, Quest Energy SA is operating 29 photovoltaic stations with total capacity of 34,7MW.
At the same time, and taking into account the National Plan for Energy and Climate (ESEK), which was recently submitted by the Greek Government, and which highlights the priorities and development opportunities that our country has in terms of energy and tackling climate change, QE evaluates new technologies and markets in the field of electricity, which are gradually developing and are expected to play an important role in the next decade, both in the use of electricity and in its management.
Therefore, in addition to evaluating investments in power plants using Renewable sources, the company also evaluates investment opportunities in areas such as:
- production of energy carriers using renewable sources (eg Hydrogen) 
- electricity storage
- Electric mobility 
- energy saving
- the provision of balancing services
- smart grids that will promote the security, reliability, flexibility and meritocracy of the country's electrical system.

entityDescription:
The Nuclear Advanced Manufacturing Research Centre helps UK companies win work across the nuclear sector – in new build, operations, decommissioning and technology development – and in other high-value manufacturing industries. Our facilities and services are open to all.
We are led by ourindustrial members, but companies don’t have to be members to take advantage of our capabilities and expertise. Ourmanufacturing innovationcapabilities andsupply chain developmentservices are open to all UK manufacturers, from specialist SMEs to top-tier OEMs.
Our engineers and sector specialists work with companies to develop innovative techniques and optimised processes for large-scale high-precision manufacturing. You can use our state-of-the-art workshops to develop and test new processes on production-scale machines, without losing capacity in your own factory. You can commissioncommercial researchto address your specific needs, or join collaborative R&D projects with external funding.
We also provide a range ofsupply chain developmentsupport to help manufacturers enter the nuclear market and compete worldwide. Our flagshipFit For Nuclear programme is a unique diagnostic tool which lets you measure your operations against industry requirements, with continuing support to help you close any gaps.
The Nuclear AMRC is backed by industry leaders and government, and owned by the University of Sheffield. Our research factory at the Advanced Manufacturing Parkin South Yorkshire forms part of a world-leading innovation cluster alongside the University of Sheffield AMRC, AMRC Training Centre and a host of high-value manufacturing companies.
Our facilities also include the new Nuclear AMRC Midlands in Derby, and our modular manufacturing R&D centre at Birchwood Park, Warrington. Our applied manufacturing research is underpinned by the nuclear and materials technology expertise of The University of Manchester Dalton Nuclear Institute.
We are part of the High Value Manufacturing Catapult, an alliance of seven leading manufacturing research centres backed byInnovate UK. This allows us to tap into a national network of manufacturing research excellence – if a particular technology falls outside our areas of expertise, we can call on our Catapult partners for the support you need for your challenge.

entityDescription:
SERMS was founded in 2004 as aspin-off of the University of Perugia. The idea behind SERMS is to use entrepreneurial and innovative expertise acquired in the Testing & Design sector for scientific experiment, AMS-02,devoted to studying fundamental physics in space.
Over the years, thecultural exchange process,stemming from the company’s academic origin, applied the market’s elements of “competitive advantage”. This made it possible to create a continuing path of growth and development that offers innovative, high-quality services and has increased the awareness that Space can be considered a scientific system of strategic importance, situated within a larger industrial world.
The sector’s highly-technical environment demands aconstant adaptation of resourcesto the increasingly stringent requirements of applicable qualification standards, both in investments for better-performing instruments, and in training more highly-qualified personnel.
SERMS became part of the UMBRAGROUP in 2017. The process of consolidation of the professional expertise led SERMS to take part in important cooperation relationships with research institutions, as well as with national and international companies, offering its customers a vast range ofEnvironmental Testing & Mechanical Design servicesfor use in the aerospace, automotive, naval, and industrial sectors.
These growing skills in these areas has gained SERMS increasing recognition, and now it can count on important collaborations with major national and international players like: Thales Alenia Space, Airbus, OHB, Sitael, AVIO, D-ORBIT.
In the framework of the Space Economy, SERMS srl was involved in a full range of activities for companies that researching, understanding and utilising space create added value to the economy of our Country. (Optec, Argotec, Instrumentation Device, Officina Stellare).

entityDescription: Baltic Satellite Service (BSS) is a company providing space data services and applications for research, educational and commercial organisations. BSS has participated in eContentpluss programme project Plan4all “European network of best practices for interoperability of spatial planning information” to prepare and process satellite imagery data for publication as an interoperable service in Plan4all geoportal. In November, 2016 the BSS has organised Discovery Day of Satellite Imagery in Riga for all Latvian geospatial information users to introduce satellite imagery applications and bring in ideas of available solutions for different industries. Currently we are working on developing our own machine learning algorithms for information extraction from satellite imagery. BSS team’s background is in GIS desktop and web application development and we have expertise in creation and maintenance of accurate spatial databases using self-developed automated geospatial data creation and quality assurance algorithms. This is complemented by our experience in satellite imagery processing algorithms to provide current and accurate supplemental data and obtain completely new information. BSS has started to develop satellite imagery processing services based on a computer vision and machine learning algorithms. The goal of our new system is to allow completely automatic detection of land use changes and artificial object movement in large territories (up to 10 million km2 at once). To assure the performance for the system to be adequate for this task, it is being developed as a distributed and completely virtualized system using new advances in containerization technologies and general purpose computing on graphics processing unit (GPU). Due to the lack of current and actual spatial data over all territory of Latvia from other sources, space satellite data became the only reliable, available, accurate and actual source of spatial information. It is very important for projects and applications where qualitative spatial data is necessary to make intelligent decisions based on understanding of geography and people relationship to location. Furthermore, with a launch of Sentinel satellites interest in space satellite data and its applications has raised significantly in Latvia. Therefore, in a long-term BSS sees a big potential in satellite imagery applications and automated data processing algorithms. Baltic Satellite Service in close cooperation with leading companies from particular fields in Latvia is developing samples for: - vegetation monitoring for electricity, gas utility network corridors, - detecting clear cuts, windfalls, height of the vegetation, separating type of trees, monitoring and predicting forest fires, detecting fire borderlines and damaged areas, collection of common statistics on forest fires for forest management company, forest owners’ association and fire fighters, - airport area monitoring and change detection for Riga airport. The main activities of the company are: - provision and delivery of satellite imagery appropriate for certain applications and research projects, - consulting about satellite imagery products, services and availability over specific areas of interest, - development of machine learning algorithms to automatically identify objects, detect changes and provide vegetation monitoring and analysis using both optical and radar satellite imagery, - development of desktop and web GIS applications which integrate satellite imagery data, automated analysis results with organisations’ spatial database.

entityDescription: CPF is the forestry administration office for private forests (80 % of all forest) in Catalonia-NE Spain. It’s a public agency-like company built on governance principles, with forest owners holding 50% of the board seats. CPF approves & monitors the voluntary site-scale Forest Management Plans (FMP) & processes forestry funds, including all RDP grants related to forests. Almost 4.000 forest owners, accounting for 30 % of the whole Catalan private forest land, hold a FMP. One of the main CPF functions, as established by Law, is to develop & transfer new knowledge on silviculture & forestry to forest owners and other public and private stakeholders in the forestry sector. Thus, a great deal of CPF work relates to forest extension & facilitation activities, which are framed in its Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Plan. A key element of this plan is the Network of forest demonstration sites (including 4 marteloscopes) which is the platform to boost peer-to-peer learning through field- trips, training & dissemination activities. As a forestry administration, it also promotes the development of technical, economic, and social innovations related to forest planning and management within the overall framework of rural development and following the collaborative innovation theory. Main present topics of interest are climate change adaptation, the provision and valuation of Forest Ecosystem Services, and integrated landscape & rural development. To frame and widen the scope of its innovation activities, CPF has participated in several EU-funded projects (POCTEFA-funded projects MOVAFOREST, IFORWOOD, CANOPEE, ACCLIMAFOR, CONNECTFOR; LIFE-funded projects DEMORGEST, SUBER, PINASSA, MIXFORCHANGE, CLIMARK, BIORGEST, BIOREFFORMED; and Hz2020 project SINCERE). It also collaborates as a forest management expert in several other and it is a member of the FOREXT Network, the association of European forest extension institutions.

entityDescription:
MaiaSpace is a space transport company focusing on the small spacecrafts market. 
Maiaspace designs, manufactures, operates, commercializes competitive and sustainable Space launch & mobility solutions through its partially reusable mini-launcher, capable of up to 3 tons of performance (SSO 500km).
The launcher is designed around a set of scalable and modular architecture meant as a stepping stone towards a "European Rocket Family" (building blocks approach, from microsat to large science spacecrafts) that shall improve launch cost by 50% and environmental impact by 40% when compared to European 2022 launch fleet. 
MaiaSpace is currently in development phase with critical key milestones passed and more to come, planning to debut commercial operations by 2026. 
The company is 100% private, owned and funded by industrial shareholders.

RGS Development is a technology company, promoting advanced silicon materials and devices for static power generation. Located in Broek op Langedijk (The Netherlands), a team of highly skilled employees are developing thermal electric materials and remote power solutions, supporting the global drive in the sustainable energy transition.

RGS development is founded by Energy Research Centre of the Netherlands (ECN) in 2000 initially to produce pSi wafers for Solar PV. Since 2013 the company has expended their activities around the application of Silicon in power generation and storage. Under the brand name Thermagy it operates the design and manufacturing of silicon germanium based thermoelectric materials and thermoelectric solutions. Under the brand name Solwafer it develops and manufacturers advanced silicon components for next generations of solar pv and thermophotovoltaics. Furthermore, it serves as technology provider for E-magy (www.e-magy.com), which introduces nano porous silicon for the next generation Li-ion batteries.

RGS development participates in a growing number of projects related to remote power generation in various industries such as Aerospace and Defense and Combined Heat and Power generation (CHP).RGS provides expertise and knowledge on Silicon and the manufacturing of thermoelectric devices, for projects such as Integral, Sparc-ee, Wraps, and Next Gen RTG programs.

entityName: CNR - ISTITUTO DI RICERCA SULLE ACQUE (TARANTO)
entityDescription: The Taranto Headquarter was established in 1914 as the "State Laboratory of Marine Biology" of the Ministry of Finance. In 1941 it passed to the dependencies of the CNR as the Thalassographic Institute of Taranto. In 2001 it became a Section of the Institute for Coastal Marine Environment and in 2018 a Secondary Headquarter of IRSA.The research activity of the Taranto branch is developed in the disciplinary areas of algology, biology, ecology, microbiology, oceanography, biochemistry, biodiversity, ecotoxicology and environmental chemistry, with application implications in the fields of aquaculture, environmental protection and recovery, and biotechnology. In particular, research is based on an integrated study approach for sustainable management of the coastal zone and focuses on the interactions between chemical-physical and biological processes in and between different compartments of the marine ecosystem, in order to quantify vulnerability, resistance to anthropogenic pressures and intrinsic resilience, and then identify eco-sustainable strategies for resource management and conservation. The Taranto office's many years of experience is widely established through participation in international and national projects.

entityDescription:
Robco was founded in 2020 and builds on the research results of more than 7 years at the Chair of Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Real-Time Systems at TU Munich. The company manufactures and sells end-to-end robot automation solutions for industrial SMBs with a unique, patented technology: a modular robot kit and software platform allowing for rapid deployment, flexible usage, cloud-connectivity and happy customers. Robco offers compelling economics for customers, with a return on investment for customers of within just 30 days through a Robot-as-a-Service rental model and attractive gross margins for Robco, enabled by a lean manufacturing setup. 
The project started with a robot manipulator concept and eventually turned into an end-to-end automation solution, conceptualised around the modular solution, which is globally the first of its kind. It exploits its advantages in terms of flexibility, scalability, repairability as well as ease of use. The advantages of an end-to-end offering become evident in comparison with the status quo, where customers experience long communication times, lacking adaptability and irregular updates as integrators are in the way between customer and manufacturer. 
Robcos vision is to make industrial robots as versatile as a tool. Companies are offered the possibility to automate their production intuitively, simply, flexibly and tailor-made with our robot kits and thus be accompanied by Robco in the transformation to Industry 4.0.
Robcos user interface is self-programming, based on CAD models or lidar scans. True IoT connectivity of the solution allows for cloud-based analytics and interfaces to enable productivity tracking. The resulting possibility for over-the-air-services diminishes capital-intensive field teams as required in robotics’ status quo. Downtime is reduced thanks to predictive maintenance features. 
Within the first year of commercialization, Robco has sold approx. 60 Robots across three continents and raised a Series A financing round, led by Sequoia Capital.

Inside Climate Service s.r.l. (ICS) is a limited liability company, an innovative start-up and spin-off of the University of Padova, incorporated in June 2021. ICS’s mission is to provide climate services for industry, agriculture and the tertiary sector. ICS develops cutting edge climate services for the public and commercial users. The primary goal is to raise awareness about the use of climate data for all sectors of society (education, energy, agriculture, tourism, etc.) through climate services that provide robust data and information and offer outstanding user interface and experience.
Tapping on some of the best climate scientists, software developers, designers, sector specialists and communicators, ICS aims to position itself as one of the global leading providers of visually-based climate services. ICS is developing around the industry pillars (particularly energy, water, agriculture, forestry), with strong focus on delivery robust and trustworthy data-based services to industry experts. 
Inside Climate Service is a spin-off of the University of Padova (https://www.unipd.it) and World Energy & Meteorology Council (WEMC, https://www.wemcouncil.org). The innovative nature of Inside Climate Service stems from a blend of Academia and operational developments.
It builds on the multi-decade experience and know-how developed in the Department of Land, Environment, Agriculture and Forestry of the University of Padova (https://www.tesaf.unipd.it) and at WEMC, also through the support of, and participation in, several world-leading EU projects such as the H2020, The Added Value of Seasonal Climate Forecasting for Integrated Risk Assessment (SECLI-FIRM, https://www.secli-firm.eu) and the award-winning Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) Climate and Energy Education Demonstrator (https://edudemo.climate.copernicus.eu) and its successor the TEAL tool (https://tealtool.earth).
More specifically, the expertise accrued by WEMC as coordinator of the C3S Energy operational service (https://climate.copernicus.eu/operational-service-energy-sector) carries through to ICS via its CEO, who is also the director of WEMC, as well as the close collaboration between ICS and WEMC staff. ICS is currently leading the development of the Enhanced Operational Service for the Energy Sector for C3S (https://climate.copernicus.eu/c3s2412-enhanced-operational-services-energy-sector).
Website address: https://www.inclimateservice.com/

entityDescription:
Our team is made up of mechanical engineers, professionals who are driven by engineering curiosity and motivated by the desire to use their experience to successfully solve technical problems and bring them to application.
Strength analysis:
We specialize in the strength analysis of machines and machine structures for static and cyclic loads as well as dynamic conditions. Our calculations are based on proven numerical simulations, which are verified by experimental investigation of material properties and structural level behaviour as required. A part of our job is to verify the compliance with standards of the analysed structures and to document the results in a credible way to our partner and the inspection authority.
Mechanical engineering development:
The safe operation of industrial equipment and machinery in general is determined by the interaction of its mechanical, thermal, fluid and electromagnetic subsystems and behaviour. Analysing such complex mechanisms of action analytically is not a viable practice. Therefore, numerical simulations are used to effectively predict the behaviour of the machine structure under operation conditions. In contrast to the experimental development method, simulations allow us to predict the behaviour of the structure under operating conditions from the beginning of the design phase. This means that the necessary development steps can be taken at an early stage, reducing development time and costs, which gives our partners a competitive advantage in the market.
Reliable background:
By correctly choosing and professionally carrying out and evaluating the proper numerical simulations for a given engineering development, we ensure that the project goals are achieved in the most efficient way. Our experts work in a supportive team environment, combining their experience and avoiding the usual development dead-ends. We use the most prevalent software tools (ANSYS, Altair HyperWorks, Code Aster, OpenFoam) for the given engineering problem, combined with automated modelling and evaluation techniques to ensure reliable results, particularly in short timeframes. We are active members of NAFEMS, the international non-profit organisation for simulation engineers, and our experts regularly participate in conferences as speakers,and in training courses. We also take care to ensure that the expertise of our engineers is constantly growing and they remain competitive.

The company focuses on leveraging digital solutions to enhance the effectiveness of newspapers in delivering information related to digital marketing, life sciences, and tourism. By utilizing advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and database analysis, Lenus Media aims to create better and more accurate information for their audience.
One of the primary objectives of Lenus Media is to improve the efficacy of newspapers in presenting results pertaining to various fields, including digital marketing. By employing AI algorithms and data analysis techniques, the agency assists newspapers in deciphering complex marketing trends, identifying target audiences, and developing strategies to optimize digital marketing campaigns. This enables newspapers to deliver more relevant and engaging content to their readers, thereby increasing their overall effectiveness in the digital realm.
In addition to digital marketing, Lenus Media also focuses on enhancing the dissemination of scientific research, particularly in the life sciences field. The company recognizes the importance of scientific advancements and their impact on society. Through the utilization of AI algorithms and database analysis, Lenus Media collaborates with research institutions and scientific communities to distill complex research findings into comprehensible and accessible formats. This approach enables the agency to effectively bridge the gap between scientific discoveries and public understanding, ensuring that the latest advancements in life sciences are effectively communicated to a broader audience.

description: Cubicure GmbH pioneers materials, equipment, and processes for polymer additive manufacturing. Their Hot Lithography-based Caligma® and Cerion® 3D printing systems produce resilient precision components for extreme environments on an industrial scale. This production process eases the construction of highly complex apparatus by reducing lead times and minimizing the need for assembly. Flame-retardant photopolymers such as Cubicure’s ThermoBlast material build the basis for space applications. Tests have shown that this Hot Lithography material is stable within a temperature range between 150 °C and 300 °C. It also passes the thermal vacuum outgassing test for space materials according to ECSS-Q-70-02. Components produced via Hot Lithography can be coated with metals such as copper or silver. Especially lightweight metalized parts will help reduce payload weight in spacecraft such as satellites.
entityDescription:
Cubicure GmbH was founded in March 2015 as a spin-off of the TU Wien by Prof. Dr. Jürgen Stampfl (Institute of Material Science and Technology) and Dr. Robert Gmeiner. The company deals with the additive manufacturing of high performance polymers for industrial applications. Here, stereolithography (SLA) is used where light-curable plastics are cured with a laser in a layer-by-layer approach in outstanding precision. Cubicure develops photopolymers of which the properties are like those of technical thermoplasts.

Since 2017 Cubicure offers a specially developed and patented 3D-printing facility and associated materials in the market. The aim of Cubicure GmbH is the creation of products of highest quality for an industrial production environment.

entityDescription:
Kosminis Vytis is an electronics company based in Lithuania, specializing in high-grade navigation equipment for professional applications. With a strong focus on precision and reliability, using GNSS chipsets licensed from NTLAB UAB (Lithuania), we create high-precision multi-system multi-frequency GNSS receiver modules, CRPA antennas and other satellite and GNSS/INS navigation devices.
In addition to our navigation modules, we are recognized for our expertise in anti-jamming technology. Our products excel in environments with high levels of signal interference, guaranteeing uninterrupted operation of navigation systems and related applications.
Furthermore, we offer a comprehensive range of GNSS equipment, including GNSS/INS solutions, CORS, and specialized tools for GNSS research. This diverse portfolio establishes us as a one-stop-shop for all GNSS needs, catering to both basic navigation requirements and advanced research and development applications.
Our company’s design process is fully integrated in-house, covering all aspects from schematics development and PCB design to software and mechanical engineering. We work closely with leading SMT assembly houses for device manufacturing, ensuring quality production under the supervision of our experienced engineers.

For customers who wish to localize production and market GNSS equipment under their own brand, we offer a licensing business model. Through this model, we provide all design documentation, including schematics, PCB files, and software source codes, enabling customers to set up their own production facilities. We also offer comprehensive technical support to ensure a thorough understanding of the product, manufacturing process, and maintenance procedures. Additionally, we facilitate the supply of necessary components (chipsets) for production.
At Kosminis Vytis, we continuously strive to push the boundaries of navigation technology. Our dedicated team of engineers, developers, and researchers is committed to innovation, ensuring that our products remain efficient, effective, and at the forefront of the industry’s evolving demands.

entityDescription:
Founded in 2000, ZIRAK s.r.l. is a SME focused on IT, with excellent technical and scientific competence, thanks to a team of doctoral students, researchers, and developers from prestigious Italian institutions, including the Politecnico di Torino, the Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa, the Fondazione Links, and renowned European institutions such as the NovaLincs research laboratory in Portugal and the University of Beira Interior (UBI).
Over the past 23 years, ZIRAK has specialized in the automotive, home automation, and embedded sectors, extending its expertise to more cross-cutting areas such as scientific software, web solutions, and mobile applications. Since 2018, ZIRAK has successfully transferred these technological competencies to the environmental sector, focusing on cutting-edge areas such as:
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) applied to Earth Observation to address problems related to invasive plant species, monitoring of forests, rivers, infrastructure, anomalies, and to support the prediction of anomalous conditions and related alarms.
- Computer Vision (CV) algorithms to integrate AI models and provide more intuitive metrics and indicators, customized to customer needs, and useful for continuous process improvement.
- Customized Earth Observation (EO) platforms to meet the needs of individual institutions and allow access to citizens, managing large volumes of data (Big Data).
- Management of aerial data obtained from satellites, equipped vehicles, and drones, with RGB, multispectral, hyperspectral, LIDAR images, etc., also in collaboration with partners specialized in these technologies.
ZIRAK's headquarters are located in Mondovì (CN), with an office in Turin and a research and development laboratory in Portugal.

entityDescription:
In our region, we believe in cooperation. That is why in 2021, 9 space entities founded Brno Space Cluster - a local cluster consisting of both companies and academia.
Building on multiple years of previous cooperation, the cluster expanded from 9 to 19 members just in the first year. Currently, the cluster is consisting of more than 22 members and still growing. This is making it the biggest space association in the Czech Republic.
The cluster plays a platform role as a place to share and exchange ideas and information, but also an active role in the business itself. To further support business, the cluster can bid as an entity - and just in the first year, the cluster placed two bids for international tenders.
As Business & Education are the main goals of the cluster, a new master’s study program was established at the Brno University of Technology. Focusing on system engineering, the new master’s is held in English and is open for up to 30 students from all over the world every year. The students have multiple classes on space systems as well as an opportunity to gain real experience as the cluster member companies are offering internships for them.

entityDescription: FEAC Engineering P.C. is an engineering & consulting company, highly specialized in Simulation Driven Product Development & physics-based Digital Twins. The company is based in Greece and operates in the global market by developing and providing specialized simulation software and consulting services, to solve challenging & complex engineering problems. FEAC’s worldwide awarded services range from Computer Aided Design (CAD) drafting, advanced multiphysics Finite Element Analysis (FEA), Boundary Element Analysis (BEM) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) and design optimization techniques. There is extensive experience in project management & certification of products (CE marking) as well. FEAC combines 1D-simulation (aka system simulation) with detailed 3D simulation techniques (CFD, FEM, BEM) to build up a comprehensive Digital Twin of the process or object/assembly, not only in the phase of the development, but also in the phase of realization (manufacturing process) and operation (under operational conditions). This allows FEAC to create a Holistic Digital Twin throughout the product’s lifecycle. Our expertise is to develop multi-physics, high-fidelity simulations that couple structural mechanics, heat transfer, fluid flow, electromagnetics, acoustics, etc., and represent the mechanical behavior of components under complex environmental conditions. Due to the company’s high expertise in Simulation, Siemens Digital Industries Software has appointed FEAC Engineering as the exclusive authorized partner of its CAE portfolio in the countries of Greece, Cyprus & Malta. FEAC develops PITHIA-CP, a world-leading Boundary Element Solver for Cathodic Protection Digital Twins, which is used by SIEMENS as an add-on on its Simcenter 3D software portfolio. FEAC has offered its expertise in physics-based simulations to numerous engineering companies, product manufacturers from a wide range of industries, research centers and universities yielding to an impressive portfolio of delivered projects.

La Gran Sasso Tech Foundation (GST) è un ente di ricerca senza scopo di lucro fondato nel 2022, a seguito di anni di proficua collaborazione tra Thales Alenia Space Italy e il Gran Sasso Science Institute, al fine di concretizzare il legame tra ricerca di base, applicata ricerca e sviluppo nel settore spaziale ad alta tecnologia. Gran Sasso Tech mira a rafforzare lo scambio tra la ricerca fondamentale in atto nel mondo accademico e gli sviluppi che si verificano all'interno del contesto industriale, con particolare attenzione alle aree dello spazio, delle tecnologie del silicio e dei sistemi software. 
Gran Sasso Tech è un'organizzazione di ricerca nata per moltiplicare l'impatto sia pubblico che privato e sfruttare la conoscenza per migliorare la giustizia sociale. GST è un'infrastruttura aperta per supportare l'innovazione tecnologica, l'educazione e lo sviluppo.
Nove aree tecnologiche di interesse della Fondazione Gran Sasso Tech: Integrazione e sviluppo di satelliti per missioni scientifiche spaziali, Qualificazione di componenti tecnologici per lo spazio, Tecnologie quantistiche, Applicazioni basate su Intelligenza Artificiale & Software Avanzato, Bioinformatica e Simulazioni Numeriche, Concurrent Engineering e Digital Twins , Osservazione, simulazioni e gestione della Terra, Tecnologie applicate per i Beni Culturali, Valutazione e gestione dell'impatto sociale.

entityDescription:
Railnova is a company that provides hardware and software solutions for rail vehicle maintenance and operations. They specialize in developing advanced telematics devices that collect real-time data from trains, analyze it using machine learning algorithms, and provide actionable insights to operators and maintenance teams.
One of the key spatial technologies that Railnova uses is GPS (Global Positioning System), which allows them to track the location and movement of trains in real-time. By integrating GPS data with other sensors on board, such as accelerometers and temperature sensors, Railnova can provide a comprehensive view of the train's health and performance.

Railnova's hardware solutions also incorporate patented FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) technology, which allows their devices to connect to any data protocol and field bus on board trains from any manufacturer. This technology provides Railnova with a high level of flexibility and interoperability, enabling their devices to work seamlessly with a wide range of onboard systems and equipment and capture mission critical data such as energy consumption, fault codes, and real time telemetry.
FPGAs are reconfigurable integrated circuits that can be programmed to perform specific tasks, allowing Railnova to customize their devices to the unique requirements of each train they work with. This approach also means that Railnova can quickly adapt to changes in the industry and new technologies, as they can update their devices with new software as needed.

entityDescription: Reactive Robotics has developed the world’s first AI-driven robotic assistance system for early mobilization of patients on intensive care units. The VEMOTION system consists of a mobile robotic device on a trolly as well as several electrical intensive care beds. This modularity allows medical personnel to transform the bed of the patient into a therapy device. This means that the patient does not have to be transferred to a separate device, which is dangerous for the patient and physically challenging for the nursing staff. The use of the VEMOTION system allows for therapy of patients that would otherwise not receive it, due to the severity of their condition or the lack of nursing staff in the hospital. Manual early mobilisation requires 3-5 caregivers, while robotically assisted early mobilisation only requires 1 caregiver. Early mobilisation is shown to reduce the length of stay of a patient by over 20%, while reducing secondary complications, such as loss of muscle mass or bone density.

description:
Covering 70% of our blue planet, the marine environments are essential to our survival as they play a significant role in the global carbon cycle, representing the largest long-term carbon sink. However, they are constantly exposed to a high level of climate pressure, mostly due to the polution (accumulation of waste). If degraded or lost, these ecosystems are likely to release most of their carbon back into the atmosphere. Plastics are the largest, most harmful, and most persistent fraction of the marine pollution, accounting for at least 85% of total marine litter. 165 million tonnes of plastic currently circulates in Earth's marine environments and prevent the absorption of up to 8.25 billion tonnes of CO2 each year.

The mismanagement of plastic waste is a global challenge that must be immediately addressed if we are to achieve the SDGs or meet the targets set out in the 2015 Paris Agreement. 

Recycllux provides means for a faster and more efficient collection of marine plastic by applying machine-learning algorithms on Earth Observation data to identify the marine plastic litter problem spots. Then, it uses blockchain to incentivize the collectors and encourage recycling. Our solution is enabling end-to-end recycling interventions. It will save billion tonnes of CO2, save natural systems, the marine food chains contamination and the serious consequences it has on human health.

The solution falls in line with the European Green Deal and, in particular with the objectives of the European Climate Law, the EU climate adaptation and mitigation strategies, the EU biodiversity strategy for 2030, the EU proposal for a nature restoration law, the Marine Strategy Framework Directive (MSFD), the UNFCCC Ocean and Climate Change Dialogue, the Global Biodiversity Framework, and many Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), in particular restoring our ocean and waters related actions will directly contribute to SDG 14 - Life below water and SDG 6 - Clean water and sanitation, as well as to SDG13 - Climate action.

In 2020 we were incubated by the Parsec Accelerator (Horizon 2020 grant no 824478, supporting the creation of new Earth Observation (EO) based products and services. We have received a €10,000 financing. This has enabled to develop our solution to TRL 4 (Ideation of the technology prototype & validate it in lab as well as confirming the product/market fit after interviews with stakeholders). 

In 2021, we were accelerated by the InnovationLabs Accelerator, where we won the Spin-off of the Year Award. This program has enabled us to build the MVP and reach TRL 5. 

In 2022, we have received support in services being valued at €50,000 in total, including a Sub-Grant of €20,000 from the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT) via EIT Climate-KIC Holding B.V. (“Climate-KIC”) under KAVA 7.1.4 Black Sea ClimAccelerator. Under this program, our climate impact was assesed and we have protected our IP (registered trademark and registered design). Right now, our main challenge is to validate our prototype in a first end-to end intervention.
entityDescription: Recycllux is a Romanian startup that proposes a systemic approach for preserving and restoring marine ecosystems which have an impact on emissions and removals of emissions, conservation and enhancement of these natural carbon sinks. Building on the research from Alexandra’s PHD thesis, we have developed a ML algorithm that makes use of the Sentinel-1 and 2 big open EO data in combination with ground-truth data to accurately identify marine litter aggregations. Knowing the waste accumulations allows one to calculate how many tonnes of CO2 are not absorbed as a result of that specific litter accumulation. Between 2020-2022, with financing and Support from the Parsec Accelerator and from the EIT Climate-KIC BlackSea ClimAccelerator, we have managed to build the solution MVP.

entityDescription:
Weather ship routing in cargo shipping today has only managed to save 3-10% in GHG emissions mainly because the input weather forecasts are not precise enough. Numerical forecast models producing these inputs have reached an accuracy dead-end due to the modelling complexity of the involved physical processes. AlongRoute is using ground-breaking AI models which overcome these barriers by “learning” how physics work. With our marine weather forecasts, existing ship routing solutions can perform up to 200% better than today which could save up to 3 million t of cargo ship GHG, in only one year. Our models are projected to evolve, whereas numerical forecast models have long reached their precision capacity. In contrast to existing models, our set-up is extremely efficient in terms of computational requirements and thus can easily produce forecasts in fine spatial and temporal resolutions.
The ideation of AlongRoute venture began in December 2021, when, with the help of PRAXI network, OMIKRON Environmental Consultants SA from Greece teamed up with Alisio Computing GmbH, from Germany. Together, the two EU SMEs formed the basic framework of the venture that would follow. They submitted a proposal at the DigiCirc Blue Economy Accelerator Programme in which they succeeded to participate Phase I and II. During these phases they were intensively supported to develop the Proof of Concept, the Business Plan with Market Research, Revenue Model and Financial Projections as well as the first operational MVP for the Mediterranean Sea. At the end of Phase II the consortium pitched in from of an external group of judges and were selected to proceed to Phase III (5 winners out of 15 teams). In October 2022, the start-up company was established in Thessaloniki, Greece as an IKE. The shareholder scheme is as follows: Mr. Eduardo Pena Vina 40%; Dr. Georgia Kalantzi 20%; Mr. Stergios Diamantopoulos 13,5 %; OMIKRON Environmental Consultants SA 10%; Mr. Konstantinos Karystinakis 9%, Mrs. Apostolia Papadoudi 7,5%.

entityDescription: The ”Vittorio Veneto Salvemini “ Business Institute, is the oldest school founded together with the town of Littoria (Latina) in 1932, but it officially opened in 1936. It is placed in the centre of the town, close to university and to the agricultural and industrial areas which afterwards were turned into an important touristic area, characterized by a relevant migration trend. The agricultural condition of the town which then turned into the industrial and touristic one, started at the beginning of the 20th century because of our “Pontine Marshes”. For this reason, lots of Italian people came from the North of Italy to work and live here, most of them, in fact died of “Malaria”.Today we are still having this phenomenon but with people coming from Europe especially from Romania, Poland, Ukraine, Albania, and from Africa, India and China.Because of this deep migration impact, our school is the attraction pole for arranging any cultural activities or initiatives with the aim of strengthening both a national and above all a European identity especially among the youngest generations. For this reason, lots of Italian people came from the North of Italy to work and live here, most of them, in fact died of “Malaria”.Today we are still having this phenomenon but with people coming from Europe especially from Romania, Poland, Ukraine, Albania, and from Africa, India and China.Because of this deep migration impact, our school is the attraction pole for arranging any cultural activities or initiatives with the aim of strengthening both a national and above all a European identity especially among the youngest generations. In order to fulfil this aim, we have already done European projects such as Leonardo and Comenius and Erasmus.

The competencies of a highly qualified team of experts at the Riga Technical University Science and Innovation Centre (furthermore – RTU SIC) meet with excellent technical support - the best-equipped prototyping workshop in the Baltics and supercomputing resources and prototyping lab. The centre develops innovation and entrepreneurial skills, offers innovative product development services, and is actively involved in local and international innovation ecosystems. The centre aims to ensure the implementation and growth of RTU's strategy and sustainable valorisation goals by promoting innovation creation and development, knowledge transfer, as well as developing cooperation with industry and students.   

The RTU SIC is structured into smaller units, each with its own set of tasks and expertise:   

• Design factory;  
• Innovative Product Development Unit;   
• Innovation Ecosystem Development Unit;  
• Research Equipment Unit.  
• HPC Unit.  
• Grant Office Unit.  

In the context of this project, Innovation Ecosystem Development Unit (furthermore - IEDU) and Innovative Product Development Unit (furthermore - IPDU) should be highlighted. The IEDU promotes RTU involvement in local and international innovation and technology ecosystems, including by implementing programmes of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), performing educational work and supporting startups in the implementation of sustainable business ideas. It is planned that IEDU will work on development of KIC for start-ups and provide mentoring and help new innovators to transfer their academic knowledge to commercial uses. 
The focus of activities of the IPDU is on the efficient creation of innovative high-value added products, as well as research and improvement of existing products and services in cooperation with industry and scientific institutions. It is planned that IPDU will provide participants with access to "Co.Lab", which is a platform that provides commercialistaion training for scientists. "Co.Lab" helps to develop and promote closer cooperation between the research and commercial sectors, involving business leaders from young scientists.

entityDescription:
The mission of Ecosmic is to enable the long-term safety and sustainability of space activities, by producing leading-edge software that will safeguard operational satellites against the threat of collision with space debris and other spacecraft. 
More than 30,000 artificial objects orbit around the Earth and the probability of their collision with operational spacecraft keeps increasing with time, as new launches are performed and space objects crash and explode creating more fragments. 
Managing close encounters in space and avoiding collisions is becoming a task that satellites operators cannot safely tackle from ground anymore: there is a growing need in the space industry for automated and enhanced on-board collision avoidance capabilities. 

To answer to this need, Ecosmic was founded to support safe space operations, aiming at a sustainable future.

PROESSA SPORT relies on innovation with, in particular, two CNES patents and has signed partnerships with the French Cycling Federation (FFC) and the professional cycling team ARKEA-SAMSIC. The www.otakam.fr platform offers cyclists solutions to analyze and track their performance with two universes. The Performance universe is aimed at sports cyclists, coaches and teams with functionalities based on patents from the space sector, and the granfondo universe concerns participants in granfondo events who can access their record of achievements, a new performance indicator and the first national and world granfondo rankings. The PROESSA SPORT team is currently working on adapting OTAKAM's solutions to health sports based on GNSS data.
With OTAKAM, evaluating your performance and health has never been easier.

entityDescription:
Interplanetary Expeditions Ltd. is a consulting company which addresses two elements of the space sector, the first of which is satellite technology transfer/capacity building for developing and emerging space nations and the second is the research into advanced space propulsion, with an emphasis on fluidised metal powder propulsion. 

Interest in fluidised metal powder propulsion stemmed from his experience working for a NASA subcontractor in 1995 and 1998. The latter was a "carbon dioxide/magnesium metal powder" or "Martian" propulsion system. He since completed his second Masters (MSc by Research) on the topic of a "Lunar propellant propulsion system".

The company's CEO is an Associate Fellow of the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA) and currently serves as Secretary of the AIAA Nuclear and Future Flight Propulsion (NFFP) Technical Committee as well as Technical Conference Chair (NFFP) for SciTech2024 in Orlando, Florida.

entityDescription: Werover provides crucial solutions to energy companies that help detect and address various issues that can arise in energy assets, such as corrosion, pollution, cracks, and damages. Our early detection capabilities are key to reducing downtime and repair costs, which can quickly escalate if problems are not addressed in a timely manner. By utilizing 3D mapping and scanning technology, we are able to identify damages in their early stages, preventing costly and time-consuming repairs from becoming necessary. Moreover, our solutions not only contribute to reducing downtime and repair costs but also enhance the efficiency of energy assets. Early damage detection enables asset owners to perform remedies at early stages which upholds the structural integrity of the asset for a longer period of time. Our business is active in the downstream area since we provide inspection services for underwater assets. Our ROVs use satellite communication so that the data coming from the robot is displayed on the operation unit screen without delay and completely. In addition, we receive support from the satellite to transmit the control commands we send to the robot.

entityDescription:
Macedo Architects – Architecture | Engineering | Consulting is a registered brand founded in 1997 in Ponta Delgada, Azores, after 10 years of professional activity of his founder, Paulo Macedo, first in the U.S. and later in the Azores.
Macedo Architects is a solid based firm, responding with organization and professional accuracy to the demands, requirements, nature and volume of contracted projects, and with a strategy of continuous progressive development, assuredness update and in response to the market requirements.
The signature of Macedo Architects – Architecture | Engineering | Consulting on public and private works carried out in the nine islands of the archipelago of Azores and in the Portuguese mainland, proves their extensive curriculum and special skills in a variety of projects in architecture, interior architecture, urban design and engineering specialties, as well as construction inspections, procurement procedures, contract management and consulting in special areas.
The diversity of work ranges from exclusive detached houses and multifamily housing to teleport stations, airport terminals, commercial, education (schools, kindergartens and nurseries), sport centers, geothermal power plants, battery energy storage system plants, health and medical care, services and tourism as well as urban design and landscaping.
Regarding analogue experience to Space Riser Santa Maria Landing Site Feasibility Phase, Macedo Architects has rendered services to Edisoft, since 2012, and to Leolabs in the areas of preliminary analysis and evaluation of field opportunities and constrains, project feasibility, architecture design, engineering specialties design, construction bidding, construction licensing and construction inspection of GSS - Galileo Sensor Station, ASIS - EUMETSAT Station, AISLP – Azores International Satellite Program, GAL Extension, Teleport and ESA Shelter

entityDescription:
EKSMA Optics is a manufacturer and global supplier of precision laser components used in lasers, laser systems, and other photonic instruments. The company serves customers across different laser and photonics applications in industrial, medical, aesthetic, scientific, and defense markets.
EKSMA Optics has been built on long-term of expertise in the laser and optics fields. Starting the first activities in 1983 developing of the opto-mechanical components for scientific laboratories. Later in 1990, the company has started sales and marketing of optical components dedicated to laser applications, nonlinear and laser media crystals. Along with additional investments into manufacturing capabilities, EKSMA Optics currently expanded its product portfolio with electro-optical modulators – Pockels cells and their high voltage drivers, high voltage power supplies, timing generators for precise synchronization of laser components or entire laser systems, pulse picking systems for ultrafast lasers, laser diode drivers.
EKSMA Optics also established a department of lens production using CNC equipment, where currently are produced spherical, aspherical, and free-form lenses starting from 8 to 150 mm diameter, and a department of dielectric coatings deposition based on Ion Beam Sputtering technology that is dedicated to laser optics and crystals. 
EKSMA Optics provides custom optical and crystal components made under the customer’s drawings and specifications. However, we also offer a wide range of standard catalog products for fast-off-the-shelf delivery.
The company participates in various national and international R&D projects funded by EuroStars or other EU or National programs. Together with partners from different companies and research institutions from Lithuania and other EU countries, we developed products and components used in the laser and optical systems for life science, medical and industrial applications.
EKSMA Optics is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

entityDescription:
Caledonian Climate is Scotland’s only dedicated environmental consultant for peatland restoration. We are independent and offer a full delivery service for high integrity peatland restoration at scale.
Building on our significant experience, and guided by a distinguishedAdvisory Board, Caledonian Climate is delivering the benchmark for long-term restoration of Scotland's degraded peatlands, locking away the carbon for good. Our work also enhances biodiversity, improves water quality, boosts local economies and creates a compelling story for all of our partners to share.
We support landholders through the full peatland restoration process, from grant applications to project management and verification. We partner them with forward-thinking businesses who want to fulfil their ambitions for carbon emission reductions through high-quality carbon credits, securing income for landholders and the businessesfar more than a transactional CSR exercise to meet net zero targets.

CCP has a partnership with Wetlands International, the global not-for-profit organisation dedicated to the conservation and restoration of wetlands, and is also a delivery partner for Peatland ACTION, Scotland’s flagship programme to restore peatlands across the country.
Our full-delivery projects are underpinned by ThePeatland Code, an independently-verified, voluntary certification standard for UK peatland projects created by the International Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN) UK Peatland Programme. Globally recognised as a credible, science-based carbon standard with rigorous accreditation requirements, the code sets out a series of best-practice requirements, including a standard method for the quantification of greenhouse gas reductions.

entityDescription:
Our Vision: The Institute for Logic and Data Science (ILDS) is a non-profit independent research institute dedicated to the spread and advancement of logic-based and data-oriented scientific methods.
Our Mission: ILDS is pursuing the following goals:
- to offer deep scientific expertise to industry through a pool of talented researchers, implementing together tailored R&D projects;
- to run research grants providing administrative and logistical support to researchers who obtain funding through national, European, or private research programmes;
- to organize scientific events to advance the state of the art;
- to build a thriving community of researchers in logic and data science.
Our Story:Founded in 2022 by five enthusiast scientists with experience in the academic and industrial worlds, ILDS is building a community of researchers and industry experts from Romania and abroad that work together on various research projects and share and advance their knowledge in scientific meetings.
Our Expertise:
- Mathematical, computational and philosophical logic
- Logic in computer science
- Data science
- Artificial intelligence
- Cognitive science
- Cybersecurity
- Blockchain
- Applications of logic and data science to formal, natural and social sciences and humanities

Leomagnetics GmbH is an SME that provides B2B consulting, data analysis and research services related to space weather as well as scientific geospace missions. Leomagnetics has expertise in thermosphere, ionosphere and geomagnetic field conditions and works mainly with these geospace parameters: 
- Thermospheric density, winds, tides and waves 
- Plasma parameters and ionospheric electrodynamics 
- Geomagnetic field and ionospheric electric current systems
- Radiation expertise can be added to the portfolio
In particular, the company can draw from experience in: 
- Calibration, validation and analysis of remote and in-situ geospace data 
- Development of empirical geospace models 
- Use of empirical and physics-based geospace models 
- Geomagnetic index development and application 
Leomagnetics GmbH (https://www.leomagnetics.com) was established as a company in 2022 in the Rostock region of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern in Germany. It operates with a small staff of employees and has an excellent network of contacts in academia.

entityDescription:
WE CREATE SOLUTIONS FOR A LIVING PLANET
All businesses create a footprint in nature somewhere in their value chain. With this comes the challenge of building a sustainable strategy with clear guidelines on how the company should deal with issues related to impacts on species and nature.
We specialise in finding solutions that both create business value and drive progress towards true sustainability. Our mindset is all about development, and we see opportunities in the most complex problems and challenges. Tackling the issue of biodiversity ultimately generates positive impacts for all of the UN's Sustainable Development Goals - not least our impact on climate.
We work across all sectors and our customers are both government and industry, but we see the major players in the business community as the key factor in the transition to a sustainable society. It is also within these companies that we find the strongest drivers for working on biodiversity. Integrating this as a natural part of a company's strategies and sustainability work is one of the cornerstones of a long-term business model.
Those who choose to take the lead are the ones who will build the sustainable society of tomorrow. Together, we create solutions that do not stand in the way of development, but drive it forward, turning risks and challenges into business opportunities with positive values for nature.

Every organisation or development project is unique, with equally unique and complex impacts and dependencies on biodiversity. With nearly 20 years of experience, we specialise in finding solutions that both create business value and drive progress towards true sustainability. We help you analyse and transform data into insight, identify opportunities and risks, and create new ways of working that promote both growth and sustainability. Our clients can be found across all industries, creating unique opportunities for synergies and collaborations. But most importantly, it gives us a deep understanding of our clients' common challenges, regardless of business model or industry.

Design Terminal is Central Europe’s leading innovation agency, which builds ‘Innovation Champions’ through corporate partnerships and talent acceleration. We believe entrepreneurial culture is based on optimism, which drives meaningful innovation. We give corporate leaders and startup founders the knowledge and access they need to catalyze innovation across any organization. Incubation programs are up and running in twelve countries, and since 2014 the organization has worked with more than 1000 startups and several leading corporations. 

The mission of Design Terminal is mentoring business talent, developing the Central European entrepreneurial ecosystem and adopting global best practices related to innovation. The goal of our global expansion was to prove that Central Europe can be a winner in the race for talent and innovative workforce. We are building a value proposition comparable with any similar initiative in Western Europe, and which can attract startups to Budapest from even remote countries of the world. Participants of the Design Terminal Mentoring Program acquire new skills not only from their mentors, but also from each other, and by sharing their network they can contribute to each other’s success as well.

Sirin Orbital Systems AG (sirin-os.com) is a Swiss innovative SME based in Zürich, Switzerland, focusing on the development and commercialization of advanced technologies for the needs of the emerging space market. The company founders have more than twelve years of professional R&D experiences in the field of space-technologies. These competences comprise advanced enabling technologies for on-orbit servicing of satellites, high-performance intelligent space cameras for space debris mitigation in active debris removal missions, on-board optical instrumentation for earth observation, nanosatellites telecommunication system, micro-propulsion systems for small satellites and wireless power transmission systems for planetary exploration and solar power satellites. Sirin-OS is knowledgeable in space project management, satellite subsystem design and system engineering. In addition, miniaturization of advanced technologies for compact instrumentation on-board small satellites and planetary exploration probes was in the scope of past projects. Thus, the company is proficient in leading R&D projects on new space-born instruments in the interest of scientific programs and the commercial space market. 

WE CREATE VIABLE INNOVATIVE PRODUCTS, SERVICES AND SOLUTIONS FOR UPSTREAM AND DOWNSTREAM APPLICATIONS BASED ON CUTTING EDGE TERRESTRIAL TECHNOLOGIES AND SPACE ASSETS.
entityDescription:
Sirin Orbital Systems AG "SIRIN" creates viable innovative products, services and solutions for upstream and downstream applications based on cutting-edge technologies and space assets. 

SIRIN is an innovative Swiss space-tech company founded in 2019 in Zürich, Switzerland, specialized in the development of advanced technologies for diverse needs of the emerging space market and future sustainable space exploration. SIRIN's actual core products include: (i) a game-changing green, safe, scalable and high-performance chemical micro-propulsion system for small-satellites, (ii) an air-breathing propulsion concept for very low-altitude missions, (iii) wireless power transfer (WPT) enabling technologies, and (iv) a high-performance intelligent space camera for active debris removal (ADR) and proximity missions. Further R&D areas include innovative technologies for on-orbit servicing (OOS) of satellites, in-orbit refilling and fuel storage systems, lunar and planetary life support systems and power generators, and quantum-based systems for space applications. The company also provides AI-based solutions for the use of space technologies and EO satellite services for ground-based applications.

SIRIN is an innovative Swiss space-tech company founded in 2019 in Zürich, Switzerland, specialized in the development of advanced technologies for diverse needs of the emerging space market and future sustainable space exploration. SIRIN's actual core products include: (i) a game-changing green, safe, scalable and high-performance chemical micro-propulsion system for small-satellites, (ii) an air-breathing propulsion concept for very low-altitude missions, (iii) wireless power transfer (WPT) enabling technologies, and (iv) a high-performance intelligent space camera for active debris removal (ADR) and proximity missions. Further R&D areas include innovative technologies for on-orbit servicing (OOS) of satellites, in-orbit refilling and fuel storage systems, lunar and planetary life support systems and power generators, and quantum-based systems for space applications. The company also provides AI-based solutions for the use of space technologies and EO satellite services for ground-based applications.

entityDescription:
The Cnam is where the worlds of academics and professional activity come together.
It is the foremost higher education institution dedicated to lifelong learning in France.
Our missions & our structure
The Cnam is a public institution headed by a President, Professor Bénédicte Fauvarque-Cosson, nominated by the President of France.
The Cnam has three main missions:
- to provide lifelong learning opportunities to all
- to develop excellence in technological research and innovation
- to disseminate scientific and technical knowledge
The Cnam proposes study courses which are developed in close collaboration with companies and professional organisations in order to respond to their needs and to those of their employees. Founded in 1794 in the heart of Paris, the Cnam has grown considerably both nationally and internationally and now has 20 French regional and overseas centres. description: ECHOES s.r.l. is an Italian engineering company specialized in the design, development and manufacturing of innovative radar systems and sub-systems (both hardware and software).
entityDescription:
ECHOES s.r.l. is an Italian engineering company specialized in the design, development and manufacturing of innovative radar systems and sub-systems (both hardware and software).

ECHOES offers customer-oriented full-stack radar solutions, from the design up to small-series production for a wide range of civil and military applications from HF up to K bands.
ECHOES is mainly focused on imaging radar market segment, in particular towards:
- structural, geotechnical and environmental monitoring,
- aerospace & defence,
- security and surveillance.

ECHOES has a strong experience in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and Inverse SAR systems with imaging, interferometric and change detection capabilities for deformation monitoring, mapping and surveillance applications from both terrestrial and aerial platforms (UAVs and aircrafts). ECHOES offers light-weight, affordable and reliable radar systems with the best user experience guaranteeing an extremely ease of transportability, installation and use also in harsh environments with real-time and on-board processing.
Our lean structure, high level of know-how and innovative radar technologies are our main competitive advantages. 
Our expertise is mainly in radar imaging (SAR, ISAR), beamforming, multichannel and MIMO architectures, advanced radar signal processing techniques with real-time capabilities.

entityDescription:
The New Space Foundation (NSF) promotes and supports the exploration and use of space as a tool for scientific, industrial, economic, and social development in Poland and Europe. It was founded in 2013 to combine experiences and networks from various bodies supporting the Polish accession to the European Space Agency (ESA) and to develop the best model of the presence of Poland in the Agency. To achieve this goal, NSF actively collaborates with public administration, NGOs, research and academic institutions, as well as space industry representatives.
NSF uses the output of 10 years of founders’ experience in the field of education and public engagement (International Year of Astronomy 2009 activities, conferences for teachers, workshops for students, media relations etc.) to organize science and technology communication initiatives (eg. IAU Communicating Astronomy with the Public 2013 conference gathering ~200 communicators) and development actions (it was a part of the IAU Office of Astronomy for the Development project of establishing the regional node for the Eastern Partnership countries). NSF acted as a dissemination node of the Space Awareness EU-founded educational project (http://www.space-awareness.org) and is also involved in the Universe Awareness educational project (https://www.unawe.org), organizing workshops for kids, students, teachers training, public talks, and astro-shows. NSF was also a consortium member of the spaceEU project (https://www.space-eu.org) founded by the European Commission (consortium also included Ars Electronica, Ecsite, European Schoolnet, Cité de l'espace, Parque de las Ciencias, Universum Bremen, Science In, Science Gallery Dublin, Ciência Viva, Leiden University, Ellinogermaniki Agogi). spaceEU consortium implemented a space outreach and education programme to spark the interest of young people in STEAM and to encourage them to consider space-related careers.

NSF leads SPLOT UA – a project of young Ukrainian creatives’ residency in science, art, culture, design and entrepreneurship (https://www.ua.splot.institute) to support development of cross-disciplinary social innovations for post-war Ukraine recovery. SPLOT UA is organized in partnership with the United States Department of State and the United States Embassy in Poland.

Since more than 40 years we operate in the design and installation of navigation maritime systems as well as radiocommunications. This market gave to us significant satisfactions: our systems are still working in many seas, from Sweden to Oman, with a great presence in the Mediterranean area. In the last decade, driven by the will to provide our Customers better technologies and performances, we also designed and developed a line of advanced components, such as antennas, amplifiers and radars, with particular attention to the Customer applications and needs. These systems received a remarkable success either in the Sea and Land Defence market. Nowadays, our units work around the world in several Special Corps missions.

We work with passion to meet any specific requirement since the challenges are our boost, believing that Customer’s satisfaction is our own satisfaction. Innovation is the guideline of the company, which, thanks to the continuous R&D investments, has widened its offer, both in terms of technology and products range, in order to anticipate the increasing needs of both the military and the civil fields. We are aimed at being the better choice like strategic partner for the Sea & Land System Designers, allowing them to better shape the future of their products, by creating unprecedented value and opportunity.

At system level, Elettronica Marittima main capabilities are related to the following fields: Design and Integration of Sea Navigation Systems, Sea Command & Control and C4ISystems, Automatic Report system for coastal guard and Police naval and terrestrial units, Design and Integration of military communication systems. In the branch of components, Elettronica Marittima capabilities are: Sea sensors design and production, Land and sea tactical antennas design and production, Land and sea satellite antennas designand production, Realization of ad-hoc Antennas tailored for the Customer both civil and military ones.

entityDescription: The Water Development Department is responsible for the protection and sustainable development as well as the rational management of the water resources of Cyprus, in accordance with European and National legislation and within the framework of the Government water policy in force from time to time. The Department is invited to fulfil a number of objectives covering a wide spectrum of actions whose main axes are the following: ensure the maximum possible satisfaction of water requirements for all uses; encourage the effective use of water resources and secure the quality and protection of water sources and the water environment. The duties and responsibilities of the Department are as summarised as follows: The planning, study, construction and operation of waterworks such as dams, reservoirs, water conveyance projects, irrigation and water supply networks and water treatment plants. Obtaining the necessary quantities of desalinated water through relevant contracts.-Managing and supplying water from Government Waterworks for various uses.-Monitoring the water status and the water balance and the preparation and implementation of plans to manage the effects of droughts. The Implementation of the national programme for the implementation of European Directive on the Treatment of Urban Waste Water with actions relating to the planning and construction of relevant waste water collection and treatment works. The implementation of actions for the protection of surface and ground water bodies. The monitoring and assessment of the qualitative and quantitative status of groundwater and surface waters. The collection and treatment of hydrological, hydrogeological, geotechnical and other data for the study, maintenance and safety of development works and the protection and management of water. The implementation of the provisions of the Evaluation, Management and Handling of Flood Risks legislation. The development of a water conscience for the rational use and saving of water-The management of solid wastes (this field was assigned to the WDD in 2016). As a result of the semi-dry climate, the climatic change and the reduction of rainfall in the area of Cyprus, along with the development that occurred in the last decades, the improvement of the standard of living and the increase of the permanent population and tourism, the country struggles with permanent water shortages as the limited natural water sources are unable to respond to the increasing requirements. Within the framework of its duties, the WDD takes action to handle water shortages and ensure adequate quantities of water of appropriate quality, for the requirements of various uses. At the same time, it implements measures to encourage the more effective use of water, the rational management of water and the protection of water resources and the water environment. In addition to the construction and operation of large waterworks for the storage and use of surface run-offs, the Department also takes action towards the reinforcement of the water balance with water coming from unconventional sources. Within this framework, desalinised water is used to ensure that the requirements in drinking water are fulfilled. At the same time, the use of recycled water for irrigation purposes which is a reliable and stable source of water with important financial and environmental benefits, is also actively encouraged. In 2016, the duties and responsibilities of the WDD have been extended to the field of Solid Waste Management, as the Department was assigned the role of Technical Advisor of the district Councils for the Exploitation of the Solid Waste Disposal Sites. Within this framework, the Department will promote the completion of all new construction works for the Management of Solid Waste referred to in the “National Strategy for the Management of Municipal Waste 2015-2021”.

entityDescription:
4D Aerospace Research and Simulation GmbH (4DAE), Salzburg has been founded in 2008 as spin-off company of Paris Lodron University of Salzburg (PLUS). The company has been working closely together with the Aerospace Research Group (Head Prof. Dr. Carl-Herbert Rokitansky) of the University of Salzburg, Computer Science Institute in a number of research projects and industrial co-operations (total of around 40 projects, since 2004) in the aviation, aerospace and railway domain. 

Together with the company Mobile Communications Research and Development Forschungsgesellschaft mbH (MCO), Salzburg and the Aerospace Research Group of PLUS, the company focuses on the development of fast- and real time simulation tools (NAVSIM ATM/ATC/CNS), which allow to simulate the European/worldwide air traffic of specific reference days (today or in future years up to year 2040) very accurately. Based on this detailed simulation of European/worldwide air traffic, a large number of applications, services and future technology concepts have been implemented, tested and evaluated in close co-operation with European institutions (e.g. European Space Agency (ESA), European Commission (EC), SESAR JU, SESAR DM, etc.), Air Navigation Service Providers (e.g. Eurocontrol, Austro Control, Croatia Control, DFS, Enaire, ENAV, etc.), aviation/aerospace industry (e.g. Airbus, AMST, Frequentis, Honeywell, Indra Espacio, Inmarsat, Leonardo, OHB Digital Solutions, Selex, Thales Alenia Space Italia, etc.), research institutions (e.g. DLR, Fraunhofer Austria, Geosphere Austria, etc.) and universities (e.g. TU Graz, TU München, TU Wien, FH St. Pölten, etc.).

The evaluated concepts and future technologies cover a wide range of research areas: Terrestrial (e.g. VDLM2, L-DACS, etc.) and satellite communications (e.g. ESA/Iris); optimization of weather/volcanic ash deviation routes; advanced Arrival Manager (AMAN) solutions and optimized track calculation with ATM/ATC decision support features; Artificial Intelligence (rule) based airport operations, simulation of drones (UAV/RPAS) in (non-)segregated air spaces, ATC exercise and Pilot training scenarios based on Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR; i.e. human ATCO - virtual pilot), Flight Simulators with SATCE (Simulated Air Traffic Control Environment = human pilot - virtual ATC), air craft noise evaluations of large airports.

Together with MCO the company 4D Aerospace Research and Simulation GmbH is also funding and running the "Aviation Competence Center Salzburg" (ACCS), located at the headquarters of 4DAE.

In the railway domain, in co-operation with MCO and PLUS, the company is involved in the development of fast-time and real-time simulation tools (NAVSIM/Rail) which allow the simulation of the European-wide railway traffic (both passenger and freight trains) in order to evaluate the capacity requirements for a future satellite air interface for railway control communications. The methodology concept is similar to the aerospace domain, i.e. based on a simulation of mobile entities (trains) the applications and services of a "Future Railway Mobile Communications System" (FRMCS) are generated by NAVSIM/Rail with the assumption of specific percentages of equipped trains by train category (High Speed, International, Intercity, Regional, Urban/Suburban, Night and Freight trains), depending on the current train domain (station | yard | line) in which the simulated train is currently in. Furthermore, in a co-operation with ÖBB (the national railway service provider of Austria) and TU Graz the simulation tool NAVSIM/Rail was used to evaluate future decision support concepts for train dispatchers towards Automatic Train Operation (ATO)
