Agreed’s mission is to accelerate the adoption of regenerative farming practices, thereby reducing global CO2e emissions while improving the profitability of farms. We are doing so by becoming the data and decision hub for the rapidly expanding regenerative agriculture supply chain within the $10 trillion agriculture industry. Agreed has a specific initial focus on reducing farmers’ dependence on synthetic nitrogen fertiliser given it is an overlooked operational risk, as well as a climate and environmental risk, for farmers and their financial lenders.
Agreed provides data for banks to measure and reduce the nitrogen-related portion of their debt books while connecting farmers to the resources and support they need for a successful transition to more regenerative farming practices, thus improving soil health and reducing nitrogen dependency.

Intecs S.p.A. is an Italian private Company at the forefront in the design and implementation of high-tech electronic systems for the Aerospace, Defence, Transport markets, where safety, reliability, innovation and quality are the key ingredients for success. 
Intecs was founded in 1974. Its core business is the field of software controlling advanced defence systems. Since its foundation Intecs has been expanding its market areas and for ~50 years has been working also in the Space sector leading to the acquisition of a strong expertise in key technological areas, from satellite EO infrastructures and applications to GNSS and on-board/embedded systems

Intecs provides the most innovative software&hardware technology, engineering services and products for dependable safety and mission-critical electronics systems. 

Intecs designs and develops applications, tools, software, hardware components and products for Aerospace, Defense, Railway, Automotive, Finantial and Smart Systems markets in cooperation with major European and Italian Industries, Organizations, Universities and Research Centres.

Intecs is an international leader in System Engineering, mastering the whole value chain from Prototypes, Simulators, Automated Test Equipment to the finished product.

Our values are driven by passion for technological excellence and for continuous improvement, reliability and work dedication, respect for the individual and transparency-based relationships.

Precisely these values are leading Intecs to be one of the most advanced high-tech company in Europe.

Intecs Solutions shares with its customers the highly valuable knowledge it has available in its Centres of Excellence:
• Embedded Real Time Systems
• Model Driven Engineering
• Verification and Validation
• Guidance Navigation and Control
• Surveillance and Command & Control systems
• Human Machine Interface (HMI)
• Earth Observation and GIS
• GNSS System
• Hardware, ASIC & FPGA design
• Physical & PCB design

Intecs employs around 300 professionals. More than 80% of the staff have a university degree in engineering, computer science or other technical disciplines.

Our headquarter is in Rome, while other operational sites are located in Pisa, Naples, Milan, Turin, Reggio Emilia, Genoa and Bari.

entityDescription:
CESI is a world-leading technical consulting and engineering company in the field of technology and innovation for the electric power sector. Through its Division KEMA Labs, CESI is the world leader for the independent Testing, Inspection and Certification activities in the electricity industry. With a legacy of more than 60 years of experience, CESI operates in 70 countries worldwide and supports its global clients in meeting the energy transition challenges. The CESI’s key global clients include major utilities, Transmission System Operators, Distribution System Operators, power generation companies, system integrators, global electromechanical and electronic manufacturers. CESI also provides civil and environmental engineering services. In addition, CESI also develops and manufactures high efficiency space solar cells based on III-V compounds for civil applications.
CESI is a fully independent joint-stock company with facilities in:- Italy: Milan (Headquarter), Piacenza, Seriate, and subsidiaries in - Italy: Guidonia, RM (ISMES SpA), - Germany: Berlin (IPH GmbH) and Mannheim (FGH GmbH), - United Arab Emirates: Dubai (CESI Middle East FZE), - Brazil: Rio de Janeiro (CESI Brasil Consultoria Ltda), - United States: Chalfont (KEMA Powertest LLC, KEMA Realty LLC) Knoxville (EnerNex LLC) Washington DC (CESI USA Inc.), - The Netherlands: Arnhem (KEMA B.V., KEMA Generators B.V.), - Czech Republic: Prague (Zkušebnictví, a. s.), - China: Shangai (KEMA (Shangai) Technology Consulting Company Limited) and with commercial representatives in almost all countries worldwide.
CESI has more than 30 years experience in the research, development and production of high efficiency space solar cellsfor civil applications and is one of the topglobal suppliers of multi-junction cells using based III-V semiconductors. CESI has strongly invested for decades in developing its own proprietary technology going through all the roadmap steps from single junction to multi-junctions, while being involved in the main space research and development programs at EU and international level.
The research activities of CESI have been performed through time thanks to relevant internal investments and to the financial support of the Italian Space Agency (ASI) and of the European Space Agency (ESA). The heritage of CESI includes more than 200,000 manufactured solar cells, powering more than 100 civil satellites for Clients from over 25 different countries worldwide.

From our headquarters in Norway, we have been pioneering the ground segment business since 1968, and have introduced the near real-time concept within operational monitoring services as early as the 1990’s.
Our mission
Today our mission is to be the worlds leading commercial satellite centre. What does that mean for you? The bottom line: we give you access to satellites anytime, anywhere.
Being able to do so, we have heavily invested in, and built a network of global ground stations, consisting of more than 300 + remotely controlled antennas. With 28 sites worldwide, we provide optimized locations for satellites in polar, inclined and equatorial orbits. In addition, we offer Earth Observation services with the fastest available delivery times.
Our customers include both public and commercial users who have urgent, time-sensitive, operational requirements, as well as satellite owners and operators.
With 24/7/365 operations, KSAT is here for you whenever you need it!
Our organisation
At KSAT we have four core values that we work towards every day.
Our core values:
- Kvalitet - Quality
- Stolthet - Pride
- Ansvar - Responsibility
- Trivsel - Thriving
More than 400 of our fantastic employees reflect these values in our everyday work life. A majority is based at the head office in Tromsø, and the remaining are located at the Svalbard Ground Station and at our sales offices in Oslo, Stockholm and Colorado.

entityDescription:
Forsway visionary team sees the integration of satellite and terrestrial networks as the most efficient way to expand broadband services in regions with limited broadband infrastructure/capacity. We think the true direction of 5G technology should be to connect everyone, not to develop higher data rates for a few. We are headquartered in Sweden, but have a global production ecosystem and customer base: the majority of the end users of our solution are located in the developing world. 
Our solutions are designed as an extension of terrestrial broadband networks from the sky, using broadcasting satellites for the delivery of broadband to the subscribers, and terrestrial networks (mobile, dial-up or others) to carry the return channel. This hybrid solution combines the coverage of satellite communications with terrestrial broadband, resulting in a solution capable of breaking one of the main the cost barriers for global internet access: customer premise equipment hardware costs. We can adapt our solution to multiple deployment scenarios (including integration with customer operation and business support), and diverse up/downstream technologies; we also develop OEM solutions. 
Founded as a spin-off from Nokia Home Communications, our first modem was developed and demonstrated for Swedish Direct-To-Home market leader Viasat AB in 2005, pioneering internet over satellite as a complement to TV broadcasting. Since then, we have sold more than 50,000 terminals globally (in x 33 countries). As a leading developer of hybrid solutions in Europe; we have participated in multiple projects with the European Space Agency ESA under the ”Advanced Research In Telecommunications Systems” product development projects (ARTES 3-4) as well as national programs in Sweden. This funding has enabled both the development and the improvement of Forsway’s main solution.
.

Company description: The mission of the ISP is to contribute to increasing the quality of Italian scientific and technological research in the polar regions, and to provide knowledge on global changes in support of Italian and European environmental policies by the development of new technologies and survey methodologies.
The Institute aims to be a reference point for:
- CNR polar research; as ISP has extensive links to universities as well as national and international public and private bodies. ISP offers multidisciplinary skills and technologies that are essential to studying and protecting the environment;
- scientific personnel, able to make qualified contributions to the National Antarctic Research Programme (PNRA), the Arctic Research Programme (PRA) and European Commission projects through the development of research and monitoring activities;
- interdisciplinary polar cooperation and research, including the development of meetings, publications, research opportunities and complementary activities, and interacting with society;
- the standardisation of measurements and preparation methods to improve the quality of results, and the development of coordinated measures aimed at common research plans and/or general common objectives;
- the training of the next generation of polar scientists.

Fulfilling our mission will allow us to improve our understanding of the climatic changes taking place in the Arctic and Antarctic environments and possible future developments at both polar and global levels. Our studies address research issues related to both the chemical/geochemical and physical aspects of the poles using a multidisciplinary approach to protect these vulnerable extreme environments. The repercussions of climate change on these dynamics are still largely unknown and will require integrated research using long term multidisciplinary methods to understand them fully.

entityDescription:
The United Nations University (UNU) is the academic arm of the United Nations and acts as a global think tank. The mission of the Institute for Environment and Human Security (UNU-EHS) is to carry out cutting edge research on risks and adaptation related to environmental hazards and global change. The institute’s research promotes policies and programmes to reduce these risks, while taking into account the interplay between environmental and societal factors.
Research areas include climate change adaptation incorporating insurance-related approaches, environmentally induced migration and social vulnerability, ecosystem services and environmental deterioration processes, models and tools to analyze vulnerability and risks linked to natural hazards, with a focus on urban space and rural-urban interfaces. Research is always conducted with the underlying goal of connecting solutions to development pathways.
Beyond its research mandate, UNU-EHS is actively engaged in education. It offers the joint Master of Science degree programme “The Geography of Environmental Risks and Human Security” with the University of Bonn. UNU-EHS also hosts a number of international PhD projects and courses on global issues of environmental risks and sustainable development. The institute is based in Bonn, Germany.

entityDescription:
Based in Dingle, Co. Kerry, Net Feasa is an IoT company developing hardware and software solutions.
Net Feasa is a trusted IoT Service Provider dedicated to the Digital Transformation of the supply chain. Our compliance-based connectivity solutions are embedded in the heart of global communications networks and supply chains. Our open global connectivity platform, EvenKeel™ can support LPWAN (LoRa, NB-IoT, LTE-M) and/or Cellular (LTE, 5G).
 
The Net Feasa team has decades of experience in designing and deploying wireless communication systems across the globe including: 1,000 remote communities (Satellite/GSM/3G/Wi-Fi), 500 Aircraft (Satellite/GSM/Wi-Fi), 500 Container Ships (Satellite/GSM) and Cruise Ships (Satellite/GSM). For over 3 decades our management team has garnered expertise in; Wireless Communications, IoT, Cloud, Big Data, practical uses of Machine Learning and Network Security.
Net Feasa a fully licenced IoT mobile network operator with a global extra-territorial mobile licence. We have15 million mobile numbers and our own MCC-MNC (PLMN mobile network code), which allows us to provide our customers with authentic onboard networks, global SIM (cellular) based connectivity forIoT device monitoring and finally a low-cost Smart Container (and other asset) tracking and monitoring capability.
Net Feasa’s IoT platform is wireless technology agnostic, and our technology and solution are based on open standards. Our IoT management platform EvenKeel™ can supports Cellular (2G) and LPWAN (Low Powered Wide Area Network) technologies such as LTE/5G(NB-IoT, LTE-M) and LoRaWAN.
Net Feasa offer Smart Agri solutions. We partnered with The Dingle Hub, Kerry Agribusiness and Teagasc to deliver IoT sensor technology using LoRaWAN to six (6) West Kerry Farms. This project is expanding and will see the roll out of the technology for a further thirty-six (36) farms. We provide live access of the data to each individual farmer.
At each location, we have deployed 5 IoT sensors measuring the following:
· Air Temperature
· Humidity
· Air Pressure
· Rainfall
· Wind Speed
· Wind Direction
· Soil Temperature
· Soil Moisture
· Milk Tank Fill
· Slurry Tank Fill
The data generated from the network aims to achieve greater carbon, cost, and labour efficiency along with extending the grazing season for dairy cows.
The ‘real-time’ data collected describes current and predicted weather and soil conditions, grass growth rates and key environmental indicators. This data will be analysed and used to develop models and effective decision-support tools for farmers.

Sonaca España Group is a Spanish private organization dedicated to Aerospace sector, Tier One supplier for both aerostructures and engine systems and components for companies such as Airbus Operations, Airbus Defence & Space, Boeing, Embraer, Fokker, GKN, Aciturri Aeroengines, etc. Sonaca España is capable to develop activities from design up to customer support service, and always growing up based on a continuous R&D activity.

entityDescription: Puli Space Technologies Ltd., based in Budapest, Hungary, was founded in 2010 to enter the Google Lunar XPRIZE (GLXP), an exceptional technological incentive competition. Puli is developing a range of lunar exploration technologies,including the NASA award-winning Puli Lunar Water Snooper (PLWS), a rugged, micro-sized, lightweight neutron spectrometer instrument for exploring lunar water resources in support of In-Situ Resource Utilisation (ISRU) and our low-cost, lightweight, planetary rover platform with unique mobility capabilities. Our first lunar payload, the Puli SpaceTime Plaque, will be delivered to the Moon on the Peregrine lander of Astrobotic. Two PLWS will fly on the IM-2 Mission of Intuitive Machines to the Lunar South Pole region: one will go into a Permanently Shadowed Region on board of theSouth Pole Hopper and a second one will collect data en route on Lunar Outpost’s MAPP rover. Puli also keeps an eye on Down to Earth applications.

entityDescription:
TELETEL (www.teletel.eu) was established in 1995 and specialises in the leading edge areas of Space and Defence. Firmly established in a highly competitive global market, we are a recognised supplier of products and solutions to the international space and defence markets. We work very closely with the European industry having provided micro-electronics / software solutions and products to AIRBUS DEFENCE & SPACE, THALES ALENIA SPACE, OHB, EUROPEAN SPACE AGENCY (ESA), CNES, THALES, MBDA, DASSAULT and many other customers.

TELETEL is a Greek satellite test systems and software engineering company providing innovative solutions to Space agencies, major European space companies (including the three primes Airbus Defence & Space, Thales Alenia Space and OHB), and several other aerospace industries in US, Japan & South Korea.
Since 2008 we have contributed to the success of more than 15 Space missions including EUCLID, JUICE, PLATO, IASI-NG, MICROCARB, FLEX, CSO, Galileo 2G, Copernicus LSTM / CIMR / CRISTAL, ARIEL, etc.
TELETEL’s main competences in the Space domain include:
- iSAFT Product Line: Test Equipment for satellite/spacecraft on-board data networks (SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, MIL-STD-1553, CAN/CANOpen, WizardLink, TTEthernet, etc.)
- Integrated Satellite Test Systems (EGSEs & specialized SCOEs, such as Payload EGSE, Platform EGSE, Instrument Simulators, Platform Simulator, Custom EGSEs)
- On-board & Ground SW development (Application Software, Communication Protocols etc.)
- Engineering support services (AIT/AIV support, etc.)
TELETEL is certified according to the ISO 9001:2015 Quality Standard. All company personnel and facilities are certified and authorised to handle graded material according to NATO C-M (55) 15 FINAL Security System. The company is also registered in the Registry of Defence Material Manufacturers of the Hellenic Ministry of Defence for the activities of “Software Development for Defence systems” (Certificate No: 0051). TELETEL is a founding member of the Hellenic Association of Space Industry (H-ASI) as well as a member of the Hellenic Space Technologies and Applications Cluster (si-Cluster).

Thanks to the combination of very high specific stiffness and high thermal stability, Boostec® SiC provides the very high thermoelastic stability required for optical instruments on board satellites.
MERSEN BOOSTEC offers assistance to its customers for the design of their SiC parts to ensure better feasibility, mitigate risks and also reduce costs and lead time.
MERSEN BOOSTEC has developed over the years a unique expertise and capacity to manufacture space-quality SiC parts up to Ø 3.50m.

The Fraunhofer Institute for Integrated Circuits IIS/EAS performs contract research and developments in the fields of microelectronic systems. The researchers of its Division Engineering of Adaptive Systems EAS in Dresden develop methods and tools for the reliable computer-aided design of complex electronic and mechatronic systems. Thus, integrated circuits, electronic devices and complex sensor systems can be optimized and implemented faster in order to reduce a product’s time-to-market. Furthermore, the scientists work on innovative technologies and systems in domains like image sensing, system integration, verification, integrated sensor electronics. One goal of particular importance is closing the gap between innovative manufacturing technologies and the design of complex systems.

The EAS Division is involved in national and international networks in research and numerous standardization activities. Its results of work and developments are applied in microelectronics and its domains, such as communication technology, automotive industry or Automation.

entityDescription:
WarnerPatch is a non-invasive wearable medical device that predicts disease evolution for clinicians to give preventive care, improve patient outcome and save care costs. As it is connected with cellular connection, it allows remote monitoring for safe early discharge of post-operative patients with reduced readmission rate.
Particularly focusing on peripheral vascular diseases (PVD), which include diabetic foot and wound care, WarnerPatch reduces the treatment cycle by improving patient management for clinicians and healthcare providers. PVD has a long treatment cycle which can lead to sepsis, embolism, amputation, or, death. Depending on the patient status, the disease often evolves at different pastes according to the patient and clinicians do not have a clear overview of the disease evolution at the current clinical assessment frequency. It often leads to late recognition of disease degradation and advanced complications. 
WarnerPatch is a wearable cellular-connected sensor that continuously measures disease symptoms. The symptoms measured is related to tissue health. With advanced data analytics (AI) on the continuous measurements, a prediction on the future evolution is given with notification should degradation is predicted. Clinicians can access the results on a real time basis and get notified when a patient becomes high risk. It aims to help providing a closer follow-up of high-risk patients.

entityDescription:
Since 2014 Alpinus Chemia Sp. z o.o (Alpinus Chemia Ltd.) systematically advances research and development in its core fields of activity. We also transform the outcomes of our R&D into innovative and high value products and/or services and bring them to the market. After the final design, configuration, and production we are ready to deliver these goods and services to our customers, worldwide. We are an interdisciplinary team of scientists, researchers and engineers engaged in the development of innovative products and services for the chemical, precision metallurgical and pharmaceutical sectors, and the production of foods and food supplements.Working with nano-sized materials, ultra-high purity materials, optical quality materials, cloud-based network of laboratories, big data processing, neuralink data processing, high resolution optical scanning microscopes, wide-band optical scanning telescopes. In addition to our fine R&D capabilities our company operates facilities for low-tonnage production for the food, dietary supplement, medical, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries.
We are continuously expanding and upgrading our capacities in Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs), which has resulted in some unique (for Poland) capabilities to carry out serious and complex ICT related projects, including Q band communications.
In addition to our in-house research and development capacity we closely cooperate and carry out numerous joint R&D undertakings with scientific partners such as:
Lviv Polytechnic (Lviv, Ukraine), Warsaw University of Technology (Warsaw, Poland), University of Science and Technology in Bydgoszcz (Bydgoszcz, Poland), Collegium Medicum (Bydgoszcz, Poland), Nicolaus Copernicus University (Torun, Poland), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (Trondheim, Norway), Karolinska Institutet Medical University (Stockholm, Sweden), LabVantage Solutions – Laboratory Informatics (Helsinki, Finland), Janssen Global – Pharmaceutics (London, Great Britain), Rigaku – Measurement Equipment (Austin, Texas, USA), Waters – Mass Spectrometry (Wilmslow, UK)
The Alpinus Chemia R&D infrastructure and organisational capacities include:
1. The Ultra-High Purity/Optical Quality Materials, Pharmaceutical Laboratory, and the Clean Rooms production facilities. In the analytical laboratory we follow the Good Laboratory Practices [GLP]. We have also established highest standards to enable production of high purity raw materials.
2. The Molecular Biology Laboratory with Bioreactors, where research is carried out to demonstrate how the functioning of living organisms depends on the properties of the molecules that make them up. In this laboratory there are, among others, apparatus for DNA sequencing, high precision metabolic scanners, Fourier-Transform Ion-Cyclotron-Resonance Mass Spectrometer. Moreover, in special bioreactors, under appropriate conditions, biosynthesis is successfully carried out.
3. Laboratory for Investigation of Microorganisms in micro gravity conditions in Closed Ecological Systems (CES).
4. Installation for Extraction Processes for supercritical extraction for production of aerogels.
5. Installation for Liquid-Liquid Chromatographic Separation of Substances comprising a high-precision centrifugal chromatograph (LCLC).
6. The Technical Laboratory, for Constructing and Building of Prototype Installations, also using scanning, modelling and 3D printing.
7. Cloud based Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Systems, with strong computing capabilities including super secure ultra-fast (1TB) networks with large size virtualization capability based on a server farm consisting of 26 processors with 256 cores and 15TB RAM DDR 4, 4 Petabytes Disk Storage, 2 TB GPUs.

entityDescription:
Advanced Communications Testing Applications (ACTA Ltd.) is an SME founded in October 2002 in Athens Greece. Our expertise and experience are, as a provider and integrator of long-term performance analysis monitoring solutions as well as ad-hoc network measurements. Focus is on Telecoms, IT, Electronics and EMF & EMC technologies. Present in Southeast Europe. 
ACTA’s key competence is in 
(1) Performance monitoring solutions for telecommunication network KPIs 
(2) EMF s/w application, that collects and analyzes measurements from several types of ElectroMagnetic Field monitoring stations and 
(3) Zero-touch provisioning (TR-069) CPE (Customer Premises Equipment) management solution, with security improvement and threat mitigation via fast and massive CPE upgrades. Currently in 2 Horizon2020 EC funded projects, 5G-TOURS & 5G-HEART, utilizing 5G-EVE 5G-pilot network for Verticals.
Typical customers of ACTA are Telecom Operators, Integrators and Manufacturers, Utility companies, Universities, Research Laboratories, Regulators and Enterprises providing test and measurement solutions for a wide range of technologies with greater focus on optical, mobile, radio and access networks. ACTA has provided transmission performance monitoring solutions to Telecom Operators in Greece. Based on ACTA’s KPI Management & Validation Platform and HW probes. Collected data help in Operations and Capacity Planning. Raw data, aggregated according to physical network medium, manufacturer, demographics. 
ACTA participates in two Horizon2020 European Commission Horizon 2020 funded projects, 5G TOURS and 5G HEART in partnership with SMEs, universities and telecom providers from France, Norway, Italy, UK, Spain, Netherlands, and Greece. During these projects ACTA employs state-of-the-art measurement and testing equipment for 5G network performance analysis, in order to validate the network capabilities in the setup phase, as well as measure the actual performance during operation.
The Greek National EMF Observatory Application (sw suite) collects measurements from several types of ElectroMagnetic Field (EMF) monitoring stations. The EMF software is currently further developed to support measurements of 5G network radiation.
ACTA has deployed a zero-touch provisioning (TR-069) CPE management solution, with security improvement and threat mitigation via fast and massive CPE upgrades, in three Greek Telecom Operators. Platforms are further developed and future thought is in TR-181, TR-369 and upcoming User Services Platform-USP.
ACTA Ltd is interested in cooperating, in EC RnD, calls with other parties that focus on optical, mobile, radio and access networks. Special focus is on the technology areas of monitoring sensors, electromagnetic fields (EMF) monitoring (EMF exposure and health), 5G – IoT, edge computing.

entityDescription:
GEO-NET Umweltconsulting GmbH
Experience builds conﬁdence
For the successful implementation of wind energy projects comprehensive know-how and specialists with broad experience in numerous areas are required. Since 25 years GEO-NET is a reliable partner for the successful development, implementation and assessment of wind energy projects.
Our team of experts, such as geographers, meteorologists, renewable energy engineers and landscape ecologists, contributes with their expertise and knowledge to assure the efﬁcient, reliable and economical realisation of your projects.
Our focus is on analysis of wind meteorology and energy yields, which are included in studies of wind potentials, bankable wind and energy yield assessments, and other studies. GEO-NET applies the validated air ﬂow model FITNAH-3D to deliver a precise assessment, even for complex sites and at high hub heights.
With more than 3000 wind analysis projects in more than 35 countries worldwide, GEO-NET shows its long time and global experience. In addition, GEO-NET has produced more than 15 wind atlases and conducted 250 wind measurement campaigns all over the world.
For reduced forecast uncertainty of the report, we will conduct wind measurements at the planned site to secure highest possible accuracy and the proﬁtability of your project.
Quality standards and technical competence
GEO-NET offers high quality and reliable expertise guaranteed by the accreditation according to DIN EN ISO/IEC 17025:2005 (DAkkS* 1 , ILAC* 2 ) and internal quality management
(DIN EN ISO 9001:2008 (TÜV Nord)). As certified and accredited laboratory, GEO-NET follows the national and international technical guidelines and standards of the wind industry.
The accreditation by DAkkS covers the following procedures: wind measurements by means of measurement masts, LiDAR and SoDAR measurement devices; measurement data analysis, determining wind potential and energy output of wind turbine generators, determining reference yield of wind turbines, wind field simulation with mesoscale models.
GEO-NET is recognized by banks and public authorities worldwide, ensured via the ILAC Mutual Recognition Agreement (ILAC-MRA).
* 1 DAkkS = Deutsche Akkreditierungsstelle (German Accreditation Body)
* 2 ILAC = International Laboratory Accreditation Cooperation.

description:
Crover is centred around the commercialisation of the first proprietary technology for locomotion in bulk solids (e.g. sand, grains, powders), through which the Crover team has developed the world’s first ‘granular drone’ (i.e. a CROVER), in the sense of a device able to move through bulk solids and powders. 
While potential applications of the CROVER range from the minerals industry to moving in regolith substrates in space, Crover's first product is a probing device for the monitoring and management of cereal grains stored in bulk (e.g. whole barley, paddy rice in sheds and silos).

entityDescription:
Polbionica is a biotech company that continues to research on the 3D bionic pancreas and thinks boldly about the future.
Our mission is to bring 3D printing of the bionic pancreas into clinical practice and improve the quality of life for diabetic patients worldwide.POLBIONICA is a company established by the Foundation onResearch and Development of Science tocommercialise 3D bionic pancreas research. The application of the bionic pancreas in clinical practice will revolutionise the treatment of diabetes and become one of the greatest medical successes of the 21st century. Concerning the growing number of patients with type I diabetes and the limitations of available treatments, functional 3D bioprinting is a viable option to overcome the problem of organ shortage and will also reduce the number of complications associated with surgery and the use of long-term immunosuppression after transplantation. In late 2020, we completed the preclinical phase of 3D bionic pancreas research; we are developing very promising results and we are also preparing for the clinical phase. While working on the 3D bionic pancreas bioprinting project, we created proprietary products crucial for the 3D bioprinting development. These include customised bio inks, a bioreactor, and innovative bioprinting methods.
Polbionica is a multidisciplinary, challenge-ready team that includes physicians and medical consultants, biotechnologists, engineers, laboratory technicians, and experts for regulations, business creators and sales and marketing specialists. We trust each other and work together toward the goal of improving the lives of patients with diabetes. The Polbionica team currently consists of 15 people and will grow as the project grows to meet its goals.

description: Loft Orbital is an innovative SME based in Toulouse, France, that is a pioneer in the “Space Infrastructure as a Service”. At Loft Orbital, we fly the payloads (physical or virtual) of our customers on a microsatellite, as a service. For its customers and partners, Loft Orbital delivers an end-to-end mission service including AIT, launch, insurance, licensing, operations. Loft Orbital’s mission is to make space simple for its customers, so that they can focus their resources on the development of their payload development, and on the exploitation of the data. Our customers span institutional and commercial entities, space and non space entities, from a variety of applications (including EO, Comms, Navigation, Science).
entityDescription:
Loft Orbital Technologies is a French New Space company established in November 2019 in Toulouse. We are a subsidiary of Loft Orbital Solutions Inc., created in January 2017 in San Francisco, at the heart of Silicon Valley.
Our mission is to radically simplify access to space. We are transforming an expensive and complex process today into a simple service accessible to all budgets and in a time twice as short as with any other space operator.
For this, we buy, integrate and operate our satellites so that our customers consume the on-board resource they need to fly their sensor, their software, or to test a technology. These sensors can be an Earth Observation instrument, a telecommunication payload, a scientific experiment or a demonstrator.
Thanks to the exclusive technologies that Loft Orbital has developed, customers have complete control of their mission while getting rid of the infrastructure costs usually associated with a satellite mission.
Our approach is declined in three axes:
- Resource sharing - a satellite for several instruments on board (ridesharing) or the same instrument for several clients (timesharing).
- A service model - our service includes all the operations necessary to put a payload into orbit (production, launch, insurance, ground segment operations, etc.).
- Standardization of infrastructure - we buy satellite platforms from best suppliers in the industry. We develop the structural and software interfaces that form a universal adapter to customer sensors and allow standardizing assembly and integration procedures, whichever payload on board.

The leasing model allows customers to focus on their core business: collecting and processing data. This model also makes it possible to take advantage of resources unused by customers within a collaborative action: Orbital Impact is a non-profit initiative, led by Loft Orbital, to study the impact of climate change on our planet. The satellite data, their quality but also their quantity, are needed by scientists, decision-makers, students and non-governmental organizations which are the driving forces in the fight against global warming. Loft Orbital is committed to providing the resources and the expertise necessary for the implementation of collaborative projects that help protect biodiversity, the environment and oceans.

entityDescription:
Quantum Sound is a start-up that connects the front of scientific research in the field of physics and electrical engineering with their application with the use of computer science. One of our goals is to develop software based on scientific research and methods in the field of quantum physics, with emphasis on quantum computing and quantum algorithms, sensors and pertinent software based on research of sources, propagation and detection, and ultimately analysis of electromagnetic waves (in various spectral fields) and sound waves. We develop sensors utilizing electromagnetic waves from GHz frequencies (using Wi-Fi fields) over the THz range, visible light, to X- and gamma radiation). 
Quantum Sound will position itself on the Croatian and regional market as a rare company that has in-depth knowledge of modern quantum and photonic technologies, and that can connect and integrate them into the final product: software or sensor. The company has a high valence of cooperation on joint projects with scientific institutions and companies in the Republic of Croatia, the EU, the USA and China. This is evident from current collaborations with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Lightelligence inc. from the USA. This valence and knowledge on which Quantum Sound is based has the potential to create top products or applications based on results from the front of scientific research, which makes it a desirable partner in the Republic of Croatia and the region.

It is the dominant provider of fixed line telecommunications, mobile telecommunications and ?nternet access in Cyprus.

It was established with the aim of providing, maintaining and developing a comprehensive telecommunications service, both nationally and internationally. entityName: NEW ERA SMART SOLUTIONS AND TECHNOLOGIES S.R.L. (NESST S.R.L.)
entityDescription:
NESST is an innovative start-up whose purpose is to enhance and exploit the FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling) printing technology, also known as FFF (Fused Filament Fabrication) for the additive production of finished parts with high performance materials, functional to support and activate Metal Replacement processes in the AEROSPACE & DEFENSE sector, and in addition in the MOBILITY sector in general, OIL & GAS, MEDICAL and ROBOTICS. NESST uses additive manufacturing technology based on the use of superpolymers such as Carbon peek: composite material reinforced with carbon fiber, with extraordinary characteristics in terms of mechanical, thermal and chemical resistance, and Ultem: material with high heat resistance, resistance to deformation and high rigidity , we will proceed with the conversion of metals (such as steel and aluminum) into technopolymers. The strength of the use of this technology is to achieve an industrialization process that allows: Reduction of production and maintenance costs; Reduced lead time; Performance optimization; Achievement of the desired level of reliability, Environmental sustainability / End of life management; Design-ergonomics with greater freedom of design and flexibility suitable for improving the efficiency of the parts, Reduction of waste material.

NESST utilizza tecnologia di manifattura additiva basata sull’utilizzo di superpolimeri quali Carbon peek: materiale composito rinforzatocon fibra di carbonio, con caratteristiche straordinarie in termini diresistenza meccanica,termicaechimica, ed Ultem: materiale dall’elevata resistenza al calore, resistenza alla deformazione ed elevata rigidità, si procederà alla conversione di metalli (come acciaio e alluminio) in tecnopolimeri. Punto di forza dell’utilizzo di tale tecnologia è quello di giungere ad un processo di industrializzazione che permetta:Riduzione dei costi di produzione e manutenzione; Lead time ridotto; Ottimizzazione delle performance; Raggiungimento del livello di affidabilità desiderato, Sostenibilità ambientale/Gestione del fine vita; Design-ergonomia con una maggiore libertà di design e flessibilità idonea a migliorare l’efficienza delle parti, Riduzione del materiale di scarto.

entityDescription: The Dalla Parte Dei Bambini school was born as an experimental pedagogical and didactic experience, an alternative to traditional school. The concept of hospitality is the guiding thread of all moments of school life and constitutes the first step in the birth and development of an educational reality that considers the individual and his needs - affective, expressive and developmental - its own backbone. The school is inspired by the principles of democracy, secularism and cultural pluralism. As an “active school” it is inspired by the Freinet cooperative pedagogy, in which the centrality of the subject who learns and the cooperation in the construction of shared meanings are the cornerstones of the entire educational system. The growing strength of Dalla parte Dei Bambini lies in sharing and opening up to different artistic and scientific, as well as purely pedagogical realities, active on the national and international territory, in the belief that cooperation, interculture, freedom of research and of experimentation are fundamental for the educational success of a school that operates contemporary reality. The main commitment involving the DPDB company is the management of infant-toddler centers, kindergartens and primary schools. Thanks to over thirty years of experience in cooperative teaching, the Dalla Parte Dei Bambini School is a reference for educational innovation and adheres to the educational avant-gardes of INDIRE.

entityDescription:
We conserve & restore valuable ecosystems
Guided by a best practice approach and over 25 years of experience, BROZ works on implementing practical conservation actions in Natura 2000 areas across Slovakia. Since our foundation in 1997, we have established ourselves as a leading NGO in ecosystem conservation and restoration in the country.
More informally, we are a young and passionate team of environmentalists who try to solve environmental problems that concern us. 
Focusing primarily on the area surrounding the Danube river, we restore wetlands and river sidearms, forests, meadows and pastures.We make effort to restore traditional landscape management such as willow pollarding, cattle grazing and reed cutting.
Besides the practical field activities, we try to increase awareness of nature conservation by working with the general public and schools, organizing excursions and workshops as well as preparing publications, exhibitions and documentary films.

entityDescription:
Ecliptic Defence and Space is your trusted partner in the development of defence and space components and subsystems utilizing RF and microwave technologies. Our close ties with the global industry in these sectors, as well as our strong academic backgrounds, enable us to always use the latest and best design methodologies and manufacturing techniques to produce highly reliable products fit for the end application, whether that may be space, aerospace, maritime or land-based.
The engineers at Ecliptic Defence and Space, have decades of experience in all of the RF and Microwave technologies. Their domains of expertise range from component-level to subsystem-level designs, from low power to high-power devices, from passive to active microwave integrated assemblies and from planar to waveguide-based systems and antennas. They gained their expertise and specializations by working for large global aerospace companies, as well as for medium-sized and small-scale enterprises focused exclusively in the global markets of space and defence in the United States, the United Kingdom and Cyprus.
Our people have worked with NASA, the European Space Agency, the European Defence Agency, various European universities and research institutions in research and development projects aiming at the definition, design and the prototyping of the next generation tracking radars, synthetic aperture radars (SAR), passive bistatic radars, weather radars, radiometers, scatterometers, signal distribution units, telemetry/telecommand/control (TT&C) systems. We develop novel devices and systems that outperform the competition, because we invest heavily in our own internal research.
Using our robust design methodologies, analysis and simulation software and techniques, we have performed all quality assurance-required analyses that are an integral part of any space and defence project, such as Full-wave Electromagnetic Analyses, Worse Case Analyses, Failure Modes, Effects and Criticallity Analysis, Parts Stress Analysis, Reliability Analyses, Thermal Analysis, Multipaction and Corona Analyses.
With the establishment of Ecliptic Defence and Space, we aim that our ambitions to be your partner of choice for RF and microwave technologies, will perfectly align with your strategic goals.

entityDescription:
In a fast globalizing world where rising urban populations concentrate in always larger metropolitan cities, transport has become a major issue for mankind. As demand for transport continues to grow year on year, railway operators have to disrupt the mobility offer while addressing pollution, congestion and security issues. Rail transport is not just a market of the future, it is vital for quality of life. Given the challenges of climate change and the urgent need for regional, social and economic development, we must continue to act. SNCF – as well as the men and women we employ – has both the resources and the commitment to deliver. 
SNCF missions rely in delivering seamless, reliable and environmental-friendly passenger and freight transport, thereby contributing to develop tomorrow’s mobility. The implementation of the French rail reform (pursuant to law n°2018-515 of June 27th 2018) on January 1st 2020 reorganized the SNCF group in 5 fully-state-owned limited liability companies representing an industrial services group:
- The SNCF holding company ensures the Group's long-term strategic and financial management. It comprises the General Directorate for Technologies and its Technology, Innovation and Corporate Projects Division in charge of developing and monitoring R&D activities on behalf of the whole group.
- SNCF Voyageurs (owned by the holding company, formerly “SNCF Mobilités”) comprises all the group’s subsidiaries dedicated to passengers transport worldwide and associated rolling stock assets’ engineering and maintenance.
- SNCF Réseau (owned by the holding company) is a railway infrastructure manager in charge of engineering, operating and maintaining the French rail network. 
- SNCF Gares & Connexions (subsidiary of SNCF Réseau) manages and operates French train stations. It ensures efficient train station access and services for transport operators. 
- SNCF Fret is the leading French freight transport operator.

entityDescription:
ORCA Computing is a startup based in London with a mission to build full-stack, photonic quantum computers. ORCA’s multidisciplinary team of quantum scientists, engineers and mathematicians are developing unique hardware and architectures to completely change the face of high-performance computing and networking, from near-term quantum devices and applications to universal, fault-tolerant quantum systems.
ORCA’s employees have previously worked and held leadership positions at public institutions such as Innovate UK, Oxford University and Imperial College London, and companies such as Teledyne E2V, TTP, Xanadu and Cray.
ORCA’s technical approach emerged from 35 years of research leadership by Professor Ian Walmsley (now Chairman of the ORCA board of directors, and Provost of Imperial College), and his Ultrafast Quantum Optics Group at the University of Oxford (UK), giving ORCA a significant knowledge base and experience across the fields of quantum optics, atomic physics, error correction, AI and optical networks. Since forming ORCA, the company has built on that experience, and combined that with an industry-oriented leadership team to deliver commercially relevant quantum computing systems. This is backed by a large number of high impact publications (see table below) and patents co-authored by our employees, across the fields of quantum optics, atomic physics, error correction, machine learning, high-speed electronics and optical networking.

entityDescription: CSC - Tieteen tietotekniikan keskus Oy / CSC – IT Center for Science is a Finnish center of expertise in information technology owned by the Finnish state and higher education institutions. We provide internationally high-quality ICT expert services for higher education institutions, research institutes, culture, public administration and enterprises to help them thrive and benefit the society at large. CSC is owned by the state of Finland (70%) and Finnish higher education institutions (30%). Established in 1971, CSC currently has over 560 employees, and supports a European-wide customer base of thousands of researchers covering basically all scientific disciplines. CSC is listed on the Finnish Research Infrastructure Roadmap, hosting four national RIs: the CSCRI, including the national research network Funet, the carbon negative data centre Kajaani, and the HPC and Cloud computing facility; the Finnish node of the biomedical computing infrastructure ELIXIR; PRACE Finland, part of Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe; and a National Research Data Platform. The pan-European flagship pre-exascale EuroHPC supercomputer LUMI is hosted by CSC. LUMI is the most powerful supercomputer in Europe and the world-leading AI and Big Data platform. CSC is a founding member of the Finnish Quantum-Computing Infrastructure FiQCI and part of the Nordic-Estonian Quantum Computing e-Infrastructure Quest NordIQuEst. Several quantum computers are actively being integrated with LUMI, setting up a powerful hybrid HPC+nQC platform for Europe.

entityDescription:
Along with our core services, i.e. interpreting and translation, we offer terminology and knowledge management (KM). Our first contract in the field was with the French space agency (CNES) for which we work as a supervising contractor handling subcontractor companies and developing collaborative solutions and automatic language processing aspects.
The Terminology/KM division takes on projects for managing/creating knowledge sharing spaces (Wikis or community portals) and terminology resources for optimising documentation retrieval, indexing and classification systems. We also design professional knowledge transfer modules (for handovers following retirement or changes in job positions, for example).

Development of termino-ontological resources
Technology watch and information and documentation management:
- Information searching and text-mining
- Semantic search engines
- Categorisation (automatic addition of metadata) / documentation classification
- Knowledge structuring and collaborative spaces
Méthodology
Process of acquiring knowledge from documents (linguistic corpus) that are representative of the field/profession in question:
– Terminology extraction
– Clustering
– Development of semantic networks
– Modelling of semantic networks in the form of thesauri or ontologies
Validation by several experts in the field is an integral part of the process.
Knowledge modelling and transfer
For any company, when an employee leaves (on retirement, or by changing jobs, or being promoted elsewhere), there is often a loss of know-how, knowledge, information in general and hence of efficiency for the company. The ideal solution consists in setting up a transition pair, the replacement employee and the future ex-employee, who work together for several months so that the former can learn from the latter.
However, this is not always possible :
- For financial reasons, when the company has to pay two employees for a single job for an extended period of time;
- Or when, due to lack of resources, the replacement employee is not always available for this coaching work, or if no one has yet been chosen to replace the leaving employee; in some cases, fellow employees will temporarily handle the leaver’s tasks.
Our offer
Our intervention involves several stages before the employee leaves :
- Auditing, sorting, classifying and enhancing the value of documentation
- Gathering information from the leaver about his/her specialised knowledge, skills, techniques networks, etc.
- Gathering information from the working community on their perception of the leaver’s competence that they will most miss when the person leaves.
- Modelling the information collected so that it can be made available to the replacement person or to a community.

entityDescription:
The Institute for Plasma Science and Technology – ISTP is a CNR institute,founded in April 2019, joining three CNR research groups that have been active in plasma physics research for many decades.
ISTP counts about120 staff people, including over 80 Physicists, Engineers, Chemists and Geologists,25% of which are female scientists.
ISTP belongs to the Department of Physical Sciences and Technology of Matter of CNR (DSFTM). Headquarters are located in Milan, with three research units, in Milan, Padua and Bari. Each site has its own laboratories, experiments and premises. The majority of ISTP personnel in Padua is seconded toConsorzio RFX.
With the foundation of ISTP, the scientific and technological expertise of the Institute or Plasma Physics ‘Piero Caldirola’ (IFP-CNR) in Milan, of the Institute of Ionized Gases (IGI-CNR) in Padua and of the P.Las.M.I. Lab within the Institute of Nanotechnology (NANOTEC-CNR) in Bari were merged together in a single institute.
Thus, CNR has integrated most of its plasma science and technology expertise in ISTP, which can now boast a broad spectrum of competences to address the institute mission.

description:
Celestial is a satellite systems provider and an expert in delivering telecommunication solutions for satellites. Our story began in 2018, with a university hackathon, in the vibrant startup ecosystem of Berlin. Soon thereafter the company received support from the European Space Agency. 

We have a clear vision of not just what is possible in the space industry but also what needs to be made possible. We are committed to deliver the breakthroughs that fuel our growth in a way that resonates with people inside and outside our industry. Our vision of a lunar economy is an important component of space industrialization. It involves science, exploration, development, settlement and commerce. 

Celestial was founded by a space engineer with RF and telecommunication expertise and an industrial engineer with business management expertise. Our team is internationally spread, culturally diverse, and very resourceful.

We provide our satellite systems to a variety of markets with a diverse client base, including old space companies, new space startups, educational institutions, and space agencies.

We are the only private company working on highly integrated small satellite antennas, suitable for government and commercial satellites, operating in LEO and beyond. We are applying our capabilities to develop affordable solutions that enable new space companies to reach higher orbits, at lower cost and with better connectivity.

Our product portfolio ranges from micro to small antenna payloads, with use cases independent of satellite size. Our products are customizable to mission requirements both in performance characteristics and design constraints.

B-SENS is a Belgian company specialized in the development of OEM sensors based on two technologies, optical fibers and semiconductors. Its unique expertise lies in the design and development of physical and (bio)chemical sensors.
Optical fiber gratings yield miniaturized sensors that can be distributed, remotely monitored or inserted into small spaces, allowing their use in numerous fields. Their association with a specific sensitive layer reveals their most ground-breaking nature, opening the way to in situ (bio)chemical and physical sensing and offering new capabilities of sensors deployment.
Semiconductors yield miniaturized sensors as well. They behave as point sensors and are particularly relevant for IoT-based developments.

entityName: OBLIQUE MANEUVER - UNIPESSOAL LDA - ViBo Health
description: Despite all the wearables and related devices available to consumers, they don’t really know if they are reaching goals to improve their health conditions, wellness, fitness, nutrition, and recovery. The problem is that simply tracking vitals like pulse and movement don’t get at our underlying health states. Repeated blood tests and other invasive lab diagnostics can produce more clarity, but with associated cost, pain, and inconvenience. ViBo Health solves this problem by directly, non-invasively, measuring key blood and tissue biomarkers. We are developing a table-top metabolite scanner to help everyone track their health with actionable guidance provided on a dashboard. Using ESA technology to enhance the sensitivity of magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) antenna, makes this approach viable. Our dashboard will provide an overall health score that can be easily tracked, and metrics for health states like cholesterol, obesity factors, glucose, fitness & recovery condition, even cardiac biomarkers.
entityDescription: Smart health tracking starts with ViBo Health — we are creating a world where everyone can track their health status using a quick and painless wrist scan. Users receive actionable information on their direct and relevant metabolic measurements. Our goal is to transform healthcare to be truly personalized, precise, and predictive. We do this through non-invasive molecular spectroscopy (using advanced NMR) that customers can use daily, weekly, or whenever convenient. The ViBo Health Scanner will be a table-top device for high traffic locations like gyms or pharmacies. A health dashboard app will help our clients visualize and understand the results after each scan. ViBo Health Scanners are designed to acquire causal health insights through metabolomics, including vitamins, cholesterols, and diabetes parameters, giving deep insights and trends into health, wellness and fitness.

entityDescription:
NorthStar seeks to empower humanity to preserve our planet through a unique Space and Earth information & intelligence platform using space-based sensors. NorthStar strives to help transform the way governments, industry and institutions assess risk, enforce regulations and make decisions to foster the sustainable development of our planet and deliver a safe and secure near-Earth environment.
NorthStar's unique space-based commercial Space Situational Awareness products address many of the critical and immediate challenges facing all satellite operators. With a comprehensive view of all near-Earth orbits, NorthStar's satellites will deliver more frequent and precise observations of resident space objects than any current system. Through a suite of high-speed decision quality information services derived from its unparalleled coverage, object custody, and enhanced predictive analytics NorthStar generates its Space Information & Intelligence (Si2) services.
The Company is managed by a Board of Managers (which is vested with the broadest powers to act in the name of the Company and to take any actions necessary or useful to fulfil the Company's corporate purpose) composed of:
- Stewart Bain, as manager;
- Blazej Gladysz-Lehmann, as manager;
- Etienne Schneider, as manager.
Decisions are taken by a majority of the managers. Moreover, Board meetings are held or initiated in Luxembourg with the majority of the Board members being in Luxembourg for those Board meetings. The managers are appointed by the general meeting of shareholders (mother company in Canada).

With its innovative business model, of modular education system, CIIM has access and active cooperation with some of the best professors from around the world and works with them for both academic as well as vocational programmes putting great value in its activities and drawing the best talent and experiences from a truly international market. It offers consulting activities, as well as mentoring/coaching to collaborators and develops educational as well as research programs with partners in different countries that often are financed by European grant schemes with excellent experience in grant/fund as well as project management.

With its involvement in start-up hubs and incubators either as co-founders or simply as educators, CIIM and its staff are heavily implicated in the design, delivery and evaluation of programmes of vocational training while it recruits over 250 new students/yr in its Executive Masters’ Degrees and has at any given period more than 500 active students.
The institution is currently managed by ms. Ioanna Panayiotou the ex-Commissioner for the Environment of the Republic of Cyprus and Dr. Theodore Panayotou, 2007 NOBEL Peace Prize Contributor. entityDescription:
BLACKPIN is a business app made and hosted in Germany for communication in an absolutely encrypted and closed system, in which data is communicated, exchanged and archived. It is a knowledgesharing tool, which enables users to work faster and more effectively with colleagues, customers and partners. The communication is completely encrypted, and the archiving is based on certified highest German standards, as there is no comparable app on the market.

Looking at the development in the C2C area (the huge success of Whatsapp), there is an immense need for communication via mobile devices. But the use of Whatsapp in the B2B area is highly critical according to German/Europeen data protection standards (DSGVO). Nevertheless, Whatsapp is used there today for lack of alternatives, secure solutions are missing on the market. BLACKPIN closes this gap with an secure solution. In this way, knowledge is bundled and protected in one place, and not on the end devices. Access to this data is only determined by the data owner. In the age of agile working methods, we want to ensure a comprehensive transfer know-how, knowledge exchange within and outside companies and organisations.

entityName: Research for Science Art and Technology (RFSAT) Limited
entityDescription:
RFSAT Limited is a non-profit research-performing SME, legally established in the Republic of Ireland since 2018. It has also research office in Athens (Greece). Its UK offices have closed as of the 17thof August 2020
Its activities focus on research and development through national and international research funding, as well as industrial consultancy. RFSAT focuses its current activities on funded research activities on national levels as well as in European Research Frameworkprograms, including Horizon'2020 Framework, COST Actions, Media Europe Program and other ones. The list of research and development activities includes hybrid indoor (wireless) and outdoor (GNSS with assisted and differential variants) positioning and localisation systems, Geographical Information Systems (GIS), networked audio-visual systems, Virtual and Augmented Reality systems, mixed-reality user interfaces for gaming and entertainment, autonomous systems (UAS, UGV and UUV) for safety critical applications such as Critical Infrastructure (CI) protection, Cyber-Physical security systems, Machine Learning and Cognitive Artificial Intelligence (AI), Future Internet and 5G Mobile Communications etc. RFSAT has been strongly investing and successfully exploiting its enabling technologies in e-Health, Smart Energy/Metering application areas. Most recent work includes projects in security where research activities concentrate on autonomous day/night surveillance, area modelling(2D and 3D) and micro-embedded environmental sensing usingmicro-UAV/UAS aerial platforms for e.g. Cultural Heritage protection against natural disasters and negative effects of Climate Change.
In 2009 RFSAT has established aMedia Technologies for Arts and Culturegroup aimed at applying company's technologies in all aspects of Performing Arts and Entertainment, from Theatre and Dance to Multimedia Performances, Future Cinema beyond HD, 3D immersive television and future gaming. In this context RFSAT targets future entertainment without disregarding potential application for e-Education, e-Entertainment, e-Tourism, e-Health and other areas. Its most recent activities focus on promotion of technology transfer to Performing Arts for the benefit of the Artistic communities, some of those partly funded from the Media Europe Program.
RFSAT is currently strongly investing in Horizon 2020 funded research activities in the areas of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) in application areas of Smart Energy, e-Health systems, Secure Societies, Environmental Monitoring, Mobility services,Future Internet and Multi-Modal Transport. RFSAT participates actively in European, international and industrial research and development activities being a partner of several R&D Projects funded by the European Commission through its FP7,COST and Horizon'2020 programs. RFSAT Limited is also a Member of several European Technology Platforms (ETP), Industrial Associations, Special Interest Groups (SIG), Standardisation bodies and Strategic Alliances.

Bitrezus P.C. is a spacetech startup based in Athens, Greece and is a new incubatee at ESA BIC Greece (4/2021) and focusing on cybersecurity for the Space Industry. Our solution, Astropledge, reduces the risk of cyberattacks against space assets, using a combination of embedded H/W and blockchain technology to create an extra level of security; We enable critical opcode consensus in real-time, among untrusted partners, for resilient and cyber-proof operation of both space and ground infrastructure. 
Our Vision is to be able to evolve Astropledge solution to become a central component for intelligent diagnosis and self-healing of the software and firmware existing in the components and subsystems of the space asset that are vital for its operation. 
We are interested in establishing partnerships and collaborative relationships with Primes, SME and startup companies to explore needs and create innovative products for a cyber-proof and resilient planet.

entityDescription:
Omniais a Cyprus-based innovation and consulting organisation operating at the intersection of geospatial intelligence, big data analytics, Earth Observation, and strategic business development. The organisation supports public institutions, research organisations, SMEs, and international consortia in transforming complex data into operational intelligence, strategic insight, and measurable impact.
Omnia’s core areas of expertise include:
Geospatial intelligence (GEOINT), GIS, and spatial data infrastructure
Earth Observation and satellite-based applications for environmental and territorial monitoring
Big data analytics, AI-driven decision support, and data visualisation
Space-sector consulting and downstream exploitation of Copernicus and satellite technologies
Smart cities, climate resilience, sustainability, and digital transformation strategies
Research and innovation project development within European and international programmes
Capacity building, executive education, and specialised business training programmes
Through a multidisciplinary approach combining technology, analytics, and strategic consulting, Omnia delivers tailored solutions that enable organisations to improve operational efficiency, strengthen evidence-based decision-making, and accelerate innovation adoption. The organisation has particular expertise in translating advanced geospatial and space technologies into practical applications across sectors such as environment, agriculture, mobility, energy, regional planning, and public governance. In addition to its technical and advisory activities, Omnia develops and delivers high-level training and knowledge-transfer initiatives focused on digital innovation, entrepreneurship, sustainability, and emerging technologies.

entityDescription:
Code Magus Limited (CML) is a company that specialises in the IT system testing arena. CML has a team of expert professionals who have focused skills and experience in application and environment testing and can complement project teams to provide these necessary and complex skills, experience, and tools to ensure that projects are delivered as expected. With specific focus on the financial services industry, the CML suite of testing applications has been expanded to include banking specific requirements and is aligned with banking association standards. Code Magus Limited is able to deliver: 
- Consulting Services and Solution Development
- The CML Toolset
- Testing - Functional and Regression Testing
- Non-functional testing
- Automated Functional Testing

- Training and Post Implementation services
- Consulting Services and Solution Development

The CML team, with the use of the CML tools suite are able to provide consulting services for: 
- Solutions research. Analysing customer requirements and performing proof of concept on technology solutions
- Analysing test strategies, plans, cases and data and provide insightful recommendations based on results.
- Establishing and documenting test strategies
- Analysing real-time performance measurement of existing systems and propose recommendations.
- Problem solving and firefighting in crucial situations.

In addition, CML has the resources and tools to complement your existing team when time and deliverables are critical to the completion of a project. We are able to we are able to apply our tools to support any testing requirements that clients are not able to support themselves. This is especially apparent within the automated testing environment where difficulties often arise because of technology, interfaces, security and complexity. 
CML is able to supply deeply technical cross platform/technology, and full stack skills for these services. Areas of expertise includes, z/OS, CICS, IMS, z/OS DB2, Windows, AIX, UDB, Oracle, Solaris, Linux (i386, x86_64, zSeries, Power/PowerLinux). These skills have been applied to all types of situations including difficult machine dump analysis, intermittent I/O errors, link capacity problems, remote replication problems with specific platform experience in wintel, AIX/Linux/Solaris/ and zSeries. 
An example of where CML has successfully consulted to clients is on protocol conversion, migration strategies and management for the migration of systems off legacy protocols and integration into existing systems. Specifically, this was a protocol conversion of X.25 POS traffic to TCP/IP. This solution included the conversion, termination and end-to-end protection of sessions across various networks as well as the post implementation monitoring, reporting, alerting and analysis of traffic. 
We have specific experience in the Financial Services Sector proving testing strategies, tools and resources for non-functional and functional testing projects. Our monitoring tools are used to monitor high-volume, high-availability, high-risk financial systems with 24/7 availability year on year. We have in-depth skill and experience with financial systems such as CAMS, HOGAN, Postilion and Umbrella. CML has established lasting partnerships with our clients and strives to become a source of expertise and services but also to enable our partners through skills transfer and training.

description:
Spaceclick is an emerging 'New Space' company engaged in research and development for cutting-edge information technology (IT) hardware (HW) and software (SW) solutions. Main business lines cover the development of technology and solutions in support to training for space and space science operations, and application of these solutions to utilization on Earth, with a focus on public and scientific community engagement.

The company relies on the experience acquired by founders and collaborators for the development and management of IT projects in international environments, as well as the experience gained in defining, operating, and supporting projects for field astronaut training campaigns, while working with ESA under different frameworks. Members of Spaceclick, have experience in investigation and production of novel integrated software systems and hardware prototypes, tailored to specific customers’ needs, always guaranteeing a high professionalism while supplying technologies and providing training to customers with high level requirements. The method in use by Spaceclick involves Agile, DevOps and Concurrent Engineering. Coupling strategic and requirement analysis to software, telecommunications, electronics, optical, mechanical, automation, aerospace engineering, and to other scientific disciplines such as environmental sciences, economics, and planetary geology. Involving all disciplines’ perspectives in parallel emphasizes the response to customer expectations, maximises the return in terms of quality, and leads to shorter time-to-prototype or time-to-market.

Additional services Spaceclick provides commercially are related to generic IT consultancy, cross platform software and web development, design of cloud infrastructures, applied Machine Learning (ML) and Internet of Things (IoT), CAD and electronics prototyping design. Also, the production and marketing of big-data platforms for the aggregate analysis of data, and supported by software using artificial intelligence.
We aim to propose a space intelligence platform for supporting commercial Lunar missions, we are building an innovative set of tools for the collection, exchange, visualization of structured information from any remote environment, even extreme, for both terrestrial and space applications, including specific optimization algorithms for enhancement of mission operations, and derived from our field tests experience. The development and implementation of the services deriving from such software and hardware platforms, will contribute to supporting scientific research, scientific expeditions, Earth Observation, and as well to the development of innovative space applications in support of the 'new space economy'.

Neural Concept is a Swiss-based company that offers the first-ever deep learning-based software solution dedicated to Computer Aided Engineering and Design. 
Neural Concept Shape (NCS) is a unique Deep Learning based-software for enhanced engineering. It leverages on industrial CAE data to efficiently assist engineers during the product design stage. 

NCS’s engine cuts simulation times to milliseconds. Therefore, it can be used as complements to the traditional numerical simulation and experimental methods so as to alleviate the need for actual simulations or to avoid iterations between design, simulation and measurement teams. This dramatically accelerates and reduces the cost of the design process. NCS’s algorithms can also learn to generate new geometries that engineers may not have previously considered, allowing to reach unprecedented levels of performance and providing an intuitive approach to product design.

entityName: ESPCI Paris - ECOLE SUPERIEURE DE PHYSIQUE ET DE CHIMIE INDUSTRIELLES DE LA VILLE DE PARIS
entityDescription:
ESPCI is a leading French “Grande Ecole” founded in 1882, educating undergraduate and graduate students through a programme merging basic science and engineering, as well as a world-renowned research institution. ESPCI Paris was founded in 1882 by the Paris City Council; its legal status changed on January 1, 2006, and it now operates as an autonomous municipal administrative corporation (a Régie autonome, in French). ESPCI Paris has set up a tradition of excellence in research, with distinguished faculty that have contributed to its history, such as Pierre and Marie Curie, Paul Langevin, Frédéric Joliot-Curie, Pierre-Gilles de Gennes and Georges Charpak. The five Nobel laureates in this list are emblematic of the exceptional ethos embodied in the permanent culture of excellence at ESPCI Paris. 

ESPCI Paris hosts 9 research units, all associated to CNRS and/or INSERM and/or other Parisian Universities in the form of joined research units, covering the fields of physics, chemistry and biology. Favouring interdisciplinary, and operating at the frontiers between fundamental research and innovation, are two major objectives of ESPCI Paris. This is achieved through a flexible organisation (without departments) that ensures a cross fertilization between scientific disciplines, as well as a direct connection between basic science and applications. One of ESPCI’s distinctive features is that it carries out fundamental research into areas of major interest to industry, while developing various approaches to practical industrial problems through the deep, fundamental understanding of the mechanisms at play. Performing fundamental research while keeping an eye on applications enables ESPCI research scientists to make an impact at multiple levels.
Scientists at ESPCI Paris publish more than one scientific paper a day, and at the same time apply for one patent a week and create several technology-driven start-ups every year - over the last 10 years.
ESPCI is also a part of Paris Science et Lettres (PSL) Research University – an ambitious collaboration project of 26 research institutions in a broad range of disciplines from engineering, chemistry and oncology to economics, management, the humanities and the performing arts.
