PM_TEN could supply advisory services and environmental analysis focusing on meteorological, weather, sea and air quality assessments, environmental impacts studies, designing and implementation of atmospheric monitoring campaigns and compositional analysis of atmospheric particulate. 
Thanks to its marked innovation attitude, it could develop specific methodologies for atmospheric pollution assessment, mathematical models describing complex processes and software implementing them. Moreover, PM_TEN designs and develops innovative instruments and components for air quality analysis. In this context, recently a sequential PMx sampler has been developed (according to EN12341:2014), filing a patent application (Giano BC1 project). 
Among its competences, the technical assistance to companies concerning the whole process to prepare and manage European financed project proposals (Horizon Europe, Interreg, LIFE, etc...) can be counted, offering support in problem solving and project building also through Lego Serious Play workshops design. 
Recently, thanks to two regional funds (POR ERDF 2014-2020) devoted to complex R&D projects, PM_TEN has developed a Sea Situational Awareness system, called SINDBAD, in partnership with On Air S.r.l. and Xedum S.r.l, able to supply integrated sea and weather services such as navigation support, risk and comfort assessment in the Ligurian Sea and soon for Mediterranean Sea, for pleasure navigation. In 2020, PM_TEN, On Air and Xedum have founded the Sindbad Consortium with commercial distribution aims to develop new field applications (fishery, aquaculture, etc...) 
In addition, PM_TEN has strong scientific relationships with universities and research centres, university spin-off, public authorities and many companies. It is a member of the consortium TICASS, managing body of the Research and Innovation Hub for Energy, Environment and Sustainable Development, and of the consortium TECNOMAR LIGURIA, managing the “Distretto Ligure Tecnologie Marine” (DLTM).

entityDescription:
Problem: Local actors want to communicate with their target audience near them but have to master the GAFAM’s algorithms. Communication is time-consuming and there is no guarantee of success for their call-to-action as users' attention is constantly drawn to new messages. Doomscrolling is the basis of the dominant business model of social networks, one notification chasing another. Their communication is not central and they have only partial control over its visibility through advertising and SEO. Algorithms control the flow of information and decide what is true or not.

Wharn is a digital platform that intuitively answers the questions What, Where and When by offering local stakeholders the possibility to place their communication on an interactive map thanks to geolocation.

Wharn is accessible in one click for citizens and visitors who have intuitive access to everything that is happening in their neighborhood. Geolocation avoids the "digital bin" effect caused by social network algorithms because the appearance of objects depends on the proximity of the event to the connected person. Wharn’s search engine depends also on geolocation and tags without keeping user’s search history.

Wharn is controllable and partially decentralised; local actors authorised by the client authority can place their logo and agenda on the map. The input of data can be automated. A local cultural center will therefore not have to copy its future events to appear on Wharn.

Wharn is easy to use. No technical knowledge is required, only 4 fields need to be filled in to insert objects on the map for authorised users.Wharn respects the privacy of its users. Our business model is based on an annual subscription from public authorities for its entire territory and does not collect any user data. Citizens can use it without registration.

Find concrete examples on Escp022 (European capital of culture in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg) visible via https://app.wharn.com/ in desktop version (Wharn mobile in App).

9T Labs is a spin-off from ETH Zürich founded in 2018 by a team of pioneers, passionate about bringing the next generation of high performance manufacturing. Ee aspire to mass-produce high-performance composites as easily as metals. We do this by automating and digitizing the production workflow of composite production at the most innovative companies.

As the producer and seller of a comprehensive solution for the serial manufacturing of parts made of carbon fiber composites, 9T Labs sets new standards regarding quality, reproducibility, lightness and performance.
The Red Series® solution consists of the Fibrify®software to define the optimal fiber design, a Build Module (3D-printer) to create the fiber layup and a Fusion Module to finally fulfill the required consolidation quality. This unique additive fusion technology setup is a game changer. It allows industrial companies to manufacture continuous fiber composites in high volumes that outperform traditional metal parts in many ways. In addition, the 9T Labs technology goes beyond established solutions in making sustainable development and environmental goals a reality. It empowers engineers to create a green and circular manufacturing footprint. 9T Labs received the Solar Impulse Foundation Efficient Solution Label for its achievements.

entityName: COUNTERFOG EBT DE LA UAH, S.L.
entityDescription:
COUNTERFOG EBT DE LA UAH SL is a spin-off company of Universidad de Alcalá. In 2013 a team led by professor Pérez-Díaz was granted by the Seventh Framework Program of the European Commission to research on aerosol and fog dynamics and to develop a technology to decontaminate chemical, biological, and radiological and nuclear agents in air and surfaces. A consortium of 10 institutions from Spain, the United Kingdom, Germany, the Czech Republic, Bulgaria, and Sweden built a Fog Dynamics Laboratory and created Counterfog®. A unique technology that creates a dynamical cone of fog that scavenges air-borne particulate matter including smoke, powder, and any kind of aerosols.

Counterfog® demonstrated to provide a rapid, cheap, and large-scale response for collapsing all kinds of air-borne dispersed agents –including Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear agents as well as other air-borne micro-particles like those in smoke. Counterfog® nozzles create aconical jet of fog made of nanometric droplets that collapse and catch air-borne micrometric particles and pollutants. It was demonstrated to be effective against aerosols of Bacillus thuringiensis and their spores -a surrogate of Bacillus Anthracis-.Moreover, 99.99% effectivenesswas demonstrated after 1 minute of Counterfog® application. In summary, the Counterfog® applications are:

Covid Disinfection: Counterfog® technology traps viruses with micro-droplets of water, aggregating and precipitating them to the soil, where they can be properly treated.

entityDescription: One of the main obstacles in satellite imagery is the presence of clouds, which limits the capability to make observations and ultimately to take optimal decisions – especially in missions with long revisit times. ClearSky Vision addresses these problems by integrating data from various missions (Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-3, and more) and using a novel neural network architecture to predict urban and landscape changes underneath cloud cover. This will allow for more consistent and frequent retrieval of multi-spectral cloudless satellite imagery and indices that are crucial to improved time-series analysis and anomaly detection. This is particularly beneficial within agriculture, natural disasters, and environmental monitoring. We utilize data from transparent clouds, partly cloudy images, and historical data to predict the most up-to-date cloudless satellite image possible.

entityDescription:
Vistory is a new-generation industrial equipment manufacturer, specialising in the production of dedicated MOC equipment, which has developed a global framework to enable the scaling of distributed production, making this industrial innovation accessible to all.
Initially, Vistory's only activity was software development, focusing on cybersecurity, the cloud and blockchain. As part of its software activities, Vistory created a revolutionary secure control system: MainChain, a solution dedicated to dematerialised and decentralised production and, in particular, to additive manufacturing. MainChain has been designed as an "all-in-one" tool: it connects all the parties and tools involved in 3D printing (client, IP rights holder, 3D printing printer and its operator), and it automates all steps of the order (catalogue of parts, launch and monitoring of production, invoicing, quality control management, etc.). Above all, MainChain offers data protection and full traceability of assets and operations, giving IP rights holders total control over their IP - with no risk of theft, alteration or misappropriation. MainChain is the world 1st blockchain operated in overseas operations.
The expertise and experience gained by Vistory in the field of additive manufacturing over the last few years thanks to MainChain, has led it to develop additive manufacturing services as well as offers combining our skills in software and additive manufacturing. At the core of these new offers, there are our Mobile Clinics, a complete and autonomous 3D printing ecosystem, operated via MainChain, that is transportable, modular, connected and secure.
As a result, Vistory has gradually become an industrial systems integrator and a key player in Industry 4.0.

entityDescription:
Latvia University of Life Sciences and Technologies (previously called Latvia University of Agriculture) (hereinafter LLU) is the state founded multi-profile higher education and research institution under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, specializing in the sustainable use of natural resources aimed at the enhancement of quality of life for society.
LLU is a multi-disciplinary university with 3845 students (2019). The number of academic staff is 213, the number of leading researchers and researchers is 280. There are 8 faculties, 60 study programmes of various levels. The total budget of the university is 33.89 million EUR (2019), out of which 11.68 million EUR are allocated for the research and development and 13.42 million EUR for development of the infrastructure.
 
LLU provides higher academic and higher professional education in agriculture, veterinary medicine, food technology, engineering and forestry sciences, social science, information technologies and environmental management and develops research-based learning opportunities.
The mission of LLU is to develop competitive intellectual capital on the basis of excellence in research, application of research findings, high quality of education and effective management of the university. LLU implements research activities in the directions of Life Sciences, Engineering and technology, as well as Social sciences. LLU specialization is based on the university knowledge and competence in usage of biotic and abiotic nature resources. Research for bioeconomy and circular economy is at the focus of LLU. Multidisciplinary approach is applied at the each single stage of the bioeconomy and circular economy and research direction, providing results, which altogether lead towards novel, interdisciplinary developed solutions.
LLU has experience in management and implementation of various national, international and EU programme research, development, education and innovation projects. Local, regional and international cooperation is established with universities, scientific institutes, centres of technology transfer and SMEs since LLU is a member of different regional and international co-operation networks. Thus LLU has profound experience with remarkable results in implementing research, development, communication and innovation projects.
 
For more information about LLU look at www.llu.lv/en.

entityDescription:
Since the beginning of 2017, Fraunhofer IME has comprised the divisions of Molecular Biotechnology, Applied Ecology and Bioresources. Fraunhofer IME is a strong partnerfor contract research in the areas ofagriculture, chemistry, environmental and consumer protection, as well as pharmacy and medicine. Our interdisciplinary organization allows us to process complex projects across departments and where appropriate, also focuses on cooperation with external institutes and partners. We work closely with basic research and are internationally networked. Our laboratories with state-of-the-art equipment and complex environmental simulation facilities allow us to offer a wide range of research and services as well as studies according to good laboratory practice (GLP).
The institute has more than 400 employees working at the locations Schmallenberg, Aachen, Münster, and Gießen. We have close ties with the Department of Biology and Biotechnology of Plants at the University of Münster, the Department of Applied Entomology at the Justus-Liebig University Gießen, and the world’s first Institute for Insect Biotechnology, founded in Gießen in 2016. We cooperate with many international research partners and remain in close contact with universities and other re­search organizations. Our aim is to recog­nize trends and developments as they emerge, and to develop and implement novel research strategies and technologies.
Within the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft we have close co-operations with the other institutes of the Fraunhofer Group for Resource Technologies and Bioeconomy, the Fraunhofer Alliances Food Chain Management, and other Fraunhofer institutes. We also contribute our expertise to the High Performance Center Networked Adaptive Production Service and the Fraunhofer Sustainability Network.

Our Research:

entityDescription:
GRNET S.A. – National Infrastructures for Research and Technology, operating since 1998, is one of the largest public sector technology companies in Greece. Since August 2019 operates under the auspices of the Ministry of Digital Governance.
GRNET provides networking, cloud computing, HPC, data management services and e-Infrastructures and services to academic and research institutions, to educational bodies at all levels, and to all agencies of the public sector.
GRNET holds a key role as the coordinator of all e-infrastructures in Education and Research. With more than twenty years of specialized experience, GRNET advises the Ministry of Digital Governance on issues relating to the design of advanced information systems,e-Infrastructures and services. GRNET contributes to the country’s Digital Transformation via in-depth analysis, technological studies, standard solutions and specialized know-how, serving hundreds of thousands of users on a daily basis in the strategic fields of Public Administration, Education, Research, Health and Culture.
It is responsible for promoting and disseminating network and computing technologies and applications, as well as for promoting and implementing Greece’s Digital Transformation goals and policy. GRNET leverages the national educational and research activity, striving towards the development of applied and technological research in the fields of telecommunication networks and computing services.
It designs, develops and maintains advanced computer & networking infrastructures and services, data centers, a nation-wide fiber optic network and a high-performance computer system (HPC-ARIS).Key current initiative highlights includethe operation of theNational Competence Center for HPC (EuroCC@Greece)and theoperation, development and promotion of theNational Academy of Digital Skills.
GRNET also coordinates and participates in Open Science projects, and is involved in the formulation of the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy.Also, it is the Euro QCI (Quantum Communication Infrastructure) nationalrepresentative.
GRNET develops synergies with other agencies which provide digital services in the Greek public sector, by sharing best practices and know-how on advanced information systems. It providesinternational interconnection through the pan-European GÉANTnetwork, and is the National Research and Education Network(NREN).
It manages the Greek Internet Exchange (GR-IX), the national infrastructure that interconnects the most important internet companies activating in Greece (e.g. internet service providers, cloud, hosting, VoIP, etc.).

entityName: ISSP UL - Laboratory of Visual Perception
description:
Our main research areas include: the optical quality of different optical systems including a human; the optical properties of materials used in the vision science; various light sources and their influence on visual perception. 
For ESA we offer the following technology: a novel coded diffraction based phase retrieval wavefront sensor called "MATX" which is an adaptive optics kit/system. It was a result of 3 year EU funder R&D project.
Applications:
- Free space optical communications. 
In 2021 we signed contract with ESA for a Type A - Feasibility study to test & validate the application potential of our MATX sensor for ground to satellite optical communications. With potential to improve or substitute existing wavefront sensor methods currently used. 
- Space debris tracking. 
- Astronomy. 
More information about our laboratory can be found here>>
entityDescription:
Research aress of the Laboratory of Visual Perception include: the optical quality of different optical systems including a human; the optical properties of materials used in the vision science; various light sources and their influence on visual perception. In the laboratory, various visual stimuli for studies on visual psychophysics are designed. The laboratory connects together materials science, vision science, adaptive optics and optometry.
Currently, studies on how to reduce the influence of vitreous floaters on visual perception are carried out. These floaters are a widespread entoptic phenomenon. In the Laboratory of Visual Perception, research in aberrometry is also going on. The goal of this research is design a new type of wavefront sensor that has advantages over the current solutions. Innovative light sources are also studied and customized to seasonal chanes in illumination.

Also new EU funded project in Adaptive Optics (AO) is in progress. The aim of the project is to develop and commercialize novel wavefront sensors for correction of optical media turbidity for application with adaptive optics systems. The new type of optical sensor is based on the encoded diffraction structure method, which uses numerical algorithms to evaluate the phase of wavefront. Potential applications include astronomy (solar system & deep space observations), free space optical communications & space debris tracking.

entityName: DUBLIN INST FOR ADVANCED STUDIES - DIAS
description: The Dublin Institute for Advanced Studies (DIAS) (www.dias.ie)conducts advanced research exploring big questions of the 21st century and beyond. Its research gains insights into Celtic society and its legacy; progresses our understanding of our island, our planet and the universe; and deciphers the underpinning mathematical principles of nature. DIAS Dunsink Observatory is a designated European site of historical significance for physics.
entityDescription: The Dublin Institute for Advanced Studies is a statutory corporation established in 1940 under the Institute for Advanced Studies Act of that year. It is a publicly-funded independent centre for research in basic disciplines. The Institute has three constituent schools - The School of Celtic Studies, The School of Theoretical Physics and The School of Cosmic Physics (with two sections - The Astronomy and Astrophysics Section, and The Geophysics Section). Each School has an independent Governing Board. The Institute, through the constituent Schools, pursues fundamental research in specialised branches of knowledge and trains advanced students in methods of original research. The institute is an academic publisher of monographs, books, and journals in Celtic Studies and on advanced scientific subjects. The Council consists of a Chairman appointed by the President, on the advice of the Government, three ex-officio members and six members appointed by the governing boards of the constituent schools. The institute is financed by an annual grant from the state.

entityDescription:
Arup is an independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants and technical specialists offering a broad range of professional services.
 
We aim to help our clients meet their business needs by adding value through technical excellence, efficient organisation and personal service.
 
We provide the engineering and related consultancy services necessary to every stage of the project, from inception to completion and after. These are available to clients singly or in combination, to suit the particular circumstance of the job.
 
Throughout the world we aim to provide a consistently excellent multi-disciplinary service, which also incorporates our concern for the environment. Arup is committed to sustainable design, to its increasing incorporation in our projects and to industry-wide sustainability initiatives.
 
Founded in 1946, Arup now has more than 15,000 people working in 89 offices in 33 countries and our projects have taken us to more than 160 countries.
 
Arup is a wholly independent organisation owned in trust for the benefit of its employees and their dependants.
 
With no shareholders or external investors the firm is able to independently determine its own priorities and direction as a business. 
 
Each of Arup's employees receives a share of the firm's operating profit each year.
 
A substantial proportion of the firm's income is devoted to improving its technical standards through the continuing professional development of its members and by developing new techniques of engineering design and management.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Arup Group's policy is set by its Group Board. This body reports to the firm's Trustees and to the firm itself, represented by the global college of directors and principals.
 
Arup operates as five Regions: Americas, Australasia, East Asia, Europe, and UK, India, Middle East and Africa (UKIMEA). Each Region is responsible for geographic strategy and management.
 
Each project is the responsibility of a Project Director who has access to specialist skills within the firm, whether those skills are in the project office or elsewhere.
 
We work in multi-disciplinary teams to ensure co-ordination between the disciplines. We operate formal quality management systems, routinely reviewing and auditing our work. We structure our project teams to achieve clear lines of responsibility and communication with the client and other consultants. By these measures, we add value to our clients’ projects and achieve quality on which they can rely.

entityDescription: The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a mission-driven Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that develops advanced technologies and delivers innovative products and services to industry and society. As a major engine of the diversification and growth of Luxembourg’s economy through innovation, LIST supports the deployment of a number of solutions to a wide range of sectors, including energy, IT, telecommunications, environment, agriculture, and advanced manufacturing at national and European level. Thanks to its location in an exceptional collaborative environment, namely the Belval Innovation Campus, LIST accelerates time to market by maximizing synergies with different actors, including the university, the national funding agency and industrial clusters. The overall objective of the LIST is to turn knowledge into technologies and to develop innovative solutions to improve the quality of life of our Luxembourg and European citizens, and create business opportunities for Luxembourg companies. In this context, LIST missions are: - to develop research excellence and capability to provide a set of building block technologies in broad range of applications. - To support the efforts of the Luxembourg government to diversify the economy through active participation in socio-economic development of the Grand Duchy, - to act as a catalyst in the development of the innovation ecosystem in Luxembourg - to offer innovative and competitive solutions to meet key needs of different economic actors in Luxembourg and Europe, - to support the competitiveness of the Luxembourg ecosystem by creating value for public and private partners.

entityDescription:
Topnetwork S.p.A. is an IT company, with private capital, operating in the field of ICT (Information and Communication Technology) through the provision of services, products and solutions both in traditional IT sectors (ERP, CRM, Business Intelligence, Data-warehouse, GIS, etc.) and in modern technological areas (Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, IoT, Cloud, Fintech, Blockchain, Cyber-security, Virtual Reality, etc.). 

With a staff of about 500 professionals (mostly permanent employees), distributed among 5 offices in Italy (Rome, Naples, Milan, Genoa, Agrigento), Topnetwork achieved an average revenue in the last five years of about 29 million Euros. 

Topnetwork has a research laboratory dedicated to Artificial Intelligence, which combines statistical, mathematical and IT knowledge to develop machine learning algorithms in different areas, such as IoT, security, monitoring, search and rescue, resource and infrastructure management, environment, health, aerospace engineering, robotics. 

The company has the following certifications: ISO 9001, ISO/IEC-20000, ISO/IEC-2700, ISO-14001. 

The services offered to customers include project management, business consulting, system design, software development, system integration, system management, service management, training.

Topnetwork main customers are: Acea, Aeroporti di Roma, Alfasigma, Bank of Italy, Municipality of Syracuse, Enel, Lukoil Group in Italy, IBM Italia Spa, Invitalia, Leonardo, Metropolitana Milanese Spa, Ministry of Justice, Municipality of Syracuse, Municipality of Agrigento, Cristo Re Hospital, Octo-Telematics, Poste Italiane, SACE, Save the Children Italia Onlus, Senate of the Republic, Real Estate Administrative Services, Telecom Italia Sparkle, TIM, University of Bologna.

description: BBT-Materials Processing Ltd. is a small private technological company dedicated to development and production of high performance IR birefringent optics and Acousto-Optical components for a wide range of applications. The company is a worldwide leader in crystal growth and processing of high purity Calomel (mercurous chloride) crystals applied in mid-IR and LWIR optics. entityDescription:
Teseo was established in 1978 by a group of researchers and engineers who brought to the new company vast experience in the design of electronic equipment, signal processing and measurements. Their skills were soon employed in the development of fibre optics based equipment for EMC testing. A niche market in which Teseo has played a primary role for 30 years. The expertise in designing products, managing obsolescence over decades and tailoring them to meet customers’ needs where needed is a key feature of the company.

Teseo today
Today Teseo is the Italian subsidiary of Clemessy, which belongs to the Eiffage Group, acts as its centre of expertise for radiofrequency, fibre optics and electronics applications. 
Structured into three business units, Teseo is recognised as a highly qualified system integrator specialising in providing test solutions to a wide range of industries from aerospace & defense to automotive and transportation, from telecommunications to medical and from electronics to energy.
The three business units are:
1. Teseo Systems, which provides turn-key solutions in two main areas: (a) test equipment and world class manufacturing tools, and (b) IoT and embedded systems, RF/telemetry applications
2. Teseo RF-EMC-EMI solutions and products, including fibre optic links and amplifiers
3. Teseo Services which range from RF-EMC testing to preventive maintenance and calibration, including corrective maintenance and obsolescence management in coordination with the engineering department.

Quality is naturally a key competitive factor and is reflected in the ISO9001:2015, ISO9100:2018, AER-Q2110 and ISO17025:2005 certifications for Calibration laboratory and EMC laboratory, in addition to several other customer qualifications obtained.

entityDescription:
Quarticle is a young and innovative company founded to revolutionize the GIS solution market by developing client-tailored products that use technologies at the intersection between Geoinformatics, Cloud Computing and Remote Sensing. Another unique advantage of Quarticle products is their ability to run any Open-Source GeoServer as-a-Service in the client’s preferred Environment, e.g. own Cloud, Public, Private or Hybrid. Our team members have extensive previous experience developing outstanding products for companies like Swiss Re, Oracle, HPE, Google and ESRI. At Quarticle, we have managed to design and build the fastest geointelligence engine for the most demanding projects. We are specialized in Cloud Computing technologies, Software development and Geoinformatics.
 
The idea to start such a company came to Octavian Iercan (CEO) when connecting his experience at Google and other top employers with his observations as a researcher at several universities in Europe: Albert-Ludwig University of Freiburg (PhD), EPFL in Lausanne (Postdoc), and West University of Timisoara.
 
Quarticle was founded 3 years ago and has its development center in Western Transylvania (Arad/Timișoara).

entityName: FONDAZIONE LINKS LEADING INNOVATION & KNOWLEDGE FOR SOCIETY
description:
LINKS is a Foundation born from an agreement between Compagnia di San Paolo and Politecnico di Torino counting more than 160 researchers, a yearly turnaround of around 17M€, multiple collaborations with national and international Academies and Research Centers, a very strong presence in European and numerous collaborations with the business sector. 
Researchers at the Foundation master technical-scientific disciplines in several areas of engineering and architecture such as, for example, Artificial Intelligence, Smart Data, IoT, Photonics and Satellite Localization to carry out innovative projects in application sectors ranging from Industry 4.0 to Cybersecurity, from Intelligent Mobility to Agritech, from Space Applications to Medicine and Well Being, from Smart Cities to Cultural Heritage. 
Leveraging its research and innovation competences, with the goal of contributing to the growth of the socio-economic system, became the ambitious mission of LINKS, put in practice by working on large-scale projects with significant impact on the territory, and establishing a dialogue with the national and international entrepreneurial community with the goal of sharing and enhancing knowledge, experience and innovation.
entityDescription: LINKS Foundation is a non-profit Institution operating at a national and international level carrying out applied research in the sectors of engineering and architecture, thus focusing both on information and telecommunication and on territorial and environmental sciences. LINKS is aware of the high quality of human capital, which in recent years has grown up within the Istituto Superiore Mario Boella and SiTI, and whose innovation potential has been amplified thanks to the local and international networks which they own. LINKS aims at the constant improvement of the Foundation's staff that, along with methods and tools (start-up, IP, technological innovations), are pivotal for their integrated approach, to offer efficient and effective solutions to the increasingly complex and dynamic societal challenges. Our vision is to enhance collaborations between the world of research,start-ups, enterprises and Public Administrations, with the aim of optimizing the available economic resources, attracting talents and facilitating innovation in the ecosystem of Italian and international companies. Our mission is to boost the interaction between research and the business world towards the internationalization of the local socioeconomic system, promoting, conducting and strengthening innovation, research processes and the technology transfer We intend to enhance the impact of the connections created at the local level with a consequent increase of the competitiveness of our ecosystem. LINKS intends to serve as the primary reference point in Turin for the acceleration of the innovation, technology transfer and business development of companies, for the valorization from the local to the global geographical scale.

The ISM is built for autonomous, remote 24/7/365 outdoor operation including a wide suite of passive optical instruments available for the first time in such compact and easy to install package. Deployed in network, ISMs allow simultaneous survey of potential sites for FSO ground stations or solar power plants. entityDescription:
As of October 21, 2021, everis and NTT DATA integration has been consolidated and the two companies will be present on the market under a single brand.
everis joins the NTT DATA brand, strengthening its global presence and creating a new reality in Europe and Latin America: NTT DATA Europe and Latam, with 40,000 people in 25 countries and more than 15 Centers of Excellence employing over 2,600 NTT DATA personnel.
In Italy the group includes 5000 professionals, who are committed to build a unique and open community of people, driven by shared values with the aim of anticipating, with intelligence, the future in a unique collaborative environment, creative and generous, which allows the two realities to continue to grow together, as a community and as a company. The main objective of the group is to seize the opportunity to support the digital growth of our country and of the companies with which it collaborates, in Italy and abroad, generating even more synergies to address more important challenges, more innovative, inclusive, sustainable projects.
everis is a multinational company with HQ in Madrid that today employs more than 27,000 professionals located in 4 continents with a turnover of over 1.4 billion euros (year 2020). everis provides its clients with Business and Strategic Consulting, Application Development, Outsourcing and Application Maintenance services. 
At everis, thanks to years of consolidated experience in complex projects and services for the largest clients on the market, we have developed a framework of tools that allow us to optimally manage the service, as well as to homogenize and systematize the activities of each phase, to mitigate the risks of less structured services, when required by the client.
The organization is structured into Business Units organized into sectoral areas, which identify the markets served, and transversal service lines that support all sectoral areas). everis offers services to clients using highly specialized consultants who apply well-defined best practices derived from experience in the various sectors: Business Consulting, SAP, Enterprise & Cloud Solutions, Outsourcing (AM & IM), Business Process Outsourcing, Analytics, Technology and Advanced Solutions (Big Data, Robotics, Digital).

NTT DATA was founded in 1967 as a division of NTT (Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation), Japan's leading telecommunications operator.

In 1988, through a spin-off operation, NTT DATA became an independent company within the NTT Group and has been listed on the Tokyo stock exchange since 1995. NTT DATA entered the Italian market through the acquisition of Value Team, a company specialising in IT consultancy and solutions with operations in Brazil and Turkey, which has now become NTT DATA Italia.
NTT DATA is one of the world's Top 10 "System Integrators, IT service and outsourcing providers" and makes innovation its distinctive feature (hence the pay-off "Trusted IT Innovator"). It acts on the basis of the "GLocal" approach, which translates into making its experience and global capabilities available to customers in every country, establishing long-term and wide-ranging partnerships. Headquartered in Tokyo, the company employs more than 130,000 professionals in more than 50 countries across 4 continents (more than 4,200 in Italy), with a total turnover in the last fiscal year of more than $ 21MLD (year 2020).

NTT DATA entered the Italian market through the acquisition of Value Team, a company specialising in IT consultancy and solutions with operations in Brazil and Turkey, which has now become NTT DATA Italia.
NTT DATA is one of the world's Top 10 "System Integrators, IT service and outsourcing providers" and makes innovation its distinctive feature (hence the pay-off "Trusted IT Innovator"). It acts on the basis of the "GLocal" approach, which translates into making its experience and global capabilities available to customers in every country, establishing long-term and wide-ranging partnerships. Headquartered in Tokyo, the company employs more than 130,000 professionals in more than 50 countries across 4 continents (more than 4,200 in Italy), with a total turnover in the last fiscal year of more than $ 21MLD (year 2020).

entityDescription:
Cerpotech have industrial scale production lines for manufacturing of high quality advanced ceramic oxides. The facility includes spray pyrolysis, furnaces, calcination kilns, X-ray diffraction and equipment for post processing to produce large volume of powders. 
Cerpotech has a special production technique called spray pyrolysis which gives a very fine, sub-micron,and high quality powder in terms of homogeneity and exact stoichiometry. Our core knowledge and expertise is within our process, so we usually get the composition from our customers. Our production facility have from kg to ton scale capacity and can easily be scaled up further if needed. Pricing of materials differs mainly between standard materials, which we prepare in larger batches and keep in stock, and custom manufacturing which is produced after orders. In addition, there are a difference in pricing due to type of material and amount for the custom batch. Even though there are a downside for costs for small batches there are a great benefit of very reproducible materials independent of batch size. Another benefit of our production technology is the flexibility in type of materials we can prepare.
Both staff and the company advisory board have broad experience and competence in many fields involving ceramic materials, especially concerning synthesis, thermodynamics and stability. Cerpotech has been involved in more than 10 EU-funded projects: COBRA (H2020, Grant Agreement No 875568) on novel Co-free Li-ion battery technology; KEROGREEN (H2020, Grant Agreement No 763909); ZAS (H2020, Grant Agreement No 646186). During the last year we have started to look into production of solid-state electrolytes in addition to cathode materials with LLZ-based materials.

description:
KrattWorks builds drones with on-board machine vision and GSM-connectivity. Our drone provides fast situational awareness for fire fighters, security companies, search&rescue teams and police. KrattWorks drones can detect humans, cars, location of the fire, flooded areas etc… automatically by using machine vision on board of the drones and they can share this information instantly to the control room using mobile networks. 
KrattWorks can also combine the drone aerial data with other information: like landscape elevation module, wind speed and direction, vegetation type and humidity and use AI to predict where the fire will spread. Our drones can do precision landing into a drone nest, the drones have obstacle avoidance and machine learning capability and they can fly without range limit in mobile networks. 

We are interested in fusind low resolution satellite data (NDVI, radar data) with up-to-date and high resoltuion drone aerial imagery. For us the focus would be in fire hazard index detemination: what's the type and dryness of vegetation and how much of it there is? It should be also interesting for agriculture, forestry and marine sectors.
entityDescription:
KrattWorks helps fire fighters to understand where the fire is and contain it before it reaches out of control. This is extremely important, because once a fire has gained enough momentum, humans can not stop it.

We do that by using machine vision and mobile cellular connectivity on board of the drones to display the location of the fire on map. We then combine this data with other information like wind speed and direction, landscape elevation model and satellite data to forecast where the fire will spread. 

We are looking for fire departments to test our product, possible grants and co-operation and seed investors to help us to boost our development process.

entityDescription:
Meetecho was born in 2009 as an official acamedic spin-off of the University of Napoli Federico II. In fact, Meetecho was founded by a group of researchers of the University of Naples Federico II and from then it has been managed by seven associates, with both engineering and business background, and by Epsilon s.r.l., a small enterprise founded in 2000. In June 2021, a minority stake of the company was acquired by NFON AG, a provider of cloud-based PBX for business communication with its headquarters in Munich (Germany) and represented in 15 countries with subsidiaries and a partner network in Europe. 
Since day one the Meetecho team has been working on real-time multimedia applications over the Internet, ranging from VoIP to more advanced applications based on top of the emerging WebRTC technology. Meetecho engineers are in fact the main authors and maintainers of the well known open-source WebRTC Server Janus.
Meetecho business model includes consulting services, systems and applications development, and technology transfer programs. Meetecho skills are in web, security, networking technologies and multimedia. Main clients include: African Network Information Centre (AFRINIC), Alcatel-Lucent, Association for Computing Machinery (ACM), Infobip, Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), Microsoft, , NFON AG, Réseaux IP Européens Network Coordination Centre (RIPE NCC), etc..

entityDescription: Founded in 1419, the University of Rostock is the oldest in the Baltic Sea Region. Foundation faculties are, in addition to the facultas artium, the Faculty of Law and the Faculty of Medicine. The Theological Faculty completed the classical canon of academic disciplines in the historical studium generale in 1432. At the middle of the 20thcentury, the Faculties of Agricultural Sciences, of Business and Social Sciences and of Mathematics and Natural Sciences were added as well as, in 1950 - a novelty among the classical German universities - an Engineering Sciences Faculty. Finally, a Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Ship Technology and a Faculty of Informatics and Electrical Engineering were established out of it at the beginning of 2004. Thus, the university has nine faculties these days, comprising of numerous institutes and clinics. In addition, the Interdisciplinary Faculty as central university institution unites researchers and students from all disciplines. Research focuses which have developed out of the university tradition are merged here. Furthermore, this institution sharpens the profile by joining strengths in an interdisciplinary communication and cooperation. About 13,700 students study in bachelor and master study courses here, in curricula resulting into the State Examination degree (teaching profession study courses, human medicine and dentistry) and in the magister study course of the Theological Faculty. They can select from an extraordinarily broad range of subjects of 130 study courses in different fields of study. Over the last years, the University of Rostock has undergone significant content and organisational changes within the course of a cross-faculty, interdisciplinary profiling for meeting future social challenges in an innovative and competitive way. This includes a bundling of competences and research activities in the interdisciplinary cross-faculty departments of the Interdisciplinary Faculty. The foundation of the Interdisciplinary Faculty is a unique selling point of the University of Rostock. It pools research resources and interests in cross-faculty priority areas towards optimum exploitation of locally available potentials in terms of a focused interlinked diversity. The priorities connected via the Interdisciplinary Faculty departments are: At the department „Life, Light and Matters“, basic energy, material and life science questions are investigated. Nuclear and molecular processes are investigated here and laser optics are used for medical issues. The department „Maritime Systems“ investigates the impact of global and regional changes on coastal zones, the use of maritime systems and methods for sustainable development and coastal and sea area management. The department „Ageing of individuals and society" searches for new solutions for enabling an independent and self-determined life in old age, healthy and with full social participation. The department „Knowledge - Culture - Transformation“ is dedicated to questions on the ratio and development of culture and knowledge, from synchronous and diachronic perspective. Joint research projects with other universities, in Germany and abroad, enable networking and an expansion of the University of Rostock’s expert and expertise portfolio. Cooperations on supra-regional joint research projects with extra-university research institutions like Max Planck Society, Helmholtz Society, Fraunhofer Society, Leibnitz Community, Federal and Regional Research Institute and economy are agreed upon in contracts. Regionally, future fields of the State of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern are in the focus for supporting positive effects on company development and employments in the region.

entityDescription: Trust-IT Srl is an IT SME specialised in research analysis & communication in the field of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) as well as the development & implementation of innovative web & mobile applications across Europe and globally. In recent years it has turned its expertise into developing tools and services for smaller companies in the areas for cybersecurity and providing free, online tools for making cloud computing easier for novices especially SMEs. Trust-IT has been controlled up until 2020 by Trust-IT Services Ltd, a UK-based company founded in 2002. In 2020 the ownership of Trust-IT Srl has been transferred to three private shareolders, including the original founder of Trust-IT Services Ltd, Silvana Muscella. Trust-IT Srl's central asset is a highly skilled, dynamic, international team that performs quality ICT market research and result-oriented stakeholder communication and engagement strategies, working closely with SMEs, government and research institutions. Trust-IT Srl is committed to drive forward new ideas, pinpoint market opportunities, create multi-stakeholder partnership and build international networks and communities. It has gained high expertise in the ICT areas, covering both the technological and human interaction aspects and creating innovative business models & exploitation plans. Trust-IT is a prime mover in bringing global, ICT communities together and has a long-lasting, deep know-how in conducting user experience analyses with stakeholders, as well as contributing to innovation projects and standardisation initiatives. The Company has vast experience in co-ordination of EC-funded CSA initiatives, as well as in roll-out of sustainability activities for organisations involved in innovation efforts, with a focus on market uptake, see for instance the initiative RDA Europe (http://europe.rd-alliance.org/ ) on data-driven innovation, and its effort in development and promotion of Cloud Computing Tools and Services for SMEs (e.g., www.cloudwatchhub.eu ; www.picse.eu; www.sla-ready.eu). Trust-IT Srl has been awarded in 2021 with the ESA Tender ESA AO/1-10402/NL/20/CGD "BSGN Digital Platform", contract number 4000133758/21/NL/CGD.

It has developed robotic technologies and efficient autonomous systems to support natural human-robot interaction and collaboration for edutainment (e.g. child-robot interaction) and healthcare applications (e.g. mobility- and cognitive-assistive robotics for elderly people). Survitec is a global leader in the provision of lifesaving solutions for the marine, energy, aerospace, and defence markets. We have a proud legacy dating back 166 years which includes a history of market firsts and award-winning products. Today, Survitec employs over 3,000 people worldwide covering eight manufacturing facilities, 15 offshore support centres and over 70 owned service centres. We are further supported by a network of over 400 service stations. Throughout our history, Survitec has remained at the forefront of innovation, design and application engineering and is the trusted name when it comes to critical safety and survival solutions.
Our extensive product portfolio includes everything from lifejackets to marine evacuation systems, medical equipment to personal protective equipment. We also have market-leading rental schemes available for many of our product categories as well as commissioning services for various safety systems. Additionally, we provide a wide range of aftermarket services to support our customers’ ongoing safety requirements, including equipment servicing and repairs as well as a variety of training solutions.
With all our solutions, we design them to meet, and in many cases exceed, regulatory requirements, whilst ensuring exceptional quality and reliability. This is done with consideration to the environment and a strong focus on sustainability.

entityDescription:
GeneGIS GI is an Italian SME established in 2017 from the merging of four ICT software and services, GESP, GEOSLAB, GISITALIA and ISE-NET, all of them specialised into the GeoSpatial sector. 
GeneGIS GI experiences, for over a decade, a role in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and more generally, in the field of geospatial computer applications, developing custom projects for every need. The company’s mission is to provide customized technical solutions for to the integration of geographic data and spatial information into company information systems. This can be accomplished at any scale and level of detail, contributing to the greater competitiveness of its clients.
The company works especially on integration between GIS and other advanced technologies like specific systems existing in some market areas: environment, utilities, transportation, modelling and so on.
The company mission is to provide a full range of high value services in the Geo-ICT sector, covering the entire life cycle of any project. GeneGIS GI operates in areas such as:
● Utilities (Water, Gas, Telecommunication)
● Logistics, Supply Chain and Transportation
● Environment and Natural Resources
● Cultural Heritage
The services cover all the stages of a Geospatial project, including: Design, Development, Implementation, Commissioning, Data-processing, Training, Assistance, Application Management, Outsourcing. GeneGIS GI is technology neutral and is able to provide all services using all available Geospatial technologies, including: ESRI, Intergraph, Bentley and state-of-the-art Open Source solutions.
The technical team is currently joining technical partnerships and professional certifications with the most advanced and used technologies (such as ESRI, Intergraph, TOM-TOM, FOSS4G, Bentley, e-Spatial, CADCORP, Autodesk, Oracle, Microsoft, Safe Software, Java).
The company has acquired a long-standing experience in global market, operating for the main International Agencies like World Bank, European Union, UNDP, USAid, etc. in more than 20 countries.

Merging ISE-NET company in 2017, a university spin-off from Turin Polytechnic, GeneGIS GI gained more skills into remote sensing and in field data acquisition (terrestrial laser scanner surveying GNNS, UAV) as its first level elaboration devoted to territorial monitoring and for territorial and infrastructure management.

Engineering Research Institute Ventspils International Radio Astronomy Centre (VIRAC) of Ventspils University of Applied Sciences (VUAS) is a science education center specializing in the implementation of high-quality future research services in the field of space technology and signal processing. Research institute dealing with astronomy, astrophysics, remote sensing, signal discrete processing, high performance computing, electronics and satellite technologies.
VIRAC is a full member of the following networks: ILT (International LOFAR telescope), EVN (European VLBI network). VIRAC represents Latvia as a member in the Joint Institute for VLBI – European Research Infrastructure Consortium (JIV-ERIC). Latvia is a European Space Agency (ESA) European Cooperating State. Major observational facilities of the institute include the recently launched LOFAR station and two radio telescopes, RT-16 and RT-32, operating at centimeter and decimeter wavelengths in single-dish and VLBI modes. 
The strategic goal of VIRAC is to become a global provider of research services in the field of astronomy and space technology, to create an internationally competitive, balanced and sustainable team of researchers as well as an internationally competitive and demanding research infrastructure for science infrastructure. To ensure continuous operation of radio telescopes and of all infrastructure equipment there is a technical department as well. This gives to support the execution of research projects and to comply with requirements of the international networks, such as EVN and ILT, and of the satellite communication services.
VIRAC cooperates with various Latvian, Baltic and foreign higher education institutions and organizations to implement various projects, to contribute the development of the sector (studies in industrial mathematics, prototyping, telecommunication, satellite navigation, ionosphere, etc.), as well as training and experience of students in doctoral and physics departments. Radio interferometric studies with the EVN network partners are currently very topical.

entityDescription:
ROVIAL is a visionary startup based in Toulouse (France) developing High-Power Space platforms in high orbits that will significantly increase the amount of electrical power available in space at a fraction of today’s cost. Rovial High-power Platforms roadmap starts with 100KW satellites and incrementally goes up to Hundred-MWs power platforms.Initially, Rovial power will be used in orbit, with clients’ equipment hosted in our space platform. There are clients, markets, and needs existing today for this. In the long-term, the power could be “sent” remotely to other satellites, the Moon or the Earth through microwaves or lasers.
To do so, Rovial is developing groundbreaking AI-enabled robotics for in-space assembly of the required orbital structures, and other key enabling technologies. The first platform will be a 100KW robotically assembled PVA satellite, which will only require one single launch to service. This will be the most powerful single object ever launched in history and it will revolutionize all the businesses and applications in MEO/GEO such as hosted payload, space teleports, LEO constellation relay, etc…. It will also anticipate the first applications of space data centers, intensive data processing, high-power space lasers, ultra-high-throughput distant communications (Moon & Mars), in-space manufacturing, resource processing (e.g. space mining), and later orbiting power plants.
As the roadmap evolves, Rovial will deliver increasingly more power and will gradually incorporate a radically new power generation Technology, Solar Thermal, for which Rovial has advanced engineering (solar concentrator based on mirrors, space turbine, inflatable radiator). Once developed, this technology breakthrough would allow to scale power to the MWs range in an immensely clean, radiation-resistant way and at a radically low marginal cost per KW.

entityDescription:
ANRA Technologies, a UK Private Limited Company, with offices in London, Washington DCand New Delhi, is an international provider of end-to-end drone operations and traffic management solutions for unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) operators and airspace managers. ANRA offers highly sophisticated and modular traffic management software capabilities as part of the SmartSkies family for UAS Traffic Management (UTM) and Urban Air Mobility (UAM) operations. ANRA offers enterprise-class drone operations solution via SmartSkies Mission Manager and SmartSkies Delivery.

ANRA has conducted 10 trials similar to FFC, working alongside NASA and Civil Aviation Authorities(FAA, Swiss FOCA, India’s DGCA) on UTM-specific tests with drone manufacturers and industry UTM Service Providers (UTMSP). ANRA has taken part in multiple national campaigns to test BVLOS UTM operations and concepts at various international test locations. Currently supporting NASA’s Advanced Air Mobility National Campaign, Swiss FOCA Remote ID, FAA UTM Capacity Tests, India nation-wide UTM deployment. These tests and deployments were (are) designed to validate technology enabling multiple aircraft to share the same airspace safely while also paving the way for broader integration of unmanned vehicles into the existing Air Traffic Management system.

entityDescription:
FlySight is the new spin-off company of Flyby S.r.l. dedicated to the Defence&Security and to the Infrastructure Asset Management market sectors. 
This company inherits years of Flyby experience in satellite remote sensing and optical image advanced analytics.
FlySight team is specialized in designing and developing cutting edge software in the field of C4ISR (Command, Control, Computer, Communication for Intelligence Surveillance and Reconnaissance) systems andapplications in civil infrastructure asset management.
The proposed solutions are based on AI (Artificial Intelligence) approaches, exploiting the latest cognitive signal processing and adaptive image fusion algorithms. As an example, 
FlySight adopts deep learning methodologies together with Augmented Reality technologies to make it possible to define disruptive ISTAR (Intelligence Surveillance Target Acquisition and Reconnaissance) systems.
Real-time PED (Processing Exploitation and Dissemination) solutions are possible due to the integration of FlySight company proprietary products in the customers’ already existing IT architectures, thanks to the interoperability of FlySight systems with STANAG and OGC (Open Geospatial Consortium) standards.
Typical applications are in the avionics , naval and underwater fields, and energy production plants, electric grid and oil&gas infrastructure monitoring in order to provide an improved geospatial situational awareness for both the ground segment and for the on-board image acquisition platform.

description:
pro-beam Group is a leader in the field of electron beam and laser technology. The company provides services and systems for the welding, hardening, perforating and coating of surfaces to a wide range of industries: from automotive and aerospace to semiconductor and nuclear sectors. In addition, the company operates in the field of additive manufacturing and is developing corresponding manufacturing processes for industrial applications. Depending on their requirements, customers can opt for contract manufacturing at pro-beam or for their own customer-specific pro-beam plants.

For over 45 years, customers from over 40 countries have been trusting in pro-beam solutions. The group is represented by five locations and more than 350 employees worldwide. Headquarters are in Gilching (near Munich), Germany and act as development center for future topics like e-mobility.
For further information please visit: https://www.pro-beam.com/en/

About electron beam welding
As part of pro-beam’s R&D work in recent years, the company has been able to significantly advance the technology of the electron beam. Today pro-beam can weld 100% digitally, automate and reproduce processes and control the quality of the welded components. In addition, companies using the electron beam are highly flexible in terms of process design and construction. They are also able to weld cleanly, with a high welding speed and in a single step without the need for reworking.

The electron beam creates narrow, deep and parallel welding seams, joins different metals and creates minimal stress and distortion.

entityDescription:
The goal of SpaceLabEU is to develop technologies, which make VLEO (very low Earth orbit) accessible. This tremendous task requires a disruptive change in propulsion technology and material properties, rather than incremental research and development. We have therefore developed a prototype of an air-breathing electric propulsion drive which is currently being tested in laboratories together with Czech Airspace Research Centre in Prague. The drive, which is unique across Europe, is yet to be tested in real-life environment, i.e. in space.

SpaceLabEU brought together a team of experts from various fields – plasma dynamics, electromagnetic systems design, mission analysis and business development. Together, we are not just creating a propulsion system or a platform for VLEO, but also are enabling entirely new business cases and offering qualitative improvements to the existing ones.
Our research isprivately funded at the moment and we areconstantly looking for new research partnerships or investment opportunities.

LTCalcoli, since 1996, is offering engineering numerical analysis services using Finite Elements Method aimed at designing, evaluating, improving and optimizing structures of varying complexity. 
LTCalcoli supports the engineering activities of the Customers for: 
• ELECTROMAGNETIC analysis of low and high frequency devices and magnetic devices, evaluating magnetic field distribution as well as eddy currents with the related Maxwell and Lorentz forces.
•	THERMAL ANALYSIS
•	STRUCTURAL and THERMO-STRUCTURAL ASSESSMENT; 
•	FRACTURE MECHANICS
• VIBRO-ACOUSTICS (including fluid-structure coupling);

• Structural design of Formula1 Chassis parts;
• METALFORMING and WELDING DISTORTION evaluation; 
• Buckling and post-buckling 
• Highly nonlinear material behaviour 
• High-speed dynamics
LTCalcoli expertise in numerical analysis can support industries in the design, assessment and optimization of simple and complex structures, with the final objective of improving product performance and/or reducing development times and costs.

LTCalcoli can also design and manage the preparation of OPERATIVE PROTOTYPES as a complement to the numerical analyses, for their validation, tuning, refinement and testing.

entityDescription:
CABI’s Mission
CABI improves people’s lives worldwide by providing information and applying scientific expertise to solve problems in agriculture and the environment. This is achieved through a global network of centres undertaking capacity building, research, training, development and information management activities.
Organisation
CAB International (CABI) is a global, intergovernmental, not-for-profit organisation, owned and run by its 50 member countries - of which 14 are in the Americas, including Colombia, Chile and numerous Caribbean countries and UK overseas territories. CABI has its headquarters in the UK and operates through a network of centres in Brazil, Trinidad & Tobago, Kenya, Ghana, Zambia, India, Pakistan, Malaysia, China and Switzerland, and offices in Uganda, Ethiopia, the Netherlands and the USA. Globally, CABI has around 500 staff, with project operations in over 70 countries. 
From its inception, CABI has been concerned with enhancing the effectiveness of rural and peri-urban farming with a particular focus on its member countries. CABI’s role in international development is closely aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals and international treaties (e.g. Convention on Biological Diversity, World Trade Organization). Through putting information, skills and tools into people's hands, CABI helps address issues of global concern, such as safeguarding the environment andimproving global food security. We do this by helping farmers grow more and lose less of what they produce,combating threats to agriculture and the environment from pests and diseases, protecting biodiversity frominvasive species, and improving access to agricultural and environmental scientific knowledge. Globally, CABI works to improve livelihoods, natural resource management and sustainable agriculture throughout the world while conducting research into commodity crops, good agricultural practices and integrated pest and crop management (IPM/ICM). In addition, CABI’s publishing operations can provide training and information products that are used by the research community, academia and development professions worldwide. We are involved in digital development, knowledge management and advocacy for knowledge management within third-party programmes. We also have a strong team of social scientists leading work to evaluate interventions and integrate learning activities into projects and programs.
Areas of Work include:
· Communications and Knowledge Management
· Value Chains and Trade
· Crop Health
· Invasive Species
· Development Communication and Extension
· Digital Development
· Climate Change

They help to benefit from data and manage the organization’s digital evolution in an agile and flexible way. We have been on the market for over 15 years and have in-depth knowledge of business needs. That’s why we have equipped the all-in-one Irion EDM platform with unique functions. In addition to traditional data processing, it supports more innovative practices and methodologies for data-intensive solutions (Agile, DataOps). It also ensures compliance with the norms and regulations that are more and more oriented towards risk assessment and data assets governance.

entityDescription:
OXALIS is a cooperative of activities and employment (SCOP CAE) created in 1997, established in several French regions and providing an economic, legal and social framework to more than 200 activities of various trades. Within Oxalis, cooperation is one of the cardinal values. It allows us to build multidisciplinary projects and to experience every day the richness of cross-fertilization, especially in terms of territorial dynamics and social innovation. The women and men who make up Oxalis share, add up, and multiply their skills, know-how and experience to develop and consolidate their economic activities, both individually and collectively. They pool the resources and services necessary for their activities, allowing each of them to focus on their projects while being supported and secured.
As a generalist cooperative, it is involved in a wide range of trades organized into trade groups (e.g., the Craft/Building/Manufacturing group, the Catering/Trade group, the Design/Art Crafts group, the Personal Assistance and Well-Being group, and the Organizational expert group). It is present in a large part of the country through various secondary establishments.
Oxalis has observed a growth in Research and Development projects for several years, both internally and on behalf of clients. Oxalis has been approved for the Research Ministry (CIR agreement). This approval recognizes Oxalis as an organization authorized to carry out research and development work. Oxalis provides specialized R&D services in the fields of human and social sciences, economics and management, legal and political sciences, as well as in computer science, oceanography or archaeology. Oxalis also participates in European, national and regional cooperation projects with a strong R&D or action research dimension. The Oxalis "Research Innovation and Development" pole allows to impulse new research dynamics, to centralize the management of projects and to facilitate the dissemination and the transfer of results.
To answer to the needs of a group of researchers in oceanography and spatial research, Oxalis created a secondary Establishment called DATLAS, dedicated to these activities in October 2021.

entityDescription: Urbetho CF GmbH , registered in Alling, Germany, was founded in 2021 by Dr. Ursula Benz and Thomas Benz. It provides business development consultancy for Geo-IT companies who want to scale up their business and integrate their services into business solutions of other verticals like agronomics, IoT, logistics, telecom, utilities and others. Geo-IT companies get support by Urbetho CF GmbH and its partner network to evolve their business from one-off projects to reusable solutions and finally to repeatable geoservices with a high degree of automation and well packaged for a scalable sales approach. The rapidly growing number of public funded and private market- and Geo-IT platforms are a great opportunity for many of those geoservices. Urbetho CF GmbH explores for its customers how and which platforms can be of best help for the certain services to simplify and speed up the intended go-to-market strategy and to reach business scalability fast and at low risk. For example, market platforms, as e.g. ArcGIS Marketplace, cloudeo, NoR and eoMall can serve as worldwide marketing and sales channels and take away a lot of the technical and financial administration processes and overhead. They allow their platform members to fully focus onto the development of the solutions and services to accommodate their customers’ needs. The IaaS, DaaS and SaaS offerings of Geo-IT platforms, e.g. AWS, Google, GBDX from Maxar and the DIAS – funded by ESA to support especially the European business – save with their fast access to a multitude of data and re-usable software tools production cost and time and provide scalability and reliability for the service delivery. However, to unlock this potential technical, commercial and sometimes also legal challenges have to be overcome. Together with its partners Urbetho helps its customers to address these topics and to pave their path to a scalable business and – if applicable – to accelerate a successful onboarding of such services onto the best fitting marketplaces and Geo-IT platforms.

entityDescription:
NEUROPUBLIC (www.neuropublic.gr) is an innovative ICT, SME company (100+ employees), specialized in the development of integrated information systems and high-demand applications built in Cloud computing architecture. NEUROPUBLIC (NP) has built and operates its own data center offering cloud services at platform level (PaaS) and software level (SaaS). NP products and services are being successfully used for over 10 years, by more than 800.000 end-users in agriculture, local government and healthcare. NP has been for many years one of the healthiest and financially most robust informatics companies in Greece. Its financial state, its efficient infrastructure and resources, as well as its longstanding innovation, proper organization and proven technical know-how experience, consists the company to be one of the most reliable and quality companies in the area of Informatics in Greece. Since 2006, NP has been the main provider of the Payment and Control Agency for Guidance and Guarantee Community Aid (OPEKEPE) regarding the development of Information Systems on the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) and Rural Development. NEUROPUBLIC developed the information system GAIA (https://www.c-gaia.gr) which is a significant and efficient tool for information support of the needs of each body of the cooperative and private agricultural economy (“real economy”). GAIA provides on a subscription basis a variety of services to the whole spectrum of agri-food shareholders, including farmers, agronomists, merchants, researchers, consultants, consumers, manufacturers, public organizations etc. It consists of nine subsystems (administrative knowledge, operational resources management, special applications, e-commerce, traceability, smart farming, community aid utilization services, strategic investments consultant services), which are available as Cloud service, either as a whole or separate. NP is a member of AIOTI (www.aioti.eu), BDVA (www.bdva.eu) and EARSC (www.earsc.org), invests considerable amount of money in Research and Development (1.5 million euros for the biennium 2013-2014) and implements the research results on innovative products that satisfy the demands of the future and the new trend markets. Our automatic code generation team (a part of our R&D department) has applied its ASN.1 and code generation know-how to a number of projects for ESAESTEC, and is a large part behind the TASTE series of projects (http://taste.tuxfamily.org). NP has participated in various European Space Agency (ESA) projects (Euro-VO Registry, Space Certifiable Compiler Extensions, Data Modelling Technologies, EGOS Coding Convention and Quality Model etc.). NP is also a Gold Level member at the XIFI program (eXperimental Infrastructures for the Future Internet). 

NP started its Smart Farming project on 2013, aiming to provide next generation advice to farmers. NP designed and developed GAIAtron telemetric stations, for the monitoring of environmental and soil variables. GAIA Tron stations are ultra-low cost, very flexible/mobile and scalable, to constitute a sustainable solution and the aim of the company is to further develop them in the context of this project. On 2015 NP launched its pilot program which aims at producing and installing its gaiatron agrometeorological telemetric stations, at open fields covering the whole Greek arable area. The program has secured private funding from Piraeus Bank that will ensure its completion independently of any EC funding. At its first stage, the pilot program has commenced at selective areas of Greece, where a data acquisition infrastructure has been installed for area monitoring. Taking as input the variables coming from the environmental sensing network, a cloud-based Decision Support System supports the decision making mechanism for the farmer’s every-day farming activities, in an efficient and environmentally friendly way.

Company description: SME4SPACE is a Panel of Space SMEs Associations of the ESA Member States and ESA cooperating States. - organising seminars and information sessions;
- organising a network of SMEs in order to increase the possibilities to cooperate;
- carrying out research projects, participating at National, European and International calls in space and related activities.

entityName: UNIVERSITY OF ZAGREB FACULTY OF ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING AND COMPUTING
entityDescription:
University of Zagreb
The University of Zagreb (1669) is the oldest and biggest university in South-Eastern Europe. Ever since its foundation, the University has been continually growing and developing and now consist of 30 faculties, three art academies and the Centre for Croatian Studies. With its comprehensive programmes and over 70,000 full-time undergraduate and postgraduate students the University is the strongest teaching institution in Croatia. It offers a wide range of academic degree courses leading to Bachelor's, Master's and Doctoral degrees in the following fields: Arts, Biomedicine, Biotechnology, Engineering, Humanities, Natural and Social Sciences. It is also a strongly research-oriented institution, contributing with over 50 percent to the total research output of the country.
 
The Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing (FER) is the largest technical faculty and leading educational and R&D institution in the fields of electrical engineering, information and communication technology and computing in the Republic of Croatia. Being a constituent of the University of Zagreb, FER has its roots in the Technical Faculty, founded in 1919. In 1956, the departments of Technical Faculty grew into four new faculties, Faculty of Electrical Engineering being one of them. The Faculty offers today substantial educational and R&D facilities including 35 lecture halls, more than 60 laboratories, Congress centre, tele-conference centre, central library and 12 department libraries, student restaurant, sport and recreation facilities on 43308 m2. The Faculty is organised in 12 departments which represent the focal points of education, research and development in various fields. The present research and educational staff comprises more than 190 professors and 202 teaching and research assistants and around 3300 students at the undergraduate and graduate level and 326 PhD students. All those numbers clearly emphasize highly spirited activities in teaching and research. 
The Faculty has developed valuable international cooperation with many research institutions around the world, either directly or through inter-university cooperation.

It is also a strongly research-oriented institution, contributing with over 50 percent to the total research output of the country.
 
The Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing (FER) is the largest technical faculty and leading educational and R&D institution in the fields of electrical engineering, information and communication technology and computing in the Republic of Croatia. Being a constituent of the University of Zagreb, FER has its roots in the Technical Faculty, founded in 1919. In 1956, the departments of Technical Faculty grew into four new faculties, Faculty of Electrical Engineering being one of them. The Faculty offers today substantial educational and R&D facilities including 35 lecture halls, more than 60 laboratories, Congress centre, tele-conference centre, central library and 12 department libraries, student restaurant, sport and recreation facilities on 43308 m2. The Faculty is organised in 12 departments which represent the focal points of education, research and development in various fields. The present research and educational staff comprises more than 190 professors and 202 teaching and research assistants and around 3300 students at the undergraduate and graduate level and 326 PhD students. All those numbers clearly emphasize highly spirited activities in teaching and research. 
The Faculty has developed valuable international cooperation with many research institutions around the world, either directly or through inter-university cooperation.
