entityDescription:
The Centre for Marine Technology and Ocean Engineering (CENTEC), is a research centre of IST, recognized and funded by the Portuguese Government through the Foundation for Science and Technology of the Portuguese Ministry of Science and Technology.

The Unit of Marine Technology and Engineering was founded in 1994 following a restructuring of the Portuguese research and development system, which led to the extinction of the National Institute of Scientific Research (INIC), from where the 3 PhD researchers that founded this Unit were transferred. In 2007, already with 20 PhD researchers, the Unit’s denomination changed to Centre as a result of IST’s newly created statutes. In late 2015, CENTEC had 44 PhD researchers, among its more than 100 researchers.

CENTEC concentrates its activities on developing scientific research, development and demonstration, and their application to sustainable exploration and exploitation of marine resources, through the various fields of interest such as maritime transport and ports, ocean space utilization, including coastal areas, exploration and exploitation of marine resources, and nautical activities, as well as the protection of the marine environment and its resources. These activities are made possible by the design, construction, maintenance and planning of operation of ships and other floating structures and submersibles that constitute the main objectives of CENTEC’s activities.

CENTEC puts significant emphasis on research activity in the areas of risk analysis, safety and reliability, including occupational safety, and promotes their application to the industrial and tertiary sectors.

One of the important objectives of CENTEC is to promote and encourage advanced education and training through research activities and to promote dissemination of scientific results through the participation and organization of technical and scientific meetings.

 SYSGO is the leading European provider of real-time operating systems for critical embedded applications in the Internet of Things (IoT). Our products have been designed to meet the highest requirements when it comes to Safety and Security. Our customers are leading players in the Aerospace, Railway, Automotive and Industrial Automation industries, who use our PikeOS product as a platform for critical systems that need to be certified against industry-specific Safety and Security standards.
entityDescription: SYSGO has 25 years of expertise in certifiable software, agile and responsive, with long term support for our OS products, PikeOS Hypervisor and ELinOS. SYSGO is the European Leader in Hypervisor based OS technology offering worldwide product life cycle support. SYSGO provides invaluable extensive training services with engineering service support covering on-site support engineers and full BSP development services for certifiable BSP to the highest safety levels. SYSGO provides safety certification support for PikeOS Hypervisor, which has been certified on a variety of platforms, including multicore platforms with X86 processor architectures. PikeOS supports a wide variety of multicore processor architectures, where certification effort is ongoing... PikeOS is a Hypervisor based separation microkernel hard real time operating system, designed for the highest levels of safety and security. PikeOS Hypervisor technology has been certified on a wide range of projects using various certification standards including DO-178C, IEC-61508, EN-50128, EN-62304 and ISO-26262.

entityName: Instytut Nauk Geologicznych Polskiej Akademii Nauk
entityDescription:
For over 60 years, the Institute of Geological Sciences, Polish Academy of Science (IGS PAS), has been bringing together talented, passionate and enthusiastic people motivated to delivering cutting-edge research in Earth Sciences. Our work is dedicated to understanding the structure and evolution of the Earth’s lithosphere and its environmental implications. The institute’s research programme is multidisciplinary spanning tectonics, structural geology, exploration geophysics, basin analysis, sedimentology, igneous and metamorphic petrology, geochemistry, geochronology, isotope geology, clay mineralogy, paleoclimatology, paleobiology and paleoenvironmental studies. We use this knowledge to deepen understanding of Earth systems and the evolution of other planets. Our ultimate goal is to support sustainable development of modern society and contribute to solving today’s global challenges.
Our team of over 50 scientists is organised in 9 research groups, covering distinct aspects of our interests, that are spread among 3 research centres based in Warsaw, Krakow, and Wroclaw. We maintain a diverse network of collaborations within the Polish Academy of Sciences, Polish Earth Sciences Community and at international level. Our staff members participate in international research collaborations, co-organise and contribute to international meetings and belong to national panels and committees responsible for research strategy and policy. We have extensive links with industry, especially major Polish oil and gas companies. As a co-founder of the Earth and Planetary Research Centre (GeoPlanet), we established interdisciplinary doctoral studies for outstanding graduates, who desire to pursue their career in Earth sciences.

entityDescription: NAVENTIK GmbH (short: NAV) is a spin-off from the University of Technology Chemnitz. Based on more than 18 years (combined) of R&D of the founders, the company's mission is to enable satellite navigation (short: GNSS) for automated driving. Core competency is the integration of GNSS data into vehicle positioning architectures for ADAS of SAE Level 3+. Along the requirements for the mass market deployment these systems, NAV has created a software based GNSS sensor plus fusion algorithms - dedicated for the deep integration into state-of-the-art vehicle sensor stacks. NAV is the first vendor on the market to offer a comprehensive sensor + fusion solution for direct embedding on the automotive ECU. After the successful market entry in 2018, NAVENTIK currently serves commercial customers in ADAS projects in Europe, the USA & China. Backed by two VC investors and strategic partnerships with major Tier 1s and OEMs, NAVENTIK currently employs 24 highly specialized software developers, customer integration engineers and business developers. Beyond technological leadership, NAV gained market & business development experience during renowned accelerator programs like Susanne Klattens Techfounders and Volkswagens Future Mobility Accelerator. NAV was awarded with the main price for digital innovations at Cebit 2017 and ranked as most innovative automotive company in central Germany and Top 10 Startup in Germany 2018.

description: EPFL has a strong experience with space activities, since 2003, a dedicated centre was created to host initiatives in this domain, foster and promote to students and researchers’ projects and related applications. Currently, more than 15 laboratories are active in this domain as lead or in sub-contract of industrial projects funded by ESA, 5 students associations are addressing different areas of space under the umbrella of the EPFL Space Center (eSpace) and a unit of VPI (Space Innovation, formerly Swiss Space Center) has built a network of more than 45 Swiss entities.
entityDescription: EPFL is one of the two Ecoles Polytechniques fédérales in Switzerland. Like its sister institution, ETHZ in Zurich, it has three missions: education, research and technology transfer at the highest international level. Associated with several specialised research institutes, the two EPFs form the EPF domain, which is directly dependent on the Federal Department of Home Affairs. EPFL, in its idyllic location on the shores of Lake Geneva, brings together a campus of more than 10,000 people. EPFL offers 13 complete study programs at the Bachelor's and Master's levels in engineering, basic sciences, computer and communication sciences, life sciences, civil engineering, architecture and the environment. These study programs are designed to be flexible and modular. They meet the requirements of the Bologna accords and as a result, students can take advantage of a wide array of exchange opportunities, and the degrees they earn are internationally recognized. Within EPFL's Doctoral School, PhD students share ideas, provide mutual support and intellectual stimulation, and round out their education with high-level specialized courses. PhD students benefit from EPFL's scientific expertise and excellent infrastructure. Working for space projects has always been a tradition at EPFL since the early 1980's. Some of the key domains of expertise developed in Lausanne include aerodynamics, antennae and robotics for planetary exploration. In 2002, this high interest was confirmed by including space research in the EPFL 2004-2007 strategic plan which yields to the creation of the Space Center EPFL (http://space.epfl.ch). The three main objectives of the Center are: to promote space education projects to develop R&D related to space to foster special partnership with space industries

entityDescription:
NOESIS Science Center and Museum of Technology is a cultural, educational, public benefit Institution that offers the student community, but also the general public a suitable environment for getting to know and understanding the positive sciences and informing them about technological developments.
Its founder was the Technical Museum of Thessaloniki, which began its course in 1978 and then, in 2001, developed into NOESIS. It reports to the General Government and reports to the General Secretariat for Research and Innovation (GGEK).
It is worth mentioning that NOESIS has won two top international honors, from the European Network of Science Centers and Museums (ECSITE) and from the world’s most important Association of Science and Technology Centers (ASTC Association of Science) ) for the refugee reception program that has been in force since September 2016.
At the same time, the body holds a major role in collective bodies of its field of activity, as it has twice been elected a member of the Board. of ECSITE, as well as the largest international Association of Technology Centers and Museums CIMUSET – ICOM (International Committee for Museums and Collections of Science and Technology).
At NOESIS visitors can watch screenings:
a. In the digital Planetarium, 160 seats.
b. In the Wide Screen Cinema (Cosmotheatre), 300 seats, with projection of two and three (3D) films.
c. In the Virtual Reality Simulator, 18 positions, with projection of two and three (3D) movies.
They can also visit the Technology Museum which includes 3 permanent exhibitions:
a. Ancient Greek Technology, unique in its kind, covering from prehistoric times to the Hellenistic and Byzantine times.
b. Technopark, with interactive exhibits, where the visitor has the opportunity to discover and understand scientific knowledge in an interactive and fun way.
c. The Car Showroom, with typical samples of the history of the car.
NOESIS has:
Amphitheater, 200 seats, for conferences, corporate presentations, events, etc.
Periodical Exhibition Hall, a specially designed space that occasionally hosts exhibitions from other Museums and cultural institutions in Greece and abroad.
Library with relevant bibliography and computer island (internet with 1Gb).
Digital Producers Laboratory, for the creation of internal multimedia producers.
At NOESIS are organized during the year:
Educational Programs, such as “Science in the kitchen”, “It is in our DNA: breeding dragons”, “Drones I: fantastic missions” etc.
“Explora”, a five-day summer creative activity program with a variety of scientific topics that affect daily life and are presented with an entertaining approach.
Children’s parties that include magic experiments, games in the Museum of Technology, screenings and creative activities.
Meetings and discussions with representatives of the scientific community and in collaboration with other bodies, such as the French Institute, the British Council, etc.
At least two large events per year with free admission for the public and attendance of more than 5,000 people.
Also, on its premises there is a cafe-restaurant, with excellent views of the city, canteen, as well as shops selling educational toys, special editions and souvenirs.

entityName: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid - UC3M
entityDescription: GENERAL PRESENTATION The Carlos III University of Madrid (UC3M) is a public university founded in 1989. Its main goal is to provide specialised training in Law and Social Sciences and Engineering, as well as to become a prime European research centre. In addition, the Carlos III University of Madrid pursues the creation of an innovative university and seek to offer a University model based on a quality-oriented philosophy. In this sense, modern, flexible and multidisciplinary curricula have been designed trying to suit the scientific and technological demand of the Society. The university is located in the southern metropolitan area of Madrid and consists of three centres: the Faculty of Law and Social Sciences, the Faculty of Humanities, Communication and Library Science and the School of Engineering. Concerning the training area, the Carlos III University of Madrid was the first in Spain to be fully adapted to the requirements of the European Higher Education Area (EHEA) (The Bologna Process) and offers studies in most of the scientific disciplines. KEY FIGURES 18.676 students 1.907 Teaching Staff (724 Full Professors and Associates) 681 Administrative Staff 2 Faculties, 1 Technical School, 1 School of Graduate Studies and 1 Doctoral School in 4 Campuses (Leganés, Getafe, Colmenarejo and Puerta de Toledo-Madrid), Faculty of Law and Social Sciences, Faculty of Humanities, Communication and Library Science, School of Engineering, School of Graduate Studies, Doctoral School 28 Bachelor´s Degrees (more than 50% of them can be taken either fully in English or in a bilingual option) 1 Science & Technology Park - Leganés Tecnológico. 4 Research Centers: UC3M Center for Disability and Dependence Spanish Center for Subtitling and Audio Description (CESyA), Joint Center for Global Change, EADS-UC3M Center for Integration of Aerospace Systems RESEARCH UC3M has strived, since its foundation, to make research one of the fundamental pillars of its activity, both for the enhancement of its teaching and for the new knowledge and new areas of research. UC3M is organized into 27 Departments and 26 University Research Institutes. In addition, since 2005 it has an Official Catalogue of Research Groups, composed of scholars who share common lines of work, carry out collaborative research project and publish jointly. The Catalogue is comprised of 126 groups, which cover almost all of bodies of knowledge and studies at UC3M. UC3M, as university, has a national reputation for its research efficiency. In 2009 was the fourth Spanish University in participation in the EU Framework Programme (standardized data by number of permanent researchers) and second in average number of publications per permanent researcher in the period 2002-2006 (Web of Science). Recently (Report 2009 of CNEAI-National Commission for Evaluation of Research Activity), UC3M has reached the top of the Spanish universities in research activity. Main figures (numbers below are from 2013): - Researchers: 1.724 - Research Teams: 127 - Doctoral students: 988 - Chairs of Research: 12 - Technology Laboratories: 18 - Research funding: 20.491 ME - Competitive (regional, national or international programmes) 13.859 ME - R&D contracts with Industry: 6.001 ME - Others: 631 ME The Research Service (with a staff of 31 persons) is responsible for the overall management of the UC3M research. It functions range from raising public and private funds and managing them to centralizing all the research information, including assessment and prospective. As a result of an agreement with three other Spanish universities, UC3M has opened in 2009 an Office in Brussels, to promote the incorporation of scientific and scholarly research activity at universities into European Union research programs.

description:
With a workforce of over 120, Werum Software & Systems AG is one of the largest independent employers for IT professionals in Germany. For more than 50 years, Werum has been implementing sophisticated software and systems for customers all over the world, among them many renowned companies from the automotive and aerospace industry as well as scientific institutions and public authorities.
Werum's activities focus on the support of customer-specific processes in the core areas of earth observation, test data and information management, eGovernment and enterprise information management. The software solutions are based on platforms specially developed for these areas.
In the area of earth observation, Werum is strongly involved in Payload Data Ground Segment functionality ranging from production workflow management through to data dissemination and long-term archiving. The involvement covers a wide range of missions and mission concepts through both the multi-mission paradigm promoted in many projects as well as involvement in dedicated mission-specific functions for missions like ENVISAT, SMOS, Swarm, Sentinel-1, Sentinel-3, EarthCARE or BIOMASS. 
By continually adapting both the workforce skillset and the software stack used for implementation, Werum has maintained the capability to provide up-to-date, technologically sound and secure solutions for self-hosted and cloud environments.
Diversity, reliability, flexibility and fairness are part of Werum's philosophy and create the basis for sustainable customer relations. Werum offers its international customers well-founded application know-how as well as the knowledge and experience gained in many years of implementing most di-verse projects and IT solutions. Already in the run-up to project implementation Werum assists customers in advisory capacity with regard to any IT-related aspects of the specific task setting. Long-term maintenance and servicing of the solutions supplied are a matter of course for Werum.
Werum is a privately held stock company with a nominal stock capital of 1.1 million Euros. The company is fully owned by the company employees or former employees and their families. Moreover, Werum has been certified according to DIN EN ISO 9001 since 1995.

entityDescription:
DRONE HOPPER, S.L. (hereinafter referred to as DH) is a Spanish start-up created with the aim of designing, manufacturing and operating unmanned drones for transport and for the release of large quantities of liquids. The drones are intended to be used mainly for wildfire firefighting and agricultural operations. Its drone design and technology are patented, primarily for the innovative water mist release system that uses the air downstream the engines to transform water into water mist. The unique water mist feature directs the resulting wet flow directly onto the ground. DH’s drone concept also provides protection over the double-fairing architecture design that protects the sensitive inner equipment, and over the stability system that maintains the equipment’s integrity, even in very harsh conditions. 

Its unique technology makes it possible for firefighters to operate at night and in heavy wind conditions while minimizing the risk for the pilots. Operationally, it also offers the possibility of working on contention operations, using additives to block the advance of the fire. DH’s vision is to be a pioneer in the drone market by developing and commercializing a family of drones for multiple aerials works applications, including forest and urban firefighting, logistics, precision agriculture, surveillance, search and rescue, parcel and medical delivery among others. 

Full team details: DH complete team is composed of 20 fully dedicated employees with complementary skills from both the technical and the business development sides, including aeronautical, mechanical, environmental and flight control engineering, manufacturing and assembling, as well as business development, analysis, marketing and communication skills. Full details can be accessed in DH’s People LinkedIn profile.

description:
Adamant Composites is developing high-end, state-of-the-art solutions serving primarily the Space, Aerospace, Defence and Energy Storage markets. Since our foundation in 2012, we have successfully completed projects for several institutional and industrial clients such as the European Space Agency and Airbus. 
Our expertise lies in the design of large deployable structures, and the use of composite and nano-enabled materials in applications such as batteries, hydrogen storage tanks, UAVs, deployable structure subsystems and structural components for satellites and launchers. We have contributed to >10 ESA activities on Materials and Structures (primarily as Prime Contractors) as well as participated in ESA Mission contracts.
We have an informal, hard-working, and kind team culture and offer our people the opportunity to work on cutting-edge engineering projects and flexible working hours. Our culture is friendly and fast paced – we are constantly challenging, testing, and adapting the way we do things. We are also really committed to working with integrity, doing the right thing, and building a company we are truly proud of. We are all passionate about our mission and are determined to create a truly fantastic and reputable provider of Structures Hardware and Subsystems in the Space Industry.
entityDescription:
Adamant Composites is a well-established partner in Europe’s aerospace and defense ecosystem, delivering bespoke and trusted solutions in complex hardware. For over 10 years, the company has been developing integrated solutions for Space, Air, and Land applications. Trusted by ESA, EDA, Airbus, Thales Alenia Space, and other industry leaders, Adamant leverages innovation in materials and engineering to deliver systems critical to mission success. With a heritage of more than 15 ESA activities in the field of Materials & Structures, we are supporting Space Missions for Science and Earth Observation led by ESA and Large System Integrators. Our product portfolio covers Composite Structures, Novel lightweight and Multifunctional materials, Deployable Structures, and MGSE.
We offer end-to-end product lifecycle support, encompassing Design Authority, Capability Integration, Prime Contracting, Manufacturing & Supply Chain, and Next-Generation Product Development. Applications span batteries, hydrogen storage tanks, UAV airframes, deployable structure subsystems, structural components, and ground support equipment for satellites and launchers. We work on the full product development cycle following a holistic approach and covering activities from specifications, to simulation, to process development, to testing and to production.

Missions we have delivered hardware for: JUICE, CHIME, CRISTAL, LSTM, CIMR, ROSEL, ARIEL, EXOMARS, Greek Smallsat Constellation.

Since 2016, Adamant Composites has been certified by EUROCERT under EN ISO9001:2008 (Certificate number 1869/Δ) for a range of technical activities covering the end-to-end process cycle for composite structures; from concept and feasibility to processing and manufacturing for aerospace applications as well as high-end technology industries. In 2018 the company successfully transitioned to ISO9001:2015 (Certificate number 00.12.1272) and has successfully completed the ESA course on Product and Quality Assurance in ESA Projects.

Adamant is an active member of several international industry bodies, including the Hellenic Manufacturers of Defense Material, the Greek Association of Space Industries, and the siCluster (Hellenic Space Technologies and Applications Cluster).

description:
Coventry University is a dynamic, global and transformational ‘modern university’ whose roots can be traced back to 1843 to the Coventry School of Design. With a proud tradition as a provider of innovative teaching and learning and a focus on impactful research, the university has established a robust reputation for pushing the boundaries of higher education regionally, nationally and across the world.

Through its links with leading-edge businesses and organizations in a variety of countries and industries, Coventry University’s 29,000+ students enjoy access to placements and international opportunities which ensure that their employment prospects are enhanced by the time they graduate. Its students also benefit from state-of-the-art equipment and facilities – including on its London and Scarborough campuses – in all academic disciplines, from health, business and performing arts to industrial design, engineering and computing.

In recent years Coventry’s student satisfaction levels and teaching quality have been rated amongst the best in the UK, which in turn has led to impressive rises in every major university league table. The combination of these successes and its innovative approach to developments in the sector – including the Institute for Advanced Manufacturing and Engineering and a new campus in Scarborough – earned Coventry the title ‘University of the Year’ in the THE Awards 2015, and saw it secure a gold rating in the UK government’s Teaching Excellence Framework (REF) in 2017.

As of 2020 we’re Top 15 in this year's Guardian University Guide – as well as being named ‘Modern University of the Year’ in the Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide for three years running from 2014 to 2016. Coventry also places in the top 200 in the THE Young University Rankings 2017.

entityDescription:
The Fraunhofer Institute for Microstructure of Materials and Systems IMWS is a methodologically oriented Fraunhofer Institute in the material sciences and materials engineering disciplines. The Fraunhofer IMWS is a contact for industry and public clients for all issues concerning materials and systems – with the objective of increasing material efficiency and profitability and to use resources carefully.
The work of the Fraunhofer IMWS is aimed at identifying defects and weakpoints in materials, components and systems on the micro- and nanoscale, to clarify their cause and to offer clients solutions based on the outcomes. The institute's industrial clients come, among other things, from the microelectronics and microsystem engineering, photovoltaics, plastics engineering sectors, the chemical industry, energy engineering, automotive engineering and the aircraft industry. This work is accompanied by the further development of methods to shed light on microstructures. Together with analysis equipment manufacturers, precise-fitting equipment configurations can be developed, so that in future industrial clients can identify and avoid the source of defects themselves.
As an institute of the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft, the Fraunhofer IMWS promotes and conducts internationally networked, application-orientated research for the direct benefit of industry and to the advantage of society. It makes important contributions to material efficiency, careful use of resources and profitability and thus faces the central challenge of the 21st century; the sustainability of all areas of life and in particular, efficient handling of limited raw materials. At the same time it thus contributes to the competitiveness of Saxony-Anhalt, Germany and Europe.
The Fraunhofer IMWS sets itself the highest scientific and technical standards. It prepares cost-efficient and quality-assured, high-quality innovative solutions for its clients. In its core areas of expertise, microstructure diagnostics and microstructure design, the Fraunhofer IMWS is the leader within the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft and is recognized internationally. The Fraunhofer IMWS offers its employees personal development opportunities and supports them in their scientific and entrepreneurial qualification.

The Fraunhofer IMWS is a contact for industry and public clients for all issues concerning materials and systems – with the objective of increasing material efficiency and profitability and to use resources carefully.
The work of the Fraunhofer IMWS is aimed at identifying defects and weakpoints in materials, components and systems on the micro- and nanoscale, to clarify their cause and to offer clients solutions based on the outcomes. The institute's industrial clients come, among other things, from the microelectronics and microsystem engineering, photovoltaics, plastics engineering sectors, the chemical industry, energy engineering, automotive engineering and the aircraft industry. This work is accompanied by the further development of methods to shed light on microstructures. Together with analysis equipment manufacturers, precise-fitting equipment configurations can be developed, so that in future industrial clients can identify and avoid the source of defects themselves.
As an institute of the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft, the Fraunhofer IMWS promotes and conducts internationally networked, application-orientated research for the direct benefit of industry and to the advantage of society. It makes important contributions to material efficiency, careful use of resources and profitability and thus faces the central challenge of the 21st century; the sustainability of all areas of life and in particular, efficient handling of limited raw materials. At the same time it thus contributes to the competitiveness of Saxony-Anhalt, Germany and Europe.
The Fraunhofer IMWS sets itself the highest scientific and technical standards. It prepares cost-efficient and quality-assured, high-quality innovative solutions for its clients. In its core areas of expertise, microstructure diagnostics and microstructure design, the Fraunhofer IMWS is the leader within the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft and is recognized internationally. The Fraunhofer IMWS offers its employees personal development opportunities and supports them in their scientific and entrepreneurial qualification.

entityDescription:
Roadfill Ltd was set up to tackle three epidemics facing all countries; potholes, plastic waste and Co2 emissions.
Roadfill has developed a method of recycling polyethylene terephthalate (PET) which is predominately food wrappings and water bottles, and using this to replace a percentage of bitumen (tarmac) traditionally needed to repair or relay a road. This method reduces our dependence on fossil fuels and promotes a circular economy by recycling plastic waste destined for landfill sites. As the company has grown, further products have been developed which use natural plant and minerals to store and capture vehicle emissions and micro plastics caused by tyre fatigue.
In the UK, our strategic road network is valued as an asset class in excess of �465 billion. However there is no automated way of monitoring the condition of our road surfaces and Highways England and other local government authorities rely solely on manual human inputs to report on the conditions of our roads. Roadfill is developing an app which allows surface conditions to be monitored in real time data. It is the very first of its kind and this segment of the market is unchallenged.

entityName: Zentrum für Sonnenenergie- und Wasserstoff-Forschung Baden-Württemberg
entityDescription:
The ZSW was established in 1988 as a non-profit foundation under the civil code. 
The goal of the foundation is: "...to conduct and promote research and development in the field of renewable energies, energy efficiency, energy conversion and storage, with a focus on solar energy and hydrogen technology, in co-operation with universitary and non-universitary research and by transferring the results into industrial application."

entityDescription:
Eucentre is a private non-profit foundation that pursues a mission of research, training and service provision in the field of earthquake engineering and, more generally, of risk engineering.
Founded in 2005 as an evolution of the European Centre for Training and Research in Earthquake Engineering already active in Pavia since 2003, it was established by four Founders, the University of Pavia, the University School for Advanced Studies IUSS of Pavia, the Italian Department of Civil Protection, the National Institute of Geophysics and Volcanology, to further develop the scientific, research and training expertise in the sector present in Pavia.
Today Eucentre has an important asset of experimental labs consisting of shaking tables able to reproduce any seismic event for testing both structural and non-structural elements and for the qualification of anti-seismic devices.
Eucentre also manages a data lab that, thanks to an extensive database of Italian buildings and infrastructures, allows to produce risk analyses and scenarios related to both measured and hypothetical seismic events.
Eucentre operates within an international network with other research centres, earthquake engineering laboratories, institutions and companies.
Eucentre is Centre of Competence of the Italian Department of Civil Protection, to which it provides emergency support, elaboration of risk scenarios and research activities for the improvement of Civil Protection activities.
Together with the two Pavia universities, Eucentre also offers training courses for undergraduate and postgraduate students and for practitioners in the field of earthquake engineering and risk management.
Today Eucentre is an international reference centre for institutions, for which it operates in the definition of emergency plans, in the elaboration of risk scenarios, in the vulnerability assessment of buildings and infrastructures, and for companies, to which it offers experimental and supporting services for the seismic design in various sectors such as civil engineering, transport networks, energy production and transport, hydrocarbon extraction, production of industrial devices, certification of anti-seismic devices.

Therefore, the company considers as the main growth drivers the investment in intellectual property, in the expertise in engineering frontier applications and in the creation of high value-added innovative products/services, either through joint venture and/or partnerships, often in R&D consortia in international and national R&D projects.
The company aims at promoting and implementing, in partnership with other companies and/or research centers, R&D projects that have as their ultimate goal to promote the growth of competitiveness of SMEs in particular through the matching between industrial partners’ innovation needs and the supply of technological knowledge by the research system.
The overriding aim is to act as a technological interface between the local industrial sector and the target market, presiding the whole process from the innovation needs’ detection to the implementation of new technological solutions.

entityDescription:
From molecule to society
Research conducted at the Department of Health Science and Technology takes a mutual starting point; the human body. Our research spans “from molecule to society” covering aspects from the human cell and the molecules it is built from to the full human body.
The laboratories of the Department of Health Science and Technology are equipped to support state-of-the-art research and teaching. The physical dimensions of objects in the laboratories span from micrometers (the cell) to several meters (human run).
HST's research
Spanning from molecule to society our research covers:
Biomarkers ● Biomechanics and motor control systems ● Biomedicine and human biotechnology ● Cardiology ● Decision support ● Image analysis● Medical decision support systems ● Medical informatics systems ● Medicine ● Neurology ● Pharma technology ● Pre-clinical research ● Public health● Rehabilitation technology and test of new equipment ● Sports science ● Telemedicine ● Translational neuroscience ● Translational pain research and drug profiling ● Welfare technology
At the Department of Health Science and Technology weaim to produce and perform research-based innovation and teaching. Dissemination of our knowledge is prioritized and we always strive towards establishing dialogue with industry and other potential beneficiaries – our surrounding society, our citizens.

entityDescription:
Many of the terrestrial customers would benefit from using capabilities of Earth Observation satellites in a more direct manner, but it takes years of time, a lot of money and many regulatory hoops to launch any kind of satellite to space. At the same time many space start-ups are trying to do this nevertheless, but they lack means to attract many customers, at least initially.
Exodus Orbitals is developing "satellites-as-a-service platform, matching both customers and providers of satellite capabilities, similar to model used by cloud computing providers on Earth, with pay-per-use billing and flexible subscription plans, in the following :
1. We will offer customers on the ground the way to augment software applications by accessing space-based hardware capabilities, running such apps either on the ground or directly on the satellite onboard computer, aggregating all accessible space assets into a single API platform.
2. We will offer emerging satellite operators access to widest possible customer base through deploying our “virtual satellite” software application on their satellites and connecting it to our singe-point of entry platform .

entityDescription: Meat Tomorrow is a CellAg startup dedicated to making meat production sustainable through the development of cultured meat –that is, meat grown from muscle cells in bioreactors in ways that are better for our health, our planet, and our hoofy friends. Building on the last 20 years of academic research in stem cells, we are developing methods for growing pig muscle cells from stem cells. However, while academic research unraveled methods to grow stem cells into many kinds of cells (fat, liver or muscle), a key challenge remains before we can realize the potential of cultured meat: Creating a sustainable and cheap growth medium, i.e. the aqueous mixture of sugars, fats, vitamins and growth factors the cells grown in. This is one of two development potentials within the field of cultured meat that we strive to meet within the next five years.

entityDescription: The Geodetic Cloud Computing Service (GCCS) was created in 2015 as a start-up company in the ESA Business Incubation Centre of Darmstadt (Germany). It forms primarily the operational platform that facilitates the distributed analysis of geodetic GNSS data by means of the GPSdancer software and solution approach. This analysis places any regional or global GNSS reference station in true global network solution time series, functionaly identical to the analysis of the International GNSS Service, but implemented in the form of a distributed computing system in the cloud. The key advantage of this approach is that there is no limit to the number of participating stations, while the data and products of individual stations remain private to the station operator. The GPSdancer solution approach has been developed over the period 2009-2015 in the form of a voluntary software development by a Working Group of the Reference Frame Commission of the International Association of Geodesy (IAG).

entityDescription:
Niki Rotor Aviation delivers ready to fly gyroplanes that suite your particular flying preferences. The main priority for our team is your safety, comfort and unique personal experience with our gyroplanes. We provide opportunities that make your flight one of a kind. We like our partners and treat them as family members. Strong business relations are based on a friendly attitude, know-how and professional expertise.

Niki Rotor Aviation was created in 2010 in the Pravets. The company is known as a manufacturer of the first two-seater gyrocopter in Bulgaria.
In 2000, the company designed its first helicopter prototype. The machine was made of composite materials. Unfortunately, the helicopter does not reach the market potential required due to certain technical characteristics. However, the challenge of building a flying machine motivated the Rotor Team Aviation and in 2004 they started their new project – Gyrocopter for NIKI 2004.
Based on market research and observation, visiting many aviation shows world wide, Niki Rotor Aviation made all efforts required to make all dreams come true by manufacturing the first two-seated gyrocopter in Bulgaria.The body of the 2004 NIKI prototype was made of composite materials combined with plywood and aluminum. Gyrocopter NIKI 2004 successfully obtained the first flight test in December 2008 in Montana, Gabrovnitsa Airfield.
The improvements of NIKI 2004 set the new challenge in front of the company – the new prototype NIKI 2004 M ie APIS. This machine will be with the same design, but the cab will be with about 40 cm more.
Niki Rotor Aviation is working hard for the last couple of years and now the company is launching two brand new machines – Lighning and Kallithea. They combine very innovative elements, designers and constructive decisions. Both machines have one and the same cockpit and the main difference comes from the design of the tail and helix axis. New challenges ahead!

entityDescription: Fhoster is a technology venture founded in 2008 to develop a low-code application development platform named“Livebase”, with an initial funding of over �1M from international private investors and a venture capital fund.Livebase improves effectiveness and efficiency in application development and maintenance, drastically reducing bothdelivery time and number of developers required. Thanks to its pure model-driven approach (inducing a better anddeeper initial understanding of the requirements) and to its intelligent code-generation capabilities, Livebaseconsistently delivers high-quality and virtually bug-free applications fully consistent with customer’s needs, in a fractionof the time required by traditional manual coding.Applications built with Livebase are entirely based on an open-source software technologies (CentOS, mySQL,GraphQL, Apache Karaf, Hazelcast, Docker), can scale to hundreds of concurrent users and millions of databaserecords, can be deployed anywhere (on-premise and in cloud) even in high-availability configurations, can beupdated, extended and integrated effortlessly, and run royalty free with virtually unlimited end-users.The Livebase project started in 2006 from an academic research trial in software modelling and code generation.Commercially available since 2012, the platform now serves dozens of private and public organizations in a widespectrum of business domains: public administration, public transport, project financing and monitoring, compliancemanagement, clinical research, logistics and real-time tracking, metrology and instrument calibration, manufacturing,strategic consulting.The Livebase platform is actively maintained and constantly improved by a team R&D software engineers withmany years of experience on the product, releasing a new version of the platform twice a month on average. EachLivebase release is fully compatible with application models drawn previously, it is checked with over 11 thousandsautomated tests, and it leaves developers free to decide if and when to regenerate their applications and takeadvantage of the new features introduced in the platform.Fhoster licenses the Livebase technology and related services (consultancy and training) to customers with internalsoftware development teams and to partner system integrators (e.g. REPLY).

entityDescription: Over the next 10 years, a staggering 10000 new satellites will be launched; 70% of these are “Nano-Satellites”: they weigh less than 10Kg, cost under 100k$, and are revolutionising, and democratizing, access to space; most follow the first open-access standard in the space sector: the CubeSat standard. CubeSats are quickly acquiring new, varied and crucial functionalities: from high-speed communication networks, satellite internet, IoT, and earth observation, to space exploration. However, one last challenge remains a limiting factor: the lack of on-board propulsion. ienai SPACE, a newly-established company located in Madrid (Spain), aims to be a one-stop-shop for highly efficient ionic-liquid electric propulsion systems and mission analysis for nano-satellites. We will provide propulsion modules following the plug&play philosophy of CubeSats, but deeply customized for each particular platform and mission: from 2U to 12U; from RAAN-spacing to Earth-Moon transits or de-orbiting (aimed at containing the issue of space debris). Our versatile ATHENA Thruster is designed to be highly scalable in specific impulse and thrust; the technology is based on a novel iteration of electrospray thrusters, which boast some of the highest theoretical efficiencies for electric propulsion technologies in the low power range. In combination with its reduced form factor, this means less propellant on-board, making this technology attractive in constrained volumes. ienai SPACE uses a proprietary software for design and optimization of low-thrust trajectories which allows for concurrent engineering of both thruster and propulsive maneuvers. A software tool, ienai GO (go.ienai.space) has been developed to allow clients to perform preliminary analysis of propulsive requirements and maneuvers, in order to obtain a preliminary design of the optimal thruster. We also provide support to control activities during the mission, allowing these satellites to reach further, for longer.

entityDescription:
Creocean is a consultancy company providing environmental, engineering and planning services in marine and coastal environments. Headquartered in La Rochelle, France Creocean has a team of 60+ employees and operates from an established network of 5 offices in France, one in the Caribbean (Fort-de-France/Martinique), one in Tahiti, two in the Middle-East (Doha/Qatar and Abu Dhabi-UAE), one in North-Africa (Casablanca/Morocco), one in South-East Asia (Jakarta/Indonesia) and one in Brazil (Salvador de Bahia). With the technical and financial resources provided by its parent company, Keran located in Nantes (France), Creocean has the resources to conduct a wide range of projects. 
Creocean conducts applied projects as well as Research and Development in biological, ecological, geological, chemical, and physical aspects of coastal and marine environments. Our teams are supported by powerful tools for the acquisition of field data and data processing which in turn offer the most appropriate solutions to our customers.
Our services cover all stages of a project from the assessment of the potential of an area to the implementation of compensatory environmental measures after its development. For each project, Creocean is able to assemble the range of professional services most suitable to the client's need.
Projects are assigned to a team of Creocean experts and a project manager best suited to address project-specific requirements. The project manager is the single customer contact.
Creocean’s commitment is to provide science-based decision-making tools for the Sustainable Development of coastal activities in harmony with humans and their natural surroundings.

entityDescription: Studio SPERI. Founded in 1974 by Giuseppe Lupoi, Studio SPERI s.r.l. has established itself as a nationally recognized civil and structural engineering firm specializing in the planning, design, and management of engineering/inspection, supervision, execution of civil works and infrastructures. In over forty years we have been delivering projects in Italy and abroad in cooperation with international firms, government representatives, universities and research institutions. Studio SPERI s.r.l. has been involved in the design, construction and environmental impact assessment of more than hundreds civil structures including hospitals and other strategically important buildings, hotels, industrial plants and infrastructures including viaducts and bridges. It has been involved in a large number of engineering projects in Italy (the Headquarter of the company is in Rome) as well as abroad (including Indonesia, Oman, Russia, Panama, Mauritania, Liberia, etc.). Thanks to important collaborations with the scientific community and academia, in the last ten years Studio SPERI has developed specific and advanced expertise: Structural Engineering, Port Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Road Engineering, Architecture, MEP Engineering, Safety Engineering, Risk analysis. Since 2002, the company applies a quality management system in compliance with UNI EN ISO 9001:2008, now updated to UNI EN ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015 e 45001:2018 for preliminary, detailed and final design, work supervision, health and safety management and checks for final validation. Studio SPERI is part of the Italian association of engineering and technical- economical consultants, OICE. OICE represents FIDIC’s interests in Italy. Since 2012 we are members of Green Building Council (GBC), an organization that empowers industry leaders to effect the transformation of the local building industry toward sustainability (LEED rating system). Our headquarter, located in Rome, provides a vibrant working place to high qualified people committed to achieve the best result by developing simultaneously each and every aspect of every project. This coordinated approach allows us to respond efficiently to all client needs. Other main offices are in Milan, Palermo and Naples. Employees of Studio SPERI are IPMA (International Project Manager Association) certified and are able to perform integrated 3D modeling (BIM).

description:
Helping to shape a sustainable future: This will call for a move toward an ecological while economical approach to creating high-tech products using fibre composite materials such as carbon-fibre reinforced plastics (CFRP) or glass-fibre reinforced plastics (GFRP). Guaranteed to be suitable for the highest demands and for usage under the most extreme conditions. INVENT GmbH has built up a wealth of experience in fibre composite technology over many years. As a competent development partner, we offer a comprehensive range of services from which our customers can profit. Reliability, individuality and a sustained quality philosophy make us successful in the demanding market for lightweight structures. 
As a recognised lightweight construction specialist for innovative fibre composite technologies for the aerospace, mechanical engineering, automotive, rail and ship-building industries, we – as an EN 9100 and Nadcap certified company – develop and produce highly precise structural components, from the initial idea right through to series production. Our own designers and engineers work together closely with the different manufacturing specialists. This allows us to offer our customers a complete package from a single source with regard to design, production planning, manufacturing processes, mechanical processing, fitting and assembly, painting and quality control.
entityDescription:
The INVENT GmbH is allocated in Braunschweig in northern Germany. INVENT offers a qualified know-how in the field of high performance fibre composites, allowing for manufacturing from prototypes and samples up to delicate flight hardware. Further on even more unique composite types like Kevlar or structures made out of renewable/natural fibres (Hemp) can be handled as well. Its products are mainly sold to aerospace industry, but there are also automo-tive and railway OEMs among INVENTS regular customers.
The company is privately owned and has a staff of about 65 qualified employees. To provide an excellent quality for its parts INVENT¿s personnel is acquainted in detail with state of the art manufacturing processes like SLI- (Single-Line-Injection), RTM- (Resin Transfer Moulding), winding- or prepreg-procedures. Thus, the employees are ideally able to economically produce fibre composite structures with innovative production engineering.
The philosophy of INVENT is based on the efficient transfer of innovative technologies between basic research and industry. Together with HPS, there exists an optimum prospective for future supply of space equipment such as highly stable antenna reflectors, sandwich panel structures for satellites, struts for truss works or deployable booms. In this regard a clean room for manufacturing these delicate parts has been started up in 2006.

entityDescription:
Since its foundation in 1983, Commercial Space Technologies (CST) has been dedicated to providing the space industry with the highest quality of launch brokerage, management and consultancy services, which helps to keep CST partners and customers at the leading edge of their field. The company is engaged in three main fields of activity:
 
- Launch Brokerage –CST’s launch team has over 100 combined years of launch brokerage and mission management experience. We can offer in-country support on the key milestones of your mission that require (or strongly benefit from) hands-on intervention, including: construction and negotiation of Launch Service Agreements, Fit Checks, ICD meetings, logistics, mission specific procurements and launch campaigns.
 
-Consultancy – CST uses its long experience and established contacts to offer the best expertise from the UK, China and former Soviet countries. This allows us to economically produce in-depth consultancy reports on a wide range of topics, from technical reviews and trajectory analysis to market surveys/analysis. These are added to our database of over 800 reports, which has become a notable repository of detailed information on space technology, markets, and more.
 
- Trade and Commerce - With the contacts and experience that CST has gained in Europe, former Soviet countries and beyond, it is also able to offer unique trading opportunities, facilitating interactions on site with an international team. These techniques have also been applied by CST to manage satellite development projects (such as Kanopus) between Eastern and Western companies, or procurements such as identifying, negotiating and managing the delivery of laser reflectors for Europe’s Galileo PNT constellation.
 
CST’s support extends to players in both upstream and downstream space markets, service providers in the insurance and legal sectors, space agencies (such as NASA, ESA and UKSA), establish new entrants to the industry and start-ups.

entityDescription: My main drive is to inspire people as an artist and as a gallerist in the perspective of collaboration with galleries in New york, L.A. and Paris for my artists and me, with the help of the newest technologies and blockchain. NORAVISION, is a decentralized ecosystem through which an eclectic pool of artists, collectors, investors, auction houses, and galleries gather in efforts to raise awareness of the world’s most talented artists through liquidable digital-asset investments, an AIpowered digital community, and blockchain-driven authenticity & tracking protocols. The mission of the NORAVISION platform is to create further transparency in efforts to demotivate the art black market, whilst offering higher transactionatory speeds, within a fully-traceable art world. At the core, functional level, the NORAVISION ecosystem leverages “eDLT” technology, of which boasts a custom Blockchain protocol. In efforts to decentralize the art world, each member of the NORAVISION ecosystem acts as a “node” which has the capacity to engage in smart-contract based transactions and data sharing that is traced from the artists, to the end-clients. In the position of acting as a “node,” each ecosystem member has - due to the decentralized manner of the NORAVISION ecosystem, the complete right of privacy over their data and personal information sharing, of which is especially important when protecting the privacy of the entire ecosystem. With each node acting as an active member of NORAVISION, the eDLT-powered platform allows for a true peer-to-peer experience through offering each member AI-driven curation via an intuitive e-boutique; authenticate and physically track art on different scales with the latest IoT (Internet of Things) hardware; whilst allowing for artists to “tokenize” their businesses, and raise funds from their audience base in a seamless, highly-liquidable fashion. Via the NORAVISION ecosystem’s fundraising model, we were able to create the world’s first example of tokenizing artists themselves through which he/she is able to share gross revenues with his/her investor community via a Digital Security Offering (otherwise known as a Security Token Offering - STO) NORAVISION will be a cornerstone in the art world, and all of its inner-workings, as the main element of our “why” is fueled by personal pain points stemming from our Founder’s experience as an artist herself. NORAVISION was built for the international Art community, by members of the international Art community. NORAVISIONSOLAR - CREATIVE & CIRCULAR, SOLAR PANELS as Work of Art, sold on Auctions or metro - airport murals, profit goes to Artists and Trustees delegated for recyclation of old panels...The prolonged lifetime of the panel itself allows dignified hold and creates a positive economic model that indirectly takes care of the fate of old panels, while also creating recyclables and creating unique added value. This model uses the ready - made concept, recorded in the historical course of time. Picture of the Diptych Solar Queen uses the principle of creative recycling, leaving a visible solar network, which is only slightly indicated in the impressionist Sunset. The works were created in cooperation with the director of Suncontract, Mr.Gregor Novak and with BISOL solar company. Recent projects including paited solar panels were: Contemporary Venice, 2019, Luce Dell eterno, Glass Cathedral Santa Chiara, Murano, 2020, Artes Dei, Festival Ljubljana, 2020, Metamorphoses - The Worlds of Change, 2021, Ministry of Culture, Republic of Slovenia.

entityDescription: https://www.reply.com/en/#/en/about/reply-at-a-glance Reply is a company that specialises in Consulting, Systems Integration and Digital Services with a focus on the conception, design and implementation of solutions based on the new communication channels and digital media. Reply partners with key industrial groups in defining and developing business models made possible by the new technological and communication paradigms such as Big Data, Cloud Computing, Digital Communication, the Internet of Things and Mobile and Social Networking. In so doing, it aims to optimise and integrate processes, applications and devices. Reply’s offer is aimed at fostering the success of its customers through the introduction of innovation along the whole economic digital chain. Given its knowledge of specific solutions and due to a consolidated experience, Reply addresses the main core issues of the various industrial sectors. Reply’s offer covers three areas of competence: Processes – for Reply the understanding and the use of technology involves the introduction of a new enabling factor for business processes, based on an in-depth knowledge of both the market and the specific industrial contexts of implementation; Applications – Reply designs and develops application solutions aimed at meeting core business needs; Technologies – Reply optimises the use of innovative technologies, creating solutions that are capable of guaranteeing maximum operational efficiency and flexibility for its clients. Within the three areas Reply offers: Consultancy – on strategy, communications, processes and technologies; Systems Integration – to use the full potential of technology by combining business consulting services with innovative technical solutions and high levels of added value; Application Management – the management, monitoring and continuous development of software assets. Reply is listed on Borsa Italiana S.p.A. [MTA, STAR: REY].

entityDescription: The Space Research and Technology Institute - BAS carries out fundamental and applied research in the fields of Space Physics, Remote Sensing of the Earth, Space Technology, Space Biology and Medicine and Materials Science. As a leading space research organization of the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences, the SRTI and its director is primary in charge of long-term planning and elaboration of space research programs in close connection with national priorities of which a considerable part is performed within the framework of international space research cooperation, development of space materials and technologies and their transfer to the national economy, education of post-graduate students and MS students. The SRTI-BAS works in close cooperation with similar institutes from Bulgaria and abroad. entityDescription:
Tilde is a leading European language technology innovator and service provider that strives to enable different languages in the digital age. By using the latest cuttingedge AI-driven technologies, Tilde develops intelligent virtual assistants, speech technologies and custom machine translation systems. Tilde has special experience in developing high-demand cloud-based technologies for complex, highly inflected languages, particularly smaller European languages. Tilde develops technologies for big data processing (e.g., speech corpora for speech recognition, parallel corpora for machine translation), storage, management, and application in machine learning driven artificial intelligence technologies. 
Tilde is a regional language technology research hub and a pioneer in using neural networks for processing complex language text and speech. Our services are used by the European Commission and international companies such as IBM and Microsoft. Tilde.AI language technology platform is a blend of cutting-edge technology and business know-how. Tilde.AI supports a variety of communication channels, which means that you are reachable everywhere. Be it text or voice our 3D avatar and the latest generation support in development keeps our solutions fresh and future-proof. 
Tilde’s excellence in AI-driven language technologies is showcased by its success in neural machine translation development and deployment for its customers. Tilde’s NMT systems are available to all users of its cloud-based MT platform Tilde MT. Since 2017, Tilde’s neural machine translation systems have been supporting translation efforts for the EU Council presidencies in Estonia and Bulgaria, Austria, Romania, Finland, Croatia, and Germany.
Tilde is a full Big Data Value Association (BDVA)/ Data, AI and Robotics (DAIRO)member, elected to the board of directors and EU partnership board and leading the SME group. Tilde also serves on the board of the European Language Resource Association (ELRA), European language technology industry association (LT-Innovate), and Multilingual Europe Technology Alliance (META-NET). 
Tilde has a long track-record of large-scale EU projects, both coordinating and participating as a partner, including Framework Programmes 5th, 6th, and 7th, as well as H2020 and CEF Telecom, Interreg and EUROSTARS. Tilde is a long-time technology partner of the EC and is currently helping to develop its large-scale automated translation infrastructure CEF eTranslation. More information: http://tilde.com. 
Tilde has 150+ employees in three offices including 10 PhDs advancing research in AI and language tech area. We are proud of our 170+ scientific publications. Tilde’s award-winning technologies are serving a large user base from corporates and governments to SMEs and individuals.

entityDescription:
Established in 2006, Europe Consultancy is a Brussels-based company with solid experience collaborating with International and European Public Sector Organizations and Agencies (EU, UN, OECD, ESA, ESO, EPO, NATO etc.) in the Learning & Professional Development area. Our coaching, training and consultancy services support organizations, teams and individuals from multiple cultural and professional backgrounds across five world regions, in the effective implementation of their mission and strategies. 
Europe Consultancy specializes in international leadership, management, and professional development. Our clients and partners appreciate our high level of flexibility, reliability, and fast responseplus a proven capability to collaborate closely and effectively with them. At all times, we focus on a customer-centric and partnership approach.
We take a holistic approach to professional development where the human being is centre-stage: beyond supporting clients in harnessing skills and behaviours in their immediate work environment, Europe Consultancy associates help their clients reach their human potential by building self-awareness, tapping into their strengths, fully using their creative resources, and developing a sense of life purpose. 
All our interventions are anchored in the realities of international organizations. At the same time, they are informed by research disciplines including leadership and professional development theory, psychology, brain functioning, cultural intelligence, and emotional competence. 
Being committed to optimal translation of our clients’ needs, Europe Consultancy rigorously applies the A.D.D.I.E. instructional and qualitative process in its relationships with client organizations.
Experiential learning is the guiding principle of our quality, highly-customized “blended” training solutions. We aim for the immediate application of course participants’ new skills and knowledge in their workplace. Our course design is orientated towards their daily needs. 
In our coaching interventions for individuals and teams, we pull from diverse and evidence-based approaches from positive psychology to cultural anthropology to not so basic common sense. We work together to help them raise the bar of their performance, or integrate new leadership skills and behaviours.
Europe Consultancy operates with a core team of managing partners. Before setting up as executive coaches, trainers and consultants, all had 15+ experience holding leadership functions in the world of international public organisations and corporate companies, as well as in academia. Europe Consultancy furthermore collaborates with a network of inspirational, qualified, experienced, multicultural and multi-lingual associates who deliver transformational coaching and training interventions, as well as consulting services. 
Any further questions on Europe Consultancy’s sustainable and impactful approach and learning solutions? Please contact us at: info@europeconsultancy.com and visit our website on: www.europeconsultancy.com. We look forward to partnering with you.

DB SERET is a technology leader specialising in the design and delivery of high-quality digitisation services and innovative platforms for long-term digital preservation (LTDP), data governance, and interoperability.

entityDescription:
There are few companies today that are able to design projects that have a strong impact on the future of people. Often, despite these winning ideas, for various reasons, you can’t make them and push them in the right way. The incubator companies enter this stalemate, with the precise aim of making them emerge, grow and compete in the global market.
Only the best projects hit us. We are digital talent scouts because we recognize the potential of nascent projects, which stand out for innovation and for the positive impact they could have on people. IES, always an incubator of innovative ideas, supports companies in achieving their business objectives. Our team, with its technological, strategic and design skills, supports companies and startups that want to achieve a higher level of performance. Our research and analysis work lead to the design and development of the best-finished product. Through technology, design and marketing, an idea is shaped into a functional digital and physical product. The delivery of the project to the customer does not close the circle. In fact, is followed from the analysis of user feedback. Monitoring the impact of our creation on users is essential to improve the project in all its aspects, so we support customers from beginning to end. As an incubator for other companies' projects, we feel more responsible and, for this reason, we are committed to double the task. The success of an external company project is first of all our success. IES Italia specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new technologies and digital Platforms. Through its own Full-stack-Development Team and a wide network of certified consultants around 45 persons, IES Italia supports customers and partners to define and develop new business models, suited to the new paradigms of telecommunication, Cybersecurity, Blockchain, Digital Media and the Internet of Things. Italia services include: Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services. Moreover, iES Italia aims to act like a startup incubator creating spinoff from internal R&D development. entityName: University of Ioannina - Composites and Smart Materials Laboratory
entityDescription:
The Composite & Smart Materials Laboratory (CSML) was established in 2007, as part of the Mechanics and NDE Division of the Department of Materials Science and Engineering (DMSE), University of Ioannina.

The mission of the CSML is to provide education and research in the field of Advanced Composite Materials and Structures with special emphasis in Non-Destructive Evaluation and Multiple Smart Functionalities. In the area of destructive evaluation emphasis is given in the durability of composite materials (wear behavior, mechanical / thermomechanical characterization, environmental loading, fracture and fatigue). Research activities include hierarchical Composites and interfaces, biodegradable micro/nano-composites: manufacturing and processing, smart multifunctional materials and structures, and novel NDE and process monitoring technique development based on Thermal, Optical and Electrical stimulation/ response of the interrogated structures.
Since its foundation, CSML features more than 150 journal and conference publications, cited more than 2400 times, a significant number of national and international collaborations, the hosting of the “Emerging Technologies in Non-Destructive Testing” international conference and the organization of the summer school on "Composite and Smart Materials: Theory and Applications" in collaboration with the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki and Texas A& M University. CSML has attracted approximately M�2 funding, almost in total (>97%) from competitive research programs and private collaborations.
The academic members of CSML are responsible for the teaching (or co-teaching) of 10 theoretical and laboratory undergraduate courses in the DMSE curriculum and 4 courses in the recently established postgraduate course of DMSE, “Advanced Materials”. In CSML, more than 15 postgraduate students (MSc or PhD) work in a variety of research projects and more than 20 undergraduate students perform their final year project.

entityDescription:
QED Software is a research and development company focused on creating new mathematical methods and their application in production environments. Our focus lies in data analysis, data exploration, machine learning and approximated reasoning / artificial intelligence. We have years of experience with computer vision, time series analysis and forecasts, exploratory data analysis, as well as analysis of heterogonous data. Implementations include large scale image processing, predictive maintenance, time series forecasts, modelling and prediction of environmental hazards, text and data mining, as well as secure processing of image streams combined with non-image data sources. 

Research work is supervised by academic staff: prof. Dominik Slezak, prof. Bogusław Cyganek, prof. Marek Sikora. 

Research topics: 
Computer vision - segmentation, classification and extracting features from images combined with non-image data sources. Utilization of these methods on large and quickly-increasing data sets. Building services on satellite data. We cooperate closely with CloudFerro as manager of CREODIAS platform. 
Scaling of ML on big data sets - pairing custom compression methods with ML methods that can be used on compressed data. As a result, machine learning models can be executed much faster than on the original data, without big loss of output accuracy. These methods can be used both on time series data, and on images / video sources. These methods can be used for edge processing - where its not feasible to transfer data to data center for full processing - or as a tool for quick approximated scans of big data sets. 
Explainability of ML - our research focuses on introduction of explainability overlay to existing and new machine learning models, aimed at explaining reasoning behind system output, impact of data quality on model errors and giving insight into sources of uncertainty of model outputs. The toolset can be used both by end users, to enrich model output, and by engineers to optimize model operation during its creation/modifications. 
Support for active learning - optimization of active learning cycles by choosing optimal data for labelling and using it to retrain / upgrade ML model output quality. Using this approach, it is possible to begin with a machine learning model, and upkeep / increase its output quality by picking minimal set of data points that, when used to retrain the model, has maximum output in terms of model quality. These set of tools and techniques can be used to maintain model quality for models operating in changing and unstable environments. 
Steering of agents in simulation environment - a technology primarily developed for game development studios, it can find its use in any multi-agent simulation environment, where there's need for algorithmic and evolutionary behavior of agents, especially if said agents need to perform in a certain way (e.g. human-like behavior). 
Automatic coaching - a system allowing for automated coaching and insights to humans, in any situation where tasks are well measured and when a goal function can be defined / observed. Adding a layer of human-language ontology, it is possible to give feedback regarding what can be done in order to perform these tasks better. Possible usage includes high-value specialized equipment operators or high risk human operations - both within VR training facilities and in a real world use scenarios. 

Before 2020, the company operated as a central hub for daughter companies, each focusing on different aspect of machine learning and AI applications. 
In 2020, we're moving people and projects into QED Software, forming a uniform R&D team of 40 employees till the end of the year.

description:
OUR SOLUTION

Future communication networks are getting more advanced, but also more complex. Analyzing such advanced networks, scenarios, algorithms, and protocols, require detailed radio network simulators. Magister Solutions Ltd. offers network simulations as a service targeted for the design, development, optimization and maintenance of satellite and terrestrial communication networks. The service, Magister SimLab, integrates the whole network simulation workflow into one service including scenario and campaign design, simulation execution and monitoring, and results analysis. 

CUSTOMER BENEFIT

Development of detailed system simulators for telecom and/or SatCom purposes require long lasting development projects requiring time, money, and competent personnel. We offer our detailed radio network simulators for use though the SimLab simulation service without massive development projects enabling reduced capital costs. Graphically defined guided simulation process shall speed-up the simulation workflow enabling to get results faster, and thus, reducing labor costs. SimLab service is built on a scalable, high performance cloud-based architecture with no capital costs and operational costs only based on use. 

COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE

Magister Solutions has a long history related to development of wireless technologies, network simulators and R&D services for both ESA and leading telecom and SatCom companies. This has given us a front seat view to the telecom industry enabling us to build state-of-the-art simulation services. Providing detailed network simulations as a service is a unique solution throughout the world. 

COMPANY

Magister Solutions is Finnish company specializing in network simulation tools and services for modelling real world telecom and SatCom in detail. We have been years up front in the technology development and standardization, working together with leading mobile and satellite communication organizations. 

SUMMARY

Magister Solutions Ltd. offers communication network simulations as a service targeted for the design, development, optimization and maintenance of satellite and terrestrial communication networks.
