description:
Shaping the Future of Autonomous Exploration

NGC Aerospace Ltd is a Canadian high-tech SME recognised for the design and deployment of artificial vision, guidance, navigation and control systems for the autonomous operation of space, aeronautical and terrestrial vehicles. The analyses, algorithms, simulators and real-time software developed by NGC aim at increasing the autonomy, performance, reliability and safety of these intelligent vehicles while at the same time reducing their operational cost. From theoretical concepts and innovations to satellites and autonomous rovers currently in operation, NGC has demonstrated creativity, quality, excellence and performance consistent with its motto.
entityDescription: NGC Aerospace Ltd is a Canadian SME located in Sherbrooke in Quebec. NGC is a corporation registered with the Canadian Federal Government and is 100% Canadian-owned. NGC Aerospace Ltd is recognised for the design and deployment of artificial vision, guidance, navigation and control systems for the autonomous operation of space, aeronautical and terrestrial vehicles. The analyses, algorithms, simulators and real-time software developed by NGC aim at increasing the autonomy, performance, reliability and safety of these intelligent vehicles while at the same time reducing their operational cost. From theoretical concepts and innovations to satellites and autonomous rovers currently in operation, NGC has demonstrated creativity, quality, excellence and performance consistent with its motto of shaping the future of autonomous systems through ingenuity, expertise and collaboration. NGCs expertise covers the full range of knowledge and skills from defining the mission of an intelligent mobile system to its realisation in an operational environment including: the requirement analysis, the conceptual design, the architectural design, the detailed design, the implementation and the validation. NGC's expertise also extends to the mathematical modelling of the intelligent mobile system itself and the development of the associated high-fidelity engineering simulators required for the validation of the intelligent mobile system. Since its incorporation in 2001, NGC has a long list of accomplishments covering the full spectrum from research and development projects to flight software development and in-orbit validation. NGC has been involved in several space mission programs starting with the development of the Attitude Control and Navigation System (ACNS) software for PROBA-1, then continuing with, amongst others, the Attitude and Orbit Control System (AOCS) software for the PROBA-2 and PROBA-V spacecraft. NGC has participated in a series of field demonstrations, either as a preparation for space missions or for the demonstration of its technologies in terrestrial applications. NGCs employees have been involved in several R and D projects including: Planetary Exploration Mission Concepts and Technologies, Formation Flying GNC Technologies, Rendezvous GNC Technologies, Asteroid Exploration Mission Concepts, Verification and Validation Technologies, Earth Observation Mission Concepts and Advanced Attitude and Orbit Control System Technologies

- Systems Engineering: consultancy, study and design with regard to mechanical, underwater, marine and space systems for which design with a strong multidisciplinary and inter-functional approach is necessary. 
- Modelling and Simulation: dynamic simulation services and software solutions for systems operation and control, which is necessary to verify their design.
- Diagnostics and Knowledge Extraction: software solution and services for anomaly detection, diagnostics and prognostics of systems and for the extraction of knowledge from data, exploiting State-of-the-Art Machine Learning or SATE proprietary data-driven approaches. 
- On-board / In-field software products: customised software solutions for simulation, diagnostics or data processing for on-board or in-field applications.
SATE quality system is certified according to ISO 9001-2015 standards.
entityDescription: S.A.T.E. entityDescription:
Neuraspace aims to solve the issue of space traffic at large and debris specifically by protecting satellites operators from collisions and providing manoeuvring assistance, with an end-to-end automated solution built on three pillars:
(1) Data Fusion: a persistent and reliable data source for better characterization of conjunction events by reducing uncertainties, from space debris images, collision data messages (CDMs), ephemeris files, state vectors from established catalogues and satellite owners, space weather and asset’s information about the assets being managed.
(2) Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML): automate complex decision processes, detect patterns from complex data to provide better collision predictions for risk mitigation.

(3) Manoeuvring Automation: An end-to-end automated 24/7 AI-enabled collision risk prediction complemented by intelligent manoeuvre suggestions that considers operator constraints and priorities will significantly reduce operation’s time and costs.

entityDescription:
Aimsun’s international team of technologists, scientists, and transportation engineers works to solve the world’s most complex mobility problems.
Aimsun develops and markets four high-performance software applications:
Aimsun Next is a multi-resolution modeling platform that simulates mobility in networks of all sizes, from a single intersection to an entire region. Modeling traffic, cyclists, pedestrians and public transport in one package, Aimsun Next is the perfect all-in-one tool for everything from planning to operations and evaluation of ITS and autonomous vehicles.
Built on the Next platform, Aimsun Live is a real-time decision support tool that helps traffic operators predict future traffic conditions and simulate the impact of different traffic management strategies.
Aimsun Auto is a software toolkit for the design and validation of path-planning algorithms for self-driving vehicles. Used in combination with sensor and vehicle dynamics simulation tools, Auto provides a test harness that is full-stack, highly automated and infinitely scalable.
Aimsun Ride is a demand-responsive transportation platform that simulates and analyzes the efficiency of flexible mobility services. Ride helps understand the interaction between a fleet and other road users and helps develop business cases for running a service.
Whether testing the impact of connected and autonomous vehicles, training artificial intelligence and machine learning to forecast and manage traffic, modeling the interaction of public and private vehicles, or offering insights into smarter multi-modal transportation choices ,Aimsun never stops harnessing innovations in science and technology to improve human mobility.
Aimsun is the parent company of the UK Entity - Aimsun Ltd.

entityDescription: The National Institute for Astrophysics (INAF) is the Italian agency for astrophysical research. It runs 17 research Institutes in the country and several research infrastructures such the Telescopio Nazionale Galileo (TNG) in the Canary Islands, the Large Binocular Telescope (LBT) in Arizona, the Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) Antennas, etc. INAF comprises about 700 research staff, 390 technical and administrative support staff, 310 postdoctoral and 110 graduate students. Its main active areas of interest are the study of the Universe in all its aspects, from the Solar System to Cosmology, and the development of advanced instrumentation and technologies for both ground-based and satellites observations. Since many of these technologies are potentially useful in our lives as well, INAF is also deeply engaged in creating and strengthening opportunities for technological transfer.

KYOCERA AVX Components s.r.o. (before AVX Czech Republic s.r.o.) is part of the multinational KYOCERA AVX Corporation based in South Carolina, USA (owned by the Japanese company Kyocera Group). KYOCERA AVX Corporation is the world's leading manufacturer of passive electronic components and a recognized technical leader in the industry. Its market share also makes it a dominant player in the world market.
Part of the tantalum division is the Lanškroun plant, which was founded in 1992 under the name AVX Czechoslovakia s.r.o. based on successful cooperation between AVX Corporation and Tesla Lanškroun (traditional electronic components manufacturer).
The Lanškroun plant was the first KYOCERA AVX Corporation plant in the Czech Republic, gradually expanding and currently KYOCERA AVX Components s.r.o. has four factories producing a wide range of products.
 
- the Lanskroun plant (tantalum division), not only produces a wide range of tantalum capacitors, but also serves the research and development center of these electronic components
- the Uherske Hradiste plant (ceramic capacitors division and "special products") produces ceramic and power capacitors, MLO capacitors and varistors
- the plant in Bzenec (Connector Division) focuses on the manufacture of contacts, plastic injection and assembly of connectors
 
All KYOCERA AVX Components s.r.o. plants in Czech Republic hold all the necessary certifications for product distribution even for the most demanding markets.
In total, the company has more than 2500 employees in the Czech Republic, of which, more than 150 are expert technicians, technical and development engineers.

Company description: MIPRONS is a Start-Up, set-up in 2019, aims at developing innovative high-performing miniaturized space propulsion systems adopting water as a propellant which is “split” into hydrogen and oxygen through a water-electrolysis process.
In particular, 2 innovative space propulsion systems are under development and patent filed:
- “Space propulsion system” (PCT/IB2018/055595, already issued in Italy and filed in 49 countries), is able to deliver high thrust and high Isp (specific impulse), ideal to quickly accomplish manoeuvres such as orbit raising, de-orbiting, collision avoidance, etc, with low propellant weight.
- “Low and high thrust space propulsion system”, PCT/IB2021/061166. The second patent, a technological advancement of the first, refers to an innovative propulsion system, capable of delivering both low and high thrust (aka multi-mode), using water as a single primary propellant. Beside the water-electrolysis system there is a steam propulsion system for low thrust, ideal for high-precision maneuvering (attitude & control). In this way, it is possible to reply to all the satellite manoeuvres requirements (DV and RCS) with a simplified system (small, light and cheap). 
The systems can be installed on:
· Satellites and/or their carriers;
· Extra-atmospheric drones;
· Final stages of launchers;
· Small spacecraft mission services.

entityDescription: CRS4 (Centro di Ricerca, Sviluppo e Studi Superiori in Sardegna-CRS4 Srl Uninominale, https://www.crs4.it) is a research organisation founded in 1990. Initially headed by the Nobel Prize in Physics Carlo Rubbia, CRS4 has a current staff of about 150 people among researchers and professionals, working at 6 main strategic sectors: Biosciences, Computational Infrastructures and Smart Projects, Digital Technologies for Aerospace, HPC for Energy and Environment, ICT-Information Society and Visual and Data Intensive Computing. CRS4 is equipped with one of the major Italian High Performance Computing centers, the largest Next Generation DNA Sequencing platform in Italy and a state-of-the-art Visual Computing Lab. CRS4 has participated in +35 EU R&D projects, among which 16 in FP7 and 12 in H2020 mainly in the topics ENVIRONMENT, SECURITY, PEOPLE, SMART CITIES, INFRASTRUCTURES and ENERGY, in +70 projects funded by National/Regional Research Programmes and in various R&D contracts with the Private Sector (Oil&Gas and IT Industry). CRS4 is fully-owned by the Sardinian regional agency Sardegna Ricerche (https://www.sardegnaricerche.it) and it is located in the Technology Park of Sardinia (Pula (Cagliari), Italy).

entityDescription:
KU Leuven is Europe’s most innovative university. Located in Belgium, it is dedicated to education and research, and as such to service to society. KU Leuven is a founding member of the League of European Research Universities (LERU) and has a strong European and international orientation. Our scientists conduct basic and applied research in a comprehensive range of disciplines. University Hospitals Leuven, our network of research hospitals, provides high-quality healthcare and develops new therapeutic and diagnostic insights with an emphasis on translational research. The university welcomes more than 60,000 students from over 140 countries. The KU Leuven Doctoral Schools train over 6,000 PhD students.
KU Leuven consistently performs well in the international rankings. It is currently ranked 45th in the Times Higher Education World Ranking and 84th in the QS World University Ranking. As a comprehensive university, KU Leuven researchers are driven by curiosity to expand the frontiers of all academic fields. As a university deeply interwoven into society, our researchers also pursue targeted and demand driven research in an interdisciplinary environment. The university has a strong record of securing funding from the most competitive research funds, including the prestigious ERC Grants awarded by the European Research Council. KU Leuven is ranked fifth in the number of projects awarded to universities under the EU Horizon 2020 Programme, preceded only by Cambridge, Oxford, Copenhagen and University College London. The university’s research output consistently ranks among Europe’s best. Since 2014, KU Leuven has acquired 514 projects and around 291 million euros in funding from Horizon 2020.
University Hospitals Leuven has a total of 2,000 beds and 9,000 employees, and is among the most modern and well-equipped hospitals in Europe. The university hospitals are embedded in a Health Sciences Campus, where education, advanced research and medical care are brought together in one single location, facilitating a strong cross-fertilization between research and patient care.
KU Leuven Research & Development (LRD) is KU Leuven’s technology transfer office and deals with projects which involve a collaboration with companies or the exploitation of research results. Ever since 1972, LRD has been building bridges between science and industry. By launching innovative technologies in society and the commercial market, LRD advances the impact of research results on people’s lives across the globe. LRD has established an international reputation for collaborating with industry, securing and licensing intellectual property rights, creating spin-off companies and stimulating knowledge-driven regional development. LRD supports researchers throughout the entire knowledge and technology transfer process and helps them to best leverage the societal and economic potential of their research. 
For more information, please visit: https://lrd.kuleuven.be/en

The KU Leuven Research Coordination Office is the front office to the legal and financial department of KU Leuven. We are the first contact points for budget checks and legal advice. Our mission is to inform, stimulate and support KU Leuven researchers in performing research and securing research funding.

description:
C3S LLC is a determining player in the international nanosatellite industry. Our products and solutions serve and support both scientific payloads and industrial demands throughout the missions. Our mission planning activity encompasses 3-16U, high-reliability platform, and subsystem design, as well as the prelaunch simulation software and hardware development and mission operation environment development. Beyond the world of CubeSats, we participate in large satellite projects as the designer of power distribution systems and payload synchronization. Long lifecycle and high availability are the characteristics of our in-house developed, and redundant subsystems.

A 40-strong collective of young and creative space engineers and experts understanding all the related areas of engineering necessary for developing satellites stands beyond the technology-independent, world-level products. Innovation and added value are our guiding principles that manifest themselves throughout the entire lifecycles of the company’s products.

We develop our products with the partner’s scientific and business demands in our minds. We offer them tailored turnkey solutions that encompass the entire lifecycle of the mission, from planning through simulations, tests, and manufacturing to mission tracking and operation.

entityDescription: Titan4 is committed to leveraging innovative earth observation downstream solutions to advance environmental stewardship and safety on a global scale. Building on our successful incubation period in the European Space Agency BIC program, Titan4 harnesses innovative technologies to process and analyze optical and radar satellite images with unparalleled speed, cost-effectiveness, and accuracy. Our mission is to empower stakeholders to monitor and safeguard the health of our planet's ecosystems and infrastructure, providing actionable insights and timely information to inform strategic planning, risk management, and policy development. With the Titan4 platform, users can assess and monitor public and private infrastructures, land stability, structural deformations, seismic areas, and more. Our automatic InSAR data processing tool delivers near real-time results at a millimeter scale, complemented by data fusion features, visual and historical reports, trend analysis, and critical deformation alerts. Key features of Titan4 platform include: - Rapid and highly accurate results - Flexible pay-per-use pricing model - Scalable high-performance computing for large geographical areas - Streamlined automation of all processing phases - Intuitive interface and API connections for data integration - Comprehensive training and dedicated assistance at every stage At Titan4, we pride ourselves on our interdisciplinary team of telecom engineers, data scientists, and software architects. This collaborative approach ensures the robustness, reliability and innovation of our solutions, making Titan4 the preferred choice for both public and private sector clients seeking to leverage satellite technology for environmental monitoring and sustainability initiatives. Join us in our vision to preserve our planet for future generations. Let's work together to unlock the full potential of satellite data integration and drive positive environmental impact.

entityDescription: Early in 2004 the Ministry of Education and Science (Spanish Government), Generalitat de Catalunya (local Catalan Government) and Technical University of Catalonia (UPC) took the initiative of creating a National Supercomputing Center in Barcelona. BSC-CNS (Barcelona Supercomputing Center ¿ Centro Nacional de Supercomputación) is the National Supercomputing Facility in Spain and was officially constituted in April 2005. BSC-CNS manages MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, located at the Torre Girona chapel. The mission of BSC-CNS is to investigate, develop and manage information technology in order to facilitate scientific progress. With this aim, special dedication has been taken to areas such as Computational Sciences, Life Sciences and Earth Sciences. All these activities are complementary to each other and very tightly related. In this way, a multidisciplinary loop is set up: our exposure to industrial and non-computer science academic practices improves our understanding of the needs and helps us focusing our basic research towards improving those practices. The result is very positive both for our research work as well as for improving the way we service our society.

entityDescription:
Quanta & Qualia (Q&Q) is a Greek, private, for-profit, deep tech SME established in 2017. Its headquarters are located in Greece and currently operates in Athens Digital Lab in Athens Greece.R&D and smallproductionis performed 100% in-house;
Q&Q aspires of a future where current user interaction devices, like joysticks in the XR, will be replaced by a more intuitive one, entirely revolutionizing the interaction framework, providing an appreciably higher User Experience.
Goal is to enable the sense of touch (interaction via fingers) in digital environment like this happens in the natural world.
Its main focus and activity concern the commercialization of MAGOS (patent pending (PCT/EP20200/73034) solution.

Based on studies and reports of high profile organizations, the interaction in extended reality (XR) is not at the desired level yet. A major factor is the lack of a device that enables user to interact with the use of their fingers within the Digital environment, as this happens in the physical world. As you can see in the picture the trainee uses the state of the art controllers that impacts the natural interaction between trainee and virtual cockpit.
Existing solutions only partially address the problem since they have technology constraints that impact the UX.
For that reason, we see a next generation input device, that revolutionizes the interaction within digital environment. So, the end user will interact using their fingers in a natural, more immersive and intuitive way.
Magos comes to treat a pain point, in two Virtual Reality applications.
The one is the Virtual Training and Simulation, where companies like Airbus Lockheed martin and Nasa, be trained and experience the cockpit of the future.
The second one is the Virtual design and engineering, where companies like Siemens, Philips and Pixar, design their products within virtual environment. The difference with Magos is that you can interact naturally via fingers instead of holding a pair of controllers.
MAGOS is a Platform As A Service solution at TRL 7
It is comprised by the MAGOS gloves and the unique interactions platform. The hardware and the software have been optimized for the best XR experience which pushes the level of immersion, generations ahead.

description:
Axon Engineering S.A (legal name Axon Michanologiki ) was established in 1985 as a manufacturing company. One of our key areas of expertise is the production of built to print aircraft engine maintenance tooling, ground support equipment, lifting devices, wheelsets and complex fabrications for aerospace industry. In addition to the aerospace sector , Axon Engineering also manufactures a wide range of products for companies in sectors such as electronics , optics, sensors, telecommunication, transportation, marine and defense /military (NATO Cage Code G1727). 

Our aim is to provide to our customers a complete Engineering solution by always maintaining good lead times, on-time delivery, quality and reliability at competitive prices. Providing our customers all the necessary services of a "one stop shop" supporting them all the way from sourcing and manufacturing to assembly and delivery of products. Axon employs some of the most skilled professionals in our industry combining engineering expertise and over 35 years of technical experience. 

Our capabilities include: 

* CAD / CAM Design
* Research & Development 
*Machining - Wide range of CNC & Conversional Machines 
* Welding Area (ASME Section IX / EN certified )
* Special Finishing Processes (such as Painting, Black oxide ,Alodine, Anodize, Deconyl)
* Load & Pressure Tests 
* Fabrications - Assembly department 
*Aircraft tooling department 
* Worldwide procurement & delivery capabilities

Ensuring top quality products and services is a cornerstone of Axon’s philosophy. As a quality- orientated company, Axon fully certified with ISO 9001/2015 standards and working towards AS9100 certification.
Our Quality control department is fully equipped with many testing and inspection equipment as well as a Mitutoyo CMM & a Romer Absolute Arm by Hexagon Metrology.

description: Frentech Aerospace s.r.o. is a leading supplier for aircraft and space industry in Czech Republic and has also great experience with deliveries for defense. As almost 100% exporter the company has long term experience in cooperation with key European companies like AIRBUS, Thales Alenia Space, Airbus Defence and Space, SAFRAN, SAGEM, EMERSON and others. Frentech Aerospace s.r.o. delivers components for all Airbus aircrafts including A400M and also to Boeing and Embraer including KC390. Historically Frentech Aerospace has delivered more than 2 million of parts for Airbus aircrafts. Frentech Aerospace cooperates for more than 12 years with European space industry and ESA and took part within the projects IRIDIUM NEXT, MTG, O3B, ExoMars 2016, ExoMars 2022, JUICE, Ariane 5, Ariane 6, VEGA and others. Frentech Aerospace is certified per ISO9001, AS9100-D, ISO14001, Airbus and other approvals.
entityDescription:
Frentech Aerospace s.r.o. focuses on production and delivery of mechanical parts, assembled modules and subsystems mostly for aircraft and space industry. Frentech Aerospace s.r.o. also delivers for demanding markets in the field of instrumental technique, microelectronics, nanotechnology, radar technique, production of special machines, medicine and vacuum technique. Frentech Aerospace s.r.o. is mature technological company equipped with modern productive CNC machines, assembly premises, 'Clean Room' per ISO7 (10 000) and clean zone per ISO5 (100). CMM MITUTOYO and testing thermal chamber ANGELANTONI 1 m3 for thermal cycling test performance in range of +200°C / - 180°C also in vacuum (0,2 m3) is placed within clean room per ISO7. This vacuum chamber is equipped with TQCM monitoring during outgassing and bake-out per ECSS standards. The clean room is equipped with particulate and molecular contamination evaluation possibility. The workstation for ESD operations is also placed within the cleanroom.

Frentech Aerospace s.r.o. has 24 CNC machines available for production of complex parts. Five machines have five driven axes and one is equipped with 9 driven axes. Two HSC five axes Fehlmann machines are installed for productive production of parts with high level of automation with robot EROWA and magazines with 140 pallets. These machines operates in unmanned mode. Inspection department is equipped with CMM's MITUTOYO. Frentech Aerospace s.r.o. is sophisticated company with system for real time production management CPC (Mazak). Planning module, Tool Management System and Machine Monitoring System is actively used within this system. Three workstations with Solid Works and Solid Cam (CAD/CAM) are used for programming. All materials are machined (Aluminum, Titanium, Stainless steels, Inconel, Monel, PTFE and more). Material is purchased form certified resources from Europe and USA. Surface treatments are performed at subcontractors with NADCAP certification. Frentech Aerospace s.r.o. is certified per ISO9001, AS9100-D, ISO14001 and QSF-A and is qualified by Thales Alenia Space for performance of special processes (CQT 448 , TAS-F) and by Airbus in accordance with Airbus Procedure AP5270. During past years the company acquired necessary know-how for production of aircraft and space technique and is also equipped with device for qualification of the screws per aerospace standards.

All employees, technicians and operators , are skilled and motivated in order to achieve the best technical and economical results of the company. Frentech Aerospace is offset partner for SAAB and Airbus S.A. Frentech Aerospace is a member of Czech Space Alliance, SPACE Association (D) and Confederation of Industry of the Czech Republic.

entityDescription:
Deimos Engenharia founded 2002, provides R&D and systems engineering for Space and Defense from Portugal. DEIMOS Engenharia leads an extensive portfolio of activities for ESA, NASA, EUMETSAT, EC, GSA commercial civil and military clients. Flagships projects include National Space Situational Sensors and Networks Systems for Portuguese MoD, ground systems for European Defense satellites, control systems for launchers and satellites, SDR Galileo precise navigation receivers, and QKD over SDN networks. Deimos is a contractor at all ESA’s sites (ESTEC, ESOC, ESRIN, ESAC) and at most important European space companies OEMs.

DEIMOS Engenharia builds on a solid team of (80+) highly motivated and specialized engineers being a reference player in the Portuguese space sector.

entityDescription:
ExoLabs mission is to provide state-of-the-art and user-friendly EO products and services across various spatial and temporal scales. ExoLabs’ track record includes (1) active monitoring and quantification of natural resources on a global scale (e.g. snow cover, depth and water equivalent), (2) build-up of EO based in-house capacities for insurances (e.g. for SwissRe) and (3) big data processing and management for federal offices (e.g. for the Swiss Federal Statistical Office). ExoLabs was founded in January 2017, after winning the CTI-Zurich Start-up Award for the most compelling business concept. 
The motivation to found ExoLabs as a service provider for EO products arose as a unique opportunity of several emerging developments: (1) The diversifying space sector provides an ever increasing number of satellite data that is in part freely available (cf. Space 4.0), (2) machine learning algorithms and artificial intelligence tools transformed data analysis with unprecedented levels of accuracy and (3) cloud computing solves previous data storing and processing power issues to scale EO products in time and space.

In the context of climate change and the associated changes in environmental conditions, ExoLabs enable businesses to better apply insights from Earth Observation (EO) data across sectors ranging from energy, insurance, tourism, commodity trading or agriculture to research and government. We ensure that cutting-edge scientific research finds a direct implementation in user-defined applications by building customized solutions for our clients that deliver financial and operational advantages. To overcome big data challenges, we exploit machine learning algorithms and utilize cloud computing facilities to carry out advanced data processing and analysis on local to global scales - both in retrospect for the past 40 years and as a near real-time solution. In addition, we provide consultancy on end-user requirements. We strive to be a leading downstream Earth Observation company in Europe, which provides high-dimensional thematic information based on EO and which implements in-house solutions for big data processing and analysis. ExoLabs currently offers access to unique EO data products via the common app stores (e.g. ExoSnow) and APIs (WMTS and file servers), running financed pilot projects with companies from the insurance and tourism sector as well as with research institutions.

entityDescription:
The Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Informatics of the Technical University of Košice (FEI TU) has been formed based on the Governmental Decree No.79/1969, Coll., of July 21, 1969 as a faculty originally titled "Faculty of Electrical Engineering of the TU of Košice". Ever since its formation with electrical engineering, those scientific and study branches that presently stand for the group of informatics-related sciences, gradually became significantly entrenched. From 15th April 1994 onwards the faculty has borne the name of Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Informatics of the TU of Košice.

The principal mission of FEI TU of Košice is seen in providing education on the basis of creative research especially in such fields as electrical engineering and informatics. Presently faculty consist from 11 separate departments. Wide spectrum of research and pedagogic activities are maps to three main directions:

 Informatics and Cybernetics,

 Electronics and Telecommunications,

 Electric Power and Heavy-Current Engineering.

entityDescription: Founded in 2003 in Toulouse, the initial focus for Magellium was meeting the needs of CNES (French Space Agency), IGN (French National Institute of Geography) and Airbus Defence & Space (formerly SpotImage). Magellium has grown steadily since its creation with recognized expertise in geo-information and image processing technologies applied to various sectors such as Space, Defense & Security, Energy & Environment¿. Technical teams of the company (157 staff in November 2019) are divided into two production sites in Toulouse (head office) and Paris (Courbevoie-92). Magellium covers 4 domains of expertise: - Earth Observation : Our know-how is highly relevant for satellite, aerial or UAV imagery. We have expert knowledge of remote sensor geometry, calibration/validation & quality control processes and image processing at all wavelengths and resolutions. Relying on a strong knowledge of advanced IT technologies (web, cloud, big data visualization) and state of the art map production/GIS techniques, we are deeply involved in the development of Earth Observation user services for EO data dissemination. - GIS & Mapping : We integrate third-party GIS solutions for various applications and handle challenging security, mobility and data fusion issues. Magellium proposes 3 levels of offers : - Technical & Scientific Studies: We have a dedicated pool of experts (mathematics, physics, image processing, computer sciences) who can deliver high level technical & scientific studies from concept to prototype. - Software & System development: We have delivered hundreds of engineering projects from software development to full system integration, underpinned by robust management and quality approaches ISO 9001:2008 certified. - Turnkey solutions & products: Our R&D programs give us the capability to deliver turnkey solutions for new geo-information & computer vision applications (software components, online services or complete systems).

Relying on a strong knowledge of advanced IT technologies (web, cloud, big data visualization) and state of the art map production/GIS techniques, we are deeply involved in the development of Earth Observation user services for EO data dissemination. - GIS & Mapping : We integrate third-party GIS solutions for various applications and handle challenging security, mobility and data fusion issues. We propose generic tools for large scale map production and dissemination. - GeoINT : Our expertise ranges from map production solutions to open source intelligence (source collections inventory & qualification, risk analysis, geospatial data obsolescence monitoring¿). - Computer vision & Robotics : Our expertise in geometry and image processing is valuable in many robotics and optoelectronics applications ranging from 2D/3D pattern recognition to vision-based localization. Magellium proposes 3 levels of offers : - Technical & Scientific Studies: We have a dedicated pool of experts (mathematics, physics, image processing, computer sciences) who can deliver high level technical & scientific studies from concept to prototype. - Software & System development: We have delivered hundreds of engineering projects from software development to full system integration, underpinned by robust management and quality approaches ISO 9001:2008 certified. - Turnkey solutions & products: Our R&D programs give us the capability to deliver turnkey solutions for new geo-information & computer vision applications (software components, online services or complete systems).

entityName: UNIVERSITY OF STRATHCLYDE - Aerospace Centre of Excellence
entityDescription:
Aerospace Centre of Excellence (ACE)

Our Research
The Aerospace Centre of Excellence (ACE) develops frontier research on innovative concepts and solutions for current and future space systems, sustainable aerospace transport, space exploration, satellite applications and the sustainable exploitation and exploration of space. The research in ACE has a target horizon of more than 50 years in the future but deploys practical solutions, over a wide range of Technology Readiness Levels to respond to the needs of today. The Aerospace Centre of Excellence currently encapsulates three application labs: Advanced Space Concepts laboratory (ASCL), Future Air-Space Transportation Technology laboratory (FASTT) and Intelligence Computational Engineering laboratory (ICElab). 

Key Areas of Research
· Advanced Space Concepts Laboratory (ASCL)
The ASCL undertakes frontier research on visionary space systems. Our work is delivering radically new approaches to space systems engineering to underpin new technologies for space exploration, new space services and the sustainability development of space activities. Our research projects are in the following areas:
- Cubesat and small satellites services and technologies
- Swarm engineering and networked systems
- Space situational awareness and space environment management
- Minor bodies exploration, exploitation and manipulation
- Autonomous systems
- Astrodynamics
- Advanced space concepts

· Future Air-Space Transportation Technology Laboratory (FASTTlab)
FASTTlab is a multidisciplinary research unit developing and integrating a range of aerospace technologies required for future sustainable aerospace systems. The vision of the laboratory is to transform the global air-space transportation system that include superior performance, safety and sustainability. Our research projects are in the following areas:
- Theoretical and computational aeroscience
- Trajectory and design optimisation fortrans-atmosphericvehicles
- Environmental impact of aerospace activities
- Planetary re-entry modelling and analysis
- Advanced propulsion systems

· Intelligent Computational Engineering Laboratory (ICElab)
ICElab develops advanced research on artificial and computational intelligence techniques with particular focus on optimisation, optimal control, uncertainty-based multidisciplinary design optimisation and machine learning applied to the design and control of complex engineering systems. Our research projects are in the following areas:
- Continuous and combinatorial optimisation methods
- Design for robustness, reliability and resilience
- Approaches for uncertainty treatment 
- AI, Machine learning and data science
- Uncertainty quantification and Resilience Engineering of complex engineering systems

- Intelligent Control

entityDescription:
We provide comprehensive services in the field of mechanical structures. We want to reduce the environmental impact ofopencast minesthrough new technological innovations.
Our mission is to provide high-quality projects, machines and prototype series. We offersupportto companies that do not have their ownR&D departaments. WesupportexistingR&D departamentsby sharing our knowledge and experience.

Together as a team we decided to concentrate our efforts towards a greener, more sustainable, futurethat would bring a positive impact on theenvironment. That is the reason why our project havecentered around innovative ideas for theopencast mining industry.
Our world is constantly changing in terms of climate and environment. Some changes are more disturbing than others. For this reason, our team decided to focus on a very specific area of resource extraction. There are many newenvironmental solutionsthat focus on afforestation, water usage, waste reduction. We saw potential in the area ofopencast mining industry, that has not seen improvements for some time.
As an industry with a huge direct impact on theenvironmentwe believe creating tools for better management ofextractionand re-cultivation can bring in turn huge positive improvements. Since the scale of the extraction operations can be enormous, the efforts to improve the status quo can result in better efficiency and better cohesion with the environment. We hope that our efforts can bring the positive change needed for the future of our planet.
Our activities may be described by 5 projects:
- RSOM– remote sensing for opencast mines
- ATP– autonomous transport platform
- SRE– space resources extraction
- RSUG– remote sensing for urban green
- R&D– research and development
We work with people who have extensive professional experience, with experts in their fields with an innovative approach to problem solving. We are excited about thenew possibilitiesthe future holds with advances inartificial intelligencecoupled withsatellite imageryandautonomous machines. Through our innovative projects, the realization of the dream of better cared for theenvironmentis possible.
We know that such a plan for the rehabilitation of our environment can be successful!

description: ATRON Metrology operate a particles accelerator to perform radiation testing, characterization and calibration with electrons and X-Rays. entityDescription:
ATRON is a technological platform providing scientific expertise and radiation testing. 
In partnership with CNRS and CEA laboratories, ATRON developed a new way of calibration for radiation sensors and radiation testing with an electron beam and a X irradiation field connected to a primary radiation source.
We offer a more accurate and representative method of testing and calibration compare to existing technologies, with higher safety and radiation protection standards. 
To achieve its project and meet various irradiation needs, ATRON has developed a technological platform equipped with:
- an electrostatic electron accelerator with a removable X target,
- tools allowing irradiation in special conditions,
- a measurement and analysis laboratory,
- a team with scientific skills,
- a network of partnerships with research laboratories.
ATRON has benefited from the support of the Normandy region for the implementation of this project.

description:
KP Labs Sp. z o.o. was established in 2016 by a group of engineers and scientists from the Silesian University of Technology, Gliwice, Poland, who saw an upcoming business potential in applying machine learning algorithms to solve real-life problems. Our mission is to accelerate space exploration through the advancement of autonomous spacecraft operations and robotic technology. 
The engineering team is working mainly on R&D activities in developing processing units (DPU, OBC with DPU) and AI-based solutions for space applications such as detection of anomalies from telemetry data, super-resolution reconstruction, hyperspectral satellite imaging analysis, image processing, classification and segmentation, markers processing, and object detection (using both classical image analysis, machine learning, and deep learning approaches).

KP Labs develops its own product line called Smart Mission Ecosystem. For mission integrators and operators who need to build advanced spacecraft, the Smart Mission Ecosystem brings together the necessary hardware, software and AI-powered algorithms for complete missions. Unlike fragmented and difficult to integrate solutions, the ecosystem was designed with a holistic approach to enable on-board data processing on the payload and satellite level, as well as to ensure safer and more fault-tolerant missions.

Smart Mission Ecosystem is built of:

- Leopard - a CubeSat standard compliant data processing unit based on Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ enabling mission designers to apply AI solutions in space. It was designed to support the capturing, managing and processing of data in orbit. 

- Oryx - a modular flight software tool developed for the mission control of small satellites. If components are not directly supported by Oryx, customers can simply extend their simulation by creating customised drivers. 

- Antelope - an on-board computer that combines a Telemetry, Tracking & Command module and a data processing unit. It is the powerful heart of the satellite, responsible for satellite control and basic task performance. 

- Oasis - a single-board, CubeSat PC-104 compatible EGSE (electrical ground support equipment) that enables the running of a complete flight version of software on actual hardware before the subsystems are physically present. 

- The Herd - a group of on-board AI-powered algorithms for image correction & data analysis dedicated to Earth Observation.

description:
Laborelec is a leading expertise and research center in electrical power technology. Drawing on the skills of 280 highly specialized engineers and technicians, the company is active on the whole electricity value chain and backs a large set of customers in the fields of generation, transmission, distribution, storage and final use. It was established in 1962 in order to support Belgian electricity companies with research, development, and specialized services. Today, Laborelec is nearly entirely owned by ENGIE, a world leader in energy (99% of the company is owned by Electrabel, a ENGIE company). The turnover of the company was around 68M€ in 2019. Laborelec offer specialized research and services in electrical power technology, to companies in all parts of the world. Laborelec headquarters are located in Linkebeek near Brussels. International activities are fostered by Laborelec branch offices operating in the Netherlands, in Germany, in the Middle-East area (Abu Dhabi) and a subsidiary in Chile. 
The combination of specialized services and contracted research activities cross-fertilizes each other by a virtual positive loop. Specialized services put experts in close contacts with commercial and industrial reality. They bring back many concrete ideas for feeding the research portfolio. In turn, contract research activities are the main product & service development engine that feeds and renews the service offering portfolio of Laborelec. The specialized services, which cover about 60% of the company’s revenues, are clustered in three main product lines: (i) experts services to survey and maintain the condition of components, mainly for power plants where the Laborelec monitors & assesses the structural integrity of various types of equipment, (ii) expert services to optimize the sustainability of energy-related processes, mainly for power plants, and (iii) expert services to address technical challenges for grid operators, power plants, and industrial and tertiary companies regarding electrical equipment, performance and quality monitoring and electromagnetic compatibility
entityDescription:

Drawing on the skills of nearly 400 specialized engineers and technicians, the company is active on the whole electricity value chain and backs a large set of customers in the fields of generation, transmission, distribution, storage and final use, with a particular focus upon the energy transition and net zero carbon.

All forms of electricity generation come within our capabilities, whether centralized or decentralized, from renewables to fossil and nuclear technologies. Total independence, unbiased recommendations
Laborelec is the only global service provider in the market which is completely independent of equipment manufacturers, which allows us to provide unbiased recommendations. Laborelec in the ENGIE Group

entityDescription: The ultimate goal of HOSTmi is the establishment of platform economics in the global space market, thereby improving the sustainable growth of the industry. The development of a dedicated online space market place adapted to the needs of the industry lays the foundation for standardized processes efficiently hooking up more payloads with flight opportunities. HOSTmi addresses the issue of bringing space payload owners and suitable space mission providers (providers of platform and service) together by creating a web-based automated online platform and by acting as an honest broker. By offering Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), HOSTmi acts independently to best match space experiments and other payloads with the most suitable flight opportunities worldwide. PaaS means neutrally serving both the demand and supply side by facilitating a ‘matchmaking process’ between clients and suppliers. Clients - space experiment or payload owners - can use search criteria to define requirements in detail, as well as generate an in-situ ‘match’ with hosts and flight opportunities. These clients, for instance, can specify payload size, mass, power consumption and more technical details to search for possible hosting opportunities. HOSTmi, in turn, provides the secure infrastructure and centralized supplier services in contrast to the arguably highly fragmented offers in today’s market. Moreover, HOSTmi can provide access to mission-critical support services of third parties, such as centralized technical support, finance and insurance packages, as a digital one-stop-shop, thereby offering and bundling services over the lifecycle of a satellite. Given the NewSpace developments and multiple efforts towards modularity, building blocks and new standards, HOSTmi envisages an evolution of its service offering, including technology standards for experiment accommodation and interfaces with satellites and other space platforms

description:
Indigo Legal is an advisory firm based in Brussels offering combined legal and regulatory expertise to high tech industry entities (including aerospace, aviation, information technology and satellite telecommunications) and governmental agencies. 
The independent firm is led by Mr. Patrick Michielsen, a senior legal advisor qualified under EU and Belgian law (i.e. often the chosen applicable laws for contracting under EU space projects), with more than 20 years of practitioner’s experience in all legal fields of technology law comprising general regulatory/legal advisory and contract drafting/negotiation work. Further to obtaining his specialist graduations in EU law, aviation & space law, Patrick has built up unique practical experience in the space industry with focus on satcom, earth observation and satnav (Galileo and Egnos). 
He served private tech industry clients and cooperated on various space technology study projects for ESA (i.a. Artes 10 and 20 feasibility studies) and for the EU Commission. He has also been instrumental in assisting numerous clients with their deployments in the area of satellite communications and other innovative technological applications. More broadly his experience also includes advisory work in the field of IT, telecommunications, intellectual property (IP), broadcasting law, transport law, geo data, data protection/security, R&D, funding, public procurement, and regulatory compliance for a wide range of clients. 
Prior to founding the independent law firm Indigo Legal, he worked for over more than a decade in the “top 1 tier” technology, media, telecommunications and aerospace departments of various major internationally oriented law firms in Brussels. He has been involved in technology dispute resolution and litigation matters. Furthermore he has worked on secondment in various multinational technology companies. 
Patrick has authored various legal articles on the aforementioned topics (e.g. UN Space Treaties and national space legislation) and he has acted as a legal speaker/trainer at various legal and industry events. He is also affiliated to various legal/technology associations, i.a. the European Centre of Space Lawyers (ESA) and Belgian engineering working groups in aerospace (including Cubesats). 
Indigo Legal offers its legal services in English, French and Dutch (working languages); combined with a sound practical knowledge of German, Italian and Spanish. 
Brussels Belgium T +32 489 922 839 E contact@indigolegal.eu

entityDescription:
Politehnica University Timisoara (UPT) one of the Romanian schools with tradition is an university of advanced research and education that has gained its national and international recognition thought the ongoing activity of generations of teachers and the exceptional activity of prestigious academics. 
The research activity of UPT is carried out through the Research Institute for Renewable Energies - ICER, as well as in the 25 research centers able to carry out research grants in national and international competitions, to generate fundamental research activities and high quality application. These centers are specialized in the field of engineering sciences and not only, aiming at excellence in key multidisciplinary fields of society development, such as: information and communication technology; energy, environment and climate change; advanced production technologies and materials; safety and durability of constructions, etc. The aim is to interconnect these fields with doctoral, postdoctoral, and postgraduate training programs, as well as the transfer of know-how to society.
Most of the research activities carried out in UPT are financed by external sources obtained by participating in national and international calls, respectively by contracts with private companies. This represents a confirmation of the superior quality of the research and also of the prestige and professional deontology of the researchers affiliated to this institution. UPT has always been involved and still continues to be involved in a series of projects funded by national programs (funds provided by the Romanian Government through UEFISCDI, ANCSI), international programs (Horizon2020 Framework Program, European Cooperation in scientific and technical research, European Space Agency, Erasmus +, Bilateral Cooperation)..
UPT is currently developing fruitful collaboration with many universities in Europe, USA, Canada, South America and Asia, resulting in over 190 cooperation agreements concluded directly or under European Union programs.

description:
SkyGeo is a next generation Earth Observation company. Our global data feed starts on a satellite and provides millimeter-accurate displacement data to customers all over the world. Our Antares processing engine and our InSAR-based displacement data feed is designed to help our users manage their assets for the long term.

Radar satellites started recording in 1992. Since then the number of satellites and the resolution of the images have increased dramatically. We have built a processing engine and visualization platform to scale insights with this investment in imagery. Over the years we have also built a data archive of dynamic shape changes of most types of infrastructure. Our users access that library to gain insights in the problems affecting their infrastructure. By comparing shape changes against this library, we provide early warnings for prevention of environmental disasters.

We started SkyGeo with the goal to apply the InSAR technique to dike and dam stability problems. Over the years, we gradually expanded our working field to other industries with large scale assets that are prone to slow failure modes.

We are actively developing products to help more asset managers apply remote sensing data to their displacement-related problems and optimize on-site inspection.
By working with thousands of users on hundreds of real asset stability problems, we have built up a library of unique insights. How to process, how to validate, how to visualize and how to interpret.

Each problem is unique and a one-size-fits-all approach is never the correct approach to deploying InSAR. SkyGeo is scaling trust in InSAR data.

description:
IngeniArs is an Italian SME company with expertise in digital electronics and HW/SW embedded systems. 
IngeniArs portfolio includes: 
- Intellectual properties (IP-core) implementable on ASIC and FPGA technologies including all commercial and rad/hard Families (applications are in particular high-speed interfaces and digital signal processing blocks)
- Test-equipment/software in order to simplify systems verification during the development phase. SPACEART is our main product for testing unit based on SpaceWire/SpaceFibre/WizarLink interfaces. 
- Design services: FPGA and ASIC system design following customer specifications on commercial and rad/hard technologies.
- Artificial Intelligence application for on-board applications (e.g. image processing, cloud detection....)
 The company is particularly active in the aerospace business providing design services in several space missions funded by the European Space Agency such as, Meteosat Third, Generation, Copernicus Sentinel 3, FLEX, PLATO and EUCLID.
entityDescription:
IngeniArs was founded in 2014 as innovative start-up and University of Pisa spin-off company, from the long experience of our co-founders in the area of Electronics and Computer Science Engineering advanced research. We are specialized in design and development of innovative high-tech electronic/informatics and embedded systems mainly in the domains of Aerospace, Artificial Intelligence, Healthcare and Cybersecurity.

In the Aerospace field, we offer products and design services both for satellite design and ground testing mainly related to data handling, high-speed data interfaces (i.e., SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, Wizardlink, etc.) and satellite communication (i.e., CCSDS 131.2-B, etc.). Our products portfolio includes:
- Intellectual properties macrocells (IP Core) for the realization of high-speed reliable communication link (SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, CCSDS 131.2-B) on board of satellites, implementable on ASIC and FPGA technologies.
- Test-equipment/software in order to simplify systems verification during the development phase. Our flagship product family is SPACEART (SpaceWire/SpaceFibre Analyser Real Time) which are standalone devices for the functional verification of the high-speed links on-board of satellite (i.e., SpaceWire, SpaceFibre, Wizardlink).
- Design services: FPGA and ASIC design following customer specifications.
- Verification Services: Advanced independent verification and Verification IPs using SystemVerilog and UVM.

We are particularly active in the aerospace business providing design services in several space missions funded by the European and Italian Space Agency such as Meteosat Third Generation, Copernicus Sentinel 3, FLEX, PLATO, EUCLID, PLATINO and PHISAT-1. We are also official Microchip Design Partner and Xilinx Certified Partner with our solutions available on their websites.

For Artificial Intelligence, IngeniArs works on the development of AI algorithms, based on neural networks, with reduced complexity, so that they can be portable on devices with limited resources or implemented within hardware accelerators, e.g. an FPGA or a VPU. IngeniArs has successfully flown a cloud detection neural network on-board satellite within the ESA mission Phisat-1.

entityDescription:
Coactum aims to revolutionize cargo transportation in space - just like UPS “last mile” delivery services.
Briefly, we propose a simple, secure and fast service of in-space transportation by using standalone small satellites - simplifying access to high Earth orbits and beyond. We envision a future where moving around in space becomes as common as doing it on Earth. This is a future where our space “taxies” are safe, agile, low-cost, and often thrilling – able to move cargo, and eventually people, to multiple outposts. By applying our proprietary high-thrust hybrid propulsion technologies, Coactum aims to radically increase the safety and reduce the cost of in-space transportation, allowing fast access to orbits which are otherwise expensive to reach.
We are developing a platform in-house to bring instruments and deploy nanosatellites at their desired orbits: a space delivery vehicle. Both the propulsion system and the satellite platform are scalable, allowing us to quickly and effectively adapt them tootential markets for future stages of the project. Among them:launchers upper stages, landers and ascent vehicles,crafts tolunar and Martian outposts, de-orbiting devices, human transportation, or space clean-up crews.

description: Nitrexo is an engineering company specialized in delivering cost-effective solutions for thermal, mechanical, and analytical problems in the space industry. We have achieved expertise in space thermal and mechanical engineering through the successful delivery of various projects such as PROBA, MTG, EUCLID, ExoMars, Luna 27 and MetOp-SG across Europe. We use new standard methods and techniques based on field user experience. We are developing a unique Digital Engineer® that leverages our expertise.
entityDescription:
Nitrexo’s Expertise

Thermal and mechanical engineering, particularly in the space industry, is the expertise of Nitrexo, a start-up company based in Ireland. The team has 20 years experience in Thermal and Mechanical Engineering &
Space and Technology. The company provides engineering and consultancy services, as well as digital solutions, and various space products, to its clients.

Nitrexo’s competence involves using ESATAN-TMS for conducting thermal analyses on space systems and sub-systems prior to the implementation of the thermal design. This ensures that the device or product that undergoes analysis and testing will function effectively under certain space conditions. 

In addition, the company specializes in thermal hardware (MLI, radiators, heat pipes, heaters and thermal straps), payloads, platforms, system level, struts, solar panels, mechanisms, instruments, antennas, sensors, mirrors, electronics, cameras, optoelectronics devices for satellites, rockets, microelectronic components, and mechanical ground support equipment. Clients are also assured of receiving a technical reports on their projects.

Having completed projects for the ESA and QinetiQ, Nitrexo’s strengths include running tests and verifications, as well as the integration of improvements to various engineering designs and processes.

Nitrexo’s Mission and Vision

Nitrexo believes in democratic ways of doing things to achieve competence and expertise, particularly in the field of space thermal and mechanical engineering. In this regard, it uses education as an effective platform and tool for enhancing people’s capabilities.

Through its digital solutions, it aims to provide any interested party--whether business entities or individuals--equal access to educational and skills enhancement materials and applications that will help them create and innovate effectively.

Knowledge Management

Nitrexo guarantees that its training programs are not limited only to the transfer of theoretical knowledge to thermal engineers but that they also teach them how to accurately apply such knowledge in their field of work. Thus, Nitrexo trainings are designed to ensure a delightful user experience.

entityDescription: GeoVille is an internationally operating company providing consultancy, services and products related to remote sensing, geo-information and geographic information systems. GeoVille provides value-added services in the land domain with focus on urban, regional and spatial planning, environmental surveillance, forestry, biodiversity and infrastructure applications. Specialised services comprise generation of digital land cover and land use maps, titling and cartography. GeoVille's mission is to offer turnkey solutions for efficient spatial data management and analysis. At GeoVille, we know that success in the rapidly advancing field of remote sensing requires not only adequate technical infrastructure, but also profound understanding of the relationship between customer demands, fields of application and available technology. GeoVille is official reseller for Airbus Defence & Space, European Space Imaging, SI Imaging Services, Blackbridge and Intermap and offers an on-line cost free service for determining data availability and quality. Since its establishment in 1998 GeoVille has established a broad international customer base and successfully participated in more than 460 national and international projects located in over 135 countries around the world. At present, GeoVille is employing a staff of about 60 experts and consultants graduated in Earth sciences and informatics. GeoVille's team has experience and expertise in managing and executing projects in Europe, Asia, Africa and America. Our staff members are holding MSc grade or equivalent, and 30% a PhD title. GeoVille is used to manage complex projects overseas. Our ISO 9001 quality management system is especially designed for the EO industry, guarantees swift study implementation and ensures fit-for-purpose outputs. In 2007 Geoville has received the Definiens GMES Innovation & Research Award 2007 for its innovative and outstanding geo-information products. In 2014, GeoVille was awarded the EARSC Company Award of the Year. The European Association of Remote Sensing Companies thereby recognised GeoVille as the company to have made the most significant contribution to the development of the Earth Observation sector in Europe.

entityDescription:
Developer of the "Cradle" requirements management (RM) and systems engineering (SE) environment and provider of related training and consultancy services.

Cradle is an integrated multi-user software tool that can support the entire system/product/process development lifecycle for agile and phase-based processes, and fully supports all enterprise architecture and business analysis activities. Cradle combines requirements management, MBSE (SysML, UML, SASD, ADARTS, IDEF, eFFBD, architecture and process modelling), risk management, product lifecycle management (PLM), application lifecycle management (ALM), test management and execution and configuration management and control (CM/CC) in a single, integrated, modular environment.

Cradle is widely used in the US and Chinese space industries and is the standard tool in CALS and in NASA for the Artemis, HLS, Orion, 21GS and previously Constellation and SCaN programmes.

3SL is widely experienced in the design of product, system and business processes and their deployment in Cradle, together with the development of customised deployments into a wide range of industry sectors. 3SL has considerable experience in the use of SE techniques in the space and aerospace sectors from 3SL and our partner's involvement in the US, Russian and Chinese manned and unmanned space programmes.

General information

Air-Parts was founded in 1955 as a trading company with a scope of supplying parts to the military and civil aviation. The good contacts Air-Parts still has with both army and marine, originates from the developed relationship with the Air-Force. 

In the early 1960's, Air-Parts started with sales and services of electronics. Over the years, Air-Parts has grown to be one of the most important idependent suppliers in the BeNeLux-countries in the domain of test- and measurement equipment.

After moving to its own building in Alphen aan den Rijn in the mid 1970's, could further expand its scope toward industrial electronics. Since 2001, after the burst of the IT and Telecom bubble, Air-Parts developed its current profile. 

In two different sales and engineering teams Air-Parts services the market of RF, Microwave and Optical solutions, and Electrical Power.

entityDescription:
Boeing Research & Technology Europe, S.L. (BR&TE) is wholly owned subsidiary of The Boeing Company, and it's the first research and technology center Boeing establishes outside of the US. The opening of this European research center in Madrid is part of Boeing initiative to become a true global company. BR&TE belongs to Boeing Research and Technology division. Boeing Research and Technology is the advanced R&D unit and catalyst of innovation for Boeing enterprise. We are innovators and integrators working across the Boeing Global Enterprise to create the future of aerospace. BR&TE in the European Community The center was legally constituted in November 2001 and started its activities in March 2002. Since then, the center has become an active member of the European technology fabric, contributing to establish a permanent footprint of Boeing in Europe as key player in the R&D community. BR&TE has allowed Boeing to establish a strong presence in Europe. 

Since it opened in 2002, its mission has been to work with partners across Europe in research and technology development to foster innovation, excellence and competitiveness within the European research and development community. A lean and agile organization, BR&T–Europe maintains the infrastructure to support other Boeing business units on demand with complementary asset and skill-based research and technology models. With three sites come the diverse perspectives necessary to succeed in solving tough multidisciplinary problems.BR&T–Europe has a staff of more than 50 employees, most of whom are engineers and scientists recruited from across Europe. It has become a key technology integrator, collaborating with more than 40 universities, 20 research centers, 5 airlines and more than 200 industry partners in 25 different countries.

entityDescription:
APPLUS+ Laboratories
Applus+ Laboratories (LGAI Technological Center S.A.) specialises in developing technical solutions to enhance product competitiveness and foster research and innovation thanks to our multidisciplinary and multisector competencies.
ENGINEERING
Applus+ Laboratories develops customized turnkey test bench and VHT (Virtual Hybrid Testing) projects, applying its engineering, mechanical, electrical, software, cybersecurity and automation skills together with its experience in testing and certification.
Thus, we are capable to reproduce components and systems behavior in different environments creating tailored testbed solutions whether to validate customer requirements and regulations or to study service failures and hardware/software resilience to cyber-attacks.
Applus+ Laboratories develops electrical, hydraulic and functional test equipment customized for integration into all the production stages of any vehicles components answering to manufacturers and integrators need to incorporate customized testing equipment into their production lines to validate their products at the component, subcomponent or full vehicle level, ensuring conformity with their requirements and the applicable regulations. 
MECHANICAL
Applus+ Laboratories material and structural testing laboratories cover a wide range that includes multi-axial tests – static and fatigue –on medium and heavy loads with quality granted by our ISO 17025 quality certification.
We also have the capabilities to reproduce the environmental and operating conditions over the useful life of a product in order to predict its performance, safety, reliability and durability. 
Our unique facilities allow us to validate the structural integrity of components and subcomponents of large dimensions, both of composite materials and metal, for the aerospace industry, defense, marine, railway, automotive, renewables, oil and gas, and civil construction.
Applus+ Laboratories is accredited as a strategic supplier of structural mechanical testing for the main aeronautical manufacturers. We are “preferred laboratory” for structural testing for Airbus (ST2S) and Rolls Royce, we have NADCAP accredited laboratories for testing metallic and non-metallic materials, and we have ISO 9100 certification for test tooling design.
CYBERSECURITY
Applus+ Laboratories is a global leader in testing, certification and consultancy services in payment systems and security for IT products such as chips, smart cards, telecommunications equipment, mobile devices, commercial software, SaaS and cloud computing systems. 
Applus+ Laboratories is an IT Security Evaluation Facility (ITSEF) accredited for Common Criteria and SOG-IS evaluations. We manage the process to obtain the Common Criteria Certification (ISO 15408:2005) for IT products.
Our capabilities includes Common Criteria Evaluations (up to level EAL 7), an international recognized standard to evaluate IT products security functionalities and assurances (ISO 15408) and depending on the evaluation level, Common Criteria requirements include:
•	Products evaluation: focused on risk vulnerabilities mitigation
•	Developer design evaluation: focused on ensuring development process reliability
•	Development Site Audits: focused on ensuring supply chain integrity and confidentiality.
ELECTRICS & ELECTRONICS (IoT)
Currently, in a vehicle the components and systems must be validated in compliance with industry standards in addition to the standards of each end manufacturer (OEMs).
The increasing integration of electronic systems in vehicles and their interaction with portable devices (IoT ecosystems) have made the development and validation of automotive products increasingly complex. In order to meet regulatory and industry standards for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and radio systems (RED), manufacturers need to evaluate and ensure the reliability of electrical and electronic components from the design and concept stage.

TST is committed to create innovative solutions that improve process efficiency through digitalisation and data exploitation. TST's solutions are capable of providing intelligence to any infrastructure, urban or industrial, in a reliable way and guaranteeing data security.
TST was founded in 2007 by a group of entrepreneurs with academic and business backgrounds and many years of experience in technology start-ups.
With more than 15 years of expertise within the field of Industry 4.0, the company has a highly qualified engineering team with strong expertise on electronics design, sensors networks, wireless communications and IoT platforms. In 2024, TST merged with Wireless Innovative MMIC SL, a company with more than 7 years experience in the design of integrated circuits for different applications such as telecommunications and defence. Therefore, TST acquires all this expertise in the microelectronics industry.

entityName: TECHNOLOGICAL CENTRE FOR TEXTILE AND CLOTHING OF PORTUGAL
entityDescription:
CITEVE is a Technological Center, a private non-profit organization, based in Vila Nova de Famalicão and with commercial branches in Brazil, Tunisia, Argentina, Pakistan, Chile and Mexico, that offers companies in the Textile and Clothing Sector, mainly SMEs (90%), a portfolio of services that includes laboratory tests, product certification, technical and technological consultancy, R&D+innovation, training, and fashion and design.
As a reference organization on the national and European scene, regarding the promotion of innovation and development of the Textile and Clothing Industry, CITEVE's mission is to support the development of technical and technological capabilities of the textile and clothing industries, by fostering and disseminating innovation, promoting quality improvement, and providing instrumental support to the definition of industrial policies for the sector.

Active since 1989, CITEVE is participated by companies (630), mostly SMEs based in the Northern region of Portugal. With a very close relationship with companies and a deep knowledge of the reality and performance of the sector, CITEVE also plays an important role in the definition and implementation of public policies.

Besides being a service provider to companies and a support organization with an active role in promoting knowledge and information to the sector, CITEVE is strategically positioned between academia (universities) and companies.
CITEVE's Missionis "to support the development of innovative capacity of companies, through the development and dissemination of scientific knowledge and technology, enhancement of creativity and instrumental support to the definition and implementation of public policies".
CITEVE and its collaborators guide their actions by the following values
- Innovation and Creativity
- Good standing, Knowledge and Quality
- Integrity, Independence, Transparency and Impartiality
- Cooperation and Loyalty
- Sustainability and Social and Environmental Responsibility

The following diverse fields of study are represented: plant ecology (population biology, synecology, comparative and production ecology, ecophysiology) including geoinformatics and studies of spatio-temporal changes in populations and communities and their spatial structure on different scales, paleoecology, taxonomy, biosystematics and phytogeography of higher and lower plants, and mycorrhizal symbioses. Currently, the strongest research fields in terms of scientific outputs are ecology of invasive species, biodiversity and evolutionary trends among plants, responses of plants and vegetation to environmental change and the mechanisms that enable species to coexist in ecosystems.
