entityDescription:
EUROPEAN DYNAMICS was founded in 1993 and is a leading Information Technologies (ICT) service provider and software developer in the field of e-government. We operate internationally as a group of companies, with offices and antennas in Luxembourg, Athens, Thessaloniki, Brussels, Berlin, Basel, Kaatsheuvel, Vienna, London, Milan, Nicosia, etc.
We design, develop, support and operate complex IT systems and commercialise our own software products and tools, using state-of-the-art technologies in the areas of:
- Bespoke development and delivery on IT projects on a turn-key basis, specialising in the field of e-government;
- IT consulting services - outsourcing;
- Outsourcing, SaaS (software as a service), cloud and managed services.
EUROPEAN DYNAMICS expertise covers:
e-procurement, contract management, e-collaboration (workflow, content, document and knowledge management), customs and taxation applications, intellectual property, systems for the electronic publication of legislation, reporting systems in the finance sector, defence/law enforcement, etc.
Moreover, we participate in the implementation of a significant number of R&D projects worldwide.
The group uses a main development centre in Athens, Greece, supported by additional, fully owned development centres; near-shore and off-shore. This arrangement allows EUROPEAN DYNAMICS to compete optimally with all key players in the field of IT from Europe, America or Asia.
Our client portfolio comprises European Union Institutions and Agencies, International Organisations, national government administrations and the private sector.
The group generates annual revenues in excess of EURO 100 million, with an EBITDA margin in the range of 25% and is net profit and cash flow positive with a zero debt position (both short and long term).
The value of our contract portfolio exceeds EURO 300 million.
EUROPEAN DYNAMICS employs over 1100 engineers, IT experts and consultants (around 3% PhD, 41% MSc and 54% BSc or equivalent). Our staff is multilingual and multinational with in-depth experience in the delivery of services to the government sector worldwide. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS is an equal opportunity employer and applies an Equal Opportunities Policy (EOP). We also comply with all measures and obligations related to the prevention and combating of all forms of violence and harassment, including violence based on gender and sexual harassment.
EUROPEAN DYNAMICS holds ISO 9001:2015 certification for ICT systems integration, software design and development, ISO 27001:2022 certification for its hosting services platforms, ISO 20000-1:2018 for maintenance and support services for software applications and ISO 22301:2019 for development, implementation, maintenance and support of Information Technology Systems.
Security is a top priority area for the group. EUROPEAN DYNAMICS holds a NATO and EU secret security clearance. Moreover, the group applies state-of-the-art standards in ICT security (e.g. COBIT, UML, RUP, PRINCE2, Agile and ITIL).

We have established long term cooperation and business relations with a considerable number of hardware and software firms being a Systems Integrator, Value Added Reseller or Business Partner of a wide range of vendors, which include: CISCO, IBM, HP, ORACLE, MICROSOFT, REDHAT, SAS, ESRI, FILENET, OPENTEXT, UTIMACO, VMWARE, etc.

entityDescription: Université de Montpellier is a research-intensive university where education and research cover most of the Scientific and Technological fields. UM gathers around 41000 students and 4300 staffs with an overall budget of 380 million euros. The studies are organized in the following fields: Fundamental and applied Sciences, Human and Social Sciences (law, economy), Health studies. Research is structured within 70 laboratories in partnership with well recognized research organizations such as CNRS, IRD, INRA or CIRAD. Moreover, in terms of innovation UM is linked to 8 Competitiveness Clusters in the Region Languedoc Roussillon. These clusters include enterprises, training centers, laboratories (public or private) with the goal to create new collaborations and projects for a better competitiveness at the international level. At the international level, UM is one of the most attractive university in France in terms of student exchange (it represents more than 7500 incoming students for the last years), in terms of research collaboration (for example, the number of PhD in co-supervision with international universities is around 120 for the two merged institutions), as well as in terms of international projects (Research and Education).

entityDescription:
MARIS has originated from a governmental project in the Netherlands. MARIS is very much involved in the development and implementation of the pan-European infrastructure for ocean and marine data. In particular as coordinator of EU Sea-Search project (2002-2005), and technical coordinator of its successor projects EU SeaDataNet (2006-2011), EU SeaDataNet II (2011-2015) and EU SeaDataCloud (2016-2020). MARIS is also very active in the implementation of the European Marine Observation and Data network (EMODnet) as coordinator of EMODnet Bathymetry and EMODnet Ingestion, and as technical coordinator of EMODnet Chemistry and EMODnet Physics. At present SeaDataNet gives discovery and access to major marine data resources of more than 110 data centres from 34 countries around the European seas for physics, chemistry, geology, geophysics, and biology.

MARIS is also quite leading in the strategy domain around marine data infrastructures in Europe. As such MARIS is involved in the formulation and further roll-out of the Blue Cloud initiative as a 'blue print' how the European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) might be deployed for the European marine and ocean data community, involving major infrastructures such as SeaDataNet, Copernicus (CMEMS), EuroGOOS, EMODnet, EuroArgo and others.

Next to strategy MARIS develops and operates infrastructures, dynamic web portals, internet applications, including mobile apps, incorporating databases, content management systems, mapping services, sensor web enablement, responsive design, crowd sourcing, citizen science and supporting multiple platforms.

entityDescription:
Hydronaut Lab specializes in the research, design, and engineering of technologies for extreme environments. The company develops advanced habitats, scientific modules, and support systems designed for conditions that demand high reliability, safety, and long-term sustainability — including underwater, polar, and space-related applications.
Our activities include:
Design and engineering of products for extreme conditions, such as pressure-resistant modules, research probes, robust structural components, and systems intended for long-duration operation in isolated or hostile environments.

Engineering design of habitats and life-support systems for research, training, and experimental purposes.

Development of experimental technologies supporting space-analog missions, human performance studies, and life-support concepts.

Applied research and testing of technical solutions relevant to the space industry and other high-tech sectors.

Hydronaut Lab also operates the Deep Lab Hydronaut H003, an experimental underwater habitat and space-analog facility enabling long-duration crewed stays and the testing of technologies, materials, procedures, and human-factors scenarios under conditions of elevated psychological and physiological demands.
Deep Lab Hydronaut H003 is used for:
Space mission simulations,

Technical testing of systems designed for extreme environments,

Research on human behavior, performance, and adaptability,

Crew and mission training for research and operational teams.

entityDescription:
The University of Alicante (UA) was created in 1979. Today it educates and trains more than 20.000 national and 3.000 international students and offers 43 undergraduate and 80 postgraduate programmes: consequently it is proportionally one of the fastest growing universities in Spain. Thus, the UA employs 3.862 researchers and management staff (46%women), which involves an annual budget of 200 million Euros. Currently, UA is investing near to 39M Euros for boosting frontier research and technology transfer processes via spin off, licensing and international promotion mainly. In 2018 the University generated an income of 19 million Euros from research funded projects on a National, Regional, European level and private R&D thanks to its 251 research groups in many knowledge areas and its 13 Research Institutes, most of them multidisciplinary-based. Despite its youth, the University of Alicante is already present in the three main university rankings in the world ARWU-FIELD (Shanghai), Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) andTimes Higher Education (THE) World University. 
In 2019, the University of Alicante has appeared prominently in the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU-FIELD), known as Shanghai Ranking, in its classification by fields of knowledge. In the 2019 edition, the University of Alicante has managed to further improve on last year’s excellent performance in the field ofTourism and Hotel Management, when it was ranked 39th in the world, two positions above the result of the previous year. In addition to this, the UA joins for the first time the world's best in the fields ofEnergy Science and Engineering,EcologyandManagement, ranked 301-400th for the first two fields and 401-500th the third. Excellent performance has also been achieved in other fields of knowledge in previous editions of this ranking, such as inChemical Engineering, which remains in the 201-300th position; inEnvironmental Science and Engineering,ChemistryandEconomicsranked 401-500th in the world classification.
It is also an appreciated reference point for international relations. Its strategy lies within the context of international cooperation and particularly in the training of university management staff to support the integration of non-EU countries and develop their international status and networks.
The campus is considered one of the best campuses in Europe: one million square meters with the best urban design, the most innovative architecture in a framework of environmental excellence (large green areas, landscape design, pedestrian, cultural, sporting, educational areas...) and a wide variety of services. In addition to the strong commitment by the innovation and technology, the University of Alicante reaches the most prestigious heights in its firm commitment to culture and heritage. A virtual tour to the 100% pedestrian campus is available at: http://web.ua.es/tour-virtual-ua/ua.html

entityName: AUSTRIAN SPACE FORUM (Österreichisches Weltraum Forum, OeWF)
entityDescription: The Austrian Space Forum (Österreichisches Weltraum Forum, OeWF) is a national network for aerospace specialists and space enthusiasts. Our organization serves as a communication platform between the space sector and the public; it is embedded in a global network of specialists from the space industry, research and policy. Hence, the ASF facilitates a strengthening of the Austrian space sector through enhancing the public visibility of space activities, technical workshops and conferences as well as Forum-related projects. The Forum has a small, but highly active pool of professional members contributing to space endeavours, mostly in cooperation with other -national as well as international- space organizations. The spectrum of our activities ranges from simple classroom presentations to 15.000-visitor space exhibitions, from expert reports for the Austrian federal ministry for technology to space technology transfer activities for terrestrial applications: we are Austria's space network. In summary, the Austrian Space Forum is... * a volunteer space organization, led by space professionals, * focussing on space research (e.g. human-robotic Mars exploration) and outreach/education, * an independant organisation funded via research projects, donations and outreach activities.

entityDescription:
The Medical University of Graz comprises 3 pre-clinical Research Centers, 4 pre-clinical Institutes not organized in Research Centers, 19 Clinical Departments, 1 Clinical Institute and a purpose-built Center for Medical Research equipped with highly specialized core facilities as well as lab and office space for research projects. The Medical University of Graz runs one of the largest biobanks in Europe and plays a leading role in the European Union’s endeavour to build up a harmonized biobanking infrastructure across Europe. The number of employees is about 2500. Approx. 4300 students are enrolled in the study programmes (Human Medicine, Dentistry, Doctoral Programs) and post-graduate programs. 
The University cooperates with many national and international partners. It strongly supports interdisciplinary cooperation with other universities and actively liaises with academic institutions and the business sector in the region. Its most important partner is the Regional & University Hospital Graz with its 1500 beds, 87,000 inpatients and 1.2 million outpatient services per year, which – in close cooperation with the University – provides tertiary care for all other hospitals in the Province of Styria and in the neighbouring provinces. This creates an environment in which researchers have access to patients needing primary care as well as high-end medicine, which is ideally suited for research into translational and practice-relevant aspects of medicine.

entityDescription:
SISTEMATICA’s main activities are the development of “Turn Key” SW solutions, System Integration and Consulting Services, in the following sectors:

Aerospace and Telecommunication Industry

Energy Industry

Mobility and Geolocation

Monitoring and Control

Public Service, Health Service, Document management and Dematerialization

Safety Partner
The Group's experience is now decade-long in the AEROSPACE INDUSTRY, particularly with regard to the Ground Segment (G/S), having participated for the major agencies of the sector to the development of projects of great importance (COSMO-SkyMed, Galileo, Iridium, Astrolink SRTM) Aerospace and Satellite sector. The experience gained has allowed to consolidate specific expertise in:

Analysis and definition of requirements for the construction of ground segments (G/S)

Design and implementation of the components of G/S Monitoring & Control (Planning and production control, etc.).

Design and development of components for processing, distribution of remotely sensed data

Navigation Systems (Galileo, EGNOS, GPS)

Protocols for Remote Controls/Telemetries (eg CCSDS)

Standard Products Features (eg, MGD, GEC, GTC)

Typical formats for remote sensing (CEOS, x-TIFF, DTED)

ESA standard knowledge (PSS05, ECSS, etc.)., DoD
In parallel with the projects in the aerospace sector, Sistematica Spa has established itself in the area of MOBILE SYSTEMS as technological reference partner in the design and implementation of operational centers for remote monitoring and location (via GPS) of mobile vehicles and for the fleet management, using GIS systems and communication networks both terrestrial (GSM-GPRS, TETRA) and satellite (EMSAT GLOBALSTAR, ORBCOMM). The main customers in this sector are: VIASAT, OCTOTELEMATICS, TELESPAZIO, ELSACOM, for some of these Sistematica has taken care of most of the software developments and of the necessary system integration in projects of:

Mobile Surveillance Systems: location services and remote surveillance of vehicles for crash events,

theft and robbery, mechanical failures, sickness, etc..

Fleet Management Systems: management of vehicle fleets for logistics services

Various services usable by GSM phones: Alerting (traffic, weather, events, advertising, etc..),

Mobile Banking, Tele-reservations, Mobile-learning, etc. ..
Sistematica also develops applications for automatic data collection (Automated Data Collection) and for the automation of mobile workforces (Work Force Automation), using standard equipment (J2ME phones or PDA devices) or specific devices such as BENEFON phones, with built-in GPS and particularly suitable for the management of teams for emergency management and for the Search and Rescue services.
The Sistematica team is able to ensure coverage of all phases of the development of a system:

Analysis & System Engineering

Design & Development

AIV & Post-sale Support
Since 2009 Sistematica has obtained accreditation as a Research Laboratory introduced in the register maintained by the Ministry of University and Research.

entityDescription:
Experts in Additive Manufacturing (AM), 3T RPD Ltd produces parts that are unachievable by traditional manufacturing techniques. For one-off prototype parts to end-use production components, and most things in between, aerospace engineers are being inspired to design parts specifically for the AM process, freeing them up from previous design constraints.

Lightweight, high performance parts are produced using Selective Laser Sintering (SLS) for plastic parts, and Direct Metal Laser Sintering (DMLS) for metal. Parts can be optimised in order to retain strength whilst reducing weight. And any reduction in weight in an aerospace part delivers a quantifiable reduction in the lifetime CO2 emission of that plane.

3T can produce parts in a range of high performance alloys including Aluminium, Titanium and Inconel, which make them suitable for the extreme environments found within the aerospace sector. 3T are producing parts that are being sent into space in satellites as well as manufacturing parts for major aerospace companies.

More than 9,000 students study at six TBU faculties. Amphos 21 feeds on its national and international large experience in nuclear waste management and disposal, and public perception for more than 15 years. Since 2007, the consultant team has increased its technical capacities to offer services in the large spectrum of CCS activities.
Amphos 21 has a renowned prestige in thermodynamic and kinetics reactive transport modelling of pollutants. Our team has also gained capacities to develop numerical multiphase models in saturated and unsaturated formations or in soils, hydromechanical and heat transfer models. 
Amphos 21 has its own field team that designs in-situ monitoring strategies, measures physicochemical parameters and gases emission, collects water and soils, and uses sensors to assess the potential areas of CO2 leakage. Amphos 21 offers technical, scientific and strategic consulting in geochemistry, hydrogeology, energy, market assessment and public participation to companies developing and managing CO2 Capture and geological Storage (CCS). Our services focus on the generation of solutions based on a thorough understanding of the deep geological media and geochemical phenomena. 
Amphos 21 team is expert on site characterisation, monitoring strategy and leakage control, as well as risk analysis, public communication and social engagement in a CCS project.
In order to offer high-tech experimental studies and innovative and efficient monitoring products and solutions, strategic partnerships have been created with other companies and research centers.

entityDescription:
Cogent is a multinational Tier 1 Internet Service Provider consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world. Our primary service offering consists of Internet access and data transport, offered over our award-winning fiber optic, IP data-only network, along with colocation in any of our 43 Internet data centers. We service two customer segments: "Corporate" (small businesses to Fortune 100 companies) and "NetCentric" (Carriers / Service Providers and Application / Content Providers, whose businesses rely primarily on Internet access).

Our innovative, facilities-based network spans across North America, across the Atlantic throughout Europe, and across the Pacific to Asia. With over 56,200 route miles of intercity fiber and more than 19,800 metro fiber miles, we provide service to over 175 major markets and interconnect with over 3,940 other networks.

Cogent was founded on the premise that bandwidth can be treated like a commodity¿produce mass amounts and position it for sale based on price. Leveraging new technologies, we built our own IP data network independent of the traditional voice-based networks owned by the RBOCs (Regional Bell Operating Companies). By doing so, we believed we could reduce the cost of high quality bandwidth down to a level never before offered in the marketplace. Less than five years after lighting our network backbone, we have become widely recognized as one of the largest carriers of Internet traffic in the world.

We stand apart from our competitors in many areas, but key differentiators include:


Our customer connections are dedicated and non-oversubscribed

Our prices are the lowest in the industry

Our diversity from traditional carriers enables redundancy for customer data

Our simple network structure allows for rapid provisioning

Our 'self-healing' ring architecture design minimizes outages

Cogent is Smart Business Internet

Cogent Communications is a public company trading on the NASDAQ under the symbol CCOI. Cogent is headquartered in Washington, D.C., United States of America.

entityDescription:
Hochbau
Lupp ist Ihr Spezialist für Hochbauprojekte. Die besondere Kompetenz zeichnet sich durch maßgeschneiderte, effiziente Baulösungen aus, die wir individuell auf die architektonischen Anforderungen ausrichten und die höchsten Ansprüchen an Wohn- und Arbeitskomfort gerecht werden. Neben dem industriellen Hochbau realisieren wir Gewerbe- und Verwaltungsbauten sowie Hotel-, Kliniken-, Altenheim- und Schulbauten.
Als Generalunternehmer mit einem großen Netzwerk an qualifizierten Partnern und Nachunternehmern erstellen wir Hochbauprojekte überwiegend schlüsselfertig als Komplettlösung.

Infrastrukturbau
Mit fundierten Kenntnissen beim Einsatz von Mensch, Material und Geräten sowie mit jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung realisieren wir individuelle Neubauten oder Rekonstruktionen in den Bereichen Brücken-, Kläranlagen-, Rohrleitungs- und Kanalbau. Perfekt geplante Bauabläufe und -verfahren garantieren dabei die termingerechte Durchführung und kompromisslose Qualität. Firmeneigenes Spezialequipment ermöglicht es uns, flexibel und unabhängig zu agieren.

 

Bauen im Bestand
Lupp setzt mit speziell qualifiziertem Personal komplexe Projekte im Bereich ¿Bauen im Bestand" um. Die besondere Herausforderung liegt darin, dass das Gebäude auch während der Projektausführung in großen Teilen genutzt wird ¿ insbesondere bei Immobilien wie Hotels oder Bürogebäuden. Ver- und Entsorgungssysteme werden während der kompletten Bauzeit aufrecht erhalten, sodass Beeinträchtigungen auf ein Minimum reduziert werden. Ergänzt durch unsere umfangreichen Erfahrungen im logistischen Bereich werden Bauen im Bestand-Projekte perfektioniert. Denn besonders hier sollten Zwischenlagerungen vermieden und alle Materialen termingerecht geliefert werden.

Bauwerkserhaltung
Bauen ist die Kernkompetenz von Lupp. Bauwerke müssen aber auch erhalten werden. Deshalb realisiert der Bereich Bauwerkerhaltung eingebettet in das Gesamtunternehmen komplexe Erhaltungs- und Instandsetzungsmaßnahmen. Für die Projektbearbeitung stehen speziell geschulte und qualifizierte Mitarbeiter zur Verfügung. Laufende Aus- und Weiterbildung in dieser sich ständig weiter entwickelnden Sparte ist für uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit.
Als Gründungsmitglied und durch das Engagement von Lupp in den Vorstandsgremien der Landesgütegemeinschaft Betonerhaltung Hessen e.V. treiben wir die Qualitätssicherung in Bereich der Bauwerkserhaltung konsequent voran. Das dokumentiert auch das verliehene RAL-Gütezeichen oder die Qualifikation als Fachbetrieb nach WHG § 19. Ferner gehören natürlich auch neue Techniken der Bauwerkerhaltung, wie zum Beispiel die Bauteilverstärkung mit CFK-Lamellen, zu unserem Leistungskatalog.

Deshalb realisiert der Bereich Bauwerkerhaltung eingebettet in das Gesamtunternehmen komplexe Erhaltungs- und Instandsetzungsmaßnahmen. Für die Projektbearbeitung stehen speziell geschulte und qualifizierte Mitarbeiter zur Verfügung. Laufende Aus- und Weiterbildung in dieser sich ständig weiter entwickelnden Sparte ist für uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit.
Als Gründungsmitglied und durch das Engagement von Lupp in den Vorstandsgremien der Landesgütegemeinschaft Betonerhaltung Hessen e.V. treiben wir die Qualitätssicherung in Bereich der Bauwerkserhaltung konsequent voran. Das dokumentiert auch das verliehene RAL-Gütezeichen oder die Qualifikation als Fachbetrieb nach WHG § 19. Ferner gehören natürlich auch neue Techniken der Bauwerkerhaltung, wie zum Beispiel die Bauteilverstärkung mit CFK-Lamellen, zu unserem Leistungskatalog.

entityDescription:
With 15 000 students, a rich multidisciplinary training offer and 19 internationally recognized research laboratories, the Savoie Mont Blanc University (Chambéry) is a human-sized establishment that combines proximity with its territories , belonging to the PRES University of Grenoble as a founding member and a wide openness to Europe and the world.

Between Geneva, Turin, Lyon and Grenoble, at the borders of Switzerland and Italy, with the unwavering support of the communities that saw it born, it is a territorial, regional and cross-border actor, a major player in social, economic and Cultural.

It proposes short courses (university diplomas, academic degrees of technology) and long (licences, masters, doctorates and also diplomas of engineers), whether in initial training, in continuous training, alternating or in validation of Experience acquired (VAE), on-site or remotely.

On its three campuses, Annecy, Bourget-du-Lac and Jacob-Bellecombette, Savoie Mont Blanc University offers particularly attractive conditions of study at the heart of an exceptional environment. Everywhere, in this multipolarity structured from the Presidency located in Chambéry, the students find a personalised follow-up, an accompaniment in the definition and evolution of their personal projects and the strengths to succeed their insertion in working life. 
Savoie Mont Blanc University has been able to forge close and constructive links with local, regional and other socio-economic actors, which today make it an indispensable element of the Rhone dynamic, in particular that of the poles of Competitiveness.

The research is carried out by recognised laboratories, labelled and distinguished, actors of close partnerships with large organisations (CNRS, CEA, INRA), international organisations (CERN) or other structures (INES, Institut de la Montagne) also at the forefront of innovation. Our researchers are strongly involved in a few areas that accompany the territorial Dynamics: mountain, mechatronics, the sectors of organizations, tourism, image and energy. With physics, they contribute to the visibility of the University Savoie Mont Blanc on niches where its notoriety is internationally recognized as evidenced by the results obtained in the framework of investments of the future.

OPTIMAD engineering develops software for aerodynamic analysis, design and optimization. The company enjoys the status of being a Spin-Off of the Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering of the Politecnico di Torino.
Technology transfer is the company’s everyday business: Industrial process innovation is envisaged with expertise found in a large network of universities and research institutes. To this scope, the company employs a highly qualified personnel, 100% of the technical staff holds a PhD in aerospace engineering, fluid mechanics, applied mathematics or similar disciplines.
The company serves clients from different sectors, ranging from transport (aeronautical and naval industry, automotive, trains) to environmental engineering (wind energy harvesting, environmental disaster simulation), from chemical industry to virtual reality (real-time simulation).

In particular, Optimad engineering develops an innovative fluid dynamics simulation code based on its proprietary Immersed Boundaries technology for complex aerodynamic and multi-physics problems. Expertise concerns continuum and rarefied flows, fluid-solid and fluid-liquid interaction.

entityDescription:
Since its foundation in 1970, the Universitaet Klagenfurt (UNI-KLU) has become established on the national and international academic landscape. It is one of six state universities with a broad spectrum of subjects and comprises four faculties (Arts, Humanities & Education; Social Sciences; Technical Sciences; Management, Economics & Law). It offers 22 bachelor’s degree programmes, 30 master’s degree programmes, 14 teacher training programmes and 5 Doctoral programmes. Around 12,000 students from 100 countries are currently studying at UNI-KLU.
The university is experienced with EU projects – 29 FP7 projects (among which 2 coordinated by UNI-KLU), 22 Horizon 2020 projects (among which 5 coordinated by UNI-KLU) and currently 7 Horizon Europe projects (among which 2 coordinated by UNI-KLU).

entityDescription: Vicomtech (Visual Communication and Interaction Technologies Centre) is an applied research centre specialising in Advanced Interaction technologies, Computer Vision, Data Analytics, Computer Graphics and Language Technologies located in the Technology Park of San Sebastian (Spain). Vicomtech is a non-profit foundation, founded by the INI-GraphicsNet Foundation, with the Fraunhofer-IGD as founder member, and the Basque Television, Radio and Broadcasting group EiTB, It is currently formed by 20 members. Since the beginning was a member of Saretek, the Basque Network of Science, Technology and Innovation, which in July 2007 turned into Innobasque, the Basque Agency for Innovation, an instrument for the coordination and impulse of the Innovation within the Basque Country. Furthermore, the acknowledgement Vicomtech has obtained in these years has paved the way to had been a member of the IK4 alliance and also to be classified as an Innovation and Technology Centre (ITC) by the Spanish Ministry of Education and Science. It belongs to Graphicsmedia.net, a strategic alliance of international applied research centres working in computer graphics and multimedia technologies. Vicomtech aims to respond to the innovation requirements of companies and institutions. To do this, it a) Conducts applied research and develops multimedia visual interaction and communications technologies; b) Complements and closely collaborates with industry, universities and other technology centres; c) Promotes mobility and training for its researchers. Thus, this command of knowledge and technologies, either directly or through the network, provides value to clients, as Vicomtech: a) Suitably responds to its clients’ needs; b) Enables companies to make the most of the opportunities available to them; c) Proposes product improvement or developments based on state-of-the-art science and technology knowledge. Vicomtech achieved the HR Excellence in Research recognition of the European Commission, which proves its compromise with open, transparent and merit-based recruitment of researchers (OTM-R: Open, Transparent and Merit-based RECRUITMENT OF Researchers). This acknowledgement adds up to ISO9001_2015 and UNE166002:2014, which means another step forward towards international excellency in advanced management in R&D&I, an aspect of the DNA of the centre since the beginning. All its activities are covered by the innovation management system - continuous improvement and measurement of results, technology innovation process optimisation and knowledge transfer and generation - ensuring it uses the highest quality methods.

Skylife Engineering was recently created (May 2011). It was born from the Electronics Technology Group of the University of Seville (Spain). Airbus and Boeing Research and Technology Europe (located in Madrid) encouraged and promoted the creation of Skylife Engineering as an interesting solution for providing high technology level to aerospace industry thanks to the experience in more than 20 successful projects with technology transfer to the aerospace industry.
Skylife Engineering offers a high human capacity with a very high technological level and skills. Flexibility, creativity, high productivity, quality and projects finished on time characterize Skylife Engineering.
Skylife Engineering provides high technology and innovation in the design, development, integration, tests, and equipment and systems programming for Aerospace and Defense. This is because Skylife is a technology-based company, and it is a Spin off closely related to the University, the Research and the Technological Advances both national and international. 
Skylife Engineering develops, improves and modernizes software and hardware of new electronic systems for aerospace applications, using the last software design tools and last generation hardware technology. The team has a great experience in the design and electronic implementation of modulation and control algorithms that allow reducing thermal dissipation, electromagnetic interferences, and weight, size and power consumption. In this way, the designed and developed prototypes are reliable, efficient, compact and robust, helping to solve the main problems of the Aerospace field.

entityDescription:
RSP Technology (Trade-name of RS Alloys BV) is manufacturing so called ¿Rapidly Solidified Aluminium¿. The spill in the production process is the ultra fast casting method by which complex aluminium alloys are produced with cooling speeds of over 1 million ºC per second.
 
During the production process molten aluminium is casted upon a rotating copper wheel. The liquid aluminium alloy solidifies in a fraction of a second in a thin, long ribbon, resulting in a material with a very fine and homogenous micro- or nanostructure. Typically, the ribbon is chopped into flakes and compressed in a special designed press to form billets suitable for extrusion and forging to bar, rod or tubes. These can also be milled to sheets.
 
This rapid solidification process provides the fundamental base for the superior/advanced characteristics of RSP materials, like high strength, high stiffness, low thermal expansion and high wear resistance. RSP materials offer the ultimate solution for a variety of high-end applications in different industry segments.
 
RSP materials are applied in a large number of components and products worldwide such as, aerospace components, racing and engine components, products for the optical industry like mirrors and moulds, parts for medical systems, electronic housings.
 
RSP Technology is a BV and has over 15 years of experience in special alloys and melt spinning technology. RSP Technology will produce the designed alloys on their processing equipment with a team of experienced employees who all have several years of know-how in the production process.

entityDescription: The Tropical Research Institute (IICT) promotes tropical knowledge by pursuing interdisciplinary research of relevance to countries in tropical regions. It has a special mandate towards the Community of Portuguese Speaking Countries (CPLP), whose members are Brazil, East Timor, five African nations and Portugal. Established in 1883 as the Commission of Cartography, IICT is the oldest autonomous government agency that conducts research for development in human and natural sciences. In 1983 IICT became a state laboratory, now under the supervision of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Through the output of over 100 researchers, it seeks to increase the scientific and technical capacity of developing countries and also to ensure the preservation of its documental collections.

Company description: The Tropical Research Institute (IICT) promotes tropical knowledge by pursuing interdisciplinary research of relevance to countries in tropical regions. It has a special mandate towards the Community of Portuguese Speaking Countries (CPLP), whose members are Brazil, East Timor, five African nations and Portugal. Established in 1883 as the Commission of Cartography, IICT is the oldest autonomous government agency that conducts research for development in human and natural sciences. In 1983 IICT became a state laboratory, now under the supervision of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Through the output of over 100 researchers, it seeks to increase the scientific and technical capacity of developing countries and also to ensure the preservation of its documental collections.

entityDescription:
GAUSS is an Italian limited liability Company based in Rome, founded in 2012, carrying on the tradition of the Scuola di Ingegneria Aerospaziale in the field of Small Satellites.
The Company activities range from structural design and mission analysis to the realization of complete micro, nano, pico, femto satellites (CubeSat, PocketQube, TubeSats), their deployers and main aerospace subsystems (On-Board Computers, electronic and RF Subsystems, customers’ payloads) as well as in-orbit-demonstrator (IOD) services and ground segment operations.
GAUSS Srl has innovated the idea of launch provider, making the UniSat satellites themselves launcher platforms as well as carriers of fixed payloads. The Company “UniSat” satellite platform is used as a carrier and orbital deployer for third-parties’ CubeSat and PocketQube satellites in orbit.
GAUSS has designed, developed, and launched in space ten Small Satellites, gaining its experience from differently shaped and sized platforms: UNISAT, UNISAT-2, UNISAT-3, UNISAT-4, EDUSAT, UniCubeSat-GG, UNISAT-5, UNISAT-6, TuPOD, UNISAT-7.
Its latest satellite, UNISAT-7, an in-situ orbital deployer and IOD platform, was launched on March 22nd, 2021, by a Soyuz-Fregat Launcher from Baikonur Cosmodrome.
GAUSS has been active for years in the research on astrodynamics and space debris, with its CastelGAUSS observatory devoted to the identification, tracking and monitoring of space debris and Near-Earth Objects.

BAYERN-CHEMIE GmbH - The Driving PowerBayern-Chemie is the acknowledged worldwide technological leader in the area of air breathing solid propellant ramjet propulsion. In addition Bayern-Chemie has more than 50 years of experience in solid fuel missile propulsion.As the competence centre for missile propulsion within the MBDA, Bayern-Chemie develops, produces, refurbishes and modernizes solid fuel propulsion systems for tactical guided missiles and other gasdynamic systems. Bayern-Chemie has significant involvement with the continuous further development of rocket technology.It¿s more than 50 years of experience have resulted in unique key technologies for Bayern-Chemie in the following fields:

Throttleable, air breathing, solid fuel ram jets 
High-performance, double-pulse propulsion systems for highly agile homing-missiles
Throttleable rocket propulsion systems using gelled propellants
Insensitive rocket propulsion systems using gelled fuels
Solid fuel gas generators for diverse applications
Bayern-Chemie stimulates technological development for future applications with the following emphases:

High range and high velocity ram jet technology for use in multipurpose missiles 
Insensitive munitions aspects of propulsion with solid fuels
Expanding the functions and performance parameters of gel-fuel propulsion systems 
Environmentally friendly gas generator fuels 
Stockpile Management
The competence of Bayern-Chemie is internationally recognized due to its participation in numerous programs associated with the development and production of propulsion systems or gas generators for A400M, ALARM, ASPIDE, BLACKCAP, BRIMSTONE, HFK, HOT, KORMORAN, LFK-NG, MEADS, METEOR, MILAN, PATRIOT, ROLAND, SIDEWINDER..., as well as gas generators for the emergency surfacing system RESUS-SOLID, used in the submarine classes 212 and 214. Bayern-Chemie GmbH is a 100% subsidiary of MBDA.Thanks to a combination of technical excellence and competence together with a wide range of technical equipment, Bayern-Chemie is also a capable partner for many other industrial sectors besides aerospace and gladly offers as contract services its engineering know-how and its laboratory and testing facilities

- Uplink/downlink/turnaround


- Antenna hosting 


- Equipment co-location


- Back-up/disaster recovery hosting 


- Specialized video services


- Custom designed solutions


- Transponder capacity sales


- Satellite Services

- De-icing system for antennas.

entityDescription: The Forest Research Institute was established in 1930 as an Experimental Station of the State Forests Organisation, and in 1934 it has been transformed into the Forest Research Institute of the State Forests. Since 1945 it has been acting as the Forest Research Institute, currently being subordinated to the Minister of Environment. The Director and the Scientific Council are the head bodies of the Institute. The Scientific Council is a decisive, initiating and advisory body of the Institute and is empowered to award PhD degrees and habilitation (qualifying for associate professor position). It is also authorized to submit candidates for the title of professor of forest sciences. The Institute consists of 6 scientific departments and 3 laboratories that carry out scientific research and developmental work in a range of: forest afforestations and reforestations, tending, utilization and protection, ecology, nature conservation, genetics, forest economics and policy. It is in order to get a better knowledge of nature, social, technical, and economic circumstances influencing the state of forest resources, and to shape their multi-sided and balanced use due to satisfy the needs of contemporary and future generations in the field of forest productive, protective and social services. The Institute actively participates in elaborating legal acts and other documents, including those resulting from international conventions and agreements, and from Forest Policy of the State, and it undertakes activities for organs of the state power. The FRI carries out research for the State Forests National Forest Holding and other institutions including the Ministry of the Environment, Ministry of Science and Higher Education, the National Fund for Environment Protection and Water Management, the National Centre for Research and Development (BIOSTRATEG programme) as well as the European Union under its Framework Programmes and financial instrument LIFE+. Forest Research Institute cooperates within the frameworks of IUFRO and FAO, through contacts with partner institutions across Europe and received the status of PROFOREST Centre of Excellence in the area of protection of forest ecosystems. The Institute actively participates as a partner in realisation of projects financed from European Union sources (Framework Programmes RTD, Leonardo da Vinci Programme, Forest Focus Directive). FRI participated in projects TATRY (FP4), and EFFE and SCEMAFOR (FP5). The institute has been involved in COST actions and in projects as part of the EU's: 6th Framework Programme: COMFOR, EFORWOOD, EVOLTREE, FIRE PARADOX, FORTHREATS, TREEBREEDEX, 7th Framework Programme: BACCARA, BIOCOMES, FLEXWOOD, FORFIRE, ISEFOR, SUMFOREST, TREES4FUTURE, LIFE+: FutMon, HESOFF, ForBioSensing and INTERREG: EFFMIS, EUFOFINET, SUSTREE, WAMBAF. At present, IBL participates in more than 150 international and national actions and research programs financed by the EU (e.g. FP7, COST, LIFE +), Polish State Forests and governmental organizations. It organized and organized jointly many international and national meetings, seminars, trainings, workshops and conferences and carries on ecological education for children and youth in specially organised Education Centre. The IBL's library has collected for 85 years forest literature and its resources are the biggest in this part of Europe. On December 31, 2022, there were 171 people employed in the Institute.

RADIO6ENSE is an industrial Spin-off of the University of Roma Tor Vergata aiming at designing and developing short-range distributed RFID sensing technology for Industrial, Civil, Aerospace and Biomedical applications.
RADIO6ENSE originates from 10 years of pioneering research about Radio Frequency Identification carried on by the Pervasive Electromagnetics Lab of University of Roma Tor Vergata. 
The mission is to develop low-cost widespread sensing platforms, perfectly integrated in the environment, for different scenarios, bringing the new paradigms of pervasive sensing in the most varied contexts, even in the most traditional and settled ones.
RADIO6ENSE is supported, for the more conceptual and theoretical issues by the Pervasive Electromagnetic Lab of the University of Roma Tor Vergata. With the University, RADIO6ENSE shares three laboratories: one for modeling and design, one for the prototyping and one for measurements and test.

entityDescription:
ROSEAL S.A. is a SME specialized in manufacturing sealing systems, aiming permanently to fulfill the market - driven requirements for new and innovative performance products through collaboration with R&D Institutes, universities and academy. The experience in seal manufacturing dates back to 1978. Activities include research, design, production and marketing of mechanical and magnetofluidic seals, manufacturing specific spare parts of carbon materials, superaluminous ceramics, elastomers and PTFE and also training and technical assistance.
Our products and services cover a broad range of industrial sectors: pump factories, chemical plants, petrochemical plants, pharmaceutical industry, textile and paints industry, pulp and paper industry, food and beverage industry, nuclear-electric industry, thermal engines, water supply and treatment, installation, internal combustion engines.
S.C. ROSEAL SA has implemented this menu and the Management System Integrates in accordance with the ISO standard (Certification ISO 9001: 2015; ISO 14001: 2015; ISO 45001: 2018) and is authorized for design, manufacturing and services in accordance with CNCAN regulations for quality management in the nuclear field, class 1, ASME code, Section III, Subsection NCA, art. 3800 and 4000 and ISCIR authorization for the manufacture and installation of pressure components according to PT N SCP 1 – 2008.
ROSEAL S.A. became a member and even a founding member of the Romanian Association for Promotion of Magnetic Fluids, Romanian Atomic Forum - ROMATOM, Association of researchers, designers, manufacturers and exporters of circulation pumps in Romania (APPR), MHTC – Magurele High Tech Cluster, FEPA-CM - Employer's Association for Machine Building Industry.
Product portofolio:
-Mechanical and magnetofluidic seals for nuclear equipment, mixer, agitator, reactor, compressor, pump, blower, vacuum application.
-Spare parts manufactured by metal, Silicium Carbid, Wolfram Carbid and in-house made materials (carbon, ceramic, elastomer, PTFE)
-Magnetic nanomaterials: Magnetic nanoparticles (MNP), MNP clusters, magnetic nanofluids (ferrofluids), very high magnetization composite fluids.
Services: technical assistance, seal reconditioning, pump and compressor repairing, training.
Roseal S.A. is developing and manufacturing carbon materials, expanded graphite, superaluminous ceramics, elastomers and PTFE for spare parts. Over the years a large number of specific mechanical seals and components have been designed, built and tested, which currently solve concrete cases of chemical, petrochemical and nuclear power industry.
Being highly receptive to new technologies, ROSEAL Co. has developed long-term S&T cooperation with national Research & Development institutes and high ranked universities from Romania.The company team has gained research experience by participating and leading several national research projects.Among the most important achievements obtained in collaboration with Romanian Academy – Timisoara Branch, Center for Fundamental and Advanced Technical Research, Laboratory of Magnetic Fluid is the synthesis of magnetic nanoparticles, magnetic nanoparticle clusters,magnetic nanofluids and nano-micro structured composite magnetizable fluids even at micropilot scale with excellent quality, used in various long-term (~ 5 years) sealing systems.Advanced research have been performed for achieving polymeric and carbographitic heat-proof materials with increased life-time for seal gaskets exposed to radiation. The output of these researches covered both the qualification procedures and the synthesis procedures. Research results were also disseminated through numerous scientific papers, posters, patents and innovations.

TSS was founded in 2011 in Roveredo in the Grisons as a spin off of Mollificio Technosprings Italia with the aim to develop research, production and marketing of various possible applications with technology related to the development of the potential of shape memory material .
For this reason TSS takes inside transversal skills that allow them to handle and develop projects and products in many fields: medical, aerospace, mechanical, special machinery, valves, to even up the watch industry.
Thanks to these skills it has already achieved the development of numerous projects of application, filing a patent in an anti-freeze valve developed with SMA.
It is currently making prototypes for a clip for cranial surgery and developing various projects that enhance the characteristics of SMA (superelasticity, shape memory).
For this reason, it is already developing important relationships with companies and organizations such as Liebherr, Epiflex, Swiss Space Center, Auma, Gruppo Swatch...


TSS is a member of AIASI: Aerospace Industries Association of Italian Switzerland.
In the development plan for the next triennium is expected to be opened three production sectors: medical, aerospace, mechanical (for valves and projects related to automotive and oil-gas industry)

entityDescription:
green spin GmbH was founded in 2013 and is based in Würzburg. The management team of the start-up company consists of Clemens Delatrée (Business Development), Heiko Fabritius (Product Development), Dr. Sebastian Fritsch (Operational Business) and Gunther Schorcht (Technical Development). A total of eight people currently contribute to the success of the company.
green spin stands for Business Intelligence solutions, digital innovations and new business models based on Open Data. Open data is digital information that anyone can use freely and without restrictions. The primary focus of green spin is the processing of spatial data, so-called geodata. Satellite sensor data in particular can help with, for example, viewing many company processes from a completely new perspective.
green spin analyses this external geodata and uses artificial intelligence, among other things, to derive relevant information for various customer groups. This data is then integrated into existing customer processes using interfaces or visualisation applications. The comprehensive services of green spin include consulting, data services and application development. The company draws on many existing building blocks, and years of experience with previous projects. Substantial experience was gained in particular with developing solutions for the areas of agriculture, commodity trade and water supply. Examples of Smart Farming applications can be found online at www.greenspin.de. 
Typically, green spin customers are looking for innovative digital solutions and a new perspective on their business processes. green spin is open for cooperation in research and development. The emphasis of own current projects is on artificial intelligence, Big Data, data visualisation as well as Open Data based applications and interfaces.

entityDescription: The Łukasiewicz Research Network – Tele and Radio Research Institute conducts interdisciplinary research and development activities in the area of advanced digital and electronic technologies, addressing key challenges of modern economies. The Institute focuses on three strategic directions: energy transformation, defense and state security, and circular economy. The Institute actively carries out its activities in three strategic directions: Energy Transformation, Defense and State Security, and Circular Economy. Thanks to competencies in the fields of ICT, Internet of Things, sensor technologies, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), the Institute develops advanced electrotechnical solutions, including Smart Grid systems, energy management systems (EMS), and tools for predictive diagnostics and real-time infrastructure monitoring. In the area of defense and security, advanced photonic, electronic, and automation technologies are implemented, including solutions meeting safety requirements at the NATO level (AQAP). The Institute also supports the circular economy by conducting research and development projects in the co-design of electronics, automation, and digitization of technological processes, as well as technologies for the recovery, regeneration, and reuse of materials, including ultrasonic, vacuum, and electrothermal technologies. The Institute has implemented and continuously improves a Quality Management System compliant with the PN-EN ISO 9001:2015 standard.

ARQUIMEA DEUTSCHLAND GmbH (ARQ-D) is a German private company with Headquarters in Frankfurt (Oder), devoted to design, development and commercialization of space-qualified parts, including microelectronics, electronics and mechanisms. 

ARQ-D is a fabless Design House specialized in radiation-hardened-by-design (RHBD) integrated circuits for space and other harsh environments such as nuclear, aviation or medical applications. ARQ-D’s devices are designed to be immune to electrical degradation produced by cumulated radiation dose or high energy particles. ARQ-D specializes in analog, digital and mixed-signal microelectronics, covering the full supply chain, from feasibility analysis and requirements review up to qualification according to Space standards (ESCC, NASA and MIL). The following capabilities can be highlighted:
-	Space-qualified ASIC/FPGA turnkey projects
-	Deep submicron (up to 65nm) analog, digital and mixed-signal design
-	IP cores design and integration
-	Standardized design methodologies
-	Process or device electrical and radiation characterization
-	Silicon evaluation 
-	Test chips design
-	Flight model validation

ARQUIMEA provides turnkey analog, digital and mixed-signal ASICs by covering the full supply chain, from the definition of the ASIC specification in collaboration with the user, up to the delivery of the qualified chip. This implies the establishment of a complete network of partnerships with reliable partners and suppliers for the different steps of the development and procurement of our integrated circuits.

ARQ-D is also commercial partner and exclusive distributor of space-qualified actuators and mechanisms using Shape Memory Alloys (SMA) belonging to its Sister Company ARQUIMEA INGENIERIA.

PRODEVELOP, S.L. is an SME employing 80 engineers most of them computing, telecommunication, industrial and cartography engineers, located in Valencia and Barcelona, Spain. PRODEVELOP is specialized in consulting, development, deploying, and operating geospatial solutions based on free and open source software. The success in our projects is based on the acquired experience in geospatial industry, and the collaboration with the main developers groups in the world. The research lines at PRODEVELOP include mobile mapping, interoperability of sensor systems through SWE (Sensor Web Enablement), geoprocessing services, embedded software, geospatial technologies in mobile, desktop, Web and service environments, and modelling software system. PRODEVELOP main products are geospatial desktop and web applications, precision agriculture management systems as well as a complete set of products related with the maritime sector. PRODEVELOP provides consultancy for a number of departments of the Valencia Regional Government on software development and systems administration.

PRODEVELOP has 20 years of experience in the implementation of IT solutions based on geospatial technology for diverse sectors such as: Maritime, Environment, Tourism, Agriculture, Public Administration and Transport. PRODEVELOP is the key developer of two successful Open Source projects: gvSIG, a complete Desktop Geographical Information Systems management tool; and MOSKITT, a modeling tool based on the Eclipse Rich Client Platform and active contributor of other geospatial open-source projects, like Sextante or Glob3 Mobile.

entityDescription:
The University of Palermo is an internationally acknowledged public research organization which covers almost all main fields of study fostering an interdisciplinary approach. 
Its internationalization strategy envisaged in 2020 n. 53 double-degree study courses and 10 courses as well as 418 study subjects delivered in English. 
The University welcomes about 500 enrolled foreign students and 351 incoming ERASMUS students per year and is active in 186 international agreements for interuniversity cooperation.
The academic structures include: 16 Departments, 1 School of Medicine, 21 libraries, 3 decentralised premises (Agrigento, Trapani, Caltanissetta), the Museum System, the Language Centre, the Italian school for foreign students, the Guidance Centre.
The educational offer for the academic year 2021/2022 encompasses 144 degree courses (first and second cycle), 40 master courses, 29 specialization schools, 23 PhD programmes.
The academic community in 2020 consisted of 42.320 students, 1.468 lecturers, 81 research fellows, 685 PhDs, 1.255 students attending specialisation courses, 1.410 managers, technical and administrative staff units.
Research projects in operation in 2020 were 206.
In order to implement its third mission, the University of Palermo has set up an Industrial Liaison Office, launched a network of University labs (ATEN Center) for testing and transferring new technologies to SMEs, founded a university business incubator and started up a Contaminaton Lab. The University labs integrated system has been conceived to create synergies among the different academic skills available, enhance coordination with other centres and exploit research results to generate economic value.
The business incubator located within the University Campus of Palermo, managed by Consorzio ARCA (a public-private partnership) intends to boost the growth and success of innovative business ideas by means of a structured network of resources and services. It provides interdisciplinary entrepreneurship education training packages, helps generate profitable start-ups, supports academic spin-off companies and assists students for their participation in business plan competitions joined by the University

Its internationalization strategy envisaged in 2020 n. 53 double-degree study courses and 10 courses as well as 418 study subjects delivered in English. 
The University welcomes about 500 enrolled foreign students and 351 incoming ERASMUS students per year and is active in 186 international agreements for interuniversity cooperation.
The academic structures include: 16 Departments, 1 School of Medicine, 21 libraries, 3 decentralised premises (Agrigento, Trapani, Caltanissetta), the Museum System, the Language Centre, the Italian school for foreign students, the Guidance Centre.
The educational offer for the academic year 2021/2022 encompasses 144 degree courses (first and second cycle), 40 master courses, 29 specialization schools, 23 PhD programmes.
The academic community in 2020 consisted of 42.320 students, 1.468 lecturers, 81 research fellows, 685 PhDs, 1.255 students attending specialisation courses, 1.410 managers, technical and administrative staff units.
Research projects in operation in 2020 were 206.
In order to implement its third mission, the University of Palermo has set up an Industrial Liaison Office, launched a network of University labs (ATEN Center) for testing and transferring new technologies to SMEs, founded a university business incubator and started up a Contaminaton Lab. The University labs integrated system has been conceived to create synergies among the different academic skills available, enhance coordination with other centres and exploit research results to generate economic value.
The business incubator located within the University Campus of Palermo, managed by Consorzio ARCA (a public-private partnership) intends to boost the growth and success of innovative business ideas by means of a structured network of resources and services. It provides interdisciplinary entrepreneurship education training packages, helps generate profitable start-ups, supports academic spin-off companies and assists students for their participation in business plan competitions joined by the University

entityDescription:
ItalConsul was established in 1996 to operate in Logistic Support Area as logistics engineering consultant. Its Core Business is mainly based on its capability to perform advanced project and activities of logistics engineering on the following fields:
Defense; Aerospace; Transportation (Railways); Energy; Manufacturing firms.
The main ItalConsul's skills and experiences are related to the Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) and Finite Elements Methods (FEM) and Analysis (FEA) scenario. It involves, starting from a detailed Logistic Support Analysis (LSA), many activities and deliverables, regarding four different engineering fields:
-- ILS Engineering -- Continuous Acquisition Logistic Support (CALS), Maintenance Planning, System Reliability, Maintainability and Testability, FMEA & FMECA, LCC, FTA, LSA, LSAR, Spare parts analysis, PHS&T analysis, Human factor analysis, Integrated Logistic Support Database (ITP) and Maintenance Management Systems (MMS), NATO Codification.
-- Technical Publications Engineering -- Technical manuals (Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals ¡V IETM, Documentation IETD and Publications - IETP) developed according to the most important international standard requirement (AECMA 2000M, S-1000D, MIL-M-38784, etc.) and using mark-up languages as XML, SGML and HTML.
-- Technical Training Engineering -- Training course, theoretical, hands-on, on the job, Computer Based Training and e-learning SCORM Conformant, System simulations.
-- Concurrent Engineering -- Research of Design bugs and preparation of most convenient solution for the customer.
In order to keep its Know-How to eccellent levels, ItalConsul is active in Research & Development, too. Infact Italconsul holds about seventy scientific publications and three national patents, regularly recorded. Moreover it created a software tool, called "RelySoft", which constitutes a revolutionary approach to Reliability Analysis, particularly in the field of mechanics.
ItalConsul is a member of the The Latium Region SME Cluster operating in the Aerospace and Defence scenarios. This Cluster aims the SME to: intercept more easily R&D programs; strengthen marketing strategies; develop more efficiency industrial partnership, interface international cluster operating in similar scenarios.

entityName: CEREMA Cerema (Centre d’études et d’expertise sur les risques, l’environnement, la mobilité et l’aménagement)
entityDescription:
Cerema is the public expert in adapting territories to climate change. It is the only national institution whose governance is shared between the State and local authorities, with over 950 local authority members.
It is located in France and the French overseas territories, with 27 offices and 2,500 employees.
Cerema's expertise is pooled nationwide, and it supports the State and local authorities in the cooperative development, deployment and assessment of public policies and development and transport projects.
With its strong potential for innovation and research, Cerema operates in 6 areas: Expertise & Territorial Engineering, Building, Mobility, Transport Infrastructures, Environment & Risks, Sea & Coast.
Cerema is a public structure under the authority of the French Ministry of Regional Planning and Decentralization and the Ministry of Ecological Transition, Biodiversity, Forestry, the Sea and Fisheries.
Inside Cerema, the satellite applications team promotes the use of satellite data for public policies and develops methodologies based on spatial data to assist local authorities in their climate change adaptation strategies. It proposes integrated tools for sustainable urban planning and the adaptation of cities and territories to climate change. These tools focus on key areas such as managing natural risks, mitigating urban heat islands, promoting vegetation, improving water management, and supporting coastal management.

Company description: Cerema is the public expert in adapting territories to climate change. It is the only national institution whose governance is shared between the State and local authorities, with over 950 local authority members.
It is located in France and the French overseas territories, with 27 offices and 2,500 employees.
Cerema's expertise is pooled nationwide, and it supports the State and local authorities in the cooperative development, deployment and assessment of public policies and development and transport projects.

It proposes integrated tools for sustainable urban planning and the adaptation of cities and territories to climate change. These tools focus on key areas such as managing natural risks, mitigating urban heat islands, promoting vegetation, improving water management, and supporting coastal management.

Natural Resources Institute Finland is a research and expert organisation, which promotes bioeconomy and sustainable use of natural resources. Finland is Europe's most forested country - 3/4 of its land area is under forest cover. Finland is rich also in other renewable natural resources, such as fresh water, fishes, game and agricultural land. Luke is the main actor in research of natural resources in Finland.

Natural Resources Institute Finland (Luke) started at the beginning of year 2015, when three state research institutes (MTT Agrifood Research Finland, the Finnish Forest Research Institute, the Finnish Game and Fisheries Research Institute, and the statistical services of the Information Centre of the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry) were merged. 

The task of Luke are defined in the law and statute to promote competitive business activities based on the sustainable use of renewable natural resources, well-being, and the vitality of rural areas. The Natural Resources Institute Finland supports social decision-making and produces statistics related to food and renewable natural resources. Furthermore, the research institute handles tasks related to ensuring the genetic diversity of cultivated crops, livestock and forest trees. The current network of research units covers the whole country. Luke is a governmental research institute, subordinate to the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.

entityDescription:
The Lithuanian Energy Institute (LEI) was established in 1956 and became known among the local and international scientific society interested in fundamental research in hydrodynamics, thermal physics, material science, simulation and control of power supply systems, hydrology. In January 1992 the Government of the Republic of Lithuania granted a state science institution status to the Institute, which became independent from the Academy of Sciences.

The LEI is a technical research centre dealing with energy related research in analysis of security of energy supply, development of energy planning methods, fuel cells and hydrogen, renewable energy, thermal physics and fluid mechanics, nuclear safety, structural integrity assessment of components and structures, simulation of complex energy systems. LEI have 280 persons of staff (as of year 2013). Among them there are 11 Dr. Habilitus, 91 Ph.D., 36 researchers with B.Sc. and M.Sc. and 20 Ph.D. Candidates.

Institute has an extensive experience in international projects: H2020 (1 project), FP7 (23 projects), FP6 (14 projects), FP5 (11 projects), Phare, Intelligent Energy Europe (28 projects), COST (15 projects), IAEA (9 projects), Eureka (4 projects), Leonardo da Vinci (1 project), INTERREG III (3 projects), Baltic Sea Region 2007-2013 programme (3 project), South Baltic Cross-border Co-operation Programme 2007-2013 (1 project), Nordic Energy Research Programme (2 projects).

entityDescription:
Consulting and Innovation: 
Cell & Sat associates acquired during their career a strong expertise in the cellular and satellite fields. They have all been employed by telecom operators or equipment manufacturers, and held various responsibilities including system definition, technical development, business planning, sales & marketing or operational deployment of cellular or satellite networking products.
Cell & Sat engineers contribute their deep knowledge of cellular radio systems to assist telecom operators in the technical and economical evaluation of their networks. Recent assignments concerned the impact of new 3G and 4G developments, emerging network architectures including macro cells as well as small cells, and the impact of fast growing IP based services.
A particular focus of the company is the evaluation of new technologies to extend the coverage of telecommunications networks in rural environments. This includes the technical and economical assessment of satellite transmission systems used to replace or complement terrestrial backhaul infrastructure. Other recent activities concerned the design of cost efficient solar energy systems to serve cellular base stations.
Cell & Sat is also assisting satellite operators and manufacturers in their technical assessments, market evaluations or business plan simulation concerning the potential contribution of satellite systems to telecommunication networks. Recent studies included the impact of various broadband satellite technologies, including geostationary as well as low / medium earth orbit, and the analysis of High Throughput Satellites ¿HTS¿ with spot beams in Ku or Ka bands.
Cell & Sat is working in partnership with selected consulting and development partners to broaden its knowledge and experience base. Cell & Sat is familiar with various aspects of the satellite industry, including business modelling, the management of large international projects and the development of complex satellite platforms and associated ground infrastructure. 
Cell & Sat engineers have a particular interest for innovation in the cellular and satellite fields. The company patented and developed innovative functions to reduce the cost and optimize the quality of satellite infrastructure within cellular networks. Its initial developments concerned the optimization of satellite backhaul by locally switching 2G mobile voice channels, while Cell & Sat ongoing research activity is now focussing on the application of satellite technologies to efficiently transport 3G/4G mobile data

entityDescription: EBE Solutions has years of experience in managing R&D projects in the field of road safety and telematics and has successfully undertaken numerous R&D projects over the past years. Many exciting products and services of their portfolio are based on the results of previous R&D projects. For example, EBE developed and implemented a Park & Ride entry/exit control system for the parking garages of the Austrian Federal Railways (ÖBB) to prevent unauthorized persons (no train ticket) from parking illegally. EBE also developed a modern railway crossing safety system and a red light enforcement system at railway crossings. This was very challenging due to competitors in Austria and Germany, as these systems were split between two companies until EBE entered the market. Market entry in the road and rail safety sector is very difficult due to high safety and norm standards and sometimes involves high financial resources. EBE has been involved in the digitalization of roadworks in the road traffic sector for many years. Some time ago, a start was made on connecting roadworks safety components to a control center via a network. This means that information regarding position and display information is supplied to the control center. From this, requirements for simple traffic jam warning systems were defined and developed for use in Europe. EBE Solutions is responsible for project management and organization, as well as the facilitation of project meeting. Project meetings will be held on a regular basis to ensure the information flow between the partners.

entityDescription: Nextworks, located in Pisa (Italy), is a very dynamic SME that was created in 2002 by a group of engineers and computer scientists as a spin-off company of the Department of Computer Science and Telecommunications (DITEL) of Consorzio Pisa Ricerche (CPR), in order to exploit the vast experience gained since 1995 in the context of National and International research projects and consultancies. Nextworks operates in the IT and Telecommunications sectors. The company has long-term experience and proved skills in the frameworks of wireless, access and transport networks, digital video encoding and transport, control and automation, design and development of complex software systems on both traditional and embedded platforms. The consulting activities range from pure support consulting to long-term, third-party design & developments of protocol stacks for equipment vendors. Nextworks has been running out research and development activities in co-funded projects (EU, National and Regional). This work is carried out in cooperation with a wide range of partners (both academic and industrial), with the basic objective to consolidate and further develop the know-how of its personnel, designed to provide consulting and training, development of products and the development of their relations on the basis of future consulting and R&D. The technology sector is the reference ICT in general and frontier technologies in particular. Based on the experience gained from its teams, Nextworks promotes the dissemination and use of technologies and services at the border of the area of research and real application contexts, with the following activities: ¿ research and development in the context of emerging technologies and protocols, through the preliminary stages of study, evaluation of applicability, prototyping and product development, designed to turn innovative ideas into successful solutions; ¿ specialized training on specific technical issues, intended for companies that need to establish or strengthen their know-how or to start new industrial activities; ¿ consultancy and technical support in the areas of networking, security, and traditional/innovative services, accompanying its customers both in the early stages of realization and in the evolution and optimization of their IT infrastructure; ¿ Design and development of software and systems on data, voice and video processing and transmission, tailored to customers specific requirements in contexts ranging from home environment to industry; ¿ integration and customization of open source software, particularly in the areas of competence of the company. Since 2004, Nextworks is actively present in the market for home automation in the yachting sector, supporting one of the largest European shipyards in the design, construction and installation of their standard unified IT system, which integrates all of the electronic technologies on board. Since 2008, Nextworks produces two lines of home automation products for high-end yachting and residential markets: SeaLux (www.sealux.it) and Symphony (www.hellosymphony.it). These innovative solutions are fully developed in-house, and are characterized by the integration of home automation, security, communications and multimedia entertainment.

entityDescription:
The University of Santiago de Compostela (USC), founded in 1495, is one of the university institutions with the longest tradition in Europe. USC is situated among the top ten Spanish universities in regard to their positioning in the different international (ARWU, QS, SIR, Reuters, Nature Index, Webometrics) and national (U-ranking) university rankings.The education, research and social commitment of the USC has allowed to define a new institutional strategy based on specialization, scientific excellence and impact of results. As a result, two main projects (Campus Vida and Campus do Mar) have been awarded with the International Campus of Excellence recognition. In addition, two new projects (Campus Terra and Campus da Cidadanía) are being developed. This institutional strategy is addressed to contribute to the development of a new model of sustainable economic and social growth based on talent, innovation and internationalisation.
USC is organised into two campuses, in Santiago de Compostela and Lugo, which complement each other regarding the different specializations each of them offers (a total of 61 bachelor degrees, 68 master degrees and 55 doctoral programs). In terms of human resources, the university has more than 2,000 professional and research personnel (about 42% female) involved in education and research, over 26,000 students each year, and more than 1,000 people working in administration and services (about 8% supporting research activities).
Research and Technology Development is one of the most important activities in the USC having the infrastructure facilities and human resources needed for the training of young researchers. More than 250 research teams, belonging to the different Departments (50), Singular Research Centres (4) and Research Institutes (11), offer a high-quality scientific production in 6 strategic multidisciplinary areas (Biomedicine and Biotechnology; Physics; Environmental Technologies; Bio-economy, Territory and Entrepreneurship; Cultural Heritage and Land Resources) which are of main socioeconomic interest. This has allowed a narrow technological cooperation with regional, national and international institutions, companies and SMEs. R&D activities were supported with an average of €60 million/year (20% corresponding to contracts with private companies and 60% to competitive public funds) during the last 5 years.
