The Geneva-based Zoï Environment Network (Zoi) is an international non-profit organisation with the mission to reveal, explain and communicate connections between the environment and society. Zoi designs creative information products for decision-making and provides assistance to local, regional and national authorities, corporations and individuals who are ready to find solutions to complex environmental challenges. 

The geographic focus of Zoi is strongly on Europe¿s eastern and southern neighbours: Eastern Europe, Central Asia, the Caucasus, the Balkans, and the Mediterranean. Zoi has eight full time staff and works with a wide network of international associates and consultants based in former Soviet Union countries. Zoï is officially established and registered in Switzerland as an association. Zoi is affiliated to a number of international organisations and entities including UN ECOSOC, UNFCCC and UNEP.

Zoï¿s staff members are experienced climate change, environmental analysis and communication experts, and have excellent knowledge of the environmental and institutional situation of the former Soviet Union countries. Zoi team includes policy specialists, geographers, environmental managers and communicators; we also engage cartographers, graphic designers, writers and filmmakers to reach out to our target audiences.

entityDescription:
FRM Ingénierie (FRMi) is an independent international and private forest engineering and consulting agency. The company was founded in 1987 by Dr Bernard CASSAGNE and has become a world leader in the field of forest engineering and technical assistance to forest owners and managers and to timber industry operators especially in Africa.
Over the past 25 years more than 300 missions for the sustainable management of tropical forests have been conducted in over 50 countries of Africa, Asia and Latin America for many different international clients: institutional, private or organizations.
We promote a hands-on approach for the safeguard of tropical forests, our keywords are proximity, scientific strictness, pragmatism, capacity building and dialogue. In the field, we work to improve knowledge and consideration for the tropical forests and to promote the sustainable and reasoned management of the resources with governments, funding bodies, economic operators, civil society and local authorities.
Consulting or long term interventions by FRMi experts rely on the most up-to-date technologies and draw on the latest progress of scientific research. Numerous interventions in extremely diverse contexts and situations allow our engineers to propose options, discuss solutions, advise and work along the beneficiaries all the way.
The FRMi administrative and technical backstopping teams advise, organize and support frontline players of all projects. The team also ensures that information flows as required between the different stakeholders of the Project, experts, donor, customer, other involved parties. entityDescription:
The LZN Laser Zentrum Nord GmbH has been founded on July, 15th, 2009 as a fully affiliate of the TU Tech Innovation GmbH (51 % University of Technology Hamburg-Harburg / 49 % Freie und Hansestadt Hamburg) and is focused on innovative photonic production technologies. Initiator and chief executive officer of the LZN is Prof. Dr.-Ing. C. Emmelmann who is head of the Institute of Laser and System Technologies (iLAS) of TUHH and has over 25 years of experience in laser material processing. The LZN¿s aim is to transfer research knowledge of laser based manufacturing technologies into industrial applications. Its intention is to function as a Center of Excellence for innovative laser technologies and applications. Focusing on northern Germany, the LZN¿s goal is to strengthen SMEs in the local region of Hamburg and northern Germany in general by giving them excess to high-end laser technology and innovative product development capabilities. For its customers and partners the LZN provides infrastructure for the complete process chain from the design to manufacturing and part finishing until quality assurance for laser based manufacturing technologies. 
Amongst many publicly funded research projects with local SMEs, the Laser Zentrum Nord has acquired several industrial research and development projects in a wide range of industries with leading companies such as Airbus, Premium Aerotec, BMW, VW, Blohm&Voss, Mayer Werft, Implantcast and Körber. The strong focus on optimization of the additive manufacturing process and the development of new products for applications in the aeronautic, astronautic, medical and tooling industry makes the Laser Zentrum Nord one of the leading Center of Excellence for additive layer manufacturing (ALM).

entityDescription:
Founded in 2004, UBIMET GmbH is the largest private provider of meteorological services in Austria and among the top five largest weather companies in Europe. With the headquarter based in Vienna, UBIMET runs several affiliates in Melbourne, Munich, Karlsruhe, Zürich and New York. Currently, UBIMET has about 80 employees. 

The company's main area of expertise lies in the field of meteorology, specifically in developing forecast models, issuing weather forecasts and severe weather warnings with high temporal and spatial resolution, as well as in preparing data and forecasts tailored to suit individual customer requirements, such as information services, risk management, personnel planning, decision support etc. The clientele includes insurances, infrastructure operators, municipalities and individuals, as well as mass media, such as daily newspaper and private radio stations. 

UBIMET operates the Severe Weather Centre in Austria, Germany, Hungary, Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Slovenia, Romania, Serbia and Montenegro, France and Australia. They provide private costumers, companies and communities with forecasts and warnings for storm, thunder storm, heavy rain and hail via email, fax and SMS. The success of UBIMET (with more than 2.5 Mio private costumers) is based on their models and systems they developed. 

Due to the essential advantage of an in-house research and development department UBIMET can provide state-of-the-art know-how in all areas of meteorological technology and has experience in different joint research programmes dealing with meteorology and ICT. UBIMET invests about 20% of its business volume in R&D. The major research focus is put on the improvement of meteorological nowcasting and forecasting models, assimilation of real-time data, dynamic receiver integration and information adaptation, situation-based event notification and information logistics. 
In the framework of different co-funded projects (national and EU FP7) UBIMET was able to determine the important aspects needed for accurate weather delivery. This includes a very high spatial resolution of 1 km and a very high temporal resolution of one hour for all meteorological parameters of the forecast models. 
Based on the severe weather warning requirements, UBIMET developed high technical knowledge in the fields of spatial modeling, GIS, stable and performant data flow, logistics and communications, as well as data overlays. UBIMET has access to worldwide national weather observation data. Additionally, real-time observation data, information from international computer models as well as satellite and weather radar data from all parts of the world are received and processed around the clock in the UBIMET Data Centers.
The processing of a large data volume and the calculation of forecast models requires high computing power. UBIMET has more than 30 servers, which are mostly hosted in data centers to ensure failure safety. Additionally, a WRF (Weather Research Forecast) computer cluster is at UBIMET's disposal. With its high operative capability, UBIMET has the ability to cover the entire demand for high-resolution weather analysis and forecasts for all of Europe.

entityDescription:
EnduroSat was founded in 2015 in Sofia, Bulgaria and has grown to be a high-end space infrastructure builder, which specializes in the development and production of state-of-the-art software defined satellites and related space services, bringing a paradigm improvement in payload data services accessibility and cost. The company is vertically integrated with in-house capability to design, engineer and build satellite modules, subsystems and entire satellite platforms.
EnduroSat designs and operates satellites up to 400 kg, providing businesses and researchers with space data which can be used for environmental monitoring, urban planning, and disaster management. Company’s comprehensive Space Service handles mission design, launch, and operations, delivering analysis-ready data on demand. Equipped with advanced onboard AI, EnduroSat’s satellites offer insights with reduced data latency and transmission volume.
EnduroSat satellites are software-flexible, with AI capability in orbit, significantly outmatching the current solutions. The systems are delivered at significantly lower cost without compromising on data accuracy and performance, providing the capability to support the most advanced applications for data processing. With 5-year lifetime, the missions follow an agile development approach allowing for rapid technology iterations and enhancements with each satellite generation. With flexible mission operations, the customers have direct control over the data quality, acquisition and delivery process at significantly shorter timeframes.
Developing next generation technology requires world-class equipment. Our current facilities are housed in 17 000 sq.m. Space center in Sofia, equipped with all the necessary infrastructure to carry out modern engineering activities such as a cutting-edge RF lab, anechoic chamber, TVAC, R&D studios, satellite assembly facility, warehouse storage, and mission control.
Our team includes more than 300+ talented engineers and experts in the space sector currently attending 450+ global customers.

entityDescription: The Belgian Welding Institute is a collective research centre, with about 7 employees. BWI has extensive recognised expertise in testing of materials and worldwide reputation in testing of welds. It is a fully independent non-profit organisation, combining the functions of research and development, education, training and transferring knowledge and all service relevant research for welding and related technologies, weldability of various materials and the behaviour of welded components and structures in service. In service behaviour is studied for low or high temperature applications, static and dynamic loading and corrosive conditions. BWI has more than 30 years of experience with various solid state joining processes, such as the friction-based processes, ultrasonic welding and electromagnetic pulse joining. BWI has performed experimental research as well as feasibility studies for joining specific materials and products of companies, by rotary friction welding, friction spot welding (refill friction stir spot welding) and electromagnetic pulse welding or forming, in particular for joining of dissimilar materials.

entityDescription:
IFTH (http://www.ifth.org/is one of the main research centres in Europe and
the official Certification Centre for Textile and Clothing in France. IFTH's main mission for the last 50
years has been to develop new technologies in the textile and clothing industry and to share these
technologies with all textile and apparel manufacturers in order to improve their productivity,
competitiveness and profitability.
IFTH researches on new textile technologies in the fields of chemistry grafting, technical textiles,
finishing, printing, environment, energy, textile processes (spinning, weaving, knitting,
nonwovens).More than ever, Research and its applications, improvements in productivity, innovations
and the training that ensues, and trials and tests of new products have become unavoidable. This
requires know-how in experimenting, references based on expertise in the industry, guarantees of
objectivity and recognition at an international level. The scientific skill and qualification of its human
resources, the complementary aspects of its technological centres, its reputation for excellence and
its international relationships and partnerships make of the Institute an essential link in the new stakes
of the world-wide Textile-Apparel Distribution network.
As an active member of numerous industrial, technical, scientific or institutional networks, IFTH is
widely involved in the future of Textile-Apparel by participating in studies and actions carried out by all
of the trade's players. IFTH participates actively in the deployment of the European Technological
Platform and development of competitiveness poles in the different regions of France. IFTH also
chairs Textranet, a European association that includes nearly 30 industrial and technical Textile-
Apparel centres and is a member of the French ITC network. Thanks to this European network, IFTH
opens the doors to collaborative industrial networks to its customers in order to develop study and
research projects together and offer new opportunities at both a technological and commercial level

entityDescription:
HiETA Technologies Limited is a product design, development and production company exploiting the new technology of Additive Manufacturing (AM). Using Selective Laser Melting we ¿grow¿ components from layers of very fine powders. The high levels of three dimensional design freedom provided by the approach allows us to deploy complex geometries, for weight reduction, thermal performance and increased functionalities, and to integrate multiple components into single designs. What makes HiETA different is the fusion of design expertise to AM process expertise; which by simultaneously pushing the limits in design and the AM process, allows us to realise more compact and efficient components than is otherwise possible with conventional manufacturing techniques. 

Based in Bristol and Bath Science Park, HiETA is pioneering the use of high performance, metals, polymers and composite materials. There, in our new Technology Centre, our team of approximately twenty highly experienced and qualified engineers design, test, prototype and manufacture innovative high performance components.

Our designs for thermal management and weight reduction meet the increasing demand for smaller, lighter and more efficient engines, energy systems and structures delivered faster.

HiETA in collaboration with its partners is working hard to industrialise AM technologies to the point that they become economically viable for part volumes in the tens of thousands. This is being achieved by the application of an integrated value chain approach where all contributing elements are optimised to maximise productivity. For example this has included iterated developments in data handling, AM machine software, component design and AM hardware. Since we started component costs have already been reduced by an order of magnitude and we are confident that we will reduce costs by another order of magnitude in the near future.

As a telecommunications operator it offers broadband data transmission, Internet access and other advanced telecommunications and value-added B2B services. The infrastructure of ATM S.A. includes three state-of-the-art data centers with over 10,600 sq m (114,100 sq ft) of total area and a 42 MW power supply and a proprietary nationwide network. Our company operates under the ATMAN and Thinx Poland brands.
ATMAN is ATM¿s flagship brand under which telecommunications services are offered to carriers and enterprises. ATMAN services (e.g. colocation, hosting, private cloud computing, data transmission and Internet access) are provided on the basis of two data centers: ATMAN DC in Warsaw and Katowice, as well as the ATMAN network: international links along with a long-distance fiber-optic backbone connecting key business centers and telecommunications nodes in the largest Polish cities.
Thinx Poland is both a data center and an Internet exchange point, and most importantly stands out as the largest carrier-neutral data center in Poland. Located in Warsaw, with 3,700 sq m (39,800 sq ft) of colocation area and 16 MW of guaranteed power supply, Thinx Poland Data Center provides its customers with state-of-the-art conditions, ensuring long-term availability of colocation area, energy and fiber-optic lines. 
Thinx Internet Exchange is comprised of a network of access nodes in 11 cities in Poland and 5 cities abroad, connected through long-distance, high-throughput lines (N×10 Gbps). Its main node is located in Thinx Poland Data Center.

In-Space Missions (ISM) is a UK-based space services company, founded in 2015 and headquartered in Alton, Hampshire. The company specializes in the full lifecycle of small satellites — from design, manufacturing and integration through to launch, on-orbit operations and data delivery. 
Key Activities
- Builds and integrates satellites from “1U cubesats” up to around 150 kg small satellites. 
- Offers a “Space as a Service” model, including hosted-payload rideshare missions (their “Faraday” concept) to let customers access orbit without building a full standalone spacecraft. 
- Since 2021, ISM has been a wholly-owned subsidiary of BAE Systems Digital Intelligence, combining its small satellite and mission-services capabilities with BAE’s secure communications and defence space portfolio.

entityDescription:
The aim of HCP international is to support sustainable development, with special emphasis on the application of innovative technologies, such as earth observation. HCP international achieves this by providing added value to customers through services in the field of marketing, acquisition, management and consulting.

The market in which HCP international operates consists mainly of institutional clients: European Commission, national governments, space agencies, higher education institutes, international financial organizations. In the area of space technology there is a growing demand for concrete applications. Specifically in the field of earth observation the demand-pull needs to be stimulated, as products and services that are currently provided originate primarily from a technology-push. This provides an opportunity for the delivery of high-quality consulting and marketing services that reach new groups of potential users and go beyond a traditional approach that focuses on mere selling and promotion. HCP international is specialized in the identification of value propositions for customers and in providing feedback to the earth observation community to achieve a better adjustment to supply and demand. This is a highly specialized area in a growing market and the director/owner of HCP international has acquired a good reputation and network in the field. Although a niche market, prospects for assignments are good.

A second market is general advisory work for the international cooperation sector and the higher education sector in the areas of project acquisition, proposal writing and project evaluation. Clients are governments, international financial organizations and higher education institutions. The market is stable, although there is pressure through international competition. The director/owner of HCP international has more than twenty years of experience in the field of international cooperation with specialization in capacity building, disaster risk management, water management, agriculture and environmental management, giving the company a comparative advantage to access this market.

A third market is the international marketing of higher education. Although not a priority market for HCP international, opportunities may arise, particularly with Dutch higher education institutes as clients. The director/owner of HCP international has extensive experience in international marketing of higher education and will provide services in this area upon request.

entityDescription: Heller Consult sp. z o.o. is an IT engineering company operating in the road industry for more than 25 years. The area of competence covers all activities related to road management, in particular the maintenance of roads and implementation of PMS expert systems (Pavement Management System). The main goal is to support managers in decision making process by analysing different types of data, including road surface condition, its structure, degradation models, traffic intensity, traffic safety factors etc. Employees of Heller Consult have extensive experience in the analysis, visualization, provision and presentation of road data. Methods of presentation of various road data, developed by the company are now the standard used by many road authorities around the world. Together with its business partner HELLER Ingenieurgesellschaft, Heller Consult forms a Heller Group, which aims to develop and implement innovative solutions for road administration in Poland, Germany and other countries in Europe. Heller Consult is working together with its partner from Heller Group in realisation of long-term research and development program as well as leads own research projects financed, among others, from the EU Framework Programme 7. The Heller Consult team consists of experts in the field of road engineering, mechanics, mathematics and computer science. entityDescription:
The history of technical higher education in Cluj Napoca goes back to the beginning of the previous century. The unification of the Romanian provinces into a single state, on December 1 st 1918, opened new perspectives for education. On February 1 st 1920 the Industrial College was founded in Cluj-Napoca. The new education institution passed afterwards through a series of transformations, becoming the College for Technical Conductors in 1922. It was the only college with a major in electrical engineering in the country and the forerunner of the Cluj Polytechnic Institute. Another technical college founded in 1920 was The College for Conductors of Public Works, specializing in roads and bridges, forerunner of the Faculty of Civil Engineering. In 1937, the College for Technical Conductors, which had an excellent reputation within Romanian industry, was reorganized as The Electromechanical College. 
In 1947, the Cluj Mechanics Institute was founded, following a petition addressed to the Ministry of National Education regarding the foundation of a Polytechnic Institute with three faculties (civil engineering, electrical engineering and forestry) in Cluj-Napoca, under the provisions of the August 1948 law for the reform of education. The Mechanics Institute had a faculty with two departments: Thermotechnics and Machines. The increasing need of technical specialists helped the Mechanics Institute turn into the Cluj Polytechnic Institute in 1953. 
After the 1989 Revolution, Romanian higher education came back to the former tradition correlated to the Western system. In 1992 the Polytechnic Institute was renamed to the Technical University of Cluj-Napoca, and the three existing faculties at that time were restructured into seven faculties: Automation and Computer Science, Electronics and Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering ,Machine Building, Mechanical Engineering, Material Science and Engineering, as well as the Technical, Business and Administration College. Starting with the academic year 1998-1999 the structure of the Technical University was completed with the Faculty of Architecture and Urban Planning. 
Nowadays the Technical University of Cluj-Napoca trains specialists in the technical field (mechanical, electrical and civil engineering as well as architecture) through long and short term education programmes, postgraduate and PhD studies. It has over 12,000 students. 
Scientific research has been an essential preoccupation of the academic and research staff of the TUCN. The scientific potential of the University made it capable of organizing a series of outstanding scientific events attended by a large number of Romanian and foreign specialists. The practical results of the research activity are reflected in numerous contracts and projects with domestic and international financing. The most important projects are those with CNCSIS, ANSTI, and PNCDI as well as those financed by the European Union Commission: EUREKA, COPERNICUS, COST, PC5 and PC6. 
The University's correlation to European standards is reflected by the international conventions it is part of and by its participation in a wide range of European education programs: TEMPUS-PHARE, SOCRATES, ERASMUS, LEONARDO, CEEPUS.A series of international conventions, agreements and protocols were signed with universities from France, Italy, Germany, the USA, Austria etc. Since 2003 TUCN has been a member of the European Association of Universities. 
Nowadays the Technical University of Cluj-Napoca is a modern technical higher education institution, passing through a period of genuine rebirth and confirming authentic capabilities for scientific and technical creation.

E2L has two main objectives: - The design of new services using data from Earth observation satellites, - The development and transfer of CESBIO's methods and know-how. E2L designs services which are intended to be taken over by other operators. The staff mobilized by E2L and the expertise provided by CESBIO and other laboratories are the guarantees of a design at the best level of the state of the art. The laboratories derive a clear vision of the needs of the downstream sector and turn it into research questions. E2L performs the functions of expertise, development and transfer that CESBIO cannot assume alone and in all circumstances. E2L has the ability to mobilize complementary expertises in CESBIO, in France and abroad.

entityDescription:
Founded in 1995, Controlar has been growing and developing its business in a sustainable manner and adapted to the needs of its customers. We are a company dedicated to the development of industrial hardware and software, highly focused in the production of electrical components for the automotive industry, with a great know-how in industrial automation and development of functionality and quality test systems for electronic devices. The company is structured in 4 business areas, as follows: Test Systems: Covering all areas of electronic testing, from product validation to end-of-line testing, including in-system programming, functional testing, automatic optical inspection, reliability, stress and climatic validation, we develop equipment and software for the different levels of laboratory and production areas. Automation Systems: Dedicated to conceptualizing, project design and develop all the mechanical and automation aspects of test systems but also for product assembly, processes automation, robotics and complete lines system integration with the highest levels of precision and manufacture, giving our clients the safety and warranty of a robust, fast and economic solution. Solutions & Partners: To have the best value and quality in our systems and to better support our customers, we commercial represent and distribute equipment related to different automation areas. Aerospace & Defence: Benefiting from all the knowledge of testing and automation applied to the A&D industry to develop validation and certification systems for electronic, electric and electromechanical components.
Controlar's headquarters are in Portugal, but the group has presence in several countries around the world, like Spain, Mexico, Malaysia, Germany, India and USA.

entityDescription:
CryoVac Gesellschaft für Tieftemperaturtechnik mbH & Co. KG or Cryovac low temperature technologies respectivly, established in 1975 in Troisdorf near Cologne, Germany, is the leading supplier for customized cryogenic and low temperature vacuum systems for various research and industrial applications.

You can choose from a broad range of cryogenic equipment, open or closed cycle systems, sample in vacuum or exchange gas, small systems for your microscope or room size bath cryostat systems with days of operation time, or continuous flow for variable temperature operation.

All systems are custom and hand-made, all design, engineering, machining, brazing, welding is done in-house and allows us various options for customers and fast response to our your specifications, even during the manufacturing process.

Design and engineering of our systems is done in close cooperation with our customers, starting from the first idea and initial design, you will be part of the process, to ensure the best solution for your experiment or application.
You can either choose from a broad range of starting-designs,customizable to the very last detail or challenge us with your application problem and we will start from scratch.

Our products are sold world wide by our in-house Sales & Engineering department to ensure short communication paths. Experienced Physicists, designers and machinists will take care of your cryogenics equipement and understand what it takes to meet your application needs and to build a system based on your specifications.

Every system is tested in-house, together with the costumer if requested including a basic training of operations. Furthermore we will answer your questions and provide help after sales.

Our strengths at a glance:
 

 a high degree of customization
 customer specications define the design
 great number of designs to start from
 in-house manufacturing ensures best quality of all parts
 design adaptions even during manufacturing possible

Nowadays, as a result of nearly 40 years of building the widest range of cryogenic and vacuum components, Cryovac instruments and plants which are in operation in numerous laboratories across Europe have firmly established our reputation for high quality.

 

CryoVac's R&D department is ready to help you in solving your particular cryogenic problem, no matter if it is the dimensioning of a transfer line, the performing of a thermal study for an industrial plant, the designing of a turn-key automatic cryogenic measurement system or any other cryogenic / vacuum project.

 

From the beginning CryoVac's particular skill was the development and manufacturing of custom designed cryogenic and vacuum systems of highest quality and so will be in the future...

entityDescription:
OFMA is an Italian company that mainly works for the aerospace and defense fields. It has been founded in 1970 by Franco Olivero as a small mechanic's workshop, and now with the new Managing Director Alessandro Olivero, it has become a company of 27 employees in a headquarter of 6000 meters squared. OFMA designs, produces, assembles, and tests very high precision mechanical parts participating in different space programs as subcontractor.
OFMA can give its effort to the entire chain, from the design through the production, special processes, assembly, and quality testing. OFMA has realized structural parts for different programs, from the International Space Station with Harmony, Tranquillity, Cygnus, and Orion up to satellites for the Solar System like Cosmo Skymed, Bepi Colombo and the Galileo Constellation. OFMA also work for the aeronautics field producing and assembling flying parts for different aircraft and helicopters (e.g. A380, A320, EFA, M346, F7X, P180, C-27J, and many others).
OFMA well tested production chain ensure low costs, short times and high quality, which are key asset for every aerospace project.
The wide certified machining park which counts 15 milling machines without taking into account EDM and lathes and the agreement with its direct suppliers ensure OFMA the higher level of reliability. 
The air-conditioned CNCs allow OFMA to produce honey comb panels and working carbon fiber up to dimensions of (6000 x 3000 x 1500)mm, (236 x 118 x 59)inches. Due to its direct linked suppliers OFMA can provide to the Customer the final package including NDT, special processes and vibration tests.

entityDescription:
e-Novia is an “Enterprises Factory”, a unique business model, which streamlines and enables to scale a process to transform Research in Product, Researcher in Entrepreneur and Startup in Enterprises.
The Factory is made up of two distinct foundries: the “Innovation Foundry” and the “Start-up Foundry”. The former transforms intangible intellectual property, coming from the best Italian Universities and some of the most prestigious European Technical Universities, into inventions or tangible innovations. The latter transforms inventions into innovative enterprises or start-ups.
Our 120 (200 aggregated) top-notch digital scientists, innovation, business experts and designers have know-how in Sensing Technology (such as Computer Vision, Natural Language, Artificial Perception), reasoning technologies (such as Algorithms, Embedded AI in bounded conditions, Automation and Control, Multi Sensor Fusion, sustainable Machine Learning) and acting technologies (such as Robots-to-Human Interaction, Smart Actuators, Planning, Engagement and Decisioning).
As today we are seeing excellent progress across our portfolio that consist of interest in 30 start-ups, and strategic stakes in multi-sector platform businesses such as Smart Factory, Smart Transportation, Mobility as a Service and Med-Tech; when we happen to develop technology outside of this scope we pursue it through Joint Ventures with industry partners that have domain expertise in the matter.

entityDescription: Fraunhofer Austria is a non-profit extra-academic Austrian research organization. It is a fully-owned subsidiary of the German Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft. The key objective of the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft is to transform scientific expertise into applications of practical utility.

The Balcan Environment Center is a nonprofit organization with partners: the Regional Development Fund of Central Macedonia (RDF--RCM), the Regional Development Fund of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace (RDF--REMT), the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki (AUTH)(Research Committee), the Municipality of Lagadas, the Municipality of Delta and the Decentralized Administration of Macedonia and Thrace. 

The Balcan Environment Center , as a joint action and cooperation of five institutions with different features at the institutional level, invests to achieve a multiplier effect with regard to the dissemination of scientific knowledge and the operational implementation of this knowledge by Regional Administration and Local Government institutions aiming at environmental management and sustainable development. In particular, the catalytic role of the Center between AUTH, Regions and Local Government maximizes the benefits of cooperation of institutions during the integrated planning of joint actions and strategies for environmental management as well as during the implementation of these measures to their full operational capabilities and competitive advantages for each institution separately. 

This innovative approach to environmental issues with the catalytic role of the Balkan Environment Center brings mutual benefits to all partners of the Center (win-win situation) with positive results in social, economic and environmental level.

entityDescription:
LUNEX Stichting was founded in 2001 to promote space resarch and exploration.
LUNEX developed number of research programmes since 2003 in collaboration with universities (including Amsterdam, Leiden, TU Delft) and companies, and since 2019 research activities in applying AI to space data , in particular Earth Observations.
LUNEX joined in 2022 the EuroSpaceHub consortium with other universities (Vilnius, ISU, Madrid) and companies
to train space researchers and entrepreneurs.

We describe research and events highlights from ILEWG LUNEX EuroMoonMars Earth Space Innovation EMMESI academy, EuroSpaceHub partners contributing to MoonMars and space missions, Field Research, Astronautics and Entrepreneurship. Organisation of Conferences and Community Events: As per its terms of reference ILEWG LUNEX EMMESI has co-organised sessions (O) , workshops (W), field work cam paigns (F), committees meetings (C), community events (E), panels (P) and sessions (S) at International Conferences, and presented reports and talks (T) and Posters/Interactive presentations (IP) there, supported by students YLE Young Explorers grants (Y). Missions, Data, Instruments, Field Work, Astronauts: EuroMoonMars is an ILEWG programme [1-235] in collaboration with space agencies, academia, universities and re search institutions and industries. The programme includes research activities supporting Moon and Mars Missions for data analysis, instruments tests and development, field tests in MoonMars analogue, pilot projects, training and hands-on workshops, technical visits and outreach activities. Support for Moon, Mars and Space Missions. Data analysis, AI and Machine Learning for Space: we have developed with collaborators advanced analysis of space and astronomy data at EMMESI academy. Sample analysis: we analysed various samples including meteorites from Moon, Mars, asteroids, and analogue field samples from campaigns (Vulcano, Etna, Hawaii HI-SEAS) using spectrometry, hyperspectral imaging and Raman . LUNEX also participates in collaboration with TU Delft in the study of ice, minerals and organics mixture relevant for Moon, Mars and icy Moons. Payload development: we have developed a test bench for sample analysis and adapted an Hyperspectral camerafor telescopic observations . Space Photonics Labin collaboration with Fotonika Latvia, a shoebox module for extracting organics from icy Moons. LUNEX ExoGeoLab lander is currently adapted with shoebox instruments for supporting future missions . Cubesats for education, EarthMoonMars exploration: LUNEX EMMESI has initiated the development of universi ty education cubesats with the support of Leiden University, Delft TU, In Holland, ESA BIC.Field work and testing of instruments and protocols: EuroMoonMars field campaigns were organised in specific locations of technical, scientific and exploration interest. EuroMoonMars Analogue astronauts simulations have been organised since 2009 in collaboration with ESA, NASA, European and US universities a programme of data analysis, instrumentation tests, field work and analog missions for students and researchers in different locations worldwide, including Utah MDRS, IMA Hawaii HI-SEAs, Iceland, Etna/ Vulcano Italy, Atacama, AATC Poland, ESTEC Netherlands, Eifel Germany, etc… ExoSpaceHab Xpress (ESH-X) is an innovative portable lunar base simulator designed for education, analog missions and public outreach. This habitat has been funded by Euro pean consortium EuroSpaceHub and its partner LUNEX EuroMoonMars. ESH-X lab-hab module is used to test experiments and investigations for Artemis programme. Acknowledgments: We thank collaborators and partner institutions from EMMESI academy, EuroSpaceHub [235]: https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/search/q=euromoonmars%20or%20eurogeomars %20or%20ilewg

Oben srl is a young and innovative start-up company founded in 2010. Our team includes, experts in electronics, telecommunications, mechanics, aeronautics and archaeology, with long-standing competence acquired in the industrial R&D and academic domain. Our engineers design and realize a variety of UAVs (airship, n-copter and plane) representing a new, safe, cheap, versatile and sophisticated competitor of traditional air vehicles. UAVs can perform any kind of air work involving airborne sensors and devices, such as earth observation, remote sensing and measurement, photogrammetry, search and rescue, advertising, telecommunications, surveillance, today prerogative of manned aerial vehicles (helicopters, airplanes). 
Depending on specific customer requirements, we can design and realize UAVs appropriate for the task (e.g. regarding payload, range, size, speed, maneuverability, automatization, etc.) Moreover, Oben provides real-time- and post-processing of data, offering e.g. 2D and 3D (CAD) reconstructions of the observed scenario, as well as rendering with real images, accurate georeferencing, segmentation, automatic interpretation, object recognition, and customized processing also using learning systems, soft computing, statistical modelling, etc. Our final customers are Companies, Agencies, Research Centers, Universities, even individuals for small/occasional jobs. Oben is also an engineering enterprice operating in this sectors: 

Mechanical structure design
Thermal and efficiency solutions
Alternative energy
Domotics

Sensors and Automatic Control
Embedded systems
Computer Vision

The Carl von Ossietzky University of Oldenburg was founded in 1973, making it one of Germany‘s young universities. Its goal is to find answers to the major challenges society faces in the 21st century – through interdisciplinary, cuttingedge research.
The pathways on the Oldenburg campus are short: the University‘s academic staff and administrative staff work closely together, using an interdisciplinary approach. Many are integrated into special research areas, research groups and European clusters of excellence.
The University cooperates closely with more than 200 other universities worldwide and is also affiliated with non-university institutes in the areas of research, education, culture and business.
The University of Oldenburg is preparing over 13,700 students for professional life. It offers a broad range of disciplines, from language studies, cultural studies and the humanities to educational sciences, art and musicology, the economic and social sciences, mathematics, computer science, the natural sciences and the new medicine and health science programmes established in 2012.

Telespazio Ibérica (Spain) belongs to Telespazio Group, European leader in satellite technology services and geoinformation applications. The company, based in Madrid, currently counts on 150 employees distributed among its premises in Madrid, Barcelona, Vigo and Fuerteventura. Ownership: Telespazio SpA (100%). Telespazio SpA is a JointVenture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%).Our turnover in 2023 has been of 10,3M�.
Telespazio Ibérica, which was originally focused on Cartography production, Remote Sensing and Geographic Information Systems; currently develops its activities in Spain and Portugal through its Geo Information, SATCOM and Satellite Services Operations Lines of Business, playing an important role in E-GNSS User Services in all applications domains, both in EGNOS & Galileo, integrated in ESSP and Spaceopal Teams, both at Torrejón de Ardoz premises in Madrid.
A global approach to asset management from the geospatial point of view, allows Telespazio Ibérica to offer services covering the entire life cycle from the generation of the cartographic data using leading edge technology, to information systems development combining GIS with other corporate systems, telecommunications, and mobile devices.
We have become the centre of competence (CoC) of Telespazio Group since 2016 in the fields of cartography production, design and implementation of GIS, requirement analysis, processes definition and maintenance of the huge data volumes usually associated with complex corporate systems. From the Spanish headquarters of the company, all types of cartographic projects are addressed to Spain, other European Countries and other international destinations (especially in LATAM). Among the different projects that are produced from our CoC, the following should be highlighted: 3D urban cartography, satellite 2D cartography, Land Cover / Land Use (LCLU) and other thematic cartographies for European projects (outstanding role in COPERNICUS and in particular in Copernicus Land, Emergency and Security services), Rapid Mapping, Defence-MGCP cartography, remote sensing, etc.
Telespazio Ibérica addresses its portfolio to both public and private sectors, offering specific solutions to technology demanding markets such as Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications, Public administrations, Defence, Transport, Emergencies, Insurance or Banking sectors.

entityDescription: The Spanish National Research Council (CSIC) is the largest public institution dedicated to research in Spain and the third largest in Europe. Belonging to the Spanish Ministry of Economy and Competitiveness through the Secretary of State for Research, Development and Innovation, its main objective is to develop and promote research that will help bring about scientific and technological progress, and it is prepared to collaborate with Spanish and foreign entities in order to achieve this aim. According to its Statute (article 4), its mission is to foster, coordinate, develop and promote scientific and technological research, of a multidisciplinary nature, in order to contribute to advancing knowledge and economic, social and cultural development, as well as to train staff and advise public and private entities on this matter. CSIC plays an important role in scientific and technological policy, since it encompasses an area that takes in everything from basic research to the transfer of knowledge to the productive sector. Its research is driven by its centres and institutes, which are spread across all the autonomous regions, and its more than 15,000 staff, of whom ore than 3,000 are staff researchers and the same number again are doctors and scientists who are still training. CSIC has 6% of all the staff dedicated to Research and Development in Spain, and they generate approximately 20% of all scientific production in the country. It also manages a range of important facilities; the most complete and extensive network of specialist libraries, and also has joint research units. Its multidisciplinary and multisectorial nature means CSIC covers all fields of knowledge. Its activity, which covers everything from basic research to technological development, is organised around eight scientific-technical areas: Area 1. Humanities and Social Sciences Area 2. Biology and Biomedicine Area 3. Natural Resources Area 4. Agricultural Sciences Area 5. Physical Science and Technologies Area 6. Materials Science and Technology Area 7. Food Science and Technology Area 8. Chemical Science and Technology Its main functions are: Multidisciplinary scientific and technical research Scientific and technical advice Transfer of results to the business sector Contribution to creation of technologically-based companies Training of specialist staff Management of infrastructures and large facilities Promotion of the culture of Science Scientific representation of Spain at international level

entityDescription:
Launched in January 2001, Infoterra GmbH is a 100% owned subsidiary of EADS Astrium, Europe's leading satellite company. Infoterra GmbH was specifically founded to prepare and conduct the commercial exploitation of TerraSAR-X.
Infoterra GmbH was formed by spinning-off the 'Earth Observation Services' division of the former Astrium GmbH, Germany, and is part of the European Infoterra Group together with Infoterra Ltd. (former National Remote Sensing Centre Ltd. NRSC) in the United Kingdom. Together with the French Spot Image S.A., the Infoterra Group forms EADS Astrium´s Earth Observation Services Group.
Today, Infoterra GmbH´s staff of 25 serves and supports both, public and private customers with geo-information on cartography, land use / land cover, and forestry as well as - with a focus on GMES (Global Monitoring for Environment and Security) and thematic mapping services. Following the multi mission concept and based on a wide network of scientists, service providers, and end-users, Infoterra GmbH continuously develops new and ambitious processing procedures as well as products with improved information content. 
Through creation of the InfoTerra/TerraSAR initiative in the late 90's, the Infoterra GmbH team has established the foundation for the market-derived business development approach for innovative commercial Earth observation. In 2004, Infoterra GmbH has started marketing the exclusive commercial exploitation of TerraSAR-X. 
Infoterra GmbH supports the European GMES programme, which was initiated jointly by the European Space Agency (ESA) and the European Commission (EC). Infoterra understands this initiative as a major opportunity to provide operational geo-information services for the benefit of the environment and security.
Infoterra is ISO9001:2000 and ISO 14001 certified and guarantees that all work is completed according to internationally accepted quality and environmental standards.
Infoterra GmbH is a founding member of GEOkomm, a federation of the geo-information industry in Berlin/Brandenburg and is also represented in the German Association of Geo-Information Industries (Deutscher Dachverband der Geoinformationswirtschaft 'DDGI'). Using these platforms, Infoterra GmbH is able to support the definition of industrial standards.

entityDescription:
HISDESAT Servicios Estratégicos SA se fundó en 2001 como operador gubernamental de servicios satelitales, principalmente en los ámbitos de defensa, seguridad, inteligencia y asuntos exteriores. Desde 2005, la compañía proporciona comunicaciones satelitales seguras a organismos gubernamentales de diversos países. Este sistema de comunicaciones gubernamentales se basa en dos satélites geoestacionarios en operación (SpainSat, lanzado en 2006, y Xtar-Eur, lanzado en 2005) que ofrecen cobertura de comunicaciones en dos tercios de la Tierra. En 2019, Hisdesat inició el proceso de adquisición de la próxima generación de satélites (SPAINSAT-NG) mediante un contrato con el Ministerio de Defensa español.

Desde 2018, Hisdesat también ofrece servicios de observación de la Tierra a través de su satélite PAZ. PAZ utiliza un radar de apertura sintética (SAR) para capturar imágenes de la Tierra con fines gubernamentales y comerciales, además de otros sensores meteorológicos y de seguimiento de buques, lo que permite la cartografía de alta resolución de grandes áreas geográficas tanto de día como de noche. Estas imágenes de alta resolución se utilizan para operaciones militares, control fronterizo, inteligencia, monitoreo ambiental, protección de recursos naturales, planificación urbana y de infraestructuras, y seguimiento de catástrofes naturales. El satélite Paz opera en una constelación con los satélites SAR alemanes TerraSAR-X y TanDEM-X en la misma órbita.
Finalmente, HISDESAT ha participado en la creación de una constelación de satélites para información de tráfico marítimo (AIS).

entityDescription:
G.L. Electronic (SME) is a privately held Czech company operating in the space industry since 2008. We draw on professional experience gained in foreign companies engaged mainly in a production and an application for the space and ground technologies. G.L. Electronic has more than 13 years of experience with realization of assembly activities and providing technical support for the design of flight devices in many various international space projects, both with Czech and foreign partners. Company is focused on production of Hi-Rel electronic instruments and harnesses for aerospace technologies: procurement, design, assembly, integration and testing of cable harnesses and rework, modification, complete implementation of bonding and conformal coating on the PCBs (level EM, EQM, FM). The company performs the complete output quality control of these production processes as well. 
Testing: Electrical testing of cable harnesses (continuity test, isolation test and double-wire measuring), wire tension test, testing in the vacuum and climate chamber, endoscopic visual inspection, portable 3-channel laser meter of dust particles and microsectionning.
The implementation of the above mentioned activities is performed in clean room ISO8 (class 100 000) or in a laboratory - both with the continuous measurement of temperature and humidity. 
The team of the company consists of professionally ESA trained and certified technicians. The certification is according to the ESA-ECSS-Q-70 standards issued by the company Instituto Italiáno della Saldatura in Genova that is authorized to award the ESA certification. The company G.L.Electronic operates especially in the EU countries. 
G.L.Electronic uses the previous professional experience even in the field of industrial electronics focused on the production and nonstandard production applications.

entityDescription:
Hochschule Coburg is a public university financed by Bavarian State Ministry of Science and the Arts. As the English term “University of Applied Sciences and Arts” suggests, a Hochschule is characterized by practice-related teaching and research as well as a strong practical focus. Its educational philosophy is designed to enable its students to apply their theoretical knowledge and methodological know-how to solving concrete problems in their professional careers. During their studies the students at Coburg University are systematically trained to develop those skills. To make sure that students never lose sight of the practical relevance of what they are learning, both full-time and part-time faculty are required to have gained ample experience in leading positions of business and administration. 

Hochschule Coburg is registered on the Research Map of the German Rectors' Conference with the three research focuses: 1) One Health; 2) Smart Sensing, Automation and Analytics and 3) Sustainable mobility and energy concepts. The three research focuses illustrate the university’s research profile and demonstrate its specific expertise in addressing societal challenges. Researchers from different disciplines come together under the umbrella of a research focus to work on interdisciplinary issues.

Company description: National Institute of R&D for Optoelectronics - INOE (http://www.inoe.ro/en/) was established in 1996 and is involved in fundamental and applicative research in optoelectronics, analytical chemistry, and high pressure physics. INOE is a non-profit, independent research institute, under the coordination of the Romanian Ministry for Education. The Institute develops fundamental and applicative research in optoelectronics, analytical chemistry and mechanical engineering, well connected to the main scientific directions of the programs in the European Research Area and to the specific themes of the national research strategy. The institute's mission is to develop materials for optoelectronics and to engineer optoelectronic devices for nurturing them through to industrial applications, as well as to use innovative optoelectronics based techniques for the art restoration and for environmental monitoring/remediation domains. 

The current RDI activities are oriented to:
- Optoelectronic Engineering and Analytical Instrumentation Applications
- Optoelectronic Materials and Advanced Surface Processing
- Optoelectronic Techniques for Art Restoration
- Optoelectronics Techniques for Environment Assessment and Remediation
- Renewable source of energy 
- High pressure technologies 
 
The activities in the Institute are aiming to:
- stimulate the cooperation in research by collaboration with the universities and other higher degree institutions;
- develop the international collaboration, in EU and bilateral funded projects;
- strengthen the institutional capacity building by postgraduate education (MSc and PhD students included in the research teams), staff development, curriculum design, research and development;
- use the legal frame for an efficient know-how and technology transfer to public institutions and companies;
- increase the scientific output, widening their dissemination and promoting research valorization;
- upgrade the research facilities;
- create a stimulating and competitive environment, researcher-friendly by an up-dated management system.

Carbomap is a spin-out company from the University of Edinburgh's School of GeoSciences. We apply state-of-the-art science to the problem of measuring and mapping the world's forest carbon. 

The pioneering approach that we are leading is based on our patent Multi Spectral Canopy LiDAR (MSCL) that operates at four wavelengths, as opposed to the existing commercially available single wavelength LiDAR systems. entityDescription:
Moniteye are Structural Monitoring Equipment Providers supplying Engineering based Companies unique and specialist Monitoring instrumentation. For the past 6 years Moniteye has developed and deployed cutting edge remote structural monitoring systems in a variety of scenarios including road and rail infrastructure and domestic and commercial buildings. A varied product line has allowed Moniteye to provide accurate data on displacement, levelling and tilt movement to infrastructure managers in a variety of sectors. Utilising the latest in GPRS, GSM and SMS technology allows the recorded data to be transmitted wirelessly from site to our specially developed online gateway. Users can then access this data from
any web enabled device anywhere in the world.
Our areas of expertise include quick deployment of remote structural monitoring solutions on commercial structures and sensitive transport infrastructure assets. We have also worked closely with a number of clients to develop completely bespoke solutions. Our recent projects have included developing a bespoke monitoring instrument to measure the movement of the Thames Barrier to ascertain both the effectiveness of the Barrier's mechanism and the effect that boat strikes and wash have on the structure. Recently deployed 20 of our tilt devices to monitor the movement of a trackside embankment for Network Rail. By developing our tilt device¿s firmware we were able to provide an embankment fail alarm system that gives track controllers instant notification via SMS/e-mail should the device detect data that is indicative of imminent failure.

entityName: NATIONAL INSTITUTE FOR LASER, PLASMA AND RADITION PHYSICS
entityDescription:
The National Institute for Laser, Plasma & Radiation Physics (INFLPR) is an independent, national importance research institution established by the Government of Romania. INFLPR was founded in 1977, with the mission to advance the knowledge in several strategic areas of the sciences and technologies related to laser, plasma, and radiation physics. In 1996 INFLPR was reorganized to include the Institute of Space Sciences (ISS).

The institute employs 447 researchers and administrative staff to conduct frontier research ranging from basic photonic materials and high power lasers, nanomaterials and nanotechnologies, quantum dots and information technologies, plasma physics and X-ray microtomography to industrial photonics, biophotonics and plasma coatings. ISS branch conducts research on astrophysics, space engineering and gravitation

INFLPR is pursuing advanced scientific research funded by national and international agencies, private institutions and enterprises.

INFLPR is currently a member of the EURATOM association, a partner in the Extreme Light Infrastructure (ELI), partner in LASERLAB EUROPE, ALICE, and a leader in many projects funded by the EU, NATO, and other international organizations.

INFLPR's governing body is the Board of Trustees, which is assisted by the INFLPR Director and Board of Directors, and by a Scientific Advisory Board.

The Institute currently consists of six large research departments, the Center for Science Education and Training and ISS branch.

These microfluidic tools enable you to do your lab-on-a-chip experiments right now; they can be connected to standard lab equipment. entityDescription:
Sinergise was established in 2008 to develop enterprise-level solutions for managing spatial data, especially for support in land administration and agriculture processes. These are based on one of the first world-scale distributed GIS editing frameworks, Giselle, built in 2003 within company Cosylab (renowned company in the field of large experiments in physics, such as particle accelerators, fusion reactors, etc.), using its technology for distribution of millions of event data per second. In 2008 GIS business reached the sustainable level and Sinergise span-off from Cosylab to form an individual entity.
In 12 years of operations Sinergise built solutions for large governmental clients in Europe (United Kingdom, France, Slovenia, Croatia, Macedonia, Montenegro, Czech Republic, Azerbaijan, Moldova) and Africa (Nigeria, Ghana, Tanzania, Mauritius), almost all of them still being supported nowadays. Altogether there are more than 2 million people annually using Sinergise's tools and its technology helps to manage more than 50 million property records and more than 500 million EUR of transactions annually. 

Sinergise's disruptive technologies at present include:
•Geopedia - a cloud based crowd-sourcing GIS tool, used by more than 1 million users annually, which contributed more than 20.000 datasets combining more than 20 million records (http://www.geopedia.world).
•Spatial and temporal image archive developed to store TBs of satellite imagery and make it available to end-users in fast and efficient way in full resolution. 
•Sentinel Hub - Real-time visualisation of multi-spectral data supports building new earth-observation products, such as vegetation indices in a matter of seconds. 
•Near-real time processing chain for satellite imagery, which makes it possible to automatically improve quality of satellite data, e.g. positional accuracy, atmospheric corrections, radio-metric corrections, ortorectification, etc.
•2D and 3D mapping engine, which uses WebGL and HTML5 technologies to perform visualisation of spatial data in an efficient manner. 
A combination of these makes it possible for Sinergise to build web-based applications managing extremely large spatial datasets and accessed by tens of thousands of people at the same time.

entityDescription:
ARIESPACE is an SME established as the first spin-off company of the University of Naples Federico II. With over 15 years of experience in the fields of Remote Sensing and Geo-information solutions, we provide products, services and consultancy for monitoring agricultural and forest resources based on satellite data. ARIESPACE provides ready-to-use and user-friendly Decision Support Systems (DSS) based on satellite observations, geospatial data and biophysical models. We aim to feel the gap between currently geospatial availability tools and quantitative information needed to people working in the field. One of the main assets of ARIESPACE is the several institutional clients (Water user associations, regional Government) who uses Ariespace geo-solutions based on satellite data to solve their day-by-day managing issues.
ARIESPACE experience has been established in the context of several national (Rural Developing Program) and international projects funded by EU (H2020 COALA as Coordinator, H2020 Landsupport as WP leader of Web platform; H2020 DIANA as WP leader, H2020 Fatima as WP leader, FP7 Sirius as WP leader, FP7 Ceop Aegis, FP6 Pleiades, LIFE+ SoilConsWeb). 
Managerial capabilities: ARIESPACE is organised in four areas: Business development, R&D, Earth Observation and IT. An experienced Project Manager coordinates each project. ARIESPACE has a well-established quality management system, whose compliance with ISO standards (ISO 9001-2015) has been certified by Bureau Veritas. The managing capability has been demonstrated in the several success projects (both research and commercial) and the coordination of H2020 COALA project.
Technical capabilities: ARIESPACE innovative technologies and competitive advantages are based on the combination of competences developed in different international contexts. Collaborations and synergies with several research institutions (including University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna -BOKU, University of Castilla La Mancha, Spain, National Research Council and CREA, Italy, University of Naples Federico II, Italy, etc.) have allowed the acquisition and exchange of strong competences in the field of Earth Observation for the spatial analysis and monitoring of agro-forest systems and land resources. Since 2017, as follow up of EU funded project, we have designed and developed Irrisat�, the fist Italian and fully operational EO-based Decision Support System to provide farmers with crop growth information and irrigation advice, involving more than 2000 users in the Campania Region, Italy (about 10.000 plots). In this context, innovative approaches for detecting irrigated areas, irrigation water requirement and nitrogen uptake have been developed. Since 2015, ARIESPACE has expanded the commercial viability of Irrisat including operative services for Water User Association (WUA) and Institutions in charge of irrigation monitoring. The system has been evaluated as fully applicable from National Agricultural Ministry (ministerial decree 31.07.2015), and many Italian WUAs have adopted it for their water accounting tasks. That expertise is also exploited in the COALA project, which aims to export EU expertise in using Satellite data in Australia.

entityDescription: The Faculdade de Ciências (Ciências) is part of the Universidade de Lisboa (ULisboa), the largest and most prestigious Portuguese University, ranked among the best universities in the world in the area of Natural Sciences (173) according to the latest available QS World University Rankings. In the same ranking, Ciências is a top Portuguese faculty, covering a wide range of the key scientific areas and providing its students with high-quality infrastructures. These include 134 teaching laboratories and 184 research laboratories in its 10 departments and 19 research and development units (the majority of which are rated as Excellent). More than 5000 students, 300 academics and 900 researchers produced (2021) over 1100 scientific papers per year in indexed scientific journals, mostly Q1. Ciências has over 500 national and international research and development projects underway, including 3 ERC grants (Consolidator Grant and Starting Grant), 25 European Collaborative Grants and 4 Marie Curie Grants with an annual investment of around 40 million euros (2020), which together with more than 550 collaboration protocols with Portuguese and foreign institutions, public and private, allows Ciências to train highly qualified professionals. Ciências transfers knowledge and technology to society, hosting 35 Start-Up companies in its incubator (Tec Labs), many of which faculty spin offs. Ciências is followed by several thousand people through its social networks. Ciências interacts with public and private companies, regulatory and government entities and participates in living labs on several societal challenges. Over 70% of Ciências graduates take less than one year after graduation to find a job in the global market.

entityDescription:
Our Mission and Vision:
We are inspired by unleashing hidden possibilities embedded into location information. This is increasingly important in the world that wants to seek and know more and more.
We want to become a very special provider of location-based solutions in the Eastern Hemisphere for telecom, transport and infrastructure sectors.

Regio has four fields of activity: mapping, geospatial data, geographical information systems (GIS) and mobile positioning.

In GIS software development area our uniqueness is the ability to deliver software together with the data that is fit for the purpose. Our software development is based on Mapinfo, Oracle and proprietary web mapping tools. Our optimization solutions for transport and logistics business offer guaranteed ROI by combining software, data and consultancy together.

In geospatial data area Regio owns and maintains the most detailed geospatial database of Estonia and the Baltic States. The accuracy is up to 1:2 000 in urban and 1:20 000 in rural areas, including building addresses. Streets and roads are connected to logical network, attributed with turn restrictions and other relevant data for logistical analysis.
Regio runs the biggest internet map server in the Baltic States since 1997. In addition to selling access to our own data, Regio renders geospatial data processing services to our clients. Clients are mostly utilities and the public sector.

Mapping unit creates hundreds of maps on demand based on Regio´s own database. Majority of tourist publications, information boards, wall maps etc. feature cartographic products made by Regio. Regio publishes the best selling road atlases for Estonia. We are trained to make maps that are beautiful, readable and accurate at all scales and for all purposes.

The fourth area of activity is location-based services and mobile positioning middleware. Our unique company backround delivers everything needed for launching location-based services, including software, maps and support. entityName: THALES RESEARCH AND TECHNOLOGY FR.THALES SA
entityDescription:
THALES is a world leader group for electronics and a key player in numerous markets such as aerospace, space, ground transportation, digital identity and security, physical and cyber security and defence. Completed in 15 months, the acquisition of Gemalto by Thales for �4.8 billion creates a Group on a new scale and a global leader in digital identity and security employing 80,000 people in 68 different countries. 
The larger Thales will master all the technologies underpinning the critical decision chain for companies, organisations and governments, and will develop secure solutions to address the major challenges faced by our societies, such as unmanned air traffic management, data and network cybersecurity, airport security or financial transaction security.

Research and development (R&D) is at the core of the new Group, with its 3,000 researchers and 28,000 engineers dedicated to R&D. Thales has been developing state-of-the-art technologies to meet the most demanding requirements of customers around the world for decades. Today the Group has become a giant laboratory inventing the world of tomorrow, with a portfolio of 20,500 patents, of which more than 400 new ones were registered in 2018.

THALES participates with Thales Research & Technology France (TRT-fr) and cortAIx Labs, the main multidisciplinary research units of THALES, located on the Campus of Polytechnique in Palaiseau. Through its internal activities and scientific links with industries and universities, either in France or internationally, TRT and cortAIx are participating in the preparation of THALES industrial future in strategic R&D fields. In addition to R&D activities, TRT and cortAIx Labs also provide scientific and technical advice, expertise or services for the company. 
With more than 250 qualified personnel, 13,000 m2 of laboratory space including 1,700 m2 of clean rooms and grey rooms, TRT-France's teams conduct state-of-the-art research in cutting-edge fields such as optics and optoelectronics, quantum technologies for sensing and communication, electronic components for microwave applications, packaging, and materials. The scientific and technical competencies, ranging from materials development to modelling, processing and characterization of components, up to the integration in relevant demonstrators, are available on the site, and allow the complete validation of the technologies studied, before their transfer to the THALES Group's operational units.
CortAIx Labs is the newly created Thales integrated labs for Research, Technology and Innovation on AI for Mission Critical Systems. Located in Palaiseau, it brings together more than 160 researchers - experts, specialists, research engineers, PhD students - dedicated to both AI and a wide range of digital technologies such as cybersecurity, smart connectivity, engineering, computing architectures, quantum algorithmics and neuroscience.

entityDescription: AC2T research GmbH (limited company; non-profit) was established as “Austrian Center of Competence for Tribology” (AC2T) in 2002. Today, AC2T is one of the largest private R&D service providers in Tribology in the world. Main location is the “Technology and Research Center Wiener Neustadt” (Austria). More than 100 scientists are working at AC2T which cover the scientific fields of chemistry, physics, material science, electrical and mechanical engineering, mathematics, mechatronics as well information technology. Together with modern laboratory equipment customized solutions are elaborated ranging from concept (low TRL) to upscaling (high TRL). entityDescription:
The Hellenic Telecommunications Organisation S.A. (OTE) is a member of the Deutsche Telekom (DT) Group of Companies and is the incumbent telecommunications provider in Greece (acting both as network operator and as service provider). OTE is a full service telecommunication provider and in addition to local, long distance and international communications services, offers its customers a wide range of technologically advanced services. These include high-speed data communications, mobile telephony, internet access services, infrastructure provision, multimedia services, as well as traditional services, such as leased lines, maritime and satellite communications, telex and directories. OTE¿s vision is to rank among the largest telecommunications companies in Europe, and through its international investments (mainly in the area of South-Eastern Europe), now addresses a potential customer base of 60 million people, making OTE the largest telecommunications provider in SE Europe.
OTE¿s research effort is involved in almost all technological and infrastructural issues that pertain to OTE¿s operations, and is an active participant in many European and international collaborative projects. OTE¿s current research activities span a wide range of topics, including, inter alia, broadband technologies and services, next generation network architectures, infrastructure development etc., following to the actual challenges for the development of a fully competitive network infrastructure & a portfolio of innovative services/facilities. OTE¿s R&D Department (Labs & New Technologies Division) possesses four laboratories (Wireless/Satellite Communications Lab; Core Network Lab; Access Network Lab; Voice/VoIP/IMS Lab), all fully equipped with an immense variety of modern equipment, able to perform tests/trials and several validation processes, and thus to support modern research activities.  In addition, the above OTE's Dept. has a strong and continuous cooperation with the Research Programs Section, Fixed (RPSF) of the Network Evolution Department, Fixed & Mobile (OTE R&D Dept.)which is the corporate Functional Unit responsible for the wider OTE's involvement, supervision, management and participation to European, national and international research programs.

entityDescription: Fondazione ACROTEC is a no-profit foundation, born as a small business focused on applied research and technological transfer to the industrial market. The transformation in a Foundation, carried out according to article 2500 septies of Italian Civil Code, took effect on 1 7th July 201 7. Acrotec Foundation was created to respond to CIMA Foundation a needs of a strong and permanent technological partner. This mission is carried out through a close cooperation between computer engineers and scientists dealing with different fields of weather-related risks. Closeness with scientific research and the strategic collaboration with CIMA Research Foundation ensure high scientific level to all ACROTEC products. Software produced by Fondazione ACROTEC is the result of multidisciplinary experiences which then condense into IT systems for real time risk assessment. ACROTEC pours its 16-years experience in this field and similar systems produced for the Italian Civil Protection, Italian Space Agency and local disaster management authorities, for any project in which is involved. Actually, the company is working on a new open hardware project, namely The ACRONET Paradigm. It is a project originally developed within the “Integrated Systems” sector, but has soon involved personnel from other sectors. The Information System sector manages all task related with the ACRONETWORK infrastructure, a "Web GIS" platform compliant to the OGC standards and INSPIRE directive. It interconnects the user to the stations and provides access to recorded data. The project is also featured by a reliable infrastructure that allows to share and display data and information from the measuring stations pertaining the project. Since 2014, the company is also responsible for the design and development of the ICT platform for multi-risk assessment based on Earth Observation, within the FP7 RASOR project. Given its complementarity, ACRONET paradigm will particularly fit within the RASOR platform: successful integration Earth Observation and in situ data have been demonstrated. The Environmental Engineer sector is involved in the definition of the requirements of new Monitoring Systems and in the field-testing of the solutions before their publication.

entityDescription: The Poznań University of Life Sciences takes a leading position in rankings of universities of life sciences and biological sciences in Poland. A COMPREHENSIVE APPROACH TO EDUCATION is reflected in our care for a high level of specialisation in scientific disciplines. entityDescription: The EGI Foundation (also referred to as "EGI.eu") is a not-for-profit foundation established under Dutch law to coordinate and manage the EGI federation on behalf of its members: National Grid Initiatives (NGIs) and European International Research Organisations (EIROs).
