entityDescription: The primary purpose of the University of Urbino Carlo Bo is the promotion and organization of scientific research and higher education, the processing and transmission of scientific knowledge, the training of all staff, the cultural and professional preparation of students in the permanent and recurrent training, cultural innovation, science and technology in society, and (in forms specific to it) the development of the territory. In order to pursue this primary purpose, the University recognize as fundamental missions teaching, research and public service. The first mission is teaching, that is educating students from undergraduate to the most advanced graduate level. Through our academic programs we transmit knowledge and skills to undergraduate students, stimulate new interpretation and development of knowledge in graduate students, educate individuals for professional careers, provide them with the tools to continue intellectual development over the lifetime. The second mission is doing research by a staff of researchers well introduced in international activities with well provided laboratories, libraries, high-speed telematic networks. Hundreds of disciplines are present in our Departments, in the fields from Biology to Physics, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Social Sciences and Fine Arts, Literature and Foreign Language, Philosophy and Psychology, Mathematics and Informatics. The results of this strong research activities yield a lot of benefit to the University itself and to the industrial and cultural environment. The third mission is generally related to the public service: with an intensive program, agreed with regional stakeholders, the Urbino University disseminates research results and translate scientific discovery and technological application into practical knowledge, especially through industry partnerships, that benefit the Marche region and the Nation.

KRONO-SAFE develops and markets ASTERIOS, an integrated software tool-suite including an innovative real-time kernel (RTK) for safety-critical real-time embedded applications running on single- or multi-core hardware target platforms. 
KRONO-SAFE serves markets in need for a safer and more efficient solution to develop complex real-time embedded applications. These extend to both well-established markets such as aeronautics, space, defense, automotive, industrial automation, transportation, energy and new markets springing up where safety and security converge like the Industrial Internet of Things.
With a fifty-strong team of experts and a management staff of seasoned professionals, KRONO-SAFE is firmly focused on software development as a way of efficiently serving its customers. The company holds a portfolio of patents securing all its breakthrough solutions developed so far and is actively pursuing its innovation and patenting activities.

entityDescription: Omnisense is a privately owned micro-SME based near Cambridge, UK. The company has developed a versatile solution for high precision indoor and outdoor relative positioning, based around the ability to measure true time of arrival ranges between devices in unsynchronised radio sensor networks using COTS componentry. Our sophisticated Joint Timing and Location Engine can utilise all measurement inputs provided to it, which are based around both a 2.4 GHz and a UWB radio in the cluster relative positioning solution the company has developed. This is being targeted at key verticals we have identified in agriculture, maritime and construction, amongst others (including defence, mining, sport, healthcare). As well as the core location engine, system development has involved the development of full mobility mesh networking protocols, data management tools and a suite of APIs which make the business of providing applications to consume the positioning data easy for developers and integrators.

entityDescription:
One of the main causes of accidents both on the highway and in the mine is human error, often caused by fatigue resulting in drowsy driving, or sometimes poor driver behaviour. WOMBATT's mission is to eliminate fatigue as a cause of haul truck accidents in open pit mines, and to eliminate drowsy driving and poor driving behaviour as a cause of long distance truck and bus accidents on highways anywhere in the world, no matter how remote or inaccessible the route. 

By using the latest satellite and other communications methods, WOMBATT's skilled, locally recruited monitors can see all of the drivers all of the time, wherever they happen to be on the surface of the planet, Communicating in real time with drivers and fleet operations staff in their local language via two way communications satellites, WOMBATT monitors help keep drivers and those around them safe and alive, with a Spanish/English language fatigue monitoring centre in Lima, Peru, and an English/Afrikaans monitoring centre in South Africa.

As fatigue results from behavioural and organizational as well as physiological problems, WOMBATT conducts continuous, on site change management training, driver and supervisor training, and family training in the local communities in the local language. Fatigue training participants have full access to their own private page on the WOMBATT Online Training portal, where they can access all their own training materials as well as real time updated data on their sleep, fatigue and diet history.

Safe driving in the most remote and dangerous parts of the world requires real time monitoring by human beings, intervening immediately when things go wrong. Lives are saved by using the most advanced low cost satellite communications technologies that the Space industry and others can provide, combined with the best possible training at every level, delivered by world class fatigue, diet, sleep, human factors and change management professionals specifically for local people.

entityDescription:
Lockheed Martin UK – Strategic Systems is the single contractor providing specialist Waterfront In-Service Support to the Royal Navy. 
LMUK SS, as part of the ABL Alliance with AWE and Babcock, are responsible for the management of operations at the Royal Naval Armaments Depot Coulport (RNAD(C)).
LMUK SS are currently engaged in Lockheed Martin Space activity in the UK as part of the UK Spaceflight Programme on behalf of the UK Space Agency under 2 separate Grant Agreements. Agreement 1 is for a UK Launch Pathfinder Project. The Project creates an initial UK launch capability by performing a pathfinder launch of a small launch vehicle. Agreement 2 is for an Orbital Manoeuvring Vehicle (OMV) Upper Stage Pathfinder. The project performs the research and development (R&D), build, and flight demonstration of an OMV, a smart upper stage specifically tailored for deploying constellations of small spacecraft, to create a new UK small launch service capability unique to the commercial space sector.

entityDescription:
Competence and Innovation for the Way to Space!
DLR Space Operations is the central institution for spaceflight operations in Germany with locations in Cologne, Oberpfaffenhofen and Weilheim. This responsibility includes satellite missions for Earth observation, science and communication missions as well as for the exploration of the solar system and human spaceflight missions. Furthermore, astronauts are trained, space experiments are prepared and sounding rockets are developed and launched from sites around the world. Eventually, DLR works on new technologies, such as on-orbit-servicing in order to master even the most difficult space projects of the future.
In close cooperation with other DLR institutions and together with public and industrial partners, DLR Space Operations plays a major role for spaceflight in Europe. Here, groundbreaking space projects are realised and new ideas for spaceflight of tomorrow are developed. As a versatile interface between technology development, operations and utilisation, DLR Space Operations serves as an important venue for everyone involved in spaceflight and the general public. This is where groundbreaking projects are realised and new ideas for shaping the future of space flight are developed.

entityDescription:
TEKEVER was born from the idea that collective intelligence achieved through the sharing of knowledge anytime, anywhere and by everyone can improve society. Our teams want to push the limits by building technological products that will bring to reality what may seem impossible for most.

TEKEVER was incepted in 2001 and the Group's development strategy relies on competitive technology development, organic growth and having an international reach, operating in areas where innovative ICT and Aerospace products can make a significant impact on organizations activities and people's life. TEKEVER currently has subsidiaries in Europe, Asia, South and North America, focused on developing innovative technology, creating and distributing products, supporting partners and servicing customers around the world.
TEKEVER ASDS (Aeronautics, Space, Defence and Security) was created in 2008 as a spin-off of the TEKEVER Group, and serves as the Group incubator for innovative technologies for the aerospace, defence and security markets. The company develops technologies up to maturity levels consistent with the creation of new ASDS products or the spin-off for integration into existing product lines of other companies of the Group. TEKEVER ASDS is completely privately owned and counts on highly skilled, experienced and motivated staff. 95% of the staff has undergraduate (BSc) or graduate (MSc) and post graduate (PhD) degrees and their backgrounds cover different disciplines, from Mechanical and Electronics to Aerospace, Software and Industrial Engineering. 
TEKEVER ASDS current areas of activity include:
Manned and Unmanned Aeronautics
Drones can mean anything from simple toys up to large aircraft capable of detecting stranded survivors in the middle of the ocean. Unmanned aircraft will have their place in society, be it at filming, ferrying cargo, monitoring the environment, or transporting people. By applying Agile development methodologies, TEKEVER is making flexible aircraft capable of fulfilling multiple roles and of providing access to airspace to everyone.

Satellites
Achieving economies of scale in the world of satellites is quite a challenge: Bringing innovation, standardisation, mass reduction and quick development together into a single package is a difficult nut to crack. Grouping these packages into networks is another ballgame. TEKEVER is working on pushing Nano and Pico Satellites further to achieve these goals. Small is the new Big!

Launchers
Getting into space is tough! Gravity is a drag and anytime you want to leave you need to take everything you need to survive for as long as you’re there, with you. What if you could send things into space as easily as taking a flight from Lisbon to Tokyo? TEKEVER is working towards delivering launch capability at a fraction of the cost for small payloads.

TEKEVER currently has subsidiaries in Europe, Asia, South and North America, focused on developing innovative technology, creating and distributing products, supporting partners and servicing customers around the world.
TEKEVER ASDS (Aeronautics, Space, Defence and Security) was created in 2008 as a spin-off of the TEKEVER Group, and serves as the Group incubator for innovative technologies for the aerospace, defence and security markets. The company develops technologies up to maturity levels consistent with the creation of new ASDS products or the spin-off for integration into existing product lines of other companies of the Group. TEKEVER ASDS is completely privately owned and counts on highly skilled, experienced and motivated staff. 95% of the staff has undergraduate (BSc) or graduate (MSc) and post graduate (PhD) degrees and their backgrounds cover different disciplines, from Mechanical and Electronics to Aerospace, Software and Industrial Engineering. 
TEKEVER ASDS current areas of activity include:
Manned and Unmanned Aeronautics
Drones can mean anything from simple toys up to large aircraft capable of detecting stranded survivors in the middle of the ocean. Unmanned aircraft will have their place in society, be it at filming, ferrying cargo, monitoring the environment, or transporting people. By applying Agile development methodologies, TEKEVER is making flexible aircraft capable of fulfilling multiple roles and of providing access to airspace to everyone.

Satellites
Achieving economies of scale in the world of satellites is quite a challenge: Bringing innovation, standardisation, mass reduction and quick development together into a single package is a difficult nut to crack. Grouping these packages into networks is another ballgame. TEKEVER is working on pushing Nano and Pico Satellites further to achieve these goals. Small is the new Big!

Launchers
Getting into space is tough! Gravity is a drag and anytime you want to leave you need to take everything you need to survive for as long as you’re there, with you. What if you could send things into space as easily as taking a flight from Lisbon to Tokyo? TEKEVER is working towards delivering launch capability at a fraction of the cost for small payloads.

entityDescription:
G-HiTech is pioneering the Global Energy Supply System (G-ESS), representing an innovative approach to energy distribution. Unlike traditional, centralized grids, our mesh-grid is fully decentralized, connecting distributed production nodes - each equipped with solar panels, batteries, and standalone inverters - to create modular energy communities. This modular design significantly advances energy democratization, particularly beneficial for emerging economies due to its modularity and energy-sharing capabilities.

To operationalize the G-ESS grid, G-HiTech is developing "SOLARSTEG," a software solution designed to facilitate maintenance and enable comprehensive energy management by tracking energy production & consumption along with payment follow-up. SOLARSTEG integrates advanced satellite communication (SatCom) and global navigation satellite system (GNSS) technologies to further promote energy democratization, especially in remote areas and emerging economies.
G-HiTech's mission is to empower communities with innovative, sustainable, and economically viable energy solutions. We focus on overcoming the challenges of energy access and reliability, transforming lives, and promoting socio-economic growth in the most underserved regions.

entityDescription:
Satways Ltd. is a privately held organization founded in May 2006, based in Athens, Greece with annexes in Patras and Larissa and presence in Germany (Astrial GmbH). The company’s main activity is the development of integrated Geospatial Command and Control solutions for Security, Public Safety and Defense. Satways product line includes integrated solutions for the following vertical markets: 
● Incident and Dispatch Systems for First Responders 
● Border Surveillance and Coordination
● Critical Infrastructure Protection
● Civil Protection Solutions for Natural Hazards Prevention, Preparedness, Early Warning, Response & Recovery
● Smart Cities Coordination – Digital Twins
● Defense 
Satways’ flagship product is ENGAGE C3I software platform with a unique modular architecture that permits easy customization to meet exact user requirements, easily increase capabilities of deployed solutions by adding additional modules and everything is available through a single unified end-user interface. It can be installed in fixed and deployable command centers and can also be accessed in the field via mobile data terminals. Their common goal is to make efficient use of available resources, to provide effective decision support, to simplify operations, to provide a Common Operational Picture (COP), Situation Awareness and collaboration tools across organizations, to collect and disseminate data in the field and to coordinate response units and system users.
In addition, Satways is developing seismic and acoustic sensor based real time acquisition and analysis systems for various applications in the areas of geophysics, seismology and earthquake engineering, as well as in border security and defense. Innovation was always Satways competitive advantage. Its participation to EU (FP7, H2020, HEU and EDF) and nationally funded research activities, supported over the years Satways’ products development and the company’s growth.

entityDescription: ​Matt worked as an Engineer with the European Space Agency. He graduated from project PoSSUM Scientist-Astronaut program where his main focus was on pressurized suit operations, hypoxia, human performance in micro-g and high-g environment. He also graduated with Computer Science degree and studied Aerospace and Astronautics at Polish Air Force Academy. He is a bioastronautics researcher, private pilot, aerospace and software engineer, rescue diver and military combat medic (TCCC, ACLS). He helped ESA on Moon and Mars research with extraterrestrial habitats and Extravehicular Activities operations, 3D bioprinting, photosynthetic bioink, hydroponic and aquaponic plant cultivation, polarized light influence on time perception and human time architecture. Together with Lunares.space team he built a habitat in Poland. He was trusted to participate in three innovative analog missions. Matt received Copernicus Medal for creating foundations for Polish Human Spaceflight and building first Moon/Mars habitat in Europe. Currently he is writing HabitatOS an operating system for the extraterrestrial habitats. He also led a project management transformation for Polish Ministry of Interior's Center of Information Technology and helped more than hundred organizations with project management and software engineering as consultant and trainer.

entityDescription:
Algorithmica Srl (ALG) is an Italian research-oriented SME based in Rome, Italy. ALG is focused on robotics, cloud solutions, and entertainment applications with a particular interest on 3D reconstruction of real environments and virtual reality applications: ALG envisions autonomous robots as mobile sensors and the cloud as the enabling technology for building models out of the huge amount of data that robots collect. Starting from 2014, ALG’s investment in research and development has significantly grown: according to balance sheets, during the period 2014-2016, R&D investment has exceeded 60% of the overall costs and, in 2017, ALG has incremented it up to 80%. Leveraging on this effort it could become an “innovative SME” (Decree-Law 3/2015, known as “Investment Compact”, converted into Law 33/2015), thus enjoining the benefits the Italian Government proposed to support research and development activities of the high innovative Italian SMEs.
ALG past experiences include the participation to two FP7 EU projects: Cloud-TM, “A Novel Programming Language for the Cloud”(http://www.cloudtm.eu/), and ROVINA, “Robots for Exploration, Digital Preservation and Visualization of Archeological Sites” (http://www.rovina-project.eu/). ALG is currently involved in the HORIZON 2020 EU project INTCATCH, aiming at applying innovative approaches to the water monitoring (http://intcatch.eu/).

entityDescription:
The Federal Railway Authority (Eisenbahn-Bundesamt - EBA) is the German supervisory, licensing and safety authority for railways and railway undertakings.
EBA is an independent German higher federal authority and is part of the Federal Transport Administration. It is subject to supervisory and legal control by the Federal Ministry of Transport and Digital Infrastructure.
Over 2/3 of all railway undertakings in Germany are subject to supervision by the Federal Railway Authority.
The numerous functions of the Federal Railway Authority include plan approval for facilities of the federal railways, the authorization of rolling stock and railway infrastructure, and the granting of funds that the Federal Government has made available in the rail transport sector. 
In 2015 EBA has become a Federal Scientific Institution.
In addition, the Federal Railway Authority enforces passengers’ rights.

InTheCyber, est. 2008, has ten years’ experience in auditing and consulting for Cyber Defense.
We work under 2 perspectives: the Offensive approach and the Defensive approach.
With the Offensive approach (Red team), we verify the real effectiveness of the Defense measures and technologies adopted to protect corporates’ and institutions’ infrastructures from Cyber Threat. This means performing a series of simulations of attacks in order to challenge networks, systems, applications, people of the selected target, individuating weakness points and exploiting them.
With the Defensive approach (Blue Team), we cooperate with the Customer team towards the full establishment of a continuous presidium of the Cyber Security. This goes through procedural and technical auditing, hardening projects, advanced threat early detection, education and technology scouting. Moreover we provide full Manged Detection & Response Service in order to intercept and block residual Attacks.
The White Team is dedicated in auditing & consulting towards Cyber Security Governance.A particular attention is held in this period to the national and international laws on Data & Assets Protection, European GDPR and NIS.

entityDescription:
The Geological Survey of Sweden – SGU – is the expert agency for issues relating to bedrock, soil and groundwater in Sweden.
One key task is to meet society's need for geological information but SGU is also responsible for the Good-Quality Groundwater objective, which also involves reducing the use of natural gravel.
Important tasks are:
Supporting the development of the mining, rock and mineral industry
Promoting the use of geological information in societal planning
Uniting and strengthening geological research in Sweden
Bringing geology and geological knowledge to the fore in social debate and in schools
In addition, the Swedish Mining Inspectorate is a separate decision-making body within SGU. It is responsible for issuing permits for minerals exploration and extraction under the Swedish Minerals Act (1991:45). SGU currently has around 280 employees, with the majority being stationed in Uppsala. Others are stationed at our regional offices in Gothenburg, Lund, Stockholm, Malå, and Luleå (Mining Inspectorate). Our annual turnover is around SEK 340 million.

entityDescription:
The aim of the HERADO group company is to transforming the way that the facilities manage the radiation monitoring programs.
HERADO company provide complete radiation dosimetry services, including the research, development, distribution and collection of various types of radiation detection monitors and the analysis and reporting of exposure findings.

With our dosimeters in your faculty you can increase dosimetry compliance with very low dose limits, small size and weight and long battery life time. 

The ALMAR detector is accepted to be upload on EM-1 mission on Moon with Orion vehicle of NASA. 
Applications 
Space Applications
This technology could become a novel part of radiation protection strategy for astronauts, broadening the spectrum and depth of current radiation exposure assessment and improving risk assessment. This could lead to improved/tailored radiation protection for individual astronauts or as a collective. More importantly it provides the means to make (quasi-) instant decisions based on the radiation environment at any moment in time. Furthermore, looking ahead to future exploration missions outside of low Earth orbit, this type of technology provides an accurately monitor astronaut exposure during a mission and possibly make adaptations to protocols for radiation protection. 

Earth Applications

This type of technology has application on Earth in the monitoring of personnel involved in areas where radiation can be a significant factor, such as medical, military, in the nuclear power industry, or in high altitude professions. This technology could also find application for monitoring in areas on Earth with naturally high levels of background radiation (e.g mines).

entityName: Consorzio Italiano per il Telerilevamento dell'Ambiente e dell'Agricoltura
entityDescription:
Consorzio ITA was established 1978 to develop the application of remote sensing applied to agriculture statistics. Actually the members of the Consortium are: ENVICAST S.r.L. and Cooprogetti soc. coop.. Since 1978 ITA has developed technologies and know-how in various sectors of statistics applications to agriculture, mainly in area sampling frame, ground surveys and quality assurance and control dedicated to the production of agriculture statistics. ITA is a leader in the production of agricultural and woodland statistics, both through joint processing of ground truth data and of remote sensing images and farmer interviews. It also has extensive experience in different environmental ground phenomena modeling and in the production of thematic maps.
It develops and implements geographic information systems to manage the graphic and alphanumerical data related to environmental projects.
Since 1992 ITA is involved in the IACS for the remote sensing application and in this sector has developed the EUROPAC software for managing geographical and alfa-numerical data related to agricultural parcel control using GIS and satellite images.
Several EU projects were carried out by Consorzio ITA including: rapid estimates (MiniSites), agricultural statistics (Regional inventories, Lucas 2001 and 2003), olive trees statistics (Oli stat, Oli area) .

entityDescription:
GEO University is a registered Estonian company in Tallinn.
The name stands for: GIS (Geographical Information Systems) and Earth Observation (GEO). Beside being incorporated, GEO University consists of a group of professionals and experts in their corresponding fields. We are dedicated to create and deliver our knowledge and solutions to students, professionals, decision makers and scientists who want to introduce or enhance their knowledge in these fields or even get a solution to their geospatial problem.
Our team of professionals and experts will guide you through the following topics:

1. Geographical Information System (GIS)
2. WebGIS
3. Remote Sensing/Earth Observation
4. Photogrammetry
5. LiDAR
6. Satellite Cloud Processing
7. R and Python programming
8. Data visualization

We are constantly adding new courses and new fields of expertise. Our courses vary from simple note collections, books (for people who have constrained time to study) to complete lectures with exercises, quizzes (for people who are willing to dive into and extract the maximum value from the course).
Our courses are not only basic the theoretical principles of each field, but we also create tutorial courses for specific open-source and commercial software. We constantly add and update courses so you get the best of experience!
To maximize our student learning experience we are partnering with cloud service providers, Earth Observation adding value companies, GIS experts and many more.

entityDescription:
MEDeus is a company that focuses on providing services to healthcare organisations. This includes the delivery of medical payloads using autonomous UAV's (drones), data collection and management as well as consultation services regarding said data. 
Within the UK, as a developed nation, our focus is to increase the health intelligence of our rural communities. Public Health England has reported that we simply do not know enough about our rural population's health. With more than 11 million rural residents in the UK, a significant proportion of our citizens would benefit from the data analysis performed by our service. Moreover, the data we collect can be used by both research institutions and governments alike to allow better targeted resource allocation. We aim to perform big data analysis on the data we collect from patients to produce disease models and predictive algorithms that can monitor and determine when and how diseases spread and even stopping a deadly outbreak before it even happens. Patients would also benefit from increased autonomy over their health information which would lead to better education and understanding of their condition, thus reducing pressures on hospitals and primary care services within the NHS as patients take greater control over their health. Clinicians can benefit from a more modern way of treating and managing patients at a distance using our data service in conjunction with our drone service. The potential for telemedicine to connect those isolated and remote practices within the United Kingdom is greater than we realise. 
Further to this, our unique and clever method of data collection would be of enormous benefit to developing nations whose populations suffer from a chronic lack of access to healthcare. Our service can collect data that would otherwise never be utilised. We could manage large quantities of gold standard, real-time data to produce the best predictive algorithms possible in order to control a range of infectious diseases that are otherwise unstoppable. This not only saves lives by preventing outbreaks in developing nations but also has downstream positive effects on developed nations by reducing the risk of such infectious diseases being transmitted through borders.

entityDescription: About the Institute Our cosmic home is the main focus of the scientific research performed in the Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research (MPS): the solar system with its planets and moons, its comets and asteroids, and of course with the Sun. The researchers develop and build scientific instruments for investigating these bodies in cooperation with engineers who are highly qualified and experienced specialists. The instruments are mainly used in outer space, which is made possible through the institute’s collaboration in numerous missions of international space agencies such as ESA and NASA. The data analysis and interpretation is complemented by theoretical models and simulations. The Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research succeeded the Max Planck Institute for Aeronomy in 2004 by a simple name change. The institute was founded in 1957 in Katlenburg-Lindau. Recently, the institute's location was moved to Göttingen. The institute's new home can be found close to the Northern Campus of the University of Göttingen. The institute is organized in three scientific departments.

entityDescription:
Integrated Fiber Optics specializes on R&D and small batch production of fiber optics components for fiber lasers and special components of fibers. Main activities are: Components of fibers (for fiber lasers, telecommunications, measure instruments and special components of fibers); Integration and combination of fiber lasers; Optical frequency converters for fiber lasers; Designing of fiber amplifiers (LMA, PCF, CCC fiber based) and their integration into the laser systems of high power and pulse energy; Ultra precise CNC micro machining, micro bounding-assembling and laser micro-spot welding. 
Integrated Fiber Optics in collaboration with Center for Physical Sciences & Technology developed and offers patented ultra-short optical pulse fiber generator-oscillator based on novel patented optical pulse fiber generator technology. Main advantages provided by this technology are high stability of laser parameters, high reliability and long life-time without need for maintenance. These properties are particularly attractive for industrial applications, which is ideal for fiber MOPA (master oscillator power amplifier) seeding and industrial application where reliability, durability and long life-time are essential. Generator does not contain any critical components such as SESAM and so its life-time mainly depends on life-time of a pump diode laser. Generator can operate under normal, zero and anomalous dispersion conditions. Moreover, our developed technology is very flexible and allows achieving of different pulse parameters which could be required for specific customer applications. Ultra-short optical pulse fiber generator-oscillator is protected under Japan patent JP6276471 (B2), United States patent US10038297B2 and Republic of Lithuania patent LT6261 (B), also published as applications CN106575849 (A), EP3178137 (A1), WO2016020188 (A1).
The company also develops highly stable fiber optic components whose characteristics are practically unaffected by temperature changes (insertion losses due to temperature changes of 30 dB).

entityDescription: History of TUKE The Technical University of Košice was founded in 1952, but its roots must be sought much deeper in the past. As early as 1657 the Universitas Cassoviensis was established in Košice, but technical education in Slovakia was only elevated to higher - education level in 1762, when the Austro-Hungarian monarch Maria Theresa established the Mining Academy in Banská Štiavnica. This provided education and promoted research activity in a group of scientific disciplines ranging from ore mining through to production and processing of metal materials. The origins of higher technical education in Košice reach back to 1937, when the M.R.Štefánik State Technical College was established in the city. Teaching was supposed to start in the academic year 1938/39, but the pre-war events following the Vienna Arbitration caused the college to be moved first to Prešov, then to Martin and finally to Bratislava, where it remained and later formed the basis for the Slovak Technical University in Bratislava. The true birth of the Košice Technical College came on 8th July 1952, when the Czechoslovak Government issued Directive No.30/1952 Statutes setting up three faculties, namely the Faculties of Heavy Engineering, Mining and Metallurgy. These were joined in 1969 by the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and in 1978 by the Faculty of Civil Engineering. The important event of the renaming of the College into the Technical University of Košice occurred on 13th February 1991. In 1992 the Faculty of Professional Studies was set up in Prešov, which was transformed in 1996 into today’s Faculty of Manufacturing Technologies. The year 1992 also saw the introduction of the Faculty of Economics, which meant that the University outgrew its original framework of purely technical disciplines, and it continued in this trend in 1998 with the founding of the present-day Faculty of Arts. The Faculty of Aeronautics of the Technical University of Košice was established on 1st January 2005 as a successor of the Air Force Academy of Milan Rastislav Štefánik in Košice, which has been a prestigious educational institution in Europe and in the world providing university education for pilots and air operating personnel for over 30 years. Vision The Technical University of Košice will be: - a leading university of technology on a national basis and - a respected university of technology on the international scale, - having a strong degree of autonomy, - sufficiently diversified financial resources, - available for a wide range of applicants, - developing scientific knowledge based on its own original findings, - providing excellent education on all three levels of tertiary education, as well as - lifelong education, - meeting the expected needs of industries, region and society by its research, - substantially involved in providing services to general public. Mission TUKE will provide its environment with scientific and technological knowledge basis, innovation and workforce, in order to form beneficial and sustainable future and high quality of life. This will be achieved at TUKE by innovative research and excellent education in all scientific branches of respective University Faculties. TUKE today TUKE caters for a wide range of educational needs not only in the East-Slovak region, but throughout Slovakia and Central Europe, as in many specializations it is the only centre of education and research in this area. TUKE closely co-operates with other universities and with industrial organizations throughout the region and the Slovak Republic. In recent years there has been considerable increase in demand fromforeign students to study, whereby TUKE has been established on international scale as a distinguished education institution.

entityDescription:
SignalGeneriX is a privately owned innovative Cypriot Research and Development SME operating in the field of Digital Signal Processing and Communications. The company is based in Limassol and operates as expert provider of innovative digital technologies realised both in hardware and software for a wide network of clients and collaborators throughout Europe. The company’s diversified portfolio of innovative commercial products and intellectual property is being creatively utilised to develop beyond-the-state-of-the-art solutions for a wide range of industries. SignalGeneriX is successfully working with consortiums including leading international companies and SMEs, and has established a solid reputation for providing breakthrough thinking, leading to innovative solutions for various sectors. SignalGeneriX will utilise its 16 years’ experience in National and EU Research and Development projects for the successful implementation of the project. Since 2005, the company has successfully completed various FP6, FP7, H2020 and National projects with total budget exceeding 150M euros. 
SignalGeneriX, work has been acknowledged with various prestigious National and International innovation awards: Best SME company in Cyprus for 2020. InBusiness Awards 2020. European Satellite Navigation Award, European Space Agency, 2017. Entrepreneur of the Year Award, National Champion, European Business Awards 2016/17. National Champion in Innovation, European Business Awards 2014 and 2015. Cyprus Engineering Award, Cyprus Scientific and Technical Chamber (ΕΤΕΚ), 2015. Lloyds List Global Innovation Award for best technologies for the Maritime Industry 2014. Cyprus Quality Leader of the Year Award, Cyprus Association for Quality, OEB, 2014. ‘Manolis Christofides’ Award for contribution to Cyprus Science & Entrepreneurship, 2014. Cyprus Innovation Award, OEB, The Ministry of Commerce Industry & Tourism, 2013. EUREKA-label from EU as recognition of substantial innovation in R&D, 2012.

The company is operating according to its Quality Management System which is certified with the ISO 27001:2013 standard for Information Security Management and ISO 9001:2015 standard for Quality Management. it is also certified with SECRET UE/EU SECRET Facility clearance. 
Description of significant infrastructure & major technical equipment
The company has established the following research laboratories which support its R&D operations: 1) DSP Laboratory, 2) Wireless Sensor Laboratory, 3) Software Development Laboratory, 4) Electronics Laboratory, 5) Hardware Design Laboratory, 6) Electronic Assembly & Re-works Laboratory, 7) Product Design & 3D Printing Laboratory, 8) Mechanical Prototyping Laboratory.

About Us
Ignys helps two key types of business:
1) Start-ups and businesses with early-stage ideas looking to turn their electronics ideas into volume manufacturable products in a reliable, cost effective and commercially viable way, drawing on almost two decades of product development success.
2) Established businesses wanting to review electronics products to reduce costs, delay obsolescence and meet changing standards requirements.

What Does Ignys Do?
Whatever stage of product development, from idea creation to ensuring products are manufacturable, Ignys has the skills, knowledge, network and experience to move you forward, taking your idea through to manufacture and sales. Alternatively, that may be helping you understand that there isn’t a viable product within your idea. Of course, the former is preferable, but the latter should happen as quickly as possible if it is the case.

As an electronics design consultancy, it is our job to help:

By determining whether your idea is viable
Develop the most cost effective electronics design
by advising on the casing, where needed
Identify the best production sources, including component parts
by identifying where cost savings can be made
Replace obsolete components, including design changes where needed
At Ignys, we work with you throughout the life of your electronics products. Product lifecycles can be long, or short. It will be determined by customer demand and by costs. We help with both.

Whatever stage of product development, from idea creation to ensuring products are manufacturable, Ignys has the skills, knowledge, network and experience to move you forward, taking your idea through to manufacture and sales. As an electronics design consultancy, it is our job to help:

By determining whether your idea is viable
Develop the most cost effective electronics design
by advising on the casing, where needed
Identify the best production sources, including component parts
by identifying where cost savings can be made
Replace obsolete components, including design changes where needed
At Ignys, we work with you throughout the life of your electronics products. Product lifecycles can be long, or short. It will be determined by customer demand and by costs. We help with both.

entityDescription:
Cineon Training was founded in 2016 by a consortium of academics, nuclear industry consultants and media production experts. Consultants from the UK Nuclear Industry identified a need for more effective Human Performance training within nuclear and other sectors. Cineon Training is a collaboration between the University of Exeter and Cineon Productions ltd.

The overall aim of this collaboration has been to augment and enhance immersive human factors training content, developed by Cineon Training, with the research findings from Dr Vine’s team at the University of Exeter.

Using Virtual Reality simulation, in conjunction with more traditional methods, we aim to improve the training of techniques and principles of human factors that are critical for success (risk management, dealing with pressure, team-work, communication).

We utilise an ‘Evidence Based’ approach to the production and application of training content which is a departure from the traditional training techniques deployed by high-risk industries. This approach, which has already been adopted by the aviation industry, is considered more effective due to the fact that it makes use of up to date research and novel training techniques.

entityDescription:
Konstantin Preslavsky University of Shumen has inherited a centuries-long educational tradition dating back to the famous Pliska and Preslav Literary School (10th c) and going on through the ages in Shumen intellectual life.
Shumen University is one of the five classical public universities in Bulgaria it is recognized as a leading university that offers modern facilities for education, scientific researches and creative work. The University continues and enriches the mission of the Higher Educational Course, started 80 years ago, on the basis of which in 1964 a Faculty, as a branch of Sofia University, was founded. In 1971 it became a separate higher school with three basic faculties – philological, natural sciences and educational. At present Konstantin Preslavsky University of Shumen has seven structural educational units (five faculties, a college in the town of Dobrich and In-Service Teacher Training Department in Varna). These units cover the main fields of the classical university science in the humanities, natural, mathematical and technical sciences and education. Students’ education is based on curricula and syllabi for the educational qualification degrees vocational bachelor, bachelor and master in correspondence with the state regulatory documents.The Postgraduate Education and Qualification Centre at the University provides the necessary conditions for retraining and higher qualification of specialists having graduated from colleges and higher education institutions. Faculties provide education which allows for bachelors and masters, having shown skills and abilities to conduct research, to continue their education in full-time and part-time doctoral courses for acquiring the educational and academic degree doctor.

Over 7000 full –time and part – time students at Konstantin Preslavsky University of Shumen study in Bachelor and Master Degree Programmes offered by the Faculty of Humanities, the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Sciences, the Faculty of Natural Sciences, the Faculty of Technical Sciences, the Faculty of Education, the College in the town of Dobrich, and the Deaprtment in Varna. The educational process is based on curricula and syllabi that ensure successful professional development and flexibility in various and dynamic labor environment for the future University alumni

The academic staff within the University consists of about 400 lecturers. There are 44 professors and 151 associate professors; 30 Doctors Habil and 220 PhDs. The University is attractive for distinguished visitng professors from other Bulgarian and foreign partner universities.

The University academic staff has contributed significantly to various branches of science and has participated in a number of international educational and scientific projects. The University offers different facilities and it has at its disposal many laboratories, educational studios and scientific centres where the academic staff conducts fundamental and applied research and creative work. The research work is focused on the following scientific fields: Old Bulgarian Studies, Theory and History of the Bulgarian Language, Applied Linguistics, Theory and History of Bulgarian Literature, Theological Studies, Bulgarian Christian Art, History of Bulgaria, General History, Banach’s Algebras, Theory of Groups, Coding, Functional Analysis, Organic and Non-Organic Synthesis, Agrochemistry, Physics of Aerosols, Astrophysics, Physics of the Plasma, Crystal Optics, Ecology, Microbiology, Phosphorus Organic Chemistry, Element Organic Chemistry, Coordination Chemistry, etc.

entityDescription:
Unifly’s Unmanned Traffic Management (UTM) platform connects official entities with operators to integrate drones into the airspace safely and securely. 
The brainchild of experienced air traffic controllers and pilots, Unifly offers a wide range of solutions to support aviation stakeholders as well as drone operators.
The Unifly UTM system provides a comprehensive feature set for both authorities and drone operators. Authorities can visualize and manage drone flights and define no-drone zones enabling dynamic drone flight and airspace management including real-time drone surveillance and tracking.
In line with European initiative U-space that aims to make denser traffic of automated drone operations possible, Unifly’s technology includes flight planning, airspace approval, live tracking and dynamic situational awareness. Besides the integration of real-time drone tracking, the Unifly Unmanned Traffic Management system successfully tackles the challenge of handling the complex and dynamic European regulatory framework. This is characterized by fragmentation on both national and local level. The multilingual user interface provided by the Unifly solution is essential for maximizing the user-friendliness and user acceptance.

entityDescription:
Big Boy Systems is a startup active in the audiovisual innovation domain. We have developed and patented a camera that can copy human experience. Our camera records a unique video-format that we named "Immersive Reality" to show proximity with Virtual Reality and to highlight the immersive power of the format. Often referred to as the GoPro of Virtual reality, the camera is worn on the forehead and records everything the user sees in 3D-stereoscopy, and everything he hears with binaural sound. The content recorded is highly immersive and gives the spectator the feeling of incarnating the user of the camera through his experience. The content is best watched in 3D with virtual reality headsets and headphones or earphones for a full immersion in the vision and hearing of the user of the camera, but can also be seen in 2D on any regular screen. 
Our immersive video format allows for an enhanced retention of information for our spectators as it "teleports" them into the real-life experience of the user of the camera. This is why we are developing a B2B rental service of our camera for entities in need of a trustworthy format for the transferring and teaching of concrete information. Be it for medical education, practical training or tutorials, recording of classes and conferences,... But our format also raised interest in the cultural/entertainment environment with the recording of musical events, theatre plays, sporting events, museums and exhibits, travel promotion and many more.

entityDescription:
Muzeiko EOOD /Ltd./ and Muzeiko Foundation (ESA Entity Code: 1000 031 168) are related legal persons, as the Founder and Executive Director of Muzeiko Foundation is also the Executive Director of Muzeiko EOOD /ltd./. Also, the staff of the Foundation works part-time with Muzeiko Ltd. Thereby, despite the fact that the seat of the Foundation is at 6 Malyovitsa Str., the Executive Director and staff work at the registered address of Muzeiko Ltd. 
Furthermore, the projects and programmes initiated and implemented by Muzeiko Foundation are often piloted in the Children's Science Centre which is operated and owned by Muzeiko Ltd., as one of the goals of the Foundation is to „design, organize and perform programs and activities in order to achieve the scopes of the Children’s Science Center Muzeiko”.
In addition, Muzeiko Foundation is granted gratuitous use of a building at 8 Kliment Ohridski blvd., where its educational hub is housed.
Although the administrative address of the Children's Science Centre owned by Muzeiko Ltd. (at 3 Prof. Boyan Kamenov Str.) and the address of the educational hub (8 Kliment Ohridski blvd.) are different, practically they are two buildings located on the premises of Muzeiko's compound very close to one another (the approximate distance is 10-20 metres). 
To postal services and couriers and GPS locators, the two buildings are found at the same address.
Therefore, in Muzeiko Foundation’s registration we have pointed out that the correspondence address is at 3 Prof. Boyan Kamenov Str.

The company was registered to perform activities related to the construction and the management of a children's museum "Muzeiko", rendering of educational and consulting services; informative and publishing activities; expert support; technical assistance and communication; organising and conducting events with cultural and educational content; collection of entrance fee (through tickets sale, annual cards, etc.) for visiting sites, exhibitions and events, organising conducting of educational events, incl. school visits, school care programmes, English language and training, children's parties and workshops, adult science events, science festivals, management of gifts and souvenirs shop; production and dissemination of literature, manuals, didactic materials related to science and pedagogy.
Muzeiko specialises in science communication for children and adults, non-formal and informal learning. Its LEED-certified facility accommodates various research, training and dissemination activities, attracting approx.110,000 visitors per year. The organisation works in a specific social and geographical context with more than 40% of the population at risk of poverty or social exclusion and on major roads of migration. Muzeiko ltd. enjoys good relationship with central and local state authorities, academia, civil and corporate sector in Bulgaria.

entityDescription:
Museon (Stichting Museum voor het Onderwijs)
As an interactive museum for culture and science it is Museon’s ambition to inspire people to discover the world around them and educate themselves. It is also our mission to encourage people to treat the earth with respect. Museon seeks to realise its ambitions by offering visitors a dynamic and museological learning environment covering both existing and future topics. Our main target groups are families and schools. The museum welcomes around 200.000 visitors yearly.
In line with our carefully selected themes Museon is responsible for developing interesting exhibitions, teaching programmes, activities, lectures, workshops and presentations. Our special collections serve as authentic material for cultural education. Museon maintains an interdisciplinary approach when it comes to developing new educational products, encouraging interaction and active discovery. It dedicates structural attention to new educational forms, in which new media have a key role. Also, Museon provides a platform for social organisations, companies and ministries seeking to spotlight socially relevant and current themes.

Museon in the Hague is an educational museum for science and culture. Our main audience consists of families with children and students/schoolchildren of all ages. We have temporary exhibition spaces were we show interactive exhibitions. The action oriented permanent exhibition, One Planet, is about the 17 SDG’s (Sustainable Development Goals) of the UN (1200 m2). Our Climate Studio, open to the public at large but with a specific school-programme about Climate change, is 100m2

Museon is an active member of the VSC (Dutch association of Science Centres) and ECSITE (The European equivalent) and participates in numerous international projects.


We have around 200.000 visitors per year and some 40.000 schoolchildren/students.

entityDescription: The Institute of Electronics at the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences was established in 1963 as a non-profit state organization conducting research, education and dissemination of scientific knowledge in es. Soon, the Institute of Electronics evolved as a leading scientific institution in these areas of applied physics and engineethe fields of Physical Electronics, Photonics and Quantum Electronics and Radio Sciencring within the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences and in Bulgaria.Through the years, the Institute's research field and structure have developed dynamically in response to the changes taking place in the main trends in applied physics and technologies: materials science and technologies, physics of nano-sized objects and nanotechnologies, nanoelectronics, photonics, opto-electronics, quantum optics, environmental physics and monitoring, biomedical photonics and biomedical applications. A part of the research efforts are directed to clarifying the processes of interaction of optical and microwave electromagnetic radiation with the Earth's atmosphere and surface; developing experimental systems for laser remote sensing and monitoring of the atmosphere, including ground-based lidar measurements for validation of satellite lidar data for atmospheric aerosol content vertical profiling; developing algorithms and techniques for signals and information processing; constructing units and systems for lidar/radar and communication applications; studying non-linear processes in optical communication media. At present, the Institute of Electronics is an internationally recognized scientific institution conducting research in a range of modern fields in physics and technologies.

entityDescription:
Purpose of the company 
1. The purpose if the company is the advancement of science and research of in the field if sustainable forestry, that is both intergeneratively and intrageneretively resilient and ecologically, economically, politically and socially sustainable forestry, to facilitate and promote multi-sector, multi –disciplined development and collaboration and the advancement of development cooperation.
2. The purpose is realized in particular by:
a) facilitating and undertaking collaborative strategic and applied research and related activities in forest landscapes and forestry
b) Advancement of forestry science and by informing forest policy and management that contribute to sustainable development and human well-being 
c) promoting the transfer of appropriate new technologies and technologies for achieving forest and timber sustainability for the sustainable well –being of people globally and especially in the tropical and low income countries 
d) introduction of new methods of social organization and governance for national development.
e)securing and improving the livelihood of populations dependent on the forests, raising the importance of forest in the global development agenda , in doing so the forest is recognized as an outstanding ecosystem , which may be more or less unstable depending on the vegetation zone
f) protection of the remaining rain forests, through their sustainable management and conservation
g) undertake capacity building and communication, outreach and engagement as an integral part of the research agenda to accelerate uptake and action to contribute to the sustainable development agenda 

3 “Forestry” means the science, the art and the practice of managing and using for human benefit the natural resources that occur on and in association with lands bearing forest or with a forest professions. A “forest system” is a functional complex of forest and its biophysical, social, cultural, economic and political environment

entityDescription:
HSH Informatica e Cultura S.r.l. was founded in 1985 in Matera, Italy. It operates in the advanced tertiary sector as a technical service provider in the engineering sector, HSH supplies its services in the areas of Earth observation, geospatial analysis, computational resources and data intensive computation, mainly to Public Administation bodies and large Engineering Companies. In 2000 HSH spun out its activities related to the processing of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) to a new company called Innova Consorzio per l'Informatica e la Telematica srl, keeping in house all activities related to the management of research projects and support activities to the Cosmo-Sky-Med program and other projects of the Italian Space Agency such ROSA (Radio Occultation Sounder for Atmosphere) and Cosmo SkyMed.
HSH has been involved in the management of many industrial and scientific research projects funded by the Italian Ministries of Economic Development (MISE) and of Education, Universities and Research (MIUR) and TeRN (Technologies for Earth Observation and Natural Risks) Consortium. HSH is currently involved in the 5G experimentation activities in Italy.

AVIASPACE BREMEN is an association of dedicated companies and application-oriented research institutes in and around the federal state of Bremen. This network implements the federal state of Bremen’s strategy for the aeronautics and space industries.The association’s objective is to improve cooperation and develop innovative projects in and around the federal state of Bremen as a business and science center. Its scope covers the aeronautics and space industries and other technologies related to this area whose members have specific competences. entityDescription: BAB is the regional development bank and financial services provider of the federal state of Bremen. It supports the state of Bremen in its implementation of its state development, structure, economic and housing policies. BAB supports companies in every phase of development, especially small and medium-sized companies, both with financial and business support programmes. However, with the ongoing interest in start-ups and creating new companies, BAB established “STARTHAUS Bremen” on behalf of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Labour and Ports in Bremen (SWAH). STARTHAUS Bremen is a multifunctional one-stop-agency supporting all aspects of business formation by involving a range of diverse partners and programmes: support whilst setting up a company, business plan consulting, coaching, finance facilities as well as co-working space and special networking events. Since 2003 BAB has been supporting more than 130 start-ups with its BRUT programme, which offers financial and business support in a modular way. The new integrated STARTHAUS concept offers start-ups bespoke training and development measures and complements their journey via a mentoring system. Coaching and qualification offers are supplemented by financing options – from grants to loans and venture capital. BAB also provides close contacts to regional Business Angel networks and to business experts to assist companies and start-ups with their know-how and practical advice.

entityDescription:
Global Geo-Intelligence Solutions (GGIS) is a geospatial data analytics company. It was founded in January 2016. We utilise data from earth observation satellites, global navigation satellite systems and other data sources to provide decision support intelligence to end users. We provide geospatial intelligence and engineering solutions for resource and infrastructure monitoring and management through the use of statistical analysis, machine learning and data mining techniques. We have a strong desire to see technology used to assist communities around the world to not be victims of environmental related events and circumstance but rather to be able to rise above it and thrive. Between Nov 2017 to September 2018 GGIS conducted a feasibility study for the Caribbean Agricultural Research and Development Institute (CARDI) on the use of satellite data to assess the impact of the 2017 hurricane season on the agriculture sector of three countries in the region which were affected. These were Dominica, Antigua & Barbuda and St Kitts & Nevis. The feasibility study also included capacity building workshops on the use of satellite earth observation and GNSS in agriculture.
In May 2021 GGIS (along with partners in the university and rescue sector) successfully received funding from the Templeton Foundation to investigate the impacting of intersecting crises such as natural disasters and socio-economic issues on human trafficking/forced or illegal labour in the Bahamas.
In September 2020 we were selected as a member of one of the 15 consortiums to take part in the H2020 PARSEC Accelerator. Through this one year program we have developed and since launched our Foresight Carbon Service which uses satellite earth observation data, GNSS and machine learning to measure and monitor carbon sequestration in forests.
Our team of 3-4 people bring in several years of experience in geospatial data analysis, satellite surveying and mapping, remote sensing (radar and optical multi-spectral), machine learning, programming and cloud computing amongst others.

entityDescription:
HPP International is an affiliated company of HPP Architekten GmbH, one of Germany’s most successful architectural partnerships. 
As a result of the internationalization of markets, working on projects and receiving commissions outside of Germany has become as usual as collaborating with other specialists across national borders. HPP International Planungsgesellschaft mbH was founded in 1977 and carries out architectural and master planning projects both abroad and for foreign clients. We have amassed skills, contacts and experience in over 40 years of working internationally. Our current focus is in the burgeoning regions of South-East Europe and Asia. 
HPP International is a wholly-owned subsidiary of HPP Architekten GmbH and is responsible for the management of international plannings and is also involved in project development and project management. We assist our partners in identifying sites, in the conceptual phase and in the procurement of planning permission and thereby benefit from the country-specific knowledge and experience of our employees from 13 different nations. 
The head office of HPP Architekten GmbH is based in Düsseldorf’s Media Harbor. Further HPP offices are located in Amsterdam, Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Leipzig, Munich, Stuttgart, Istanbul, Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen. HPP International's offices are located in Düsseldorf and Berlin. Through this network we are able to benefit from local knowledge, ease of availability and good relationships to the most important local contacts. 
Among the well-known international projects are the Expo Village and the Henkel Asia-Pacific and China Headquarter in Shanghai, the AND Tower in Istanbul, the Baltic Arena in Gdansk, the Standard Bank Centre in Johannesburg, the Swan Office in Bucharest as well as the German Embassy in Washington. Under construction are currently the Multifunctional Arena in Ekaterinburg, the Alibaba Campus in Hangzhou, the Pudong Soccer Arena in Shanghai and the Taicang Campus of the Jiaotong-Liverpool University in Xi'an. Recently completed are the Yotrio Tower in Ningbo, the North Station Huide Tower in Shenzhen and the residential and mixed-use complex AND Pastel in Istanbul.

entityDescription: “Trakti is the first negotiation & contract management platform integrated in the blockchain automating the entire lifecycle of commercial contracts!” Trakti provides a simple and innovative way to manage in an end to end fashion sourcing and procurement contract negotiations, signatures and delivery management. entityDescription: The Department of Environmental research focuses on challenge-oriented approach and solutions that bring together natural sciences, which underpin the understanding, development and application of technologies to deliver a sustainable future. The main focus is directed to the research of chemical compositions of non-refractory submicron aerosol particles using mass-spectrometry methods, the processes that control aerosol formation and evolution, as well as impacts of the changing atmospheric composition on air quality, human health, climate change and ecosystems. The department of Environmental Research is also involved in creating and developing methods, experimental means and technologies for monitoring changes of climate and ecosystems as well as for creating safer and healthy environment. The Department is actively engaged in a wide range of topics covering the role and importance of aerosol science across a wide range of applied fields. By conducting fundamental and applied research, we work on long-term solutions for major challenges facing science, society and industry. The research studies aims to explore the developments in experimental techniques for aerosol studies with the ultimate goal of promoting development towards modern environmental-friendly technologies suitable in the vicinity of nuclear facilities and environmental science technologies based on radionuclide methods.

entityName: Forest and Land Owners Association of Lithuania
entityDescription: FOREST AND LAND OWNERS ASSOCIATION OF LITHUANIA (FLOAL): was established in 1993 (reestablished in 1996), as demand for knowledge in forestry was increasing and a growing community of forest owners with increasingly common purposes emerged. The creation of a strong and independent private forestry movement in Lithuania, based on shared values, has been a major goal of FOAL since its creation FOAL represents the interests of family forest owners at the national and international levels, and after more than 25 years of activity has grown into a social organization, uniting over 6500 members. Our website: www.forest.lt . FLOAL represents the interests of family forest owners at the national and international levels, and after more than 20 years of activity has grown into a social organization, uniting over 6500 members. Accepted as a member of the Confederation of European Forester Owners (CEPF), European Landowners Organization (ELO), International Family Forestry Alliance (IFFA), and supported by Danish, Swedish and other organizations, FOAL unifies private forest owners. As a member of the Chamber of Agriculture of The Republic of Lithuania, the Lithuanian Association of Impartial Timber Measuring Professionals, and a participant in the round-table of Forest Owners’ Associations‘ of the Baltic Sea Countries, FOAL is well placed in the forestry sector. A partnership with the Lithuanian Agriculture Advisory Service, Lithuanian Biomass Energy Association „Litbioma“, The Lithuanian District Heating Association is currently being developed and a cooperation agreement with the Association of Wood Working Industries „Lietuvos mediena” is in effect.

This solution has been developed in close cooperation with out pilot customer within the aerospace industry, where this problem is especially prevalent since accuracy and precision are of utmost importance. 
E.R.T.1. ensures integrity and transparency by tracing components country of origin and their adherance to regulations, i.e. REACH and RoHS. The solution is a new way of combining database and blockchain that effectively and securely tracks transactions between companies. This creates a secure image of the supply chain which raises effectivity in quality- and supplier assurance, and automises CoC.

Among the Prassel flag-ship products: ViMS, software platform made by complementary and specialized modules for the technological integration of the situation room and for the centralized management of the fixed and mobile video surveillance.

The Prassel development and organization mode is based on a solid experience in the Safety & Security Market, enriched by an Agile methodology, useful to ensure flexibility and high quality in the products and services provided. Prassel has a solid position in the Italian and international market and its main customers are: System integrator, Public Adminsitration both at a central and at a local level.

entityDescription: In Quattro Srl is a technological startup and a spinoff of ENEA created by four researchers and techician. In Quattro has developed a two-phase advanced thermal management system for high power electronics (high performance PC, gaming PC, workstation, server, datacentre). The innovative feature of this system is the use of flow boiling heat transfer for cooling electronic devices. Compared to traditional cooling systems (liquid cooling, heat pipes), significantly higher heat transfer coefficients can be achieved at significantly low flow rates and pumping power. The technology has been developed by the researchers of ENEA as a result of 20 years expertise in studying and developing two-phase flow systems for electronics cooling for space and terrestrial applications.

entityDescription:
A-techSYN Ltd. is a company from Shannon, Ireland, which has been intensely occupied with the development of Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and the associated flight control and communication systems. The company owns the self-produced IP for Flight Control Software (from scratch Without any open source) and Hardware, GCS Software, a 50 kg and 60 kg MTOW UAV, a high-speed Target Drone, Datalink Modems and many others. 

With over 5 years of experience in designing, developing, producing and flying UAVs, A-techSYN team has become a one-stop company for overcoming challenging problems and delivering user friendly and field-proven applications or transforming manned applications to unmanned. 

The business idea is built on the IP of Autopilot Hardware and Software, the IP of Ground Control Station Software and several smaller IP modules (Tracking Antenna, Pitot Tubes, Landing Gears, Retraction Mechanisms etc.), which belong to the Company. 

The company packs the complete know-how on the process of UAS or sub-system development and application starting from requirement analysis, design, component and electronics definition, production, implementation, integration and testing to application development and actual test and performance flights of UAS and its sub-systems in one place. 

A-techSYN manufacturer of fixed-wing UAVs, target-acquisition drones, autopilot, communications systems and Ground Control Software. 
 
Products: • CGT45 UAV ( VTOL, 50kg MTOW, 6 hour endurance, 4kg payload) • CGT60 UAV ( VTOL, 60kg MTOW, 6 hour endurance, 10kg payload) • CNG-V UAV (Catapult launch, Parachute landing, 21kg MTOW, 120 Knots speed) • AvionicsMini Flight Controller Hardware and Software (Double redundant, Plug’n Fly) • Ground Control Station Software • Tracking Antenna (IP, 20-80-120km range) • RTK Base and Hover Modems • Datalink Modems www.a-techsyn.com

entityDescription:
The Company EXAGONE is in charge of the exploitation and commercialization of TERIA services, which is detailed below.
TERIA is a precision satellite geolocation service. GNSS positioning provides the opportunity to position oneself with metric accuracy at the global level.
Our service corrects these signals to allow the GNSS receiver to deliver centimetric precision positioning in a few seconds using RTK and N-RTK techniques. To achieve this, we rely on standards such as the NTRIP protocol for data exchange and the RTCM format for the dissemination of corrections.
Corrections are available via the Internet. Our processing servers are in the Cloud to provide you with a 24/7 service.
